# Fase 7a — Pasien, Walk-in, Pendaftaran, dan Antrean: Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Petugas Pendaftaran dapat mengelola data pasien, mendaftarkan pasien walk-in di loket, memproses antrean dan status kunjungan harian, serta menandai pasien yang tidak hadir. Semuanya memakai mesin booking dan status fase 6. Cakupannya:
- halaman #37 Pasien (daftar, detail, tambah walk-in, ubah, aktif/nonaktif, hubungkan ke akun online);
- halaman #38 Pendaftaran (daftar, detail, transisi status, bukti cetak admin, form walk-in W-20) dan Antrean Hari Ini (W-19, Tandai tidak hadir massal);
- `AppointmentStatusService` (evaluator transisi tunggal, `transitionChecks()`, `markNoShowFor*`), perintah `appointments:mark-no-show` terjadwal 23.30, `PatientRegistrationService::createWalkIn/changeStatus`, `PatientSearch`, `PatientAccountLinker`, Policy 7a;
- bawaan fase 6: sanitasi log `QueryException`, retry `DoctorService`, tes konkurensi 7a;
- `AppointmentSeeder` (29 pendaftaran, 6 profil walk-in) dan `scripts/sql/seed-invariants.sql`.

**Architecture:** Arsitektur fase 1–6 tetap berlaku: monolit Laravel 12, controller tipis, Form Request, Policy, pelaku `Actor`, dan `AuditLogger` eksplisit.
- **Satu jalur tulis per konsep.** Pendaftaran (online maupun loket) hanya lewat `BookingService::book()`. Perubahan status hanya lewat `AppointmentStatusService::transition()`. Tombol UI dihitung oleh evaluator yang sama dengan `transition()` (`transitionChecks()`), sehingga tombol yang tampil selalu diterima server.
- **Aksi massal per appointment.** Tandai tidak hadir memanggil `transition()` satu per satu tanpa transaksi luar; appointment yang sudah berubah dilewati; `SYSTEM_BUSY` menghentikan proses dan aman diulang.
- **Layar tanpa JavaScript baru.** Form walk-in dan antrean berupa GET bertahap dengan query; aksi berupa form POST kecil dan `x-confirm-modal`. Galat domain di route admin dipetakan `BookingRedirect` ke halaman asal yang aman (`AdminReturn`).
- **Data sensitif K-04 (a).** Nomor BPJS, polis, dan referensi pembayaran selalu tersamar 4 digit terakhir di admin, tidak pernah di-flash, diaudit, atau dicatat di log (log `QueryException` tanpa bindings).
- **Tanpa migration, enum, izin, paket, entri Vite, atau JS baru.**

**Tech Stack:** sama dengan fase 6: PHP 8.2.12 (XAMPP `C:\xampp3`), Laravel 12.69, MariaDB 10.4.32, Spatie Permission, Bootstrap 5.3 + Vite 7, `barryvdh/laravel-dompdf`, `chillerlan/php-qrcode`, PHPUnit 11, Symfony Process untuk uji proses paralel.

**Spec:** dokumen desain `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-09-fase-7a-desain.md` (disetujui pemilik 2026-10-09) dan blueprint `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-unpam-hospital-blueprint/`. **Verifikasi rencana (uji coba integrasi, 2026-10-09 dan 2026-10-10):** ketiga belas tugas dijalankan persis seperti implementer pada salinan repo dari `master` `57fa3fe`. Blok kode disalin otomatis dari teks tugas, dan setiap pasangan ganti-persis terbukti cocok tepat satu kali. Setiap langkah RED dan GREEN diperiksa terhadap "Expected". Suite penuh pada salinan menghasilkan 7638 lulus dan 2 dilewati (keduanya sudah ada sebelum 7a), dalam ±25 menit. Route sesudah 7a: 166 total, 122 admin, 13 pasien. Semua temuan uji coba (Blocker, Important, dan angka Expected) sudah diterapkan ke teks tugas di bawah ini, sehingga angka tes dan durasi di "Expected" adalah angka terukur, bukan perkiraan, kecuali yang ditandai "±".

## Global Constraints

Berlaku untuk setiap tugas (rujukan "kerangka A").

- **XAMPP/Prelude P.** `C:\xampp3` (PHP 8.2.12). Apache dari Control Panel; **MySQL dengan `scripts\mysql-start.ps1`** (bukan Control Panel). Setiap blok PowerShell diawali: `$XAMPP = "C:\xampp3"; $PHP = "$XAMPP\php\php.exe"; $COMPOSER = "C:\composer\composer.phar"; $APP = "D:\Project Web RS"; $env:Path = "$XAMPP\php;$env:Path"; Set-Location $APP`
- **Paket.** Tidak ada paket Composer/npm baru.
- **Suite penuh** ±6700 tes, ±24–42 menit: implementer menjalankan tes terfilter per tugas; regresi besar di latar belakang ke `storage\logs\*.txt`. Basis `master` `57fa3fe`: **6692 tes lulus + 1 dilewati; 150 route (`route:list --except-vendor`), 106 admin, 13 di `/pasien`.** Jangan menjalankan dua proses PHPUnit bersamaan (DB uji bersama `unpam_hospital_test`).
- **PHP 8.2–8.4.** Tanpa typed class constants, `#[\Override]`, `json_validate()`, property hooks, `new` tanpa kurung pada chaining. `readonly` boleh. Berkas baru di `app/Services`, `app/Support`, `app/Rules`, `app/Policies`, `app/Exceptions`, `app/View/Components`, `app/Console/Commands` diawali `declare(strict_types=1);`.
- **Nama.** Persis kerangka ini. Enum TIDAK ditambah/diubah (`EnumCatalogTest`). Izin TIDAK ditambah (19). **Tidak ada migration baru**; migration lama tidak diubah.
- **Bahasa.** Identifier Inggris; teks UI/pesan/flash/komentar/deskripsi audit Indonesia; flash = kalimat lengkap bertitik.
- **Waktu.** `Asia/Jakarta`; "sekarang" dari `now()`/`CarbonImmutable::now()`, tidak pernah `NOW()` SQL; tes memakai `$this->travelTo(...)`. Akhir sesi = `session_date` + `end_time`. "Sudah berakhir" untuk no-show = `now > ends_at` (strik; JANGAN `PracticeSession::isEnded()`/`scopeNotEnded()` yang `<=`).
- **Mode ketat Eloquent.** Kolom non-fillable lewat `forceFill()`; daftar/halaman WAJIB eager-load relasi yang dirender (`clinic`, `doctor`, `practiceSession`, `patientProfile`, `statusHistories`, `insurancePartner`, `user`). `queue_label` butuh `clinic`.
- **Konkurensi.** Urutan kunci baku `patient_profiles` → `practice_sessions` → `appointments` lewat PK. Satu-satunya jalur tulis status = `AppointmentStatusService::transition()`; pendaftaran = `BookingService::book()`. Tes yang membuktikan retry/`SYSTEM_BUSY`/balapan memakai `Tests\Support\Concurrency\ConcurrencyTestCase` (bukan `RefreshDatabase` biasa).
- **Otorisasi.** Service TIDAK memeriksa izin Spatie (D-158). Setiap route admin 7a: middleware `permission:*` (C.1) + `$this->authorize(...)` di controller/Form Request `authorize()`. `Gate::before` meloloskan Super Admin, jadi aturan seperti "hanya profil tanpa akun" ditegakkan juga di service/view, bukan hanya Policy.
- **Output HTML.** `{!! !!}` tetap hanya lima baris rich text (`RawOutputScanTest`); QR selalu `<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,…">`. Tanpa atribut event inline, skrip inline, CDN. CSP tidak diubah. **Tidak ada entri Vite baru dan tidak ada JS baru**; layar 7a memakai komponen dan JS admin yang ada (`x-confirm-modal`, `x-loading-button`, `[data-payment-toggle]`).
- **Data sensitif (K-04 (a)).** `bpjs_number`, `policy_number`, `payment_reference` tidak pernah di-flash ke old input (`$request->except(App\Support\SensitiveInput::FIELDS)`), tidak pernah dirender lengkap di admin (tampilan `•••••••••` + 4 digit: `$profile->masked_bpjs`, `$appointment->masked_payment_reference`), tidak masuk flash, audit, notifikasi, atau log. `complaint` tidak masuk audit/notifikasi. Nama pasien selalu `{{ }}` (SEK-15).
- **Input larik/liar** di query atau form mana pun tidak pernah 500 dan tidak pernah membuka redirect ke luar (aturan proyek).
- **Penulisan berkas.** Write/Edit; LF; UTF-8 tanpa BOM; jangan menyalin pagar Markdown ke kode; `.env*` tidak di-commit. Python/heredoc rapuh: tulis berkas dengan Write.
- **Cabang/commit.** `fase-7a-pasien-pendaftaran-antrean` (dari `master` `57fa3fe`). Pesan `tipe(fase-7a): ringkasan` + baris `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>` (subagen boleh atribusi harness). Tiap commit: tes terkait hijau, `pint --test` bersih.
- **TDD.** RED nyata dicatat sebelum implementasi (tes gagal dengan alasan yang benar).
- **MANUAL (koordinator) dan DB pengembangan.** Implementer tidak menjalankan `migrate*`/`db:seed`/`sessions:generate` pada `unpam_hospital`; langkah MANUAL milik koordinator di T13.

## Review Focus

Setiap butir punya tes di tugas pemiliknya (ditunjuk dengan →). Rujukan "kerangka E".

1. **Tombol vs aturan server.** Tombol yang tampil selalu diterima server dan sebaliknya: check-in tepat `start − checkin_open` (diterima) vs satu menit sebelumnya (tombol `aria-disabled` "Dibuka HH.MM"); check-in tepat `end` diterima, `end + 1 menit` tidak ada tombol; koreksi hanya hari yang sama; pending boleh langsung check-in; status final tanpa tombol; `no_show` tidak pernah tombol per baris. → T1, T8, T10.
2. **Dua petugas/aksi ganda.** Halaman basi dengan `expected_status` lama → flash `STALE_STATUS` tanpa tulis; klik ganda Simpan walk-in → satu appointment + pesan sedang diproses; Tandai tidak hadir dua kali → total tepat N; hubungkan akun dua kali → satu. → T8, T9, T10, T11.
3. **Input admin dirusak.** Query larik/liar (`pasien[]=1`, `sesi=abc`, `tanggal=2099-13-40`, `dari>sampai`, `kode=<script>`, `status=xyz`), field tersembunyi diubah (`to=no_show`, `to=pending`, `expected_status=xyz`, `practice_session_id` sesi lain/penuh/berakhir, `patient_profile_id` nonaktif), `kembali=//evil.test`/`https://…`/`/pasien` → galat Indonesia atau diabaikan; tidak pernah 500, tidak pernah redirect ke luar atau ke luar area yang diizinkan. → T5, T6, T8, T9, T10.
4. **Data sensitif dan escape.** Nomor BPJS/polis lengkap tidak ada di HTML admin, flash, audit, log; nama pasien/keluhan `<script>` ter-escape di semua daftar, detail, antrean, bukti; log `QueryException` tanpa bindings (keluhan/BPJS uji tidak muncul). → T4, T5, T8, T10, T13.
5. **Batas waktu dan status sesi.** Tandai tidak hadir tepat `end_time` ditolak `SESSION_NOT_ENDED`, `end + 1 detik` diterima; sesi `needs_review` ditolak dan dilewati perintah; walk-in tepat `end_time` ditolak (`CUTOFF_PASSED_COUNTER`), `end − 1 menit` diterima; `--date` masa depan/format salah; profil nonaktif tidak dapat didaftarkan. → T2, T9, T10.

## Keputusan (rulings) fase 7a

Keputusan ini mengikat semua tugas (rujukan "kerangka B" atau "F7A-Rn"). Butir yang menyimpang dari blueprint direkonsiliasi ke dokumen di Task 13 (D-168 dan seterusnya).

- **F7A-R1 Cakupan.** DES §3.1. Di luar: 7b (Sesi Terdampak, `resolve`, `cancelAllForSession`, `schedule_changed_at`, `AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification`, pemberitahuan lintas peran, K-15, bawaan fase 3), fase 8 (ekspor CSV), antrean notifikasi Laravel (notifikasi tetap sinkron sesudah commit, D-149; dicatat sebagai keterbatasan).
- **F7A-R2 Skema/infra.** Tanpa migration, enum, izin, paket, entri Vite, atau JS baru. Satu berkas lang baru: `lang/id/patients.php` (T3). Satu berkas SQL baru: `scripts/sql/seed-invariants.sql` (T12).
- **F7A-R3 Route (16)** persis C.1 di `routes/admin.php` di dalam grup G-ADMIN, sesudah blok pesan kontak dan sebelum media. Pasien memakai `Route::resource('pasien', …)->parameters(['pasien' => 'patient'])` (pola dokter: grup `patients.manage` didaftarkan DAHULU, lalu `patients.view`). Pendaftaran dan antrean memakai route eksplisit (bukan `resource`). `{patient}` dan `{session}` tetap numerik (pola grup). `{appointment}` admin = **`{appointment:booking_code}`** dengan `->where('appointment', 'UPH-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}')`, dan `'appointment'` DIHAPUS dari daftar `array_fill_keys` numerik di `bootstrap/app.php` (T8). Binding implisit lewat nama variabel controller (`PatientProfile $patient`, `PracticeSession $session`, `Appointment $appointment`).
- **F7A-R4 Tes kunci route lama.** Tugas pertama yang menambah route (T5) menghapus asersi angka global dari `Phase4bRoutePermissionTest` (106 admin), `Phase5RoutePermissionTest` (106 admin), `Phase6RoutePermissionTest` (106 admin, 150 total) dan menghapus `Phase6RoutePermissionTest::test_phase_7_admin_routes_do_not_exist_yet`; docblok kelasnya diperbarui ("angka global dikunci `Phase7aRoutePermissionTest`"). Asersi spesifik fase lama tetap. `PatientPageMatrixTest` AKS-06 dipecah oleh T5: `/admin/pasien` → 403 untuk pasien; `/admin/pengaturan` tetap 404 (fase 8). T13 membuat `Phase7aRoutePermissionTest` (16 route, total 166, admin 122, 13 `/pasien`, middleware persis).
- **F7A-R5 Evaluator transisi (T1).** Pemeriksaan di `authorize()` dan `assertWindow()` dipindah ke satu evaluator privat yang mengembalikan penolakan (kode, kunci pesan, `replace`) atau `null`, TANPA mengubah urutan pemeriksaan, kode, pesan, atau perilaku `transition()` (matriks 108 kasus `AppointmentStatusServiceTest` harus tetap hijau tanpa diubah). `transition()` juga menangkap `Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException` (selain `QueryException`) dengan perlakuan yang sama (`SYSTEM_BUSY` bila konkurensi). Publik baru: konstanta `INDIVIDUAL_TARGETS`, `transitionChecks()`, `availableTransitions()` (D). Pemeriksaan tombol mengabaikan `expected` dan alasan (alasan dikumpulkan form; server tetap memeriksa). `transitionChecks()` tanpa kunci (SELECT biasa).
- **F7A-R6 Tandai tidak hadir (T2).** Persis DES §4.1 dan D:
  - `markNoShowForSession`: bila sesi `needs_review` → `InvalidTransitionException::makeVariant(INVALID_TRANSITION, 'SESSION_UNDER_REVIEW', [], ['practice_session_id' => id])`; bila `now <= ends_at` → `InvalidTransitionException::make(SESSION_NOT_ENDED, ['time' => ends_at->format('H.i')], ['practice_session_id' => id])`. Lalu ambil appointment `pending|confirmed` sesi itu (model utuh, urut `queue_number`, `id`) dan panggil `transition($a, NoShow, $actor, $reason)` **tanpa `expected`**, satu per satu, **tanpa transaksi luar**. `catch (InvalidTransitionException)` → lewati (tidak dihitung); `BookingException` lain (mis. `SYSTEM_BUSY`) → diteruskan. Mengembalikan jumlah yang ditandai.
  - `markNoShowForDate`: iterasi `sessionsAwaitingNoShow($date)` → `markNoShowForSession`; mengembalikan total.
  - `sessionsAwaitingNoShow`: sesi berstatus `open|closed`, `now > ends_at` (kueri: `session_date < hari ini` ATAU (`session_date = hari ini` DAN `end_time < jam sekarang H:i:s`)), punya appointment `pending|confirmed`; opsional dibatasi satu tanggal; urut `session_date`, `start_time`, `id`; eager `clinic`, `doctor`.
  - Sesi `needs_review` tidak pernah diproses perintah (dilewati) dan ditolak untuk aksi petugas (pesan D-95).
- **F7A-R7 Perintah `appointments:mark-no-show {--date=}` (T2).** `App\Console\Commands\MarkNoShowAppointments` (pola `GenerateSessions`), aktor `Actor::system()`. Teks VERBATIM:
  - format salah: `Opsi --date harus berupa tanggal dengan format YYYY-MM-DD.` (exit 1);
  - tanggal sesudah hari ini: `Opsi --date tidak boleh tanggal setelah hari ini.` (exit 1);
  - tanpa sesi: `Tidak ada pendaftaran yang perlu ditandai tidak hadir.` (exit 0);
  - per sesi: `- {d/m/Y} {time_range} {clinic.name}, {doctor.name}: {n} pendaftaran.`;
  - ringkasan: `{N} pendaftaran pada {M} sesi ditandai tidak hadir.` (M = jumlah sesi yang diproses; exit 0);
  - `SYSTEM_BUSY`: `Sistem sedang sibuk; {N} pendaftaran sudah ditandai sebelum berhenti. Jalankan ulang perintah ini.` (exit 1).
  - Jadwal di `routes/console.php`: `Schedule::command('appointments:mark-no-show')->dailyAt('23:30')->withoutOverlapping();` (tes: ekspresi `'30 23 * * *'`).
- **F7A-R8 Profil walk-in (T3).** `createWalkIn(array $validated, User $staff)`: satu transaksi; `PatientProfile` dengan `full_name, birth_date, gender, phone (IndonesianPhone::normalize), email (lowercase, boleh null), address`, `registration_channel = loket`, `is_active = true`, `consent_at = now()`, `consent_version = settings('privacy.consent_version','1.0')`; `forceFill(['user_id' => null, 'created_by_user_id' => $staff->id])`; nomor pasien `PatientNumberGenerator::format(id)` sesudah insert (D-145); audit `patient.created` `null` → `{"patient_number","registration_channel":"loket","consent_version"}`, deskripsi `Profil pasien {nomor} dibuat oleh petugas (walk-in).`, aktor `Actor::staff($staff)`. **Nomor BPJS tidak diisi di form profil admin** (V-13, 11 `StorePatientRequest`; menyimpang dari W-20); BPJS profil hanya tersimpan lewat booking (`save_bpjs`) atau oleh pasien sendiri.
- **F7A-R9 Ubah profil oleh petugas (T6).** Lewat `PatientRegistrationService::updateProfile()` yang ada. `UpdatePatientRequest`: profil tanpa akun → `email` `nullable email:rfc max:255`; profil berakun → field `email` TIDAK divalidasi dan dibuang dari data (email ditampilkan hanya-baca; menyimpang dari V-13 yang membolehkan ubah, dicatat D-168+). Tanpa BPJS dan tanpa `remove_bpjs`.
- **F7A-R10 Status pasien (T3/T6).** `changeStatus(PatientProfile $profile, bool $active, Actor $actor, ?string $reason = null)`: transaksi; kunci profil (`lockForUpdate`) lalu hitung appointment berstatus `AppointmentStatus::ACTIVE` di bawah kunci; menonaktifkan dengan N > 0 → `ValidationException::withMessages(['is_active' => "Pasien masih memiliki {N} pendaftaran aktif. Batalkan atau selesaikan terlebih dahulu."])`; status sama → tanpa tulis dan tanpa audit; profil berakun: `users.is_active` ikut, dan bila dinonaktifkan `DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', id)->delete()`; audit `patient.status_changed` `{"is_active":lama}` → `{"is_active":baru}` + `reason` bila ada, deskripsi `Profil pasien {nomor} dinonaktifkan.` / `Profil pasien {nomor} diaktifkan kembali.`
- **F7A-R11 Profil mirip (BR-102, T3/T6).** Diterapkan (BP V-13/06 §5; DES diam). `PatientSearch::similarTo()` (D). `StorePatientRequest::after()`: bila ada profil mirip dan `confirm_not_duplicate` tidak dicentang → galat `confirm_not_duplicate` `Terdapat profil yang mirip. Pilih profil yang sudah ada atau centang konfirmasi untuk tetap membuat profil baru.`; form ulang menampilkan daftar profil mirip (nama, nomor, tanggal lahir, telepon, tautan detail/pilih) dan kotak centang `confirm_not_duplicate` "Tetap buat profil baru".
- **F7A-R12 Hubungkan akun (T3/T7).** `PatientAccountLinker` (D) mengikuti 11 §6.8 dan 06 §16. Pesan VERBATIM (`lang/id/patients.php` `link.*`): `PROFILE_ALREADY_LINKED` "Profil ini sudah terhubung ke sebuah akun."; `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND` "Akun pasien dengan email tersebut tidak ditemukan."; `ACCOUNT_INACTIVE` "Akun pasien tidak aktif."; `ACCOUNT_HAS_HISTORY` "Akun ini sudah memiliki riwayat pendaftaran. Penggabungan dua profil berriwayat belum didukung."; kunci galat `account_email`. Akun bukan pasien = `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND`. Akun tanpa profil diizinkan. Audit `patient.account_linked` `{"removed_profile":{"id","patient_number","consent_at","consent_version"}}` (null bila tidak ada) → `{"profile_id","user_id"}`, deskripsi `Profil pasien {nomor} dihubungkan ke akun pasien.` (tanpa email/nama). UI dua langkah (DES §5.1): GET `admin.patients.show?hubungkan=<email>` → panel; panel perbandingan (nama, tanggal lahir, telepon kedua pihak) HANYA bila `problem()` null; bila tidak, hanya pesan penolakan, tanpa data akun. POST `link-account` dengan `account_email` + `identity_verified` (accepted, pesan "Anda harus menegaskan bahwa identitas pasien telah diverifikasi di loket."). Sukses: redirect `admin.patients.show` + flash `Profil pasien {nomor} berhasil dihubungkan ke akun {email}.` Profil walk-in NONAKTIF tidak dapat dihubungkan: tombol/panel diganti teks "Aktifkan profil terlebih dahulu untuk menghubungkannya ke akun online." dan POST ditolak `LinkPatientAccountRequest` (kunci `account_email`, "Profil pasien tidak aktif. Aktifkan profil terlebih dahulu.").
- **F7A-R13 Policy (T4).** D. `PatientProfilePolicy::linkAccount` mensyaratkan `user_id === null`, tetapi view memeriksa `$patient->user_id === null` juga (Super Admin lewat `Gate::before`) dan linker menolak.
- **F7A-R14 Form Request admin.** Nama dan aturan persis BP 11 §9.3 + 12 V-13…V-18 (digest-http §1.7/§12, digest-domain §2.5), kecuali yang diubah di sini. Nama field transisi **`expected_status`** (BP; DES menulis "expected"). Pesan Indonesia di `messages()`; atribut via `attributes()`. Normalisasi di `prepareForValidation()` (trim, email lowercase, telepon `IndonesianPhone::normalize`).

Gunakan aksi Tandai tidak hadir pada antrean sesi."), `reason` V-15, `expected_status` `required` enum, `kembali` opsional. Tes carry T6 fase 6 (`BookingParallelProcessesTest` arsip vs booking) diperbarui di T11: cabang `'deadlock'` tidak lagi sah; hasil sah = `archived` atau `rejected` (validasi, termasuk pesan sibuk).

## Keterbatasan yang diketahui

Butir berikut disengaja dan tidak dikerjakan di fase 7a:
- **Sesi Terdampak ditunda ke 7b.** Layar `admin.sessions.review`, resolusi `keep`/`apply`/`cancel`, `cancelAllForSession`, pengisian `schedule_changed_at`, `AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification`, pemberitahuan lintas peran, dan K-15 dikerjakan di 7b. Selama 7a, sesi `needs_review` ditolak oleh Tandai tidak hadir (pesan "Sesi ini sedang menunggu penyelesaian di layar Sesi terdampak.") dan dilewati perintah `appointments:mark-no-show`.
- **Ekspor CSV pendaftaran** (`admin.appointments.export`) menyusul di fase 8; tombol Ekspor tidak ditampilkan.
- **Notifikasi sinkron.** Notifikasi transisi staf dikirim sinkron sesudah commit (D-149), tanpa antrean Laravel.
- **Penggabungan dua profil berriwayat** tidak didukung (00 N). Menghubungkan akun ditolak bila profil milik akun sudah punya pendaftaran.
- **BPJS di form profil admin.** Form tambah/ubah profil oleh petugas tidak memuat nomor BPJS (V-13); nomor BPJS profil hanya tersimpan lewat pendaftaran walk-in ("Simpan nomor BPJS ke profil pasien") atau oleh pasien sendiri.
- **Email profil berakun hanya-baca** di layar admin (menyimpang dari V-13, dicatat di 17).
- **Bukti admin tanpa PDF.** Petugas mencetak halaman bukti; PDF tetap hanya untuk pasien.
- **Antrean tanpa pembaruan otomatis.** Petugas memakai tautan "Muat ulang".
- **Jumlah yang dilewati** saat Tandai tidak hadir tidak dilaporkan terpisah; flash hanya menyebut jumlah yang ditandai.
- **Kirim ganda walk-in** ditahan per petugas (`Cache::lock`), bukan lintas petugas; kuota tetap dijaga kunci sesi.
- **`kembali` pada galat walk-in.** Form walk-in yang dibuka dengan `?kembali=` kehilangan nilai itu sesudah galat validasi atau penolakan `book()`; tombol Batal lalu kembali ke daftar pendaftaran.
- **Peran kustom.** Pemegang `appointments.manage` tanpa `patients.view` tetap dapat mencari pasien di form walk-in.
- **Data demo bergantung hari seeding.** `AppointmentSeeder` yang dijalankan pada hari tanpa sesi hari ini (Minggu atau malam sesudah sesi terakhir) melewatkan pendaftaran hari ini dengan peringatan; angka acuan 13 §10.3 hanya dikunci tes di bawah jam Senin 07.00.

### C.1a — Bentuk AKHIR blok route 7a di `routes/admin.php` (titik sisip per tugas)

Blok ini disisipkan oleh T5 tepat SESUDAH blok kotak pesan kontak (`messages.*`) dan SEBELUM blok media, di dalam grup G-ADMIN. Indentasi mengikuti berkas. Tugas lain menyisipkan barisnya di posisi persis seperti di bawah (jangkar = baris yang dibuat tugas sebelumnya). Import controller ditambahkan oleh tugas yang pertama memakainya (T5 `PatientController`, T8 `AppointmentController` dengan alias bila perlu, T10 `QueueController`), urut abjad bersama `use` lain.

```php
        // Pasien (halaman #37, 11 §2.3 G). Kelola didaftarkan DAHULU agar /pasien/buat tidak tertangkap {patient}.
        Route::middleware('permission:patients.manage')->group(function (): void {          // T6 (seluruh grup ini)
            Route::resource('pasien', PatientController::class)
                ->names('patients')
                ->parameters(['pasien' => 'patient'])
                ->only(['create', 'store', 'edit', 'update']);
            Route::patch('pasien/{patient}/status', [PatientController::class, 'status'])->name('patients.status');
            Route::post('pasien/{patient}/hubungkan-akun', [PatientController::class, 'linkAccount'])->name('patients.link-account');   // T7
        });
        Route::middleware('permission:patients.view')->group(function (): void {             // T5
            Route::resource('pasien', PatientController::class)
                ->names('patients')
                ->parameters(['pasien' => 'patient'])
                ->only(['index', 'show']);
        });

        // Pendaftaran dan antrean (halaman #38, 11 §2.3 H). {appointment} memakai booking_code (F7A-R3).
        Route::middleware('permission:appointments.manage')->group(function (): void {      // T8 (grup + transition)
            Route::get('pendaftaran/buat', [AppointmentController::class, 'create'])->name('appointments.create');              // T9
            Route::post('pendaftaran', [AppointmentController::class, 'store'])->name('appointments.store');                    // T9
            Route::post('pendaftaran/{appointment:booking_code}/status', [AppointmentController::class, 'transition'])
                ->where('appointment', 'UPH-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}')
                ->name('appointments.transition');
            Route::post('antrean/{session}/tidak-hadir', [QueueController::class, 'markNoShow'])->name('queue.mark-no-show');   // T10
        });
        Route::middleware('permission:appointments.view')->group(function (): void {        // T8 (grup + tiga route pertama)
            Route::get('pendaftaran', [AppointmentController::class, 'index'])->name('appointments.index');
            Route::get('pendaftaran/{appointment:booking_code}', [AppointmentController::class, 'show'])
                ->where('appointment', 'UPH-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}')
                ->name('appointments.show');
            Route::get('pendaftaran/{appointment:booking_code}/bukti', [AppointmentController::class, 'proof'])
                ->where('appointment', 'UPH-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}')
                ->name('appointments.proof');
            Route::get('antrean', [QueueController::class, 'index'])->name('queue.index');                                     // T10
        });
```

### Task 1: Evaluator transisi tunggal, `TransitionCheck`, `transitionChecks()`/`availableTransitions()`, dan tangkap `DeadlockException`

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Services/Booking/TransitionCheck.php`
- Modify (tulis ulang utuh): `app/Services/Booking/AppointmentStatusService.php`
- Test (baru): `tests/Unit/Services/Booking/TransitionCheckTest.php`
- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/Booking/AppointmentTransitionChecksTest.php`
- Tidak diubah (WAJIB tetap utuh, matriks 108 kasus harus hijau tanpa perubahan): `tests/Feature/Booking/AppointmentStatusServiceTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Concurrency/TransitionConcurrencyTest.php`, `lang/id/booking.php` (milik T2), `app/Exceptions/*`, migration, enum, izin.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (sudah ada, fase 6): `AppointmentStatusService::transition()`, `TRANSITIONS`, `RULES`, `InvalidTransitionException::{make, makeVariant, CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN, ...}`, `BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY`, `SanitizedBookingFault::capture()`, `PracticeSession::$starts_at/$ends_at`, `SettingsService::bookingRules()` dan `string('contact.phone')`, `App\Support\Actor`, `InteractsWithSchedules::createSession()/bookAppointment()`, `PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()`.
- Produces:
  - `final class App\Services\Booking\TransitionCheck` (konstruktor `(AppointmentStatus $to, ?string $errorCode = null, ?string $message = null, array $replace = [])`, `allowed()`, `opensAt()`).
  - `AppointmentStatusService::INDIVIDUAL_TARGETS`, `transitionChecks(Appointment, Actor, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): list<TransitionCheck>`, `availableTransitions(Appointment, Actor, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): list<AppointmentStatus>`.
  - Satu evaluator privat (`evaluate()` + `evaluateWindow()`) yang dipakai `transition()` DAN `transitionChecks()`; `transition()` juga menangkap `Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException`.
  - Perilaku `transition()` TIDAK berubah (urutan pemeriksaan, kode, pesan, konteks, urutan kunci).

**Test IDs:** BKG-12/BKG-14 sisi pemeriksaan tombol, Review Focus E1 (tombol vs aturan server), F7A-R5, KON-05 (sisi `DeadlockException`).

**Catatan teknis:**
1. **Urutan pemeriksaan dipertahankan persis.** Lama: `authorize()` (pemilik, expected, final, pelaku-ke-status, pasangan, pelaku-di-aturan, alasan) lalu `assertWindow()` (jendela). Baru: `evaluate()` menjalankan urutan yang sama lalu memanggil `evaluateWindow()`. Penolakan dikembalikan sebagai larik `['code', 'key', 'replace']` (bukan dilempar); `transition()` melemparnya lewat `InvalidTransitionException::makeVariant($code, $key, $replace, $context)`. `key` = kunci pesan di `booking.transitions.*` (sama dengan `code`, kecuali `INVALID_TRANSITION` + `CANCEL_CHECKED_IN` untuk BR-79). `makeVariant($c, $c, ...)` identik dengan `make($c, ...)`, sehingga kode, pesan, dan `context` tidak berubah.
2. **`expected` dan alasan diabaikan oleh tombol.** `evaluate(..., bool $enforceInput)`: `true` di `transition()` (di bawah kunci); `false` di `transitionChecks()`, sehingga langkah `STALE_STATUS` dan `REASON_REQUIRED` dilewati (modal alasan mengumpulkan alasan; server tetap memeriksa). Karena itu tes kesetaraan memanggil `transition()` DENGAN alasan sah dan TANPA `expected`.
3. **Tanpa kunci.** `transitionChecks()` memakai `loadMissing(['practiceSession', 'patientProfile'])` (SELECT biasa; aman untuk mode ketat) dan status instance pemanggil. Hanya `transition()` di bawah kunci yang menentukan.
4. **Kandidat** = `TRANSITIONS[from]` yang juga ada di `INDIVIDUAL_TARGETS`, urut `INDIVIDUAL_TARGETS` (`confirmed`, `checked_in`, `completed`, `cancelled`). `no_show` tidak pernah kandidat. Status final = `[]`. Kandidat yang ditolak tetap dikembalikan (dengan `errorCode`, `message`, `replace`) agar UI dapat menampilkan "Dibuka HH.MM" untuk `CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN`; `availableTransitions()` hanya yang `allowed()`.
5. **`DeadlockException`.** Di dalam transaksi pembungkus (level > 1, termasuk setiap tes `RefreshDatabase`) Laravel tidak mengulang dan melempar `Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException` (subkelas `PDOException`, bukan `QueryException`). `transition()` kini menangkap `QueryException|DeadlockException`; `DeadlockException` selalu dianggap galat konkurensi (pola `BookingService::isConcurrencyFailure`). Tes `DeadlockException` TIDAK mengasersi isi DB: pada simulasi di dalam transaksi tes, Laravel mengurangi penghitung transaksi tanpa me-rollback savepoint, jadi tulisan sebagian tetap ada (di MySQL nyata seluruh transaksi sudah digulung server). Pembuktian retry dan `SYSTEM_BUSY` nyata milik T11.
6. Jumlah tes baru 37 (unit 5, feature 32; terukur di uji coba integrasi; kesetaraan = 12 kasus provider, masing-masing 11 saat × 2-4 target).

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit\Services\Booking;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Services\Booking\TransitionCheck;
use Error;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use ReflectionClass;

/**
 * F7A-R5: pembawa hasil pemeriksaan satu tombol transisi. Murni, tanpa DB.
 */
class TransitionCheckTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_it_is_allowed_when_there_is_no_error_code_and_has_empty_defaults(): void
    {
        $check = new TransitionCheck(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $check->to);
        $this->assertNull($check->errorCode);
        $this->assertNull($check->message);
        $this->assertSame([], $check->replace);
        $this->assertTrue($check->allowed());
        $this->assertNull($check->opensAt());
    }

    public function test_it_is_not_allowed_when_it_has_an_error_code(): void
    {
        $check = new TransitionCheck(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, 'CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED', 'Batas pembatalan online telah lewat.', ['minutes' => 120]);

        $this->assertFalse($check->allowed());
        $this->assertSame('CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED', $check->errorCode);
        $this->assertSame('Batas pembatalan online telah lewat.', $check->message);
        $this->assertSame(['minutes' => 120], $check->replace);
        $this->assertNull($check->opensAt());
    }

    public function test_opens_at_returns_the_time_only_for_checkin_not_open(): void
    {
        $notOpen = new TransitionCheck(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, 'CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN', 'Check-in belum dibuka. Check-in dibuka pukul 08.00.', ['time' => '08.00']);

        $this->assertSame('08.00', $notOpen->opensAt());
        $this->assertFalse($notOpen->allowed());

        // Kode lain yang kebetulan membawa placeholder time (mis. SESSION_NOT_ENDED) tidak boleh dianggap jam buka.
        $other = new TransitionCheck(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, 'CHECKIN_CLOSED', 'Sesi sudah berakhir.', ['time' => '12.00']);

        $this->assertNull($other->opensAt());
    }

    public function test_opens_at_is_null_when_the_time_placeholder_is_missing(): void
    {
        $this->assertNull((new TransitionCheck(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, 'CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN', 'Pesan tanpa jam.'))->opensAt());
    }

    public function test_the_properties_are_readonly_and_the_class_is_final(): void
    {
        $check = new TransitionCheck(AppointmentStatus::Completed);

        $this->assertTrue((new ReflectionClass(TransitionCheck::class))->isFinal());

        $this->expectException(Error::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Cannot modify readonly property');

        $check->errorCode = 'INVALID_TRANSITION';
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Booking;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException;
use App\Exceptions\SanitizedBookingFault;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentStatusService;
use App\Services\Booking\TransitionCheck;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use PDOException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R5, Review Focus E1: tombol (transitionChecks/availableTransitions) tidak pernah berbeda dari aturan
 * server (transition()). Waktu dibekukan dengan travelTo(): "sekarang" awal = Senin 2026-10-05 08.00 WIB; sesi
 * uji = Selasa 2026-10-06 09.00-12.00, kuota 20, sehingga batas pembatalan pasien (120 menit) = 07.00, check-in
 * dibuka 08.00 dan ditutup tepat 12.00.
 */
class AppointmentTransitionChecksTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /** Saat-saat uji kesetaraan: di sekitar batas batal pasien (07.00), buka check-in (08.00), dan akhir sesi (12.00). */
    private const MOMENTS = [
        '2026-10-05 08:00:00',
        '2026-10-05 20:00:00',
        '2026-10-06 07:00:00',
        '2026-10-06 07:01:00',
        '2026-10-06 07:59:00',
        '2026-10-06 08:00:00',
        '2026-10-06 10:00:00',
        '2026-10-06 11:59:59',
        '2026-10-06 12:00:00',
        '2026-10-06 12:00:01',
        '2026-10-07 10:00:00',
    ];

    private AppointmentStatusService $service;

    private PracticeSession $session;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 08:00:00'));
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->service = $this->app->make(AppointmentStatusService::class);
        $this->session = $this->createSession([
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-06',
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ]);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pembantu

    private function at(string $moment): void
    {
        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse($moment));
    }

    /** Appointment pada sesi uji milik pasien berakun baru. */
    private function appointment(AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed): Appointment
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create();

        return $this->bookAppointment($this->session, $status, ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id]);
    }

    private function ownerOf(Appointment $appointment): Actor
    {
        $userId = PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($appointment->patient_profile_id)->value('user_id');

        return Actor::patient(User::query()->findOrFail($userId));
    }

    /** owner = pasien pemilik; stranger = pasien lain; staff; system. */
    private function actorFor(string $kind, Appointment $appointment): Actor
    {
        return match ($kind) {
            'owner' => $this->ownerOf($appointment),
            'stranger' => Actor::patient(User::query()->findOrFail(PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create()->user_id)),
            'staff' => Actor::staff(User::factory()->staff()->create()),
            default => Actor::system(),
        };
    }

    /**
     * Selalu memakai instance BARU dari DB (relasi belum dimuat) agar `loadMissing` ikut teruji.
     *
     * @return list<TransitionCheck>
     */
    private function checks(Appointment $appointment, Actor $actor, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): array
    {
        return $this->service->transitionChecks(Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id), $actor, $now);
    }

    /** @return list<AppointmentStatus> */
    private function available(Appointment $appointment, Actor $actor, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): array
    {
        return $this->service->availableTransitions(Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id), $actor, $now);
    }

    /** @param list<TransitionCheck> $checks */
    private function check(array $checks, AppointmentStatus $to): TransitionCheck
    {
        foreach ($checks as $check) {
            if ($check->to === $to) {
                return $check;
            }
        }

        $this->fail("Tidak ada TransitionCheck untuk {$to->value}.");
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<TransitionCheck>  $checks
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function targets(array $checks): array
    {
        return array_map(fn (TransitionCheck $check): string => $check->to->value, $checks);
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<AppointmentStatus>  $statuses
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function values(array $statuses): array
    {
        return array_map(fn (AppointmentStatus $status): string => $status->value, $statuses);
    }

    private function failure(callable $call): BookingException
    {
        try {
            $call();
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            return $e;
        }

        $this->fail('BookingException tidak dilempar.');
    }

    /** Menjalankan transition() dengan alasan sah, tanpa expected, lalu menggulung semuanya (savepoint). */
    private function attemptRolledBack(int $appointmentId, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor): ?InvalidTransitionException
    {
        DB::beginTransaction();

        try {
            $this->service->transition(Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointmentId), $to, $actor, 'Alasan uji kesetaraan');

            return null;
        } catch (InvalidTransitionException $e) {
            return $e;
        } finally {
            DB::rollBack();
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ bentuk dan kandidat

    public function test_individual_targets_are_the_four_ui_targets_without_no_show_or_pending(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(
            [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, AppointmentStatus::Completed, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled],
            AppointmentStatusService::INDIVIDUAL_TARGETS,
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{0: AppointmentStatus, 1: list<string>}> */
    public static function candidates(): array
    {
        return [
            'pending' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending, ['confirmed', 'checked_in', 'cancelled']],
            'confirmed' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['checked_in', 'cancelled']],
            'checked_in' => [AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, ['confirmed', 'completed']],
        ];
    }

    /** @param list<string> $expected */
    #[DataProvider('candidates')]
    public function test_candidates_are_the_legal_targets_in_individual_targets_order_and_staff_may_use_all_of_them_at_10(AppointmentStatus $from, array $expected): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment($from);
        $staff = $this->actorFor('staff', $appointment);
        $this->at('2026-10-06 10:00:00');

        $checks = $this->checks($appointment, $staff);

        $this->assertSame($expected, $this->targets($checks));
        $this->assertSame($expected, $this->values($this->available($appointment, $staff)));

        foreach ($checks as $check) {
            $this->assertTrue($check->allowed(), $check->to->value.' ditolak: '.$check->errorCode);
            $this->assertNull($check->message);
            $this->assertSame([], $check->replace);
        }
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{0: AppointmentStatus}> */
    public static function finalStatuses(): array
    {
        return [
            'completed' => [AppointmentStatus::Completed],
            'cancelled' => [AppointmentStatus::Cancelled],
            'no_show' => [AppointmentStatus::NoShow],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('finalStatuses')]
    public function test_a_final_appointment_has_no_checks_and_nothing_available_for_every_actor(AppointmentStatus $final): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment($final);
        $this->at('2026-10-06 10:00:00');

        foreach (['owner', 'stranger', 'staff', 'system'] as $kind) {
            $actor = $this->actorFor($kind, $appointment);

            $this->assertSame([], $this->checks($appointment, $actor), $kind);
            $this->assertSame([], $this->available($appointment, $actor), $kind);
        }
    }

    public function test_no_show_is_never_offered_to_any_actor_in_any_state_or_moment(): void
    {
        foreach ([AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn] as $from) {
            $appointment = $this->appointment($from);

            foreach (['owner', 'stranger', 'staff', 'system'] as $kind) {
                $actor = $this->actorFor($kind, $appointment);

                foreach (['2026-10-06 10:00:00', '2026-10-06 12:30:00', '2026-10-07 09:00:00'] as $moment) {
                    $this->at($moment);

                    $this->assertNotContains('no_show', $this->targets($this->checks($appointment, $actor)), "{$kind} {$from->value} {$moment}");
                    $this->assertNotContains(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $this->available($appointment, $actor));
                    $this->assertNotContains(AppointmentStatus::Pending, $this->available($appointment, $actor));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ E1: check-in

    /** @return array<string, array{0: AppointmentStatus}> */
    public static function checkInSources(): array
    {
        return [
            'pending boleh langsung check-in' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending],
            'confirmed' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('checkInSources')]
    public function test_e1_check_in_is_offered_from_the_exact_opening_minute_through_the_exact_end(AppointmentStatus $from): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment($from);
        $staff = $this->actorFor('staff', $appointment);

        // Satu menit sebelum buka (08.00) dan satu detik sebelum buka: belum dibuka, jam buka 08.00.
        foreach (['2026-10-06 07:59:00', '2026-10-06 07:59:59'] as $moment) {
            $this->at($moment);
            $check = $this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff), AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);

            $this->assertFalse($check->allowed(), $moment);
            $this->assertSame('CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN', $check->errorCode);
            $this->assertSame('08.00', $check->opensAt());
            $this->assertSame(['time' => '08.00'], $check->replace);
            $this->assertSame('Check-in belum dibuka. Check-in dibuka pukul 08.00.', $check->message);
            $this->assertNotContains(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->available($appointment, $staff));
        }

        // Tepat jam buka dan tepat akhir sesi: diterima.
        foreach (['2026-10-06 08:00:00', '2026-10-06 10:30:00', '2026-10-06 12:00:00'] as $moment) {
            $this->at($moment);
            $check = $this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff), AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);

            $this->assertTrue($check->allowed(), $moment);
            $this->assertNull($check->errorCode);
            $this->assertNull($check->opensAt());
            $this->assertContains(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->available($appointment, $staff));
        }

        // Sesudah akhir: tidak ada jam buka, hanya sesi sudah berakhir.
        foreach (['2026-10-06 12:00:01', '2026-10-06 12:01:00'] as $moment) {
            $this->at($moment);
            $check = $this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff), AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);

            $this->assertFalse($check->allowed(), $moment);
            $this->assertSame('CHECKIN_CLOSED', $check->errorCode);
            $this->assertNull($check->opensAt());
            $this->assertSame('Sesi sudah berakhir sehingga check-in tidak dapat dilakukan.', $check->message);
            $this->assertNotContains(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->available($appointment, $staff));
        }

        // Hari lain (sebelum dan sesudah tanggal sesi).
        $date = $this->session->session_date->translatedFormat('l, j F Y');

        foreach (['2026-10-05 10:00:00', '2026-10-07 10:00:00'] as $moment) {
            $this->at($moment);
            $check = $this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff), AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);

            $this->assertSame('CHECKIN_NOT_TODAY', $check->errorCode, $moment);
            $this->assertSame("Check-in hanya dapat dilakukan pada tanggal kunjungan ({$date}).", $check->message);
            $this->assertNull($check->opensAt());
        }
    }

    public function test_e1_the_check_in_button_state_equals_what_the_server_accepts_at_the_boundaries(): void
    {
        $cases = [
            '2026-10-06 07:59:00' => false,
            '2026-10-06 08:00:00' => true,
            '2026-10-06 12:00:00' => true,
            '2026-10-06 12:01:00' => false,
        ];

        foreach ($cases as $moment => $accepted) {
            $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
            $staff = $this->actorFor('staff', $appointment);
            $this->at($moment);
            $check = $this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff), AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);

            $this->assertSame($accepted, $check->allowed(), $moment);

            if ($accepted) {
                $this->service->transition(Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id), AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $staff);
                $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $appointment->fresh()->status, $moment);

                continue;
            }

            $e = $this->failure(fn () => $this->service->transition(Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id), AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $staff));

            $this->assertSame($check->errorCode, $e->errorCode, $moment);
            $this->assertSame($check->message, $e->getMessage(), $moment);
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $appointment->fresh()->status, $moment);
        }
    }

    public function test_e1_confirming_is_offered_until_the_exact_end_of_the_session(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $staff = $this->actorFor('staff', $appointment);

        $this->at('2026-10-06 11:59:59');
        $this->assertTrue($this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed)->allowed());

        $this->at('2026-10-06 12:00:00');
        $check = $this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->assertFalse($check->allowed());
        $this->assertSame('CONFIRM_AFTER_END', $check->errorCode);
        $this->assertSame('Sesi sudah berakhir sehingga pendaftaran tidak dapat dikonfirmasi.', $check->message);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ E1: koreksi dan selesai

    public function test_e1_correction_is_offered_only_on_the_session_day_and_completing_has_no_time_window(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $staff = $this->actorFor('staff', $appointment);

        foreach (['2026-10-06 00:00:00', '2026-10-06 09:30:00', '2026-10-06 23:59:59'] as $moment) {
            $this->at($moment);
            $checks = $this->checks($appointment, $staff);

            $this->assertTrue($this->check($checks, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed)->allowed(), $moment);
            $this->assertTrue($this->check($checks, AppointmentStatus::Completed)->allowed(), $moment);
        }

        foreach (['2026-10-05 12:00:00', '2026-10-07 00:00:00'] as $moment) {
            $this->at($moment);
            $checks = $this->checks($appointment, $staff);
            $correction = $this->check($checks, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

            $this->assertFalse($correction->allowed(), $moment);
            $this->assertSame('CORRECTION_NOT_SAME_DAY', $correction->errorCode);
            $this->assertSame('Koreksi check-in hanya dapat dilakukan pada hari yang sama.', $correction->message);
            $this->assertNotContains(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->available($appointment, $staff));
            $this->assertTrue($this->check($checks, AppointmentStatus::Completed)->allowed(), $moment);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pembatalan: staf, pasien, sistem

    public function test_staff_may_cancel_at_any_time_but_the_patient_is_bound_by_the_cutoff(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $staff = $this->actorFor('staff', $appointment);
        $owner = $this->ownerOf($appointment);

        $this->at('2026-10-06 13:00:00');
        $this->assertTrue($this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff), AppointmentStatus::Cancelled)->allowed());

        $this->at('2026-10-05 20:00:00');
        $this->assertTrue($this->check($this->checks($appointment, $owner), AppointmentStatus::Cancelled)->allowed());

        $this->at('2026-10-06 07:00:00');
        $this->assertTrue($this->check($this->checks($appointment, $owner), AppointmentStatus::Cancelled)->allowed(), 'Tepat start - 120 menit diterima.');

        $this->at('2026-10-06 07:01:00');
        $late = $this->check($this->checks($appointment, $owner), AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);

        $this->assertFalse($late->allowed());
        $this->assertSame('CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED', $late->errorCode);
        $this->assertSame(120, $late->replace['minutes']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('120', (string) $late->message);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('(021) 0000-0000', (string) $late->message);
    }

    public function test_a_patient_only_sees_cancel_on_their_own_pending_or_confirmed_appointment(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $owner = $this->ownerOf($appointment);
        $stranger = $this->actorFor('stranger', $appointment);
        $this->at('2026-10-05 20:00:00');

        $this->assertSame(['cancelled'], $this->values($this->available($appointment, $owner)));

        $checks = $this->checks($appointment, $owner);
        $this->assertSame('FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION', $this->check($checks, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed)->errorCode);
        $this->assertSame('FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION', $this->check($checks, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn)->errorCode);

        // Pasien lain tidak melihat apa pun, termasuk batal.
        $this->assertSame([], $this->available($appointment, $stranger));

        foreach ($this->checks($appointment, $stranger) as $check) {
            $this->assertSame('FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION', $check->errorCode, $check->to->value);
        }
    }

    public function test_a_patient_sees_nothing_on_a_checked_in_appointment(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $owner = $this->ownerOf($appointment);
        $this->at('2026-10-06 09:30:00');

        $checks = $this->checks($appointment, $owner);

        $this->assertSame(['confirmed', 'completed'], $this->targets($checks));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->available($appointment, $owner));
        $this->assertNotContains('cancelled', $this->targets($checks));
    }

    public function test_the_system_actor_is_only_offered_cancel(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $system = $this->actorFor('system', $appointment);
        $this->at('2026-10-06 10:00:00');

        $this->assertSame(['cancelled'], $this->values($this->available($appointment, $system)));

        $checks = $this->checks($appointment, $system);
        $this->assertSame('FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION', $this->check($checks, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn)->errorCode);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ tanpa efek samping, tanpa kunci

    public function test_the_checks_ignore_the_reason_and_never_write_or_lock(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $staff = $this->actorFor('staff', $appointment);
        $this->at('2026-10-06 10:00:00');
        $updatedAt = $appointment->fresh()->updated_at->toDateTimeString();
        $fresh = Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id);
        $this->assertFalse($fresh->relationLoaded('practiceSession'));
        $this->assertFalse($fresh->relationLoaded('patientProfile'));

        DB::flushQueryLog();
        DB::enableQueryLog();
        $checks = $this->service->transitionChecks($fresh, $staff);
        $queries = array_column(DB::getQueryLog(), 'query');
        DB::disableQueryLog();

        // Koreksi mensyaratkan alasan di server, tetapi tombolnya tetap muncul (modal mengumpulkan alasan).
        $this->assertTrue($this->check($checks, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed)->allowed());

        $this->assertTrue($fresh->relationLoaded('practiceSession'));
        $this->assertTrue($fresh->relationLoaded('patientProfile'));

        foreach ($queries as $query) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('for update', strtolower($query), 'Pemeriksaan tombol tidak boleh mengunci baris.');
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('insert', strtolower($query));
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('update `', strtolower($query));
        }

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $appointment->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame($updatedAt, $appointment->fresh()->updated_at->toDateTimeString());
        $this->assertSame(0, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->count());
    }

    public function test_the_now_argument_overrides_the_clock_and_is_read_in_the_application_timezone(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $staff = $this->actorFor('staff', $appointment);

        // Jam dinding masih Senin 08.00, tetapi $now = Selasa 08.00 WIB: check-in sudah dibuka.
        $this->assertTrue($this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff, CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06 08:00:00')), AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn)->allowed());
        $this->assertSame('CHECKIN_NOT_TODAY', $this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff), AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn)->errorCode);

        // 01.00 UTC = 08.00 WIB (diterima); 00.59 UTC = 07.59 WIB (belum dibuka).
        $this->assertTrue($this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff, CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06 01:00:00', 'UTC')), AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn)->allowed());
        $this->assertSame('CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN', $this->check($this->checks($appointment, $staff, CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06 00:59:00', 'UTC')), AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn)->errorCode);

        $this->assertSame(
            [AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled],
            $this->available($appointment, $staff, CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06 08:00:00')),
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ kesetaraan dengan transition()

    /** @return array<string, array{0: string, 1: string}> */
    public static function equivalenceCases(): array
    {
        $cases = [];

        foreach (['pending', 'confirmed', 'checked_in'] as $from) {
            foreach (['owner', 'stranger', 'staff', 'system'] as $kind) {
                $cases["{$kind}: {$from}"] = [$from, $kind];
            }
        }

        return $cases;
    }

    #[DataProvider('equivalenceCases')]
    public function test_every_check_agrees_with_transition_on_allowed_error_code_and_message(string $from, string $kind): void
    {
        Notification::fake();
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::from($from));
        $actor = $this->actorFor($kind, $appointment);
        $compared = 0;

        foreach (self::MOMENTS as $moment) {
            $this->at($moment);
            $checks = $this->checks($appointment, $actor);

            $this->assertNotSame([], $checks, "{$kind} {$from} {$moment}");

            foreach ($checks as $check) {
                $label = "{$kind} {$from} -> {$check->to->value} @ {$moment}";
                $thrown = $this->attemptRolledBack($appointment->id, $check->to, $actor);
                $compared++;

                if ($check->allowed()) {
                    $this->assertNull($thrown, "Tombol tampil tetapi server menolak ({$label}): ".($thrown?->errorCode ?? ''));
                    $this->assertNull($check->errorCode, $label);
                    $this->assertNull($check->message, $label);

                    continue;
                }

                $this->assertNotNull($thrown, "Tombol ditolak tetapi server menerima ({$label}).");
                $this->assertSame($check->errorCode, $thrown->errorCode, $label);
                $this->assertSame($check->message, $thrown->getMessage(), $label);
            }

            $allowed = array_values(array_filter($checks, fn (TransitionCheck $check): bool => $check->allowed()));
            $this->assertSame(
                $this->targets($allowed),
                $this->values($this->available($appointment, $actor)),
                "availableTransitions sama dengan pemeriksaan yang allowed(): {$kind} {$from} @ {$moment}",
            );
        }

        $this->assertGreaterThan(count(self::MOMENTS), $compared);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::from($from), $appointment->fresh()->status, 'Tidak ada tulisan yang tersisa.');
        $this->assertSame(0, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->count());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ DeadlockException (F7A-R5)

    public function test_a_deadlock_exception_from_a_nested_transaction_becomes_system_busy(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $staff = $this->actorFor('staff', $appointment);
        $this->at('2026-10-06 10:00:00');
        Exceptions::fake();

        // Di dalam transaksi tes (level > 1) Laravel tidak mengulang dan melempar DeadlockException.
        DB::connection()->beforeExecuting(function (string $query, array $bindings): void {
            if (str_contains(strtolower($query), 'insert into `appointment_status_histories`')) {
                $driver = new PDOException('SQLSTATE[40001]: Serialization failure: 1213 Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction');
                $driver->errorInfo = ['40001', 1213, 'Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction'];

                throw new QueryException('mariadb', $query, $bindings, $driver);
            }
        });

        $e = $this->failure(fn () => $this->service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $staff, 'Dibatalkan petugas uji'));

        $this->assertNotInstanceOf(InvalidTransitionException::class, $e);
        $this->assertSame(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY, $e->errorCode);
        $this->assertSame('Sistem sedang sibuk, silakan coba lagi beberapa saat.', $e->getMessage());
        $this->assertInstanceOf(DeadlockException::class, $e->getPrevious());

        Exceptions::assertReportedCount(1);
        Exceptions::assertReported(fn (SanitizedBookingFault $fault): bool => str_contains($fault->getMessage(), 'transisi status')
            && str_contains($fault->getMessage(), 'driver=1213')
            && ! str_contains($fault->getMessage(), 'insert into'));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Booking;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException;

/**
 * Hasil pemeriksaan satu tombol transisi (F7A-R5). `errorCode` null = tombol boleh tampil dan diterima server;
 * selain itu kode `InvalidTransitionException` yang akan dilempar `transition()` pada saat yang sama, lengkap
 * dengan pesan Indonesia dan placeholder-nya (`CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN` membawa `['time' => 'H.i']`).
 */
final class TransitionCheck
{
    /**
     * @param  array<string, scalar>  $replace  placeholder pesan
     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly AppointmentStatus $to,
        public readonly ?string $errorCode = null,
        public readonly ?string $message = null,
        public readonly array $replace = [],
    ) {}

    public function allowed(): bool
    {
        return $this->errorCode === null;
    }

    /** Jam buka check-in `H.i` hanya untuk `CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN`; selain itu null. */
    public function opensAt(): ?string
    {
        if ($this->errorCode !== InvalidTransitionException::CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN) {
            return null;
        }

        $time = $this->replace['time'] ?? null;

        return is_string($time) ? $time : null;
    }
}
```
