```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Booking;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException;
use App\Exceptions\SanitizedBookingFault;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Audit\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Database\ConcurrencyErrorDetector;
use Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Satu-satunya jalur tulis status appointment setelah pembuatan (00 F.8, F6-R15). Tabel transisi T4-T10
 * ada sebagai data (TRANSITIONS dan RULES): pembuatan (T1-T3) milik BookingService. Kunci baku 00 F.6:
 * patient_profiles, practice_sessions, appointments (hanya lewat PK) sebelum kueri lain; semua pemeriksaan
 * dibaca ulang di bawah kunci. Otorisasi (izin Spatie, Policy) ada di lapisan HTTP; service menegakkan
 * aturan domain menurut JENIS pelaku dan kepemilikan. Pemeriksaan aturan ada di SATU evaluator (F7A-R5) yang
 * dipakai `transition()` (di bawah kunci) dan `transitionChecks()` (tombol UI, tanpa kunci), sehingga tombol
 * tidak pernah berbeda dari aturan server.
 */
final class AppointmentStatusService
{
    public const REASON_MIN_LENGTH = 5;

    public const REASON_MAX_LENGTH = 255;

    /** Peta dari-ke yang sah (00 F.8). Status final tidak punya jalan keluar. Dasar kandidat `transitionChecks()`. */
    public const TRANSITIONS = [
        'pending' => ['confirmed', 'checked_in', 'cancelled', 'no_show'],
        'confirmed' => ['checked_in', 'cancelled', 'no_show'],
        'checked_in' => ['completed', 'confirmed'],
        'completed' => [],
        'cancelled' => [],
        'no_show' => [],
    ];

    /**
     * Tabel F.8 T4-T10 per pasangan "dari>ke": `actors` = jenis pelaku yang boleh; `window` = jendela waktu
     * (before_end, checkin_window, same_day, cancel_rule, after_end, atau null); `reason` = jenis pelaku yang
     * wajib mengisi alasan (5-255 karakter).
     */
    public const RULES = [
        'pending>confirmed' => ['step' => 'T4', 'actors' => ['staff'], 'window' => 'before_end', 'reason' => []],
        'pending>checked_in' => ['step' => 'T5', 'actors' => ['staff'], 'window' => 'checkin_window', 'reason' => []],
        'confirmed>checked_in' => ['step' => 'T5', 'actors' => ['staff'], 'window' => 'checkin_window', 'reason' => []],
        'checked_in>completed' => ['step' => 'T6', 'actors' => ['staff'], 'window' => null, 'reason' => []],
        'checked_in>confirmed' => ['step' => 'T7', 'actors' => ['staff'], 'window' => 'same_day', 'reason' => ['staff']],
        'pending>cancelled' => ['step' => 'T8/T9', 'actors' => ['patient', 'staff', 'system'], 'window' => 'cancel_rule', 'reason' => ['staff', 'system']],
        'confirmed>cancelled' => ['step' => 'T8/T9', 'actors' => ['patient', 'staff', 'system'], 'window' => 'cancel_rule', 'reason' => ['staff', 'system']],
        'pending>no_show' => ['step' => 'T10', 'actors' => ['staff', 'system'], 'window' => 'after_end', 'reason' => []],
        'confirmed>no_show' => ['step' => 'T10', 'actors' => ['staff', 'system'], 'window' => 'after_end', 'reason' => []],
    ];

    /**
     * Status tujuan yang boleh diminta lewat aksi per appointment di UI (F7A-R5, F7A-R18). `no_show` TIDAK
     * termasuk: hanya lewat aksi massal per sesi (`markNoShowForSession`) atau perintah terjadwal.
     */
    public const INDIVIDUAL_TARGETS = [
        AppointmentStatus::Confirmed,
        AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn,
        AppointmentStatus::Completed,
        AppointmentStatus::Cancelled,
    ];

    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
        private readonly SettingsService $settings,
        private readonly AppointmentNotifier $notifier,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Mengubah status satu appointment. `$expected` (BR-67) = status yang dilihat pengguna saat memuat
     * halaman; berbeda dengan status di bawah kunci → STALE_STATUS. Instance `$appointment` pemanggil
     * disinkronkan dengan keadaan baru dan dikembalikan.
     *
     * @throws InvalidTransitionException aturan F.8 dilanggar (tidak ada yang ditulis)
     * @throws BookingException SYSTEM_BUSY bila galat konkurensi (QueryException atau DeadlockException) lolos dari 3 percobaan
     */
    public function transition(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, ?string $reason = null, ?AppointmentStatus $expected = null): Appointment
    {
        $reason = $this->normalizeReason($reason);

        if ($actor->isPatient() && $reason !== null) {
            $reason = mb_substr($reason, 0, self::REASON_MAX_LENGTH);
        }

        $appointmentId = (int) $appointment->getKey();
        $profileId = (int) $appointment->patient_profile_id;
        $sessionId = (int) $appointment->practice_session_id;

        try {
            $locked = DB::transaction(
                fn (): Appointment => $this->applyLocked($appointmentId, $profileId, $sessionId, $to, $actor, $reason, $expected),
                3,
            );
        } catch (QueryException|DeadlockException $e) {
            // DeadlockException dilempar Laravel di dalam transaksi pembungkus (tanpa pengulangan); selalu galat konkurensi.
            if ($e instanceof DeadlockException || app(ConcurrencyErrorDetector::class)->causedByConcurrencyError($e)) {
                SanitizedBookingFault::capture('SYSTEM_BUSY (transisi status)', $e, ['practice_session_id' => $sessionId, 'patient_profile_id' => $profileId]);

                throw BookingException::make(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY, [], [], $e);
            }

            throw $e;
        }

        $appointment->setRawAttributes($locked->getRawOriginal(), true);
        $appointment->setRelations($locked->getRelations());

        return $appointment;
    }

    /**
     * Pemeriksaan tombol untuk satu appointment (F7A-R5): kandidat = TRANSITIONS[status] yang juga ada di
     * INDIVIDUAL_TARGETS (urut INDIVIDUAL_TARGETS); status final menghasilkan []. Memakai evaluator yang sama
     * dengan `transition()` tetapi tanpa kunci (SELECT biasa) dan MENGABAIKAN `expected` dan alasan (modal
     * mengumpulkan alasan; server tetap memeriksa). Kandidat yang ditolak tetap dikembalikan dengan kode dan
     * pesan penolakan (mis. `CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN` + `opensAt()` untuk tombol "Dibuka HH.MM").
     *
     * @return list<TransitionCheck>
     */
    public function transitionChecks(Appointment $appointment, Actor $actor, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): array
    {
        $appointment->loadMissing(['practiceSession', 'patientProfile']);

        $from = $appointment->status;

        if ($from->isFinal()) {
            return [];
        }

        $moment = $this->momentOf($now);
        $legal = self::TRANSITIONS[$from->value];
        $checks = [];

        foreach (self::INDIVIDUAL_TARGETS as $to) {
            if (! in_array($to->value, $legal, true)) {
                continue;
            }

            $rejection = $this->evaluate($appointment->patientProfile, $appointment->practiceSession, $from, $to, $actor, $moment, false);

            $checks[] = $rejection === null
                ? new TransitionCheck($to)
                : new TransitionCheck($to, $rejection['code'], (string) __('booking.transitions.'.$rejection['key'], $rejection['replace']), $rejection['replace']);
        }

        return $checks;
    }

    /**
     * Status tujuan yang boleh dipilih aktor sekarang (tombol yang tampil): pemeriksaan `transitionChecks()`
     * yang `allowed()`, dalam urutan yang sama.
     *
     * @return list<AppointmentStatus>
     */
    public function availableTransitions(Appointment $appointment, Actor $actor, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): array
    {
        $allowed = array_filter(
            $this->transitionChecks($appointment, $actor, $now),
            fn (TransitionCheck $check): bool => $check->allowed(),
        );

        return array_values(array_map(fn (TransitionCheck $check): AppointmentStatus => $check->to, $allowed));
    }

    private function applyLocked(int $appointmentId, int $profileId, int $sessionId, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, ?string $reason, ?AppointmentStatus $expected): Appointment
    {
        // Urutan kunci baku (00 F.6): profil, sesi, appointment; hanya lewat PK dan tanpa kueri lain sebelumnya.
        $profile = PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($profileId)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
        $session = PracticeSession::query()->whereKey($sessionId)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
        $appointment = Appointment::query()->whereKey($appointmentId)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

        $from = $appointment->status;
        $now = $this->momentOf(null);

        $rejection = $this->evaluate($profile, $session, $from, $to, $actor, $now, true, $reason, $expected);

        if ($rejection !== null) {
            throw InvalidTransitionException::makeVariant($rejection['code'], $rejection['key'], $rejection['replace'], $this->context($appointment, $from, $to));
        }

        $appointment->forceFill($this->changes($appointment, $from, $to, $actor, $reason, $now))->save();

        if ($to === AppointmentStatus::Cancelled) {
            $session->forceFill(['booked_count' => max(0, (int) $session->booked_count - 1)])->save();
        }

        AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->create([
            'appointment_id' => $appointment->getKey(),
            'from_status' => $from,
            'to_status' => $to,
            'actor_type' => $actor->type,
            'actor_user_id' => $actor->userId,
            'reason' => $reason,
        ]);

        $this->audit->log(
            'appointment.status_changed',
            $appointment,
            ['status' => $from->value],
            ['status' => $to->value] + ($reason === null ? [] : ['reason' => $reason]),
            "Status pendaftaran {$appointment->booking_code} berubah dari {$from->label()} ke {$to->label()}.",
            $actor,
        );

        // refresh() lebih dulu (memuat kolom generated active_flag), baru relasi yang dibutuhkan notifier.
        $appointment->refresh();
        $appointment->setRelation('practiceSession', $session);
        $appointment->setRelation('patientProfile', $profile->load('user'));
        $appointment->load(['clinic', 'doctor']);

        $this->notifier->statusChanged($appointment, $from, $to, $reason);

        return $appointment;
    }

    /**
     * Evaluator tunggal aturan F.8. Urutan pemeriksaan (tidak boleh berubah; dikunci matriks 108 kasus):
     * pemilik, expected, final, pelaku-ke-status, pasangan, pelaku-di-aturan, alasan, lalu jendela waktu.
     * `$enforceInput` = true di `transition()` (di bawah kunci); false di `transitionChecks()`, yang melewati
     * `expected` dan alasan. Mengembalikan penolakan pertama (kode, kunci pesan `booking.transitions.*`,
     * placeholder) atau null bila diizinkan.
     *
     * @return array{code: string, key: string, replace: array<string, scalar>}|null
     */
    private function evaluate(PatientProfile $profile, PracticeSession $session, AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, CarbonImmutable $now, bool $enforceInput, ?string $reason = null, ?AppointmentStatus $expected = null): ?array
    {
        if ($actor->isPatient() && ($profile->user_id === null || (int) $profile->user_id !== $actor->userId)) {
            return $this->rejection('FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION');
        }

        if ($enforceInput && $expected !== null && $expected !== $from) {
            return $this->rejection('STALE_STATUS');
        }

        if ($from->isFinal()) {
            return $this->rejection('ALREADY_FINAL', ['status' => mb_strtolower($from->label())]);
        }

        if (! $this->actorMayTarget($actor, $to)) {
            return $this->rejection('FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION');
        }

        $rule = self::RULES[$from->value.'>'.$to->value] ?? null;

        if ($rule === null) {
            if ($actor->isPatient() && $from === AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn && $to === AppointmentStatus::Cancelled) {
                return $this->rejection('INVALID_TRANSITION', [], 'CANCEL_CHECKED_IN');
            }

            return $this->rejection('INVALID_TRANSITION', ['dari' => $from->label(), 'ke' => $to->label()]);
        }

        if (! in_array($actor->type->value, $rule['actors'], true)) {
            return $this->rejection('FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION');
        }

        if ($enforceInput && in_array($actor->type->value, $rule['reason'], true)) {
            $length = $reason === null ? 0 : mb_strlen($reason);

            if ($length < self::REASON_MIN_LENGTH || $length > self::REASON_MAX_LENGTH) {
                return $this->rejection('REASON_REQUIRED');
            }
        }

        return $this->evaluateWindow($rule['window'], $session, $actor, $now);
    }

    /** Jendela waktu pasangan (setelah semua pemeriksaan struktur lolos); null bila tidak ada jendela atau lolos. */
    private function evaluateWindow(?string $window, PracticeSession $session, Actor $actor, CarbonImmutable $now): ?array
    {
        if ($window === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $rules = $this->settings->bookingRules();
        $isSessionDay = $session->session_date->toDateString() === $now->toDateString();

        if ($window === 'before_end' && ! $now->lessThan($session->ends_at)) {
            return $this->rejection('CONFIRM_AFTER_END');
        }

        if ($window === 'checkin_window') {
            if (! $isSessionDay) {
                return $this->rejection('CHECKIN_NOT_TODAY', ['date' => $session->session_date->translatedFormat('l, j F Y')]);
            }

            $opensAt = $session->starts_at->subMinutes($rules->checkinOpenMinutes);

            if ($now->lessThan($opensAt)) {
                return $this->rejection('CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN', ['time' => $opensAt->format('H.i')]);
            }

            if ($now->greaterThan($session->ends_at)) {
                return $this->rejection('CHECKIN_CLOSED');
            }
        }

        if ($window === 'same_day' && ! $isSessionDay) {
            return $this->rejection('CORRECTION_NOT_SAME_DAY');
        }

        if ($window === 'cancel_rule' && $actor->isPatient()) {
            $deadline = $session->starts_at->subMinutes($rules->cancelCutoffMinutes);

            if ($now->greaterThan($deadline)) {
                // Nomor telepon rumah sakit boleh kosong di pengaturan: pesan tetap utuh.
                $phone = trim($this->settings->string('contact.phone'));

                return $this->rejection('CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED', [
                    'minutes' => $rules->cancelCutoffMinutes,
                    'phone' => $phone === '' ? 'nomor rumah sakit' : $phone,
                ]);
            }
        }

        if ($window === 'after_end' && ! $now->greaterThan($session->ends_at)) {
            return $this->rejection('SESSION_NOT_ENDED', ['time' => $session->ends_at->format('H.i')]);
        }

        return null;
    }

    /** Staf boleh menuju status apa pun (pasangan yang tidak sah ditolak sebagai INVALID_TRANSITION). */
    private function actorMayTarget(Actor $actor, AppointmentStatus $to): bool
    {
        if ($actor->isStaff()) {
            return true;
        }

        foreach (self::RULES as $pair => $rule) {
            if (str_ends_with($pair, '>'.$to->value) && in_array($actor->type->value, $rule['actors'], true)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Kolom yang berubah (I-14): status, kolom waktu, dan data pembatalan.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function changes(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, ?string $reason, CarbonImmutable $now): array
    {
        $changes = ['status' => $to];

        switch ($to) {
            case AppointmentStatus::Confirmed:
                if ($from === AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn) {
                    $changes['checked_in_at'] = null;
                } else {
                    $changes['confirmed_at'] = $now;
                }
                break;
            case AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn:
                $changes['checked_in_at'] = $now;
                $changes['confirmed_at'] = $appointment->confirmed_at ?? $now;
                break;
            case AppointmentStatus::Completed:
                $changes['completed_at'] = $now;
                break;
            case AppointmentStatus::Cancelled:
                $changes['cancelled_at'] = $now;
                $changes['cancelled_by_type'] = $actor->type;
                $changes['cancelled_by_user_id'] = $actor->userId;
                $changes['cancel_reason'] = $reason;
                break;
            case AppointmentStatus::NoShow:
                $changes['no_show_at'] = $now;
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }

        return $changes;
    }

    private function normalizeReason(?string $reason): ?string
    {
        if ($reason === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $reason = trim($reason);

        return $reason === '' ? null : $reason;
    }

    /** Waktu "sekarang" dalam zona aplikasi (Asia/Jakarta); `$now` dari pemanggil menggantikan jam dinding. */
    private function momentOf(?CarbonImmutable $now): CarbonImmutable
    {
        return CarbonImmutable::instance($now ?? now())->setTimezone((string) config('app.timezone'));
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, scalar>  $replace
     * @return array{code: string, key: string, replace: array<string, scalar>}
     */
    private function rejection(string $code, array $replace = [], ?string $key = null): array
    {
        return ['code' => $code, 'key' => $key ?? $code, 'replace' => $replace];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    private function context(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to): array
    {
        return [
            'appointment_code' => (string) $appointment->booking_code,
            'from' => $from->value,
            'to' => $to->value,
        ];
    }
}
```

### Task 2: Tandai tidak hadir (`markNoShowForSession/ForDate`, `sessionsAwaitingNoShow`, `pendingNoShowCount`), kunci lang, perintah `appointments:mark-no-show`, dan jadwal 23.30

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/Services/Booking/AppointmentStatusService.php` (impor + empat method publik; kode SESUDAH T1)
- Create: `app/Console/Commands/MarkNoShowAppointments.php`
- Modify: `routes/console.php` (satu entri scheduler)

- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/Console/MarkNoShowAppointmentsTest.php`
- Tidak diubah: migration, enum, izin, `InvalidTransitionException` (kode `SESSION_NOT_ENDED` dan `INVALID_TRANSITION` sudah ada), `AppointmentNotifier`, `AppointmentStatusServiceTest` (matriks 108 kasus), `GenerateSessions`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: T1 (`AppointmentStatusService` dengan `evaluate()`, `momentOf()`), `transition()` (aktor `staff`/`system`, `no_show` tanpa `expected`), `InvalidTransitionException::make/makeVariant`, `BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY`, `PracticeSession::$ends_at`/`$time_range`/`appointments()`, `SessionStatus`, `Actor::system()/staff()`, `AppointmentNotifier` (walk-in tanpa akun tanpa notifikasi; pasien berakun notifikasi `database` untuk `no_show`), pola `GenerateSessions`.
- Produces:
  - `AppointmentStatusService::markNoShowForSession(PracticeSession $session, Actor $actor, ?string $reason = null): int`
  - `AppointmentStatusService::markNoShowForDate(?CarbonInterface $date, Actor $actor): int`
  - `AppointmentStatusService::sessionsAwaitingNoShow(?CarbonInterface $date = null, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection` (isi `PracticeSession`, eager `clinic`, `doctor`)
  - `AppointmentStatusService::pendingNoShowCount(PracticeSession $session): int`
  - Kunci lang: `booking.transitions.SESSION_UNDER_REVIEW`, `booking.no_show.done` (`:count`), `booking.no_show.nothing`, `booking.no_show.confirm_required` (dipakai T10).
  - Perintah `appointments:mark-no-show {--date=}` (kelas `App\Console\Commands\MarkNoShowAppointments`) dan entri scheduler `dailyAt('23:30')->withoutOverlapping()`.

**Test IDs:** BKG-16 (service + perintah), Review Focus E5 (batas waktu dan status sesi), BR-65/BR-66, NTF-03 (walk-in tanpa akun), NTF-07 (no_show hanya kanal database), F7A-R6, F7A-R7.

**Catatan teknis:**
1. **Tanpa transaksi luar.** `markNoShowForSession()` mengambil appointment `pending`/`confirmed` sesi itu (model utuh, urut `queue_number`, `id`) lalu memanggil `transition($a, NoShow, $actor, $reason)` satu per satu, tanpa `expected`. Setiap panggilan = satu transaksi dengan urutan kunci baku `patient_profiles` → `practice_sessions` → `appointments` dan 3 percobaan. `InvalidTransitionException` per appointment (status sudah diubah pihak lain: `ALREADY_FINAL`, `INVALID_TRANSITION` karena sudah check-in) dilewati tanpa dihitung; `BookingException` lain (`SYSTEM_BUSY`) diteruskan. Hasilnya aman diulang (appointment yang sudah `no_show` tidak lagi termasuk).
2. **Pemeriksaan sesi di muka.** Sesi dibaca ulang (SELECT biasa, instance pemanggil bisa basi). Urutan: `needs_review` → `InvalidTransitionException::makeVariant(INVALID_TRANSITION, 'SESSION_UNDER_REVIEW', [], ['practice_session_id' => id])`; lalu `now <= ends_at` → `InvalidTransitionException::make(SESSION_NOT_ENDED, ['time' => 'H.i'], ['practice_session_id' => id])`. Batas STRIK (`now > ends_at`): tepat `end_time` ditolak, `end + 1 detik` diterima. JANGAN memakai `PracticeSession::isEnded()` atau `scopeNotEnded()` (batas `<=`/`>` berbeda satu detik).
3. **`sessionsAwaitingNoShow`.** Sesi `open|closed`, `session_date < hari ini` ATAU (`session_date = hari ini` DAN `end_time < jam sekarang H:i:s`), punya appointment `pending|confirmed`; opsional satu tanggal; urut `session_date`, `start_time`, `id`; eager `clinic` dan `doctor`. Sesi `needs_review` dan `cancelled` tidak pernah masuk.
4. **`markNoShowForDate`** memanggil `markNoShowForSession` per sesi hasil `sessionsAwaitingNoShow($date)`; sesi yang berubah menjadi `needs_review` di antara daftar dan pemrosesan dilewati (`InvalidTransitionException`), bukan menggagalkan seluruh proses. Perintah memakai `markNoShowForSession` langsung (butuh hitungan per sesi dan pesan `SYSTEM_BUSY` dengan total sementara); `markNoShowForDate` dipakai seeder (T12).
5. **Kunci lang dikunci tes lama.** `BookingExceptionTest::test_the_language_file_has_exactly_the_documented_keys` mengasersi kunci persis; T2 memperbaruinya (grup `no_show` dan kunci `SESSION_UNDER_REVIEW`). Grup `no_show` ditaruh SESUDAH `transitions` dan SEBELUM `submit_in_progress` (jangkar tugas T8 untuk menambah grup `admin` di bawahnya; T8 juga wajib memperbarui tes yang sama).
6. **Batas yang diketahui (dicatat, bukan bug).** Pesan `SYSTEM_BUSY` menyebut jumlah yang sudah ditandai dari sesi yang SELESAI diproses; appointment yang sudah ditandai di sesi yang sedang berjalan saat berhenti tidak ikut terhitung (tetap tersimpan; hanya hitungan pesan yang lebih kecil). Tes `SYSTEM_BUSY` dan retry massal milik T11.
7. Jumlah tes baru 41 (service 23, perintah 18; terukur di uji coba integrasi).

- [ ] **Step 3: Tulis tes service (tool Write) `tests/Feature/Booking/AppointmentNoShowTest.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Booking;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentStatusChangedNotification;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentStatusService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R6, BKG-16, Review Focus E5: tandai tidak hadir per sesi dan per tanggal. Waktu dibekukan dengan travelTo():
 * "sekarang" awal = Selasa 2026-10-06 12.00.01 WIB, satu detik sesudah sesi uji (2026-10-06 09.00-12.00, kuota 20).
 * Transaksi tes membungkus service (savepoint): pembuktian SYSTEM_BUSY, retry, dan balapan nyata milik T11.
 */
class AppointmentNoShowTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private AppointmentStatusService $service;

    private PracticeSession $session;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06 12:00:01'));
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->service = $this->app->make(AppointmentStatusService::class);
        $this->session = $this->makeSession();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pembantu

    private function at(string $moment): void
    {
        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse($moment));
    }

    /**
     * Sesi tambahan manual (default 2026-10-06 09.00-12.00, kuota 20) dalam status `open`, `closed`, `cancelled`,
     * atau `needs_review`.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function makeSession(array $overrides = [], string $state = 'open'): PracticeSession
    {
        $factory = PracticeSession::factory()->manual();
        $factory = match ($state) {
            'closed' => $factory->closed(),
            'cancelled' => $factory->cancelled(),
            'needs_review' => $factory->needsReview(['source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_EXCEPTION, 'exception_id' => 1]),
            default => $factory,
        };

        return $factory->create($overrides + [
            'session_date' => '2026-10-06',
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ]);
    }

    /** Appointment pada sesi (bawaan sesi uji); pasien berakun kecuali $withAccount = false (walk-in). */
    private function appointment(AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, bool $withAccount = true, ?PracticeSession $session = null): Appointment
    {
        $profile = $withAccount
            ? PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create()
            : PatientProfile::factory()->create();

        return $this->bookAppointment($session ?? $this->session, $status, ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id]);
    }

    /**
     * Sesi dengan appointment berstatus tertentu (satu per elemen).
     *
     * @param  list<AppointmentStatus>  $statuses
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function sessionWith(array $statuses, array $overrides = [], string $state = 'open'): PracticeSession
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession($overrides, $state);

        foreach ($statuses as $status) {
            $this->appointment($status, true, $session);
        }

        return $session;
    }

    private function failure(callable $call): BookingException
    {
        try {
            $call();
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            return $e;
        }

        $this->fail('BookingException tidak dilempar.');
    }

    private function assertFails(string $code, callable $call): InvalidTransitionException
    {
        $e = $this->failure($call);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(InvalidTransitionException::class, $e);
        $this->assertSame($code, $e->errorCode);

        return $e;
    }

    private function statusOf(Appointment $appointment): AppointmentStatus
    {
        return $appointment->fresh()->status;
    }

    private function historyCount(?Appointment $appointment = null): int
    {
        $query = AppointmentStatusHistory::query();

        return $appointment === null ? $query->count() : $query->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->count();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ BKG-16: efek per appointment

    public function test_bkg_16_staff_marks_pending_and_confirmed_with_the_right_actor_history_and_audit_per_appointment(): void
    {
        $pending = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $confirmed = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $staff = User::factory()->staff()->create();

        $count = $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::staff($staff), 'Pasien tidak datang sampai sesi berakhir');

        $this->assertSame(2, $count);

        foreach ([[$pending, AppointmentStatus::Pending], [$confirmed, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed]] as [$appointment, $from]) {
            $fresh = $appointment->fresh();
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $fresh->status);
            $this->assertSame('2026-10-06 12:00:01', $fresh->no_show_at->toDateTimeString());
            $this->assertNull($fresh->active_flag);
            $this->assertNull($fresh->cancelled_at);

            $rows = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->get();
            $this->assertCount(1, $rows);
            $this->assertSame($from, $rows[0]->from_status);
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $rows[0]->to_status);
            $this->assertSame(ActorType::Staff, $rows[0]->actor_type);
            $this->assertSame($staff->id, (int) $rows[0]->actor_user_id);
            $this->assertSame('Pasien tidak datang sampai sesi berakhir', $rows[0]->reason);
        }

        $logs = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->orderBy('id')->get();
        $this->assertCount(2, $logs);

        $oldStatus = [$pending->id => 'pending', $confirmed->id => 'confirmed'];

        foreach ($logs as $log) {
            $this->assertSame(ActorType::Staff, $log->actor_type);
            $this->assertSame($staff->id, (int) $log->user_id);
            $this->assertSame($pending->getMorphClass(), $log->auditable_type);
            $this->assertSame(['status' => $oldStatus[(int) $log->auditable_id]], $log->old_values);
            $this->assertSame(['status' => 'no_show', 'reason' => 'Pasien tidak datang sampai sesi berakhir'], $log->new_values);
        }

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing(array_keys($oldStatus), $logs->map(fn (AuditLog $log): int => (int) $log->auditable_id)->all());
    }

    public function test_the_system_actor_leaves_no_user_and_no_reason_in_history_and_audit(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $count = $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::system());

        $this->assertSame(1, $count);

        $row = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->sole();
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::System, $row->actor_type);
        $this->assertNull($row->actor_user_id);
        $this->assertNull($row->reason);

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->sole();
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::System, $log->actor_type);
        $this->assertNull($log->user_id);
        $this->assertSame(['status' => 'no_show'], $log->new_values);
    }

    public function test_only_pending_and_confirmed_are_marked_and_the_count_is_honest(): void
    {
        $pending = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $checkedIn = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $completed = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Completed);
        $cancelled = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);

        $count = $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::system());

        $this->assertSame(1, $count);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $this->statusOf($pending));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->statusOf($checkedIn));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Completed, $this->statusOf($completed));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->statusOf($cancelled));
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->historyCount());
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($checkedIn));
    }

    public function test_an_ended_session_without_pending_or_confirmed_appointments_returns_zero_without_error(): void
    {
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Completed);
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::system()));
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount());
    }

    public function test_a_closed_session_that_has_ended_is_processed_like_an_open_one(): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], [], 'closed');

        $this->assertSame(1, $this->service->markNoShowForSession($session, Actor::system()));
        $this->assertSame(1, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('to_status', 'no_show')->count());
    }

    public function test_no_show_keeps_booked_count_and_last_queue_number(): void
    {
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);

        $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::system());

        $fresh = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($this->session->id);
        $this->assertSame(3, $fresh->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(3, $fresh->last_queue_number);
    }

    public function test_the_second_call_is_idempotent_and_writes_nothing_more(): void
    {
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->assertSame(2, $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::system()));

        $audits = AuditLog::query()->count();

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::system()));
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->historyCount());
        $this->assertSame($audits, AuditLog::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(2, Appointment::query()->where('status', 'no_show')->count());
    }

    public function test_the_reason_is_trimmed_and_blank_becomes_null(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->assertSame(1, $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::staff(User::factory()->staff()->create()), '   '));

        $this->assertNull(AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->value('reason'));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ E5: batas waktu

    public function test_e5_marking_is_rejected_until_after_the_exact_end_and_accepted_one_second_later(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $staff = Actor::staff(User::factory()->staff()->create());

        foreach (['2026-10-06 11:59:59', '2026-10-06 12:00:00'] as $moment) {
            $this->at($moment);

            $e = $this->assertFails('SESSION_NOT_ENDED', fn () => $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, $staff));

            $this->assertSame('Tandai tidak hadir hanya dapat dilakukan setelah sesi berakhir (pukul 12.00).', $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertSame(['practice_session_id' => $this->session->id], $e->context);
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->statusOf($appointment), $moment);
            $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount(), $moment);
        }

        $this->at('2026-10-06 12:00:01');

        $this->assertSame(1, $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, $staff));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    public function test_a_session_on_a_later_day_has_not_ended(): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['session_date' => '2026-10-07']);

        $this->assertFails('SESSION_NOT_ENDED', fn () => $this->service->markNoShowForSession($session, Actor::system()));
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ E5: sesi needs_review

    public function test_e5_a_needs_review_session_is_rejected_with_the_review_message_even_after_it_ended(): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::Pending], ['session_date' => '2026-10-05'], 'needs_review');

        $e = $this->assertFails('INVALID_TRANSITION', fn () => $this->service->markNoShowForSession($session, Actor::staff(User::factory()->staff()->create())));

        $this->assertSame('Sesi ini sedang menunggu penyelesaian di layar Sesi terdampak.', $e->getMessage());
        $this->assertSame(['practice_session_id' => $session->id], $e->context);
        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->where('status', 'no_show')->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount());
    }

    public function test_the_review_check_comes_before_the_time_check(): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['session_date' => '2026-10-07'], 'needs_review');

        $e = $this->assertFails('INVALID_TRANSITION', fn () => $this->service->markNoShowForSession($session, Actor::system()));

        $this->assertSame('Sesi ini sedang menunggu penyelesaian di layar Sesi terdampak.', $e->getMessage());
    }

    public function test_a_stale_session_instance_does_not_hide_a_needs_review_status(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $stale = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($this->session->id);

        PracticeSession::query()->whereKey($this->session->id)->toBase()->update([
            'status' => 'needs_review',
            'pending_change' => json_encode(['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => 1]),
        ]);

        $this->assertFails('INVALID_TRANSITION', fn () => $this->service->markNoShowForSession($stale, Actor::system()));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ perubahan oleh pihak lain di tengah proses

    /** @return array<string, array{0: array<string, string>, 1: AppointmentStatus}> */
    public static function changedByAnotherUser(): array
    {
        return [
            'check-in oleh petugas lain (INVALID_TRANSITION)' => [['status' => 'checked_in', 'checked_in_at' => '2026-10-06 11:00:00'], AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn],
            'sudah ditandai oleh petugas lain (ALREADY_FINAL)' => [['status' => 'no_show', 'no_show_at' => '2026-10-06 12:00:00'], AppointmentStatus::NoShow],
        ];
    }

    /** @param array<string, string> $change */
    #[DataProvider('changedByAnotherUser')]
    public function test_an_appointment_changed_by_someone_else_in_the_meantime_is_skipped_without_error_and_not_counted(array $change, AppointmentStatus $expectedStatus): void
    {
        $first = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $second = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $firstProfileId = (int) $first->patient_profile_id;
        $secondId = $second->id;
        $fired = false;

        // Saat transaksi appointment PERTAMA mengunci profilnya (transaksinya berhasil dan dilepas), "petugas lain" mengubah
        // appointment kedua; jangan memicu di dalam transaksi kedua sendiri: savepoint-nya digulung dan perubahan ikut hilang.
        DB::connection()->beforeExecuting(function (string $query, array $bindings) use (&$fired, $firstProfileId, $secondId, $change): void {
            $sql = strtolower($query);

            if ($fired || ! str_contains($sql, 'from `patient_profiles`') || ! str_contains($sql, 'for update') || (int) ($bindings[0] ?? 0) !== $firstProfileId) {
                return;
            }

            $fired = true;
            DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $secondId)->update($change);
        });

        $count = $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::system());

        $this->assertTrue($fired, 'Penyisipan perubahan pihak lain tidak terpicu.');
        $this->assertSame(1, $count);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $this->statusOf($first));
        $this->assertSame($expectedStatus, $this->statusOf($second));
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->historyCount($first));
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($second));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ notifikasi (NTF-03, NTF-07)

    public function test_a_patient_with_an_account_gets_a_database_only_notification_and_a_walk_in_gets_none(): void
    {
        $withAccount = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $walkIn = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending, false);
        $recipient = User::query()->findOrFail(PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($withAccount->patient_profile_id)->value('user_id'));
        Notification::fake();

        $count = $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::system());

        $this->assertSame(2, $count);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $this->statusOf($walkIn));

        Notification::assertSentToTimes($recipient, AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class, 1);
        Notification::assertSentTo(
            $recipient,
            AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class,
            fn (AppointmentStatusChangedNotification $notification, array $channels): bool => $channels === ['database']
                && $notification->from === AppointmentStatus::Confirmed
                && $notification->to === AppointmentStatus::NoShow,
        );
        Notification::assertCount(1);
    }

    public function test_the_stored_notification_has_the_no_show_title_and_no_sensitive_data_and_the_walk_in_creates_no_row(): void
    {
        $withAccount = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending, false);
        $recipient = User::query()->findOrFail(PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($withAccount->patient_profile_id)->value('user_id'));

        $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::system());

        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('notifications')->count());

        $data = $recipient->notifications()->sole()->data;
        $this->assertSame('no_show', $data['status']);
        $this->assertSame('Ditandai tidak hadir', $data['title']);
        $this->assertSame($withAccount->booking_code, $data['booking_code']);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ sessionsAwaitingNoShow

    public function test_sessions_awaiting_no_show_lists_ended_open_and_closed_sessions_with_pending_or_confirmed_in_order(): void
    {
        $a = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '16:00:00']);
        $h = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['start_time' => '06:00:00', 'end_time' => '08:00:00'], 'closed');
        $c = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Pending], ['start_time' => '07:00:00', 'end_time' => '10:00:00']);
        $b = $this->session;
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        // Tidak masuk: belum berakhir, tanggal depan, needs_review, cancelled, hanya status lain, tanpa appointment.
        $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00']);
        $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['session_date' => '2026-10-07']);
        $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['session_date' => '2026-10-05'], 'needs_review');
        $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['session_date' => '2026-10-05'], 'cancelled');
        $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, AppointmentStatus::Completed, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, AppointmentStatus::NoShow], ['session_date' => '2026-10-05']);
        $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05']);

        $sessions = $this->service->sessionsAwaitingNoShow();

        $this->assertSame([$a->id, $h->id, $c->id, $b->id], $sessions->map(fn (PracticeSession $session): int => (int) $session->id)->all());
        $this->assertTrue($sessions->first()->relationLoaded('clinic'));
        $this->assertTrue($sessions->first()->relationLoaded('doctor'));
    }

    public function test_sessions_awaiting_no_show_can_be_limited_to_one_date(): void
    {
        $yesterday = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['session_date' => '2026-10-05']);
        $today = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Pending]);

        $this->assertSame([$today->id], $this->service->sessionsAwaitingNoShow(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06'))->pluck('id')->map(fn ($id): int => (int) $id)->all());
        $this->assertSame([$yesterday->id], $this->service->sessionsAwaitingNoShow(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05'))->pluck('id')->map(fn ($id): int => (int) $id)->all());
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->service->sessionsAwaitingNoShow(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-04')));
    }

    public function test_sessions_awaiting_no_show_uses_a_strict_end_boundary_and_honours_the_now_argument(): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed]);

        $this->at('2026-10-06 12:00:00');
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->service->sessionsAwaitingNoShow());

        $this->at('2026-10-06 12:00:01');
        $this->assertSame([$session->id], $this->service->sessionsAwaitingNoShow()->map(fn (PracticeSession $found): int => (int) $found->id)->all());

        // Parameter $now menggantikan jam dinding (kini 11.00): tepat 12.00.00 belum berakhir, 12.00.01 sudah
        // (05.00.01 UTC = 12.00.01 WIB, dibaca dalam zona aplikasi).
        $this->at('2026-10-06 11:00:00');
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->service->sessionsAwaitingNoShow());
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->service->sessionsAwaitingNoShow(null, CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06 12:00:00')));
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->service->sessionsAwaitingNoShow(null, CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06 12:00:01')));
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->service->sessionsAwaitingNoShow(null, CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06 05:00:01', 'UTC')));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pendingNoShowCount

    public function test_pending_no_show_count_counts_only_pending_and_confirmed_of_that_session_regardless_of_time(): void
    {
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Completed);
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::NoShow);
        $other = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed]);
        $future = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Pending], ['session_date' => '2026-10-07']);
        $review = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['session_date' => '2026-10-05'], 'needs_review');

        $this->assertSame(2, $this->service->pendingNoShowCount($this->session));
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->service->pendingNoShowCount($other));
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->service->pendingNoShowCount($future));
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->service->pendingNoShowCount($review));

        $this->service->markNoShowForSession($this->session, Actor::system());

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->service->pendingNoShowCount($this->session));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ markNoShowForDate

    public function test_mark_no_show_for_date_processes_ended_sessions_of_that_date_or_all_and_skips_review_and_running_sessions(): void
    {
        $yesterday = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['session_date' => '2026-10-05']);
        $today = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn]);
        $running = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00']);
        $review = $this->sessionWith([AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['session_date' => '2026-10-05'], 'needs_review');
        $system = Actor::system();

        $this->assertSame(1, $this->service->markNoShowForDate(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06'), $system));
        $this->assertSame(1, Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $today->id)->where('status', 'no_show')->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $yesterday->id)->where('status', 'no_show')->count());

        $this->assertSame(2, $this->service->markNoShowForDate(null, $system));
        $this->assertSame(2, Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $yesterday->id)->where('status', 'no_show')->count());

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->service->markNoShowForDate(null, $system));

        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $running->id)->where('status', 'no_show')->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $review->id)->where('status', 'no_show')->count());
        $this->assertSame(3, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('to_status', 'no_show')->where('actor_type', 'system')->count());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ teks lang

    public function test_the_no_show_texts_are_the_documented_ones(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('3 pendaftaran ditandai tidak hadir.', __('booking.no_show.done', ['count' => 3]));
        $this->assertSame('Tidak ada pendaftaran yang perlu ditandai tidak hadir pada sesi ini.', __('booking.no_show.nothing'));
        $this->assertSame('Centang konfirmasi untuk menandai seluruh pendaftaran yang belum hadir sebagai tidak hadir.', __('booking.no_show.confirm_required'));
        $this->assertSame('Sesi ini sedang menunggu penyelesaian di layar Sesi terdampak.', __('booking.transitions.SESSION_UNDER_REVIEW'));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Console;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Event;
use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R7, BKG-16: `php artisan appointments:mark-no-show {--date=}` dan penjadwalnya. Waktu tes: Selasa
 * 2026-10-06 12.30 WIB (sesi 09.00-12.00 hari ini sudah berakhir). Tes SYSTEM_BUSY dan retry massal milik T11.
 */
class MarkNoShowAppointmentsTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const NOTHING = 'Tidak ada pendaftaran yang perlu ditandai tidak hadir.';

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06 12:30:00'));
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pembantu

    /** Sesi tambahan manual dengan nama poliklinik dan dokter yang diketahui (untuk keluaran per sesi). */
    private function sessionAt(string $date, string $start, string $end, string $clinic, string $doctor, string $state = 'open'): PracticeSession
    {
        $factory = PracticeSession::factory()->manual();
        $factory = $state === 'needs_review'
            ? $factory->needsReview(['source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_EXCEPTION, 'exception_id' => 1])
            : $factory;

        $session = $factory->create([
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => $start,
            'end_time' => $end,
            'quota' => 20,
        ]);

        Clinic::query()->whereKey($session->clinic_id)->firstOrFail()->forceFill(['name' => $clinic])->save();
        Doctor::query()->whereKey($session->doctor_id)->firstOrFail()->forceFill(['name' => $doctor])->save();

        return $session;
    }

    private function appointment(PracticeSession $session, AppointmentStatus $status): Appointment
    {
        return $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, ['patient_profile_id' => PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create()->id]);
    }

    private function statusOf(Appointment $appointment): AppointmentStatus
    {
        return $appointment->fresh()->status;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ tanpa --date

    public function test_without_the_date_option_it_marks_every_ended_session_and_prints_each_session_and_a_summary(): void
    {
        $s1 = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-05', '13:00:00', '16:00:00', 'Poliklinik Anak', 'dr. Budi Santoso');
        $a1 = $this->appointment($s1, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $a2 = $this->appointment($s1, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $s2 = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-06', '09:00:00', '12:00:00', 'Poliklinik Gigi', 'drg. Sari Dewi');
        $a3 = $this->appointment($s2, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $a4 = $this->appointment($s2, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $s3 = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-06', '13:00:00', '15:00:00', 'Poliklinik Mata', 'dr. Joko Widodo');
        $a5 = $this->appointment($s3, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->artisan('appointments:mark-no-show')
            ->expectsOutputToContain('- 05/10/2026 13.00–16.00 Poliklinik Anak, dr. Budi Santoso: 2 pendaftaran.')
            ->expectsOutputToContain('- 06/10/2026 09.00–12.00 Poliklinik Gigi, drg. Sari Dewi: 1 pendaftaran.')
            ->expectsOutputToContain('3 pendaftaran pada 2 sesi ditandai tidak hadir.')
            ->doesntExpectOutputToContain('Poliklinik Mata')
            ->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $this->statusOf($a1));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $this->statusOf($a2));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $this->statusOf($a3));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->statusOf($a4));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->statusOf($a5));

        $histories = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->get();
        $this->assertCount(3, $histories);

        foreach ($histories as $history) {
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $history->to_status);
            $this->assertSame(ActorType::System, $history->actor_type);
            $this->assertNull($history->actor_user_id);
        }

        $audits = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->get();
        $this->assertCount(3, $audits);

        foreach ($audits as $audit) {
            $this->assertSame(ActorType::System, $audit->actor_type);
            $this->assertNull($audit->user_id);
        }
    }

    public function test_a_second_run_is_idempotent_and_prints_the_nothing_to_mark_message(): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-06', '09:00:00', '12:00:00', 'Poliklinik Anak', 'dr. Budi Santoso');
        $this->appointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->artisan('appointments:mark-no-show')
            ->expectsOutputToContain('1 pendaftaran pada 1 sesi ditandai tidak hadir.')
            ->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->artisan('appointments:mark-no-show')
            ->expectsOutputToContain(self::NOTHING)
            ->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->assertSame(1, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->count());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ dengan --date

    public function test_the_date_option_limits_processing_to_that_date(): void
    {
        $yesterday = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-05', '13:00:00', '16:00:00', 'Poliklinik Anak', 'dr. Budi Santoso');
        $a1 = $this->appointment($yesterday, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $today = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-06', '09:00:00', '12:00:00', 'Poliklinik Gigi', 'drg. Sari Dewi');
        $a2 = $this->appointment($today, AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->artisan('appointments:mark-no-show', ['--date' => '2026-10-05'])
            ->expectsOutputToContain('- 05/10/2026 13.00–16.00 Poliklinik Anak, dr. Budi Santoso: 1 pendaftaran.')
            ->expectsOutputToContain('1 pendaftaran pada 1 sesi ditandai tidak hadir.')
            ->doesntExpectOutputToContain('Poliklinik Gigi')
            ->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $this->statusOf($a1));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Pending, $this->statusOf($a2));
    }

    public function test_today_is_an_accepted_date_and_only_ended_sessions_of_today_are_processed(): void
    {
        $ended = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-06', '09:00:00', '12:00:00', 'Poliklinik Gigi', 'drg. Sari Dewi');
        $a1 = $this->appointment($ended, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $running = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-06', '13:00:00', '15:00:00', 'Poliklinik Mata', 'dr. Joko Widodo');
        $a2 = $this->appointment($running, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->artisan('appointments:mark-no-show', ['--date' => '2026-10-06'])
            ->expectsOutputToContain('- 06/10/2026 09.00–12.00 Poliklinik Gigi, drg. Sari Dewi: 1 pendaftaran.')
            ->expectsOutputToContain('1 pendaftaran pada 1 sesi ditandai tidak hadir.')
            ->doesntExpectOutputToContain('Poliklinik Mata')
            ->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $this->statusOf($a1));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->statusOf($a2));
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{string}> */
    public static function invalidDates(): array
    {
        return [
            'huruf' => ['abc'],
            'bulan dan hari di luar rentang' => ['2026-13-40'],
            'format Indonesia' => ['05/10/2026'],
            'tanpa nol di depan' => ['2026-1-5'],
            'kosong' => [''],
            'tanggal tidak ada di kalender' => ['2026-02-30'],
            'dengan jam' => ['2026-10-05 10:00'],
            'tahun dua digit' => ['26-10-05'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('invalidDates')]
    public function test_a_malformed_date_option_is_rejected_with_exit_code_one_and_changes_nothing(string $value): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-05', '13:00:00', '16:00:00', 'Poliklinik Anak', 'dr. Budi Santoso');
        $appointment = $this->appointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->artisan('appointments:mark-no-show', ['--date' => $value])
            ->expectsOutputToContain('Opsi --date harus berupa tanggal dengan format YYYY-MM-DD.')
            ->assertExitCode(1);

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Pending, $this->statusOf($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(0, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->count());
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{string}> */
    public static function futureDates(): array
    {
        return [
            'besok' => ['2026-10-07'],
            'jauh di depan' => ['2099-01-01'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('futureDates')]
    public function test_a_date_after_today_is_rejected_with_exit_code_one_and_changes_nothing(string $value): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-05', '13:00:00', '16:00:00', 'Poliklinik Anak', 'dr. Budi Santoso');
        $appointment = $this->appointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->artisan('appointments:mark-no-show', ['--date' => $value])
            ->expectsOutputToContain('Opsi --date tidak boleh tanggal setelah hari ini.')
            ->assertExitCode(1);

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ tanpa sesi

    public function test_with_nothing_to_mark_it_says_so_and_exits_with_zero(): void
    {
        $this->artisan('appointments:mark-no-show')
            ->expectsOutputToContain(self::NOTHING)
            ->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->artisan('appointments:mark-no-show', ['--date' => '2026-10-01'])
            ->expectsOutputToContain(self::NOTHING)
            ->assertExitCode(0);
    }

    public function test_sessions_without_pending_or_confirmed_appointments_and_needs_review_sessions_are_ignored(): void
    {
        $onlyCheckedIn = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-06', '09:00:00', '12:00:00', 'Poliklinik Gigi', 'drg. Sari Dewi');
        $checkedIn = $this->appointment($onlyCheckedIn, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $review = $this->sessionAt('2026-10-05', '09:00:00', '12:00:00', 'Poliklinik Anak', 'dr. Budi Santoso', 'needs_review');
        $reviewed = $this->appointment($review, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->artisan('appointments:mark-no-show')
            ->expectsOutputToContain(self::NOTHING)
            ->doesntExpectOutputToContain('Poliklinik')
            ->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->statusOf($checkedIn));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->statusOf($reviewed));
        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->where('status', 'no_show')->count());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ jadwal

    public function test_the_scheduler_runs_the_command_daily_at_half_past_eleven_pm_without_overlapping(): void
    {
        $events = collect(app(Schedule::class)->events())
            ->filter(fn (Event $event): bool => str_contains((string) $event->command, 'appointments:mark-no-show'));

        $this->assertCount(1, $events);

        $event = $events->first();
        $this->assertSame('30 23 * * *', $event->expression);
        $this->assertTrue($event->withoutOverlapping);
    }

    public function test_the_session_generation_schedule_is_untouched(): void
    {
        $events = collect(app(Schedule::class)->events())
            ->filter(fn (Event $event): bool => str_contains((string) $event->command, 'sessions:generate'));

        $this->assertCount(1, $events);
        $this->assertSame('5 0 * * *', $events->first()->expression);
    }
}
```


Dengan:

```text
    /**
     * Menandai `no_show` semua appointment `pending`/`confirmed` pada satu sesi yang sudah berakhir (F7A-R6,
     * BR-65/BR-66). Setiap appointment diproses satu per satu lewat transition() (transaksi sendiri, urutan kunci
     * baku, 3 percobaan) TANPA transaksi luar, sehingga deadlock tidak merembet lintas pasien dan proses aman
     * diulang. Appointment yang statusnya sudah diubah pihak lain (transisi tak sah, status final) dilewati
     * dan tidak dihitung; SYSTEM_BUSY menghentikan proses dan diteruskan ke pemanggil. `expected` tidak dipakai.
     *
     * @return int jumlah appointment yang benar-benar ditandai
     *
     * @throws InvalidTransitionException sesi `needs_review` (INVALID_TRANSITION) atau belum berakhir (SESSION_NOT_ENDED); tidak ada yang ditulis
     * @throws BookingException SYSTEM_BUSY
     */
    public function markNoShowForSession(PracticeSession $session, Actor $actor, ?string $reason = null): int
    {
        $sessionId = (int) $session->getKey();
        // Baca ulang (SELECT biasa): status dan jam pada instance pemanggil bisa basi.
        $current = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($sessionId);

        if ($current->status === SessionStatus::NeedsReview) {
            throw InvalidTransitionException::makeVariant(
                InvalidTransitionException::INVALID_TRANSITION,
                'SESSION_UNDER_REVIEW',
                [],
                ['practice_session_id' => $sessionId],
            );
        }

        // Batas strik (sama dengan jendela after_end): tepat pada end_time belum berakhir. Bukan PracticeSession::isEnded() (<=).
        if (! $this->momentOf(null)->greaterThan($current->ends_at)) {
            throw InvalidTransitionException::make(
                InvalidTransitionException::SESSION_NOT_ENDED,
                ['time' => $current->ends_at->format('H.i')],
                ['practice_session_id' => $sessionId],
            );
        }

        $appointments = Appointment::query()
            ->where('appointments.practice_session_id', $sessionId)
            ->whereIn('appointments.status', $this->awaitingStatuses())
            ->orderBy('appointments.queue_number')
            ->orderBy('appointments.id')
            ->get();

        $marked = 0;

        foreach ($appointments as $appointment) {
            try {
                $this->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $actor, $reason);
                $marked++;
            } catch (InvalidTransitionException) {
                // Diubah pihak lain sejak daftar dibaca (check-in, sudah no_show, dibatalkan): dilewati, tidak dihitung.
                continue;
            }
        }

        return $marked;
    }

    /**
     * Menandai tidak hadir semua sesi yang sudah berakhir pada `$date` (null = semua sesi lampau yang masih punya
     * appointment `pending`/`confirmed`). Sesi `needs_review` tidak pernah masuk daftar; sesi yang berubah
     * menjadi `needs_review` di tengah proses dilewati. `SYSTEM_BUSY` diteruskan ke pemanggil.
     *
     * @return int total appointment yang ditandai
     */
    public function markNoShowForDate(?CarbonInterface $date, Actor $actor): int
    {
        $total = 0;

        foreach ($this->sessionsAwaitingNoShow($date) as $session) {
            try {
                $total += $this->markNoShowForSession($session, $actor);
            } catch (InvalidTransitionException) {
                continue;
            }
        }

        return $total;
    }

    /**
     * Sesi yang sudah berakhir dan masih punya appointment `pending`/`confirmed` (F7A-R6): status `open`/`closed`
     * (bukan `needs_review`/`cancelled`), `now > ends_at` STRIK (tepat `end_time` belum berakhir), opsional satu
     * tanggal; urut `session_date`, `start_time`, `id`; eager `clinic` dan `doctor`.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, PracticeSession>
     */
    public function sessionsAwaitingNoShow(?CarbonInterface $date = null, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): Collection
    {
        $moment = $this->momentOf($now);

        return PracticeSession::query()
            ->with(['clinic', 'doctor'])
            ->whereIn('practice_sessions.status', [SessionStatus::Open->value, SessionStatus::Closed->value])
            ->where(function (Builder $ended) use ($moment): void {
                $ended->where('practice_sessions.session_date', '<', $moment->toDateString())
                    ->orWhere(function (Builder $today) use ($moment): void {
                        $today->where('practice_sessions.session_date', $moment->toDateString())
                            ->where('practice_sessions.end_time', '<', $moment->format('H:i:s'));
                    });
            })
            ->whereHas('appointments', fn (Builder $appointments): Builder => $appointments->whereIn('appointments.status', $this->awaitingStatuses()))
            ->when($date !== null, fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->where('practice_sessions.session_date', $date->toDateString()))
            ->orderBy('practice_sessions.session_date')
            ->orderBy('practice_sessions.start_time')
            ->orderBy('practice_sessions.id')
            ->get();
    }

    /** Jumlah appointment `pending`/`confirmed` pada sesi itu, tanpa syarat waktu (untuk banner antrean). */
    public function pendingNoShowCount(PracticeSession $session): int
    {
        return Appointment::query()
            ->where('appointments.practice_session_id', $session->getKey())
            ->whereIn('appointments.status', $this->awaitingStatuses())
            ->count();
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    private function awaitingStatuses(): array
    {
        return [AppointmentStatus::Pending->value, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed->value];
    }

    private function applyLocked(int $appointmentId, int $profileId, int $sessionId, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, ?string $reason, ?AppointmentStatus $expected): Appointment
    {
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Perintah (tool Write) `app/Console/Commands/MarkNoShowAppointments.php`**

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentStatusService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use DateTimeImmutable;
use DateTimeZone;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;

/**
 * Pemicu otomatis T10 (00 F.8, F7A-R7): `php artisan appointments:mark-no-show {--date=}`. Menandai tidak hadir
 * appointment `pending`/`confirmed` pada sesi yang sudah berakhir, dengan pelaku sistem. Tanpa `--date` = semua
 * sesi yang sudah berakhir. Idempoten (yang sudah `no_show` tidak diproses lagi). Sesi `needs_review` dilewati.
 * Dijadwalkan harian pukul 23.30 (routes/console.php).
 */
class MarkNoShowAppointments extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'appointments:mark-no-show {--date= : Tanggal YYYY-MM-DD (bawaan: semua sesi yang sudah berakhir)}';

    protected $description = 'Tandai tidak hadir pendaftaran yang belum check-in pada sesi praktik yang sudah berakhir';

    public function handle(AppointmentStatusService $service): int
    {
        $date = null;
        $option = $this->option('date');

        if ($option !== null) {
            $date = $this->parseDate((string) $option);

            if ($date === null) {
                $this->error('Opsi --date harus berupa tanggal dengan format YYYY-MM-DD.');

                return self::FAILURE;
            }

            if ($date->greaterThan(CarbonImmutable::today())) {
                $this->error('Opsi --date tidak boleh tanggal setelah hari ini.');

                return self::FAILURE;
            }
        }

        $sessions = $service->sessionsAwaitingNoShow($date);

        if ($sessions->isEmpty()) {
            $this->info('Tidak ada pendaftaran yang perlu ditandai tidak hadir.');

            return self::SUCCESS;
        }

        $actor = Actor::system();
        $total = 0;
        $processed = 0;

        foreach ($sessions as $session) {
            try {
                $count = $service->markNoShowForSession($session, $actor);
            } catch (InvalidTransitionException) {
                // Berubah menjadi needs_review (atau belum berakhir) sejak daftar dibaca: dilewati.
                continue;
            } catch (BookingException $e) {
                if ($e->errorCode !== BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY) {
                    throw $e;
                }

                $this->error("Sistem sedang sibuk; {$total} pendaftaran sudah ditandai sebelum berhenti. Jalankan ulang perintah ini.");

                return self::FAILURE;
            }

            $total += $count;
            $processed++;

            $this->line("- {$session->session_date->format('d/m/Y')} {$session->time_range} {$session->clinic->name}, {$session->doctor->name}: {$count} pendaftaran.");
        }

        $this->info("{$total} pendaftaran pada {$processed} sesi ditandai tidak hadir.");

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    /** Tanggal `Y-m-d` yang sah (tanpa limpahan seperti 2026-02-30) pukul 00.00 zona aplikasi, atau NULL. */
    private function parseDate(string $value): ?CarbonImmutable
    {
        $parsed = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $value, new DateTimeZone((string) config('app.timezone')));

        if ($parsed === false || $parsed->format('Y-m-d') !== $value) {
            return null;
        }

        return CarbonImmutable::instance($parsed);
    }
}
```

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**

Kunci lain pada `$validated` (mis. `bpjs_number`, `user_id`, `is_active`) DIABAIKAN karena service hanya membaca enam kunci eksplisit (V-13: walk-in tanpa BPJS; BPJS profil hanya lewat booking `save_bpjs` atau pasien sendiri). `Actor::staff($staff)` dibuat SEBELUM transaksi agar akun yang belum tersimpan gagal tanpa menyentuh DB.
2. **Audit tanpa PII.** `patient.created` `null` → `{"patient_number","registration_channel":"loket","consent_version"}`; deskripsi `Profil pasien {nomor} dibuat oleh petugas (walk-in).` Tidak ada nama, telepon, email, alamat, atau tanggal lahir (SEK-11).
3. **`changeStatus`.** Urutan: normalisasi alasan (trim; kosong = `null`) → transaksi → `lockForUpdate` profil lewat PK (kunci pertama sesuai urutan baku `patient_profiles` → …; `BookingService` juga mengunci profil lebih dulu, sehingga hitungan pendaftaran aktif di bawah kunci tidak dapat disalip booking baru) → status sama = kembali tanpa tulis dan tanpa audit (instance pemanggil tetap disinkronkan) → menonaktifkan: hitung `Appointment::active()` milik profil (semua tanggal; `pending`/`confirmed`/`checked_in`) dan tolak bila N > 0 → `forceFill(['is_active'])->save()` → bila `user_id` ada: `User::query()->whereKey()->update(['is_active' => …])` (tanpa event model; `User` tidak diobservasi `AuditObserver`) dan, saat dinonaktifkan, `DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', …)->delete()` → audit `patient.status_changed`. Alasan HANYA dicatat di audit bila ada; kewajiban alasan saat menonaktifkan (V-18) milik Form Request (T6).
4. **`PatientSearch::apply`** mengikuti F7A-R16 persis. Detail yang dikunci tes: istilah dipotong 100 karakter lalu di-trim; aturan (1) berlaku bila cocok `/^[Pp]?\d{1,7}$/` DAN (ada huruf P ATAU ≤ 6 digit) sehingga `1234567` (7 digit tanpa P) jatuh ke pencarian nama, sedangkan `P1234567` adalah nomor pasien; nomor pasien = `'P'.str_pad($digit, 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT)` (string, tanpa `(int)`); tanggal `dd/mm/yyyy` harus sah (`31/02/2026` bukan tanggal → jatuh ke nama); telepon = cocok `IndonesianPhone::PATTERN` setelah normalisasi → `phone LIKE normal%`; selain itu `full_name LIKE %term%` lewat `LikePattern` (`%`, `_`, `\` literal). Konsekuensi yang disengaja: istilah 1-7 digit dibaca sebagai nomor pasien, bukan awalan telepon (mis. `08123`).
5. **`similarTo`** (BR-102): hanya profil `is_active = true`; `(lower(full_name) = lower(trim(nama)) DAN birth_date = tanggal)` ATAU `phone = telepon ternormalisasi`; klausa nama+tanggal dilewati bila salah satunya kosong, klausa telepon dilewati bila kosong, dan bila keduanya tak ada hasilnya koleksi kosong (tidak pernah "semua profil"); `$ignoreId` dikecualikan (`whereKeyNot`); urut `id`; maksimum 5.
6. **`PatientAccountLinker`.** `findAccount` = trim + huruf kecil + hanya `account_type = patient` (akun staf tidak pernah ditemukan). `problem()` tanpa kunci dan tanpa tulis dipakai panel UI (T7): urutan pemeriksaan = (1) `walkIn.user_id !== null` → `PROFILE_ALREADY_LINKED` (didahulukan agar pesan penolakan tidak membocorkan keadaan akun), (2) akun `null` atau bukan pasien → `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND`, (3) akun nonaktif → `ACCOUNT_INACTIVE`, (4) profil milik akun punya appointment APA PUN (termasuk `cancelled`) → `ACCOUNT_HAS_HISTORY`. `link()`: satu transaksi; kunci profil walk-in dan profil milik akun menurut id menaik (`whereIn` + `orderBy('id')` + `lockForUpdate`), lalu kunci baris akun, lalu evaluasi ULANG di bawah kunci (instance pemanggil boleh basi) memakai logika `problem()` yang sama; bila profil milik akun berubah sejak dibaca (mis. ditautkan petugas lain lebih dulu) hasilnya `ACCOUNT_HAS_HISTORY`; profil kosong milik akun dihapus, lalu `user_id`, `email` (= email akun), dan `is_active` (= status akun) profil walk-in dipasang; data identitas, nomor pasien, dan persetujuan walk-in dipertahankan. Audit `patient.account_linked` `{"removed_profile":{"id","patient_number","consent_at","consent_version"}|null}` → `{"profile_id","user_id"}`; deskripsi `Profil pasien {nomor} dihubungkan ke akun pasien.` (tanpa email atau nama). Tidak ada pencocokan otomatis berdasarkan email, telepon, atau nama di mana pun (00 F.9).
7. **Tes konkurensi `link`/`PROFILE_ALREADY_LINKED` dua petugas** ada di T11 (butir (d) F7A-R27); di sini hanya pembuktian logika di bawah kunci memakai instance basi.
8. **Mode ketat Eloquent.** Service tidak memakai relasi lazy (semua lewat kueri eksplisit); `PatientProfile::refresh()` dan `setRawAttributes(…, true)` aman.
9. **`lang/id/patients.php`** hanya berisi kunci D (tanpa kunci tambahan) agar T5-T7 dapat mengandalkan isinya persis; deskripsi audit `created` dan `account_linked` ditulis literal di service (pola `register()`), sedangkan deskripsi `status_changed` memakai `patients.status.deactivated|activated` (teksnya sama dengan flash).
10. Jumlah tes baru 74 (terukur di uji coba integrasi).
