```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Patients;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Enums\Gender;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientNumberGenerator;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientRegistrationService;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R8 / WLK-01 sisi service / BR-99, BR-101..BR-103 / SEK-11: profil walk-in dibuat petugas tanpa akun, kanal loket,
 * persetujuan lisan tercatat, nomor pasien sesudah insert, audit `patient.created` tanpa data pribadi. Validasi dan izin
 * ada di Form Request dan Policy (T4, T6); service hanya membaca enam kunci eksplisit.
 */
class WalkInProfileServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private User $staff;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-09 10:15:00');
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        $this->staff = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
    }

    private function service(): PatientRegistrationService
    {
        return $this->app->make(PatientRegistrationService::class);
    }

    /**
     * Data seperti keluaran Form Request: tanpa BPJS dan tanpa field persetujuan.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function payload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return $overrides + [
            'full_name' => 'Budi Santoso',
            'birth_date' => '1985-07-21',
            'gender' => 'L',
            'phone' => '081234567890',
            'email' => null,
            'address' => 'Jl. Melati No. 7, Pamulang, Tangerang Selatan',
        ];
    }

    public function test_it_creates_a_walk_in_profile_without_an_account(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(), $this->staff);

        $stored = PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($profile->id);
        $this->assertSame('Budi Santoso', $stored->full_name);
        $this->assertSame('1985-07-21', $stored->birth_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame(Gender::Male, $stored->gender);
        $this->assertSame('081234567890', $stored->phone);
        $this->assertNull($stored->email);
        $this->assertSame('Jl. Melati No. 7, Pamulang, Tangerang Selatan', $stored->address);
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Loket, $stored->registration_channel);
        $this->assertNull($stored->user_id, 'Walk-in tidak punya akun login.');
        $this->assertSame($this->staff->id, (int) $stored->created_by_user_id);
        $this->assertTrue($stored->is_active);
        $this->assertNull($stored->bpjs_number);
        $this->assertNull($stored->bpjs_number_last4);
        $this->assertSame(1, PatientProfile::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_the_patient_number_is_assigned_after_insert_in_the_p_format(): void
    {
        $first = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(), $this->staff);
        $second = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(['full_name' => 'Siti Aminah']), $this->staff);

        $this->assertSame(PatientNumberGenerator::format($first->id), $first->patient_number);
        $this->assertSame(PatientNumberGenerator::format($second->id), $second->patient_number);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/^P\d{6,}$/', $first->patient_number);
        $this->assertNotSame($first->patient_number, $second->patient_number);
        $this->assertSame($first->patient_number, PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($first->id)->patient_number);
    }

    public function test_the_verbal_consent_is_recorded_with_the_current_time_and_version(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(), $this->staff);

        $this->assertSame('2026-10-09 10:15:00', $profile->consent_at->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
        $this->assertSame('1.0', $profile->consent_version);
    }

    public function test_the_consent_version_follows_the_privacy_setting(): void
    {
        $this->app->make(SettingsService::class)->set('privacy.consent_version', '2.3');

        $profile = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(), $this->staff);

        $this->assertSame('2.3', PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($profile->id)->consent_version);
    }

    public function test_it_normalises_text_phone_and_email(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload([
            'full_name' => '  Budi Santoso ',
            'phone' => '0812-3456-7890',
            'email' => '  Budi.S@Contoh.TEST ',
            'address' => '  Jl. Melati No. 7, Pamulang  ',
        ]), $this->staff);

        $this->assertSame('Budi Santoso', $profile->full_name);
        $this->assertSame('081234567890', $profile->phone);
        $this->assertSame('budi.s@contoh.test', $profile->email);
        $this->assertSame('Jl. Melati No. 7, Pamulang', $profile->address);
    }

    public function test_the_international_phone_format_is_kept_without_punctuation(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(['phone' => '+62 812-3456-7890']), $this->staff);

        $this->assertSame('+6281234567890', $profile->phone);
    }

    public function test_a_blank_or_missing_email_is_stored_as_null(): void
    {
        $blank = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(['email' => '   ']), $this->staff);
        $missing = $this->service()->createWalkIn(array_diff_key($this->payload(), ['email' => true]), $this->staff);

        $this->assertNull($blank->email);
        $this->assertNull($missing->email);
    }

    public function test_the_gender_may_be_given_as_a_value_or_an_enum(): void
    {
        $fromValue = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(['gender' => 'P']), $this->staff);
        $fromEnum = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(['gender' => Gender::Female]), $this->staff);

        $this->assertSame(Gender::Female, $fromValue->gender);
        $this->assertSame(Gender::Female, $fromEnum->gender);
    }

    public function test_keys_outside_the_six_profile_fields_are_ignored(): void
    {
        $other = User::factory()->patient()->create();

        $profile = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload([
            'bpjs_number' => '0001234567890',
            'user_id' => $other->id,
            'created_by_user_id' => $other->id,
            'is_active' => false,
            'registration_channel' => 'online',
            'patient_number' => 'P999999',
            'consent_version' => '9.9',
            'consent_at' => '2020-01-01 00:00:00',
        ]), $this->staff);

        $stored = PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($profile->id);
        $this->assertNull($stored->bpjs_number, 'V-13: nomor BPJS tidak diisi di profil walk-in.');
        $this->assertNull($stored->bpjs_number_last4);
        $this->assertNull($stored->user_id);
        $this->assertSame($this->staff->id, (int) $stored->created_by_user_id);
        $this->assertTrue($stored->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Loket, $stored->registration_channel);
        $this->assertSame(PatientNumberGenerator::format($stored->id), $stored->patient_number);
        $this->assertSame('1.0', $stored->consent_version);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-09 10:15:00', $stored->consent_at->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
    }

    public function test_it_writes_exactly_one_patient_created_audit_row(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(), $this->staff);

        $this->assertSame(1, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'like', 'patient.%')->count());

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.created')->sole();
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Staff, $log->actor_type);
        $this->assertSame($this->staff->id, (int) $log->user_id);
        $this->assertSame($profile->getMorphClass(), $log->auditable_type);
        $this->assertSame($profile->id, (int) $log->auditable_id);
        $this->assertNull($log->old_values);
        $this->assertSame([
            'patient_number' => $profile->patient_number,
            'registration_channel' => 'loket',
            'consent_version' => '1.0',
        ], $log->new_values);
        $this->assertSame("Profil pasien {$profile->patient_number} dibuat oleh petugas (walk-in).", $log->description);
    }

    /** SEK-11: tidak ada data pribadi di baris audit. */
    public function test_the_audit_row_carries_no_personal_data(): void
    {
        $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload([
            'email' => 'budi.s@contoh.test',
            'phone' => '0812-3456-7890',
        ]), $this->staff);

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.created')->sole();
        $dump = $log->description.json_encode($log->new_values).json_encode($log->old_values);

        foreach (['Budi', 'Santoso', '081234567890', '0812-3456-7890', 'budi.s@contoh.test', 'Melati', 'Pamulang', '1985-07-21', '21/07/1985'] as $personal) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($personal, $dump, "Data pribadi bocor ke audit: {$personal}");
        }
    }

    public function test_an_audit_failure_rolls_back_the_profile(): void
    {
        AuditLog::creating(function (): void {
            throw new RuntimeException('Audit gagal ditulis.');
        });

        try {
            $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(), $this->staff);
            $this->fail('Kegagalan audit harus merambat keluar dari service.');
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('Audit gagal ditulis.', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, PatientProfile::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_an_unsaved_staff_account_is_rejected_before_anything_is_written(): void
    {
        try {
            $this->service()->createWalkIn($this->payload(), User::factory()->staff()->make());
            $this->fail('Akun petugas yang belum tersimpan harus ditolak.');
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('Pelaku harus berupa akun yang sudah tersimpan.', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, PatientProfile::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_the_walk_in_messages_are_verbatim(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('Profil pasien P000012 berhasil dibuat.', __('patients.walk_in.created', ['number' => 'P000012']));
        $this->assertSame('Profil pasien P000012 diperbarui.', __('patients.walk_in.updated', ['number' => 'P000012']));
        $this->assertSame('Terdapat profil yang mirip. Pilih profil yang sudah ada atau centang konfirmasi untuk tetap membuat profil baru.', __('patients.walk_in.similar'));
        $this->assertSame('Persetujuan privasi lisan dari pasien wajib dicentang.', __('patients.walk_in.consent_required'));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Patients;

use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientSearch;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R16 (empat jenis istilah, urutan pengenalan), BR-102 (`similarTo`), WLK-02 sisi pencarian. Karakter `%`, `_`, `\`
 * diperlakukan sebagai teks (LikePattern). Tidak ada Form Request di sini (T5).
 */
class PatientSearchTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function search(): PatientSearch
    {
        return $this->app->make(PatientSearch::class);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    private function profile(string $name, array $attributes = []): PatientProfile
    {
        return PatientProfile::factory()->create($attributes + ['full_name' => $name]);
    }

    /**
     * Nama lengkap hasil pencarian, urut id.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function names(string $term): array
    {
        return $this->search()->apply(PatientProfile::query(), $term)->orderBy('id')->pluck('full_name')->all();
    }

    // --- istilah kosong ---

    public function test_an_empty_or_blank_term_leaves_the_query_untouched(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Ani Wulandari');
        $this->profile('Budi Hartono');

        foreach (['', '   ', "\t\n"] as $term) {
            $query = PatientProfile::query();
            $result = $this->search()->apply($query, $term);

            $this->assertSame($query, $result);
            $this->assertSame(PatientProfile::query()->toSql(), $result->toSql(), 'Istilah kosong tidak menambah kondisi.');
            $this->assertSame(2, $result->count());
        }
    }

    // --- (1) nomor pasien ---

    public function test_a_patient_number_term_is_recognised_in_all_its_forms(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Ani Wulandari', ['patient_number' => 'P000012']);
        $this->profile('Budi Hartono', ['patient_number' => 'P000123']);
        $this->profile('Citra Dewi', ['patient_number' => 'P123456']);
        $this->profile('Dedi Kurnia', ['patient_number' => 'P1234567']);

        $this->assertSame(['Ani Wulandari'], $this->names('P000012'));
        $this->assertSame(['Ani Wulandari'], $this->names('p000012'));
        $this->assertSame(['Ani Wulandari'], $this->names('p12'));
        $this->assertSame(['Ani Wulandari'], $this->names('12'));
        $this->assertSame(['Ani Wulandari'], $this->names('000012'));
        $this->assertSame(['Budi Hartono'], $this->names('  123  '));
        $this->assertSame(['Citra Dewi'], $this->names('123456'));
        $this->assertSame(['Dedi Kurnia'], $this->names('P1234567'));
    }

    public function test_seven_digits_without_the_p_prefix_are_not_a_patient_number(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Dedi Kurnia', ['patient_number' => 'P1234567']);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->names('1234567'), 'Tujuh digit tanpa P jatuh ke pencarian nama.');
        $this->assertSame([], $this->names('P12345678'), 'Delapan digit bukan nomor pasien dan bukan nama.');
    }

    public function test_a_short_digit_string_is_a_patient_number_and_never_a_phone_prefix(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Gita Lestari', ['phone' => '081234567890', 'patient_number' => 'P000050']);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->names('08123'), 'Lima digit dibaca sebagai nomor P008123.');
    }

    // --- (2) tanggal lahir ---

    public function test_a_birth_date_term_in_day_month_year_matches_the_exact_date(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Eka Putri', ['birth_date' => '1985-07-21']);
        $this->profile('Fajar Nugroho', ['birth_date' => '1985-07-22']);

        $this->assertSame(['Eka Putri'], $this->names('21/07/1985'));
        $this->assertSame(['Fajar Nugroho'], $this->names(' 22/07/1985 '));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->names('23/07/1985'));
    }

    public function test_an_impossible_or_differently_formatted_date_falls_back_to_the_name_search(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Eka Putri', ['birth_date' => '1985-03-03']);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->names('31/02/1985'), 'Tanggal tidak sah tidak digulirkan menjadi 03/03/1985.');
        $this->assertSame([], $this->names('1985-03-03'));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->names('3/3/1985'));
    }

    // --- (3) telepon ---

    public function test_a_valid_phone_term_matches_by_normalised_prefix(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Gita Lestari', ['phone' => '081234567890']);
        $this->profile('Hana Putri', ['phone' => '0812345678901']);
        $this->profile('Indra Wijaya', ['phone' => '081999999999']);
        $this->profile('Joko Susilo', ['phone' => '+6281234567890']);

        $this->assertSame(['Gita Lestari', 'Hana Putri'], $this->names('081234567890'));
        $this->assertSame(['Gita Lestari', 'Hana Putri'], $this->names('0812-3456-7890'));
        $this->assertSame(['Gita Lestari', 'Hana Putri'], $this->names('(0812) 3456 7890'));
        $this->assertSame(['Joko Susilo'], $this->names('+62 812-3456-7890'));
        $this->assertSame(['Indra Wijaya'], $this->names('081999999999'));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->names('081555555555'));
    }

    // --- (4) nama ---

    public function test_a_name_term_matches_a_substring_case_insensitively(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Budi Santoso');
        $this->profile('Ahmad Budiman');
        $this->profile('Citra Dewi');

        $this->assertSame(['Budi Santoso', 'Ahmad Budiman'], $this->names('budi'));
        $this->assertSame(['Citra Dewi'], $this->names('DEWI'));
        $this->assertSame(['Budi Santoso'], $this->names('  santoso '));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->names('tidak ada'));
    }

    public function test_like_wildcards_in_the_term_are_literal_text(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Ani Wulandari');
        $this->profile('A_i Uji');
        $this->profile('100% Sehat');
        $this->profile('Bu\\di Uji');

        $this->assertSame(['A_i Uji'], $this->names('A_i'), 'Garis bawah bukan wildcard satu karakter.');
        $this->assertSame(['A_i Uji'], $this->names('_'));
        $this->assertSame(['100% Sehat'], $this->names('%'));
        $this->assertSame(['100% Sehat'], $this->names('100%'));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->names('A%i'), 'Persen bukan wildcard.');
        $this->assertSame(['Bu\\di Uji'], $this->names('\\'));
    }

    public function test_markup_in_the_term_is_just_text(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Ani Wulandari');

        $this->assertSame([], $this->names('<script>alert(1)</script>'));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->names("' OR 1=1 --"));
    }

    public function test_the_term_is_cut_at_one_hundred_characters(): void
    {
        $this->profile(str_repeat('a', 100).'yyy');

        $this->assertCount(1, $this->names(str_repeat('a', 100).'zzz'), 'Sisa istilah setelah 100 karakter dibuang.');
    }

    public function test_the_term_is_scrubbed_of_invalid_utf8(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Ani Wulandari');

        // Urutan UTF-8 rusak dibersihkan (mb_scrub), bukan menjadi galat basis data; hasilnya hanya daftar.
        $this->assertIsArray($this->names("Ani\xC3\x28"));
        $this->assertSame(['Ani Wulandari'], $this->names('Ani'));
    }

    // --- komposisi ---

    public function test_it_composes_with_other_constraints_of_the_query(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Budi Aktif');
        $this->profile('Budi Nonaktif', ['is_active' => false]);

        $result = $this->search()->apply(PatientProfile::query()->where('is_active', true), 'budi');

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Builder::class, $result);
        $this->assertSame(['Budi Aktif'], $result->pluck('full_name')->all());
    }

    // --- similarTo (BR-102) ---

    public function test_similar_matches_the_same_name_and_birth_date_ignoring_case_and_spaces(): void
    {
        $match = $this->profile('Budi Santoso', ['birth_date' => '1985-07-21', 'phone' => '081111111111']);
        $this->profile('Budi Santoso', ['birth_date' => '1985-07-22', 'phone' => '081222222222']);
        $this->profile('Budi Hartono', ['birth_date' => '1985-07-21', 'phone' => '081333333333']);

        $result = $this->search()->similarTo('  budi SANTOSO ', '1985-07-21', '081999999999');

        $this->assertSame([$match->id], $result->modelKeys());
    }

    public function test_similar_matches_the_same_normalised_phone_regardless_of_name_and_date(): void
    {
        $match = $this->profile('Orang Lain', ['birth_date' => '1970-01-01', 'phone' => '081234567890']);
        $this->profile('Tidak Mirip', ['birth_date' => '1970-01-01', 'phone' => '081234567891']);

        $result = $this->search()->similarTo('Budi Santoso', '1985-07-21', '0812-3456-7890');

        $this->assertSame([$match->id], $result->modelKeys());
    }

    public function test_similar_returns_active_profiles_only(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Budi Santoso', ['birth_date' => '1985-07-21', 'phone' => '081234567890', 'is_active' => false]);

        $this->assertCount(0, $this->search()->similarTo('Budi Santoso', '1985-07-21', '081234567890'));
    }

    public function test_similar_excludes_the_ignored_profile(): void
    {
        $self = $this->profile('Budi Santoso', ['birth_date' => '1985-07-21', 'phone' => '081234567890']);
        $twin = $this->profile('Budi Santoso', ['birth_date' => '1985-07-21', 'phone' => '081555555555']);

        $result = $this->search()->similarTo('Budi Santoso', '1985-07-21', '081234567890', $self->id);

        $this->assertSame([$twin->id], $result->modelKeys());
    }

    public function test_similar_returns_at_most_five_profiles_ordered_by_id(): void
    {
        $ids = [];

        for ($i = 0; $i < 7; $i++) {
            $ids[] = $this->profile("Kembar {$i}", ['phone' => '081234567890'])->id;
        }

        $result = $this->search()->similarTo('Siapa Saja', '1990-01-01', '081234567890');

        $this->assertSame(array_slice($ids, 0, 5), $result->modelKeys());
    }

    public function test_similar_includes_profiles_with_and_without_an_account(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->profile('Budi Santoso', ['birth_date' => '1985-07-21', 'phone' => '081111111111']);
        $online = PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create(['full_name' => 'Budi Santoso', 'birth_date' => '1985-07-21', 'phone' => '081222222222']);

        $result = $this->search()->similarTo('Budi Santoso', '1985-07-21', '081999999999');

        $this->assertSame([$walkIn->id, $online->id], $result->modelKeys());
    }

    public function test_similar_never_returns_everyone_when_the_inputs_are_blank(): void
    {
        $this->profile('Ani Wulandari');
        $this->profile('Budi Hartono');

        $this->assertCount(0, $this->search()->similarTo('  ', '1985-07-21', ''));
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->search()->similarTo('Ani Wulandari', '', ''));
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->search()->similarTo('', '', ''));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Patients;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientRegistrationService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R10 / WLK-07 sisi service / BR-105: nonaktif ditolak bila ada appointment aktif (pesan berjumlah), profil berakun
 * menyinkronkan `users.is_active` dan menghapus baris `sessions`, aktifkan kembali, status sama tanpa tulis dan tanpa audit.
 */
class PatientStatusServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private User $staff;

    private Actor $actor;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-09 10:15:00');
        $this->staff = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $this->actor = Actor::staff($this->staff);
    }

    private function service(): PatientRegistrationService
    {
        return $this->app->make(PatientRegistrationService::class);
    }

    private function walkIn(): PatientProfile
    {
        return PatientProfile::factory()->create();
    }

    /** Menyisipkan baris sesi login (driver database) untuk akun. */
    private function loginSession(string $id, ?int $userId): void
    {
        DB::table('sessions')->insert([
            'id' => $id,
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'ip_address' => '127.0.0.1',
            'user_agent' => 'uji',
            'payload' => 'x',
            'last_activity' => time(),
        ]);
    }

    private function book(PatientProfile $profile, AppointmentStatus $status): void
    {
        $this->bookAppointment($this->createSession(), $status, ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id]);
    }

    private function statusAudits(): int
    {
        return AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.status_changed')->count();
    }

    // --- menonaktifkan / mengaktifkan ---

    public function test_it_deactivates_a_walk_in_profile_and_audits_it(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();

        $result = $this->service()->changeStatus($profile, false, $this->actor, 'Pasien pindah domisili');

        $this->assertSame($profile, $result, 'Instance pemanggil dikembalikan dan disinkronkan.');
        $this->assertFalse($profile->is_active);
        $this->assertFalse(PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($profile->id)->is_active);

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.status_changed')->sole();
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Staff, $log->actor_type);
        $this->assertSame($this->staff->id, (int) $log->user_id);
        $this->assertSame($profile->getMorphClass(), $log->auditable_type);
        $this->assertSame($profile->id, (int) $log->auditable_id);
        $this->assertSame(['is_active' => true], $log->old_values);
        $this->assertSame(['is_active' => false, 'reason' => 'Pasien pindah domisili'], $log->new_values);
        $this->assertSame("Profil pasien {$profile->patient_number} dinonaktifkan.", $log->description);
    }

    public function test_the_reason_is_optional_and_a_blank_reason_is_not_audited(): void
    {
        $first = $this->walkIn();
        $second = $this->walkIn();

        $this->service()->changeStatus($first, false, $this->actor);
        $this->service()->changeStatus($second, false, $this->actor, "   \n ");

        foreach (AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.status_changed')->get() as $log) {
            $this->assertSame(['is_active' => false], $log->new_values);
        }

        $this->assertSame(2, $this->statusAudits());
    }

    public function test_it_reactivates_a_profile_and_audits_it(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->inactive()->create();

        $this->service()->changeStatus($profile, true, $this->actor);

        $this->assertTrue(PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($profile->id)->is_active);

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.status_changed')->sole();
        $this->assertSame(['is_active' => false], $log->old_values);
        $this->assertSame(['is_active' => true], $log->new_values);
        $this->assertSame("Profil pasien {$profile->patient_number} diaktifkan kembali.", $log->description);
    }

    public function test_the_same_status_writes_nothing_and_no_audit(): void
    {
        $active = $this->walkIn();
        $inactive = PatientProfile::factory()->inactive()->create();
        $before = [
            DB::table('patient_profiles')->where('id', $active->id)->value('updated_at'),
            DB::table('patient_profiles')->where('id', $inactive->id)->value('updated_at'),
        ];

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-09 12:00:00');

        $this->service()->changeStatus($active, true, $this->actor, 'Tidak ada perubahan');
        $this->service()->changeStatus($inactive, false, $this->actor, 'Tidak ada perubahan');

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->statusAudits());
        $this->assertSame($before[0], DB::table('patient_profiles')->where('id', $active->id)->value('updated_at'));
        $this->assertSame($before[1], DB::table('patient_profiles')->where('id', $inactive->id)->value('updated_at'));
    }

    public function test_a_stale_instance_is_resynchronised_and_a_no_op_does_not_audit(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();
        $stale = PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($profile->id);
        PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($profile->id)->update(['is_active' => false]);

        $this->service()->changeStatus($stale, false, $this->actor);

        $this->assertFalse($stale->is_active, 'Status dibaca ulang di bawah kunci.');
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->statusAudits());
    }

    // --- penolakan karena pendaftaran aktif ---

    public function test_it_refuses_to_deactivate_while_active_appointments_exist(): void
    {
        $patient = $this->createPatient();
        $profile = $patient->patientProfile;
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $this->loginSession('sess-a', $patient->id);

        try {
            $this->service()->changeStatus($profile, false, $this->actor, 'Pasien pindah domisili');
            $this->fail('Penonaktifan harus ditolak.');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(['is_active' => ['Pasien masih memiliki 2 pendaftaran aktif. Batalkan atau selesaikan terlebih dahulu.']], $e->errors());
        }

        $this->assertTrue(PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($profile->id)->is_active);
        $this->assertTrue(User::query()->findOrFail($patient->id)->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', $patient->id)->count(), 'Sesi login tidak disentuh pada penolakan.');
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->statusAudits());
    }

    public function test_the_refusal_counts_every_active_status_including_a_confirmed_one(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        try {
            $this->service()->changeStatus($profile, false, $this->actor);
            $this->fail('Penonaktifan harus ditolak.');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('Pasien masih memiliki 1 pendaftaran aktif. Batalkan atau selesaikan terlebih dahulu.', $e->errors()['is_active'][0]);
        }
    }

    public function test_an_old_pending_appointment_on_a_past_session_still_blocks(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();
        $this->bookAppointment($this->createSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-01']), AppointmentStatus::Pending, ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id]);

        $this->expectException(ValidationException::class);

        $this->service()->changeStatus($profile, false, $this->actor);
    }

    public function test_final_appointments_do_not_block_the_deactivation(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::Completed);
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::NoShow);

        $this->service()->changeStatus($profile, false, $this->actor);

        $this->assertFalse(PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($profile->id)->is_active);
    }

    public function test_only_the_appointments_of_this_profile_are_counted(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();
        $this->book($this->walkIn(), AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->service()->changeStatus($profile, false, $this->actor);

        $this->assertFalse(PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($profile->id)->is_active);
    }

    // --- profil berakun ---

    public function test_deactivating_a_profile_with_an_account_deactivates_the_account_and_deletes_its_sessions(): void
    {
        $patient = $this->createPatient();
        $other = $this->createPatient();
        $this->loginSession('sess-a', $patient->id);
        $this->loginSession('sess-b', $patient->id);
        $this->loginSession('sess-c', $other->id);
        $this->loginSession('sess-d', null);

        $this->service()->changeStatus($patient->patientProfile, false, $this->actor, 'Permintaan keluarga pasien');

        $this->assertFalse(PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($patient->patientProfile->id)->is_active);
        $this->assertFalse(User::query()->findOrFail($patient->id)->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', $patient->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', $other->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('sessions')->whereNull('user_id')->count());
        $this->assertTrue(User::query()->findOrFail($other->id)->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->statusAudits(), 'Satu baris audit, tanpa baris audit akun.');
    }

    public function test_reactivating_a_profile_with_an_account_reactivates_the_account_without_restoring_sessions(): void
    {
        $patient = $this->createPatient();
        $this->loginSession('sess-a', $patient->id);

        $this->service()->changeStatus($patient->patientProfile, false, $this->actor);
        $this->service()->changeStatus(PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($patient->patientProfile->id), true, $this->actor);

        $this->assertTrue(PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($patient->patientProfile->id)->is_active);
        $this->assertTrue(User::query()->findOrFail($patient->id)->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', $patient->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->statusAudits());
    }

    public function test_deactivating_a_walk_in_profile_leaves_every_session_and_account_alone(): void
    {
        $other = $this->createPatient();
        $this->loginSession('sess-c', $other->id);

        $this->service()->changeStatus($this->walkIn(), false, $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('sessions')->count());
        $this->assertTrue(User::query()->findOrFail($other->id)->is_active);
    }

    public function test_an_audit_failure_rolls_back_the_profile_the_account_and_the_sessions(): void
    {
        $patient = $this->createPatient();
        $this->loginSession('sess-a', $patient->id);
        AuditLog::creating(function (): void {
            throw new RuntimeException('Audit gagal ditulis.');
        });

        try {
            $this->service()->changeStatus($patient->patientProfile, false, $this->actor);
            $this->fail('Kegagalan audit harus merambat keluar dari service.');
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('Audit gagal ditulis.', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertTrue(PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($patient->patientProfile->id)->is_active);
        $this->assertTrue(User::query()->findOrFail($patient->id)->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', $patient->id)->count());
    }

    public function test_the_status_messages_are_verbatim(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('Pasien masih memiliki 3 pendaftaran aktif. Batalkan atau selesaikan terlebih dahulu.', __('patients.status.active_appointments', ['count' => 3]));
        $this->assertSame('Profil pasien P000012 dinonaktifkan.', __('patients.status.deactivated', ['number' => 'P000012']));
        $this->assertSame('Profil pasien P000012 diaktifkan kembali.', __('patients.status.activated', ['number' => 'P000012']));
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Tulis tes `tests/Feature/Patients/PatientAccountLinkerTest.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Patients;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientAccountLinker;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientRegistrationService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R12 / WLK-05, WLK-06 sisi service / BR-106..BR-109: hubungkan profil walk-in ke akun pasien. Semua penolakan 06 §16
 * (`ValidationException` kunci `account_email`), akun tanpa profil diizinkan, `problem()` tidak menulis dan tidak mengunci,
 * dan tidak ada pencocokan otomatis. Pembuktian dua petugas bersamaan ada di T11.
 */
class PatientAccountLinkerTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const ALREADY_LINKED = 'Profil ini sudah terhubung ke sebuah akun.';

    private const NOT_FOUND = 'Akun pasien dengan email tersebut tidak ditemukan.';

    private const INACTIVE = 'Akun pasien tidak aktif.';

    private const HAS_HISTORY = 'Akun ini sudah memiliki riwayat pendaftaran. Penggabungan dua profil berriwayat belum didukung.';

    private User $staff;

    private Actor $actor;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-09 10:15:00');
        $this->staff = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $this->actor = Actor::staff($this->staff);
    }

    private function linker(): PatientAccountLinker
    {
        return $this->app->make(PatientAccountLinker::class);
    }

    private function walkIn(array $attributes = []): PatientProfile
    {
        return PatientProfile::factory()->create($attributes);
    }

    private function linkedAudits(): int
    {
        return AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.account_linked')->count();
    }

    /** Memastikan penolakan: pesan pada kunci `account_email`, tanpa audit dan tanpa perubahan profil. */
    private function assertRejected(PatientProfile $walkIn, User $account, string $message): void
    {
        $profilesBefore = PatientProfile::query()->count();

        try {
            $this->linker()->link($walkIn, $account, $this->actor);
            $this->fail('Penghubungan harus ditolak.');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(['account_email' => [$message]], $e->errors());
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->linkedAudits());
        $this->assertSame($profilesBefore, PatientProfile::query()->count(), 'Tidak ada profil yang dihapus pada penolakan.');
    }

    // --- findAccount ---

    public function test_find_account_trims_and_lowercases_the_email(): void
    {
        $account = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'siti.rahma@contoh.test']);

        $this->assertSame($account->id, $this->linker()->findAccount('  Siti.Rahma@CONTOH.test ')?->id);
    }

    public function test_find_account_returns_null_for_unknown_blank_and_staff_emails(): void
    {
        $this->createPatient(['email' => 'siti.rahma@contoh.test']);
        $staff = $this->createStaff('content-admin', ['email' => 'konten@contoh.test']);

        $this->assertNull($this->linker()->findAccount('tidak.ada@contoh.test'));
        $this->assertNull($this->linker()->findAccount(''));
        $this->assertNull($this->linker()->findAccount('   '));
        $this->assertNull($this->linker()->findAccount($staff->email), 'Akun staf bukan akun pasien.');
    }

    public function test_find_account_returns_an_inactive_patient_so_the_reason_can_be_reported(): void
    {
        $account = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'nonaktif@contoh.test', 'is_active' => false]);

        $this->assertSame($account->id, $this->linker()->findAccount('nonaktif@contoh.test')?->id);
    }

    // --- problem() ---

    public function test_problem_is_null_when_the_link_is_allowed(): void
    {
        $this->assertNull($this->linker()->problem($this->walkIn(), $this->createPatient()));
    }

    public function test_problem_allows_an_account_without_any_profile(): void
    {
        $this->assertNull($this->linker()->problem($this->walkIn(), User::factory()->patient()->create()));
    }

    public function test_problem_reports_a_profile_that_is_already_linked_first(): void
    {
        $linked = $this->createPatient()->patientProfile;

        $this->assertSame(self::ALREADY_LINKED, $this->linker()->problem($linked, $this->createPatient()));
        $this->assertSame(self::ALREADY_LINKED, $this->linker()->problem($linked, null), 'Profil terhubung didahulukan, juga tanpa akun.');
        $this->assertSame(self::ALREADY_LINKED, $this->linker()->problem($linked, User::factory()->patient()->inactive()->create()));
    }

    public function test_problem_reports_a_missing_account_and_a_non_patient_account(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(self::NOT_FOUND, $this->linker()->problem($this->walkIn(), null));
        $this->assertSame(self::NOT_FOUND, $this->linker()->problem($this->walkIn(), $this->createStaff('registration-officer')));
    }

    public function test_problem_reports_an_inactive_account(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(self::INACTIVE, $this->linker()->problem($this->walkIn(), $this->createPatient(['is_active' => false])));
    }

    public function test_problem_reports_history_of_any_status_on_the_account_profile(): void
    {
        foreach ([AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, AppointmentStatus::Completed] as $status) {
            $account = $this->createPatient();
            $this->bookAppointment($this->createSession(), $status, ['patient_profile_id' => $account->patientProfile->id]);

            $this->assertSame(self::HAS_HISTORY, $this->linker()->problem($this->walkIn(), $account), $status->value);
        }
    }

    public function test_a_walk_in_history_does_not_block_the_link(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();
        $this->bookAppointment($this->createSession(), AppointmentStatus::Completed, ['patient_profile_id' => $walkIn->id]);

        $this->assertNull($this->linker()->problem($walkIn, $this->createPatient()));
    }

    public function test_problem_neither_writes_nor_locks(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();
        $account = $this->createPatient();
        $statements = [];
        DB::listen(function ($query) use (&$statements): void {
            $statements[] = strtolower($query->sql);
        });

        $this->linker()->problem($walkIn, $account);
        $this->linker()->problem($walkIn, null);

        $this->assertNotEmpty($statements);

        foreach ($statements as $sql) {
            $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('/^\s*(insert|update|delete)\b|for update/', $sql);
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->linkedAudits());
    }

    public function test_it_links_the_walk_in_profile_and_removes_the_empty_account_profile(): void
    {

        $emptyProfileId = $account->patientProfile->id;

        $this->assertSame('Budi Santoso', $stored->full_name);
        $this->assertSame('1985-07-21', $stored->birth_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('081234567890', $stored->phone);

        $this->assertSame('1.0', $stored->consent_version);

        $this->assertSame($walkIn, $result);
        $this->assertSame($account->id, (int) $result->user_id);
        $this->assertSame($walkIn->id, User::query()->with('patientProfile')->findOrFail($account->id)->patientProfile->id);
    }
```

```php
    /**
     * Profil pasien walk-in yang dibuat petugas loket (F7A-R8, BR-98..BR-103): tanpa akun login, kanal `loket`,
     * persetujuan privasi lisan dicatat sebagai `consent_at = now()` dan versi persetujuan yang berlaku. Hanya enam
     * kunci identitas yang dibaca; nomor BPJS tidak diisi di sini (V-13: hanya lewat booking `save_bpjs` atau pasien
     * sendiri). Nomor pasien diisi sesudah insert dalam transaksi yang sama (D-145). Audit `patient.created` tanpa data pribadi.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $validated  full_name, birth_date (Y-m-d), gender, phone, address, email (opsional)
     */
    public function createWalkIn(array $validated, User $staff): PatientProfile
    {
        // Akun petugas yang belum tersimpan gagal di sini, sebelum ada yang ditulis.
        $actor = Actor::staff($staff);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($validated, $staff, $actor): PatientProfile {
            $consentVersion = $this->settings->string('privacy.consent_version', '1.0');
            $email = mb_strtolower(trim((string) ($validated['email'] ?? '')));

            $profile = new PatientProfile;
            $profile->fill([
                'full_name' => trim((string) $validated['full_name']),
                'birth_date' => $validated['birth_date'],
                'gender' => $validated['gender'],
                'phone' => IndonesianPhone::normalize((string) $validated['phone']),
                'email' => $email === '' ? null : $email,
                'address' => trim((string) $validated['address']),
                'registration_channel' => BookingChannel::Loket,
                'consent_at' => now(),
                'consent_version' => $consentVersion,
                'is_active' => true,
            ]);
            $profile->forceFill(['user_id' => null, 'created_by_user_id' => $staff->getKey()])->save();

            // Id baru diketahui setelah insert, jadi nomor pasien diisi dalam transaksi yang sama.
            $profile->forceFill(['patient_number' => PatientNumberGenerator::format((int) $profile->getKey())])->save();

            $this->audit->log(
                'patient.created',
                $profile,
                null,
                [
                    'patient_number' => $profile->patient_number,
                    'registration_channel' => BookingChannel::Loket->value,
                    'consent_version' => $consentVersion,
                ],
                "Profil pasien {$profile->patient_number} dibuat oleh petugas (walk-in).",
                $actor,
            );

            return $profile->refresh();
        });
    }

    /**
     * Aktifkan atau nonaktifkan profil (F7A-R10, BR-105). Satu transaksi: profil dikunci lebih dulu, lalu pendaftaran
     * aktif (`pending`/`confirmed`/`checked_in`) dihitung di bawah kunci itu; menonaktifkan dengan N > 0 ditolak
     * (`ValidationException` kunci `is_active`). Status yang sama tidak menulis apa pun dan tidak diaudit. Profil
     * berakun: `users.is_active` ikut berubah dan, saat dinonaktifkan, baris `sessions` akun dihapus agar login
     * pasien berakhir. Kewajiban alasan saat menonaktifkan (V-18) ada di Form Request; service hanya mencatatnya.
     */
    public function changeStatus(PatientProfile $profile, bool $active, Actor $actor, ?string $reason = null): PatientProfile
    {
        $reason = $reason === null ? '' : trim($reason);
        $reason = $reason === '' ? null : $reason;

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($profile, $active, $actor, $reason): PatientProfile {
            $locked = PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($profile->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

            if ($locked->is_active === $active) {
                $profile->setRawAttributes($locked->getRawOriginal(), true);

                return $profile;
            }

            if (! $active) {
                $count = Appointment::query()->where('patient_profile_id', $locked->getKey())->active()->count();

                if ($count > 0) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'is_active' => __('patients.status.active_appointments', ['count' => $count]),
                    ]);
                }
            }

            $locked->forceFill(['is_active' => $active])->save();

            if ($locked->user_id !== null) {
                User::query()->whereKey($locked->user_id)->update(['is_active' => $active]);

                if (! $active) {
                    DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', $locked->user_id)->delete();
                }
            }

            $new = ['is_active' => $active];

            if ($reason !== null) {
                $new['reason'] = $reason;
            }

            $this->audit->log(
                'patient.status_changed',
                $locked,
                ['is_active' => ! $active],
                $new,
                __($active ? 'patients.status.activated' : 'patients.status.deactivated', ['number' => $locked->patient_number ?? '-']),
                $actor,
            );

            $profile->setRawAttributes($locked->getRawOriginal(), true);

            return $profile;
        });
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Buat `app/Services/Patients/PatientSearch.php` (tool Write)**

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Patients;

use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Rules\IndonesianPhone;
use App\Support\LikePattern;
use DateTimeImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

/**
 * Pencarian pasien oleh petugas (F7A-R16, 05 #37) dan deteksi profil mirip (BR-102, F7A-R11). Tanpa state; tidak
 * memeriksa izin. Satu kotak pencarian mengenali empat jenis istilah menurut urutan baku: nomor pasien, tanggal lahir
 * `dd/mm/yyyy`, nomor telepon, lalu nama. Karakter `%`, `_`, `\` pada istilah nama adalah teks biasa (LikePattern).
 */
final class PatientSearch
{
    /** Panjang istilah maksimum (sisanya dibuang). */
    public const MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 100;

    /** Jumlah profil mirip maksimum yang ditampilkan. */
    public const MAX_SIMILAR = 5;

    /**
     * Menambah satu kondisi pada kueri `patient_profiles`; istilah kosong tidak mengubah kueri.
     *
     * @param  Builder<PatientProfile>  $query
     * @return Builder<PatientProfile>
     */
    public function apply(Builder $query, string $term): Builder
    {
        $term = trim(mb_substr(trim(mb_scrub($term)), 0, self::MAX_TERM_LENGTH));

        if ($term === '') {
            return $query;
        }

        // (1) Nomor pasien: "P000012", "p12", "12". Tujuh digit hanya sah bila berawalan P.
        if (preg_match('/^([Pp]?)(\d{1,7})$/', $term, $matches) === 1 && ($matches[1] !== '' || strlen($matches[2]) <= 6)) {
            return $query->where('patient_number', 'P'.str_pad($matches[2], 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT));
        }

        // (2) Tanggal lahir dd/mm/yyyy yang sah (31/02/2026 bukan tanggal).
        if (preg_match('/^\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}$/', $term) === 1) {
            $date = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!d/m/Y', $term);

            if ($date !== false && $date->format('d/m/Y') === $term) {
                return $query->where('birth_date', $date->format('Y-m-d'));
            }
        }

        // (3) Nomor telepon seluler yang sah setelah normalisasi: awalan.
        $phone = IndonesianPhone::normalize($term);

        if (preg_match(IndonesianPhone::PATTERN, $phone) === 1) {
            return $query->where('phone', 'like', $phone.'%');
        }

        // (4) Selain itu: nama mengandung istilah.
        return $query->where('full_name', 'like', LikePattern::contains($term));
    }

    /**
     * Profil AKTIF yang mirip dengan data yang akan dibuat: (nama sama tanpa membedakan huruf besar/kecil DAN tanggal
     * lahir sama) ATAU telepon sama setelah normalisasi. `$ignoreId` dikecualikan; maksimum lima, urut id. Klausa yang
     * datanya kosong dilewati, dan tanpa klausa sama sekali hasilnya kosong (tidak pernah "semua profil").
     *
     * @return Collection<int, PatientProfile>
     */
    public function similarTo(string $fullName, string $birthDate, string $phone, ?int $ignoreId = null): Collection
    {
        $name = mb_strtolower(trim($fullName));
        $date = trim($birthDate);
        $phone = IndonesianPhone::normalize(trim($phone));
        $byName = $name !== '' && $date !== '';

        if (! $byName && $phone === '') {
            return new Collection;
        }

        return PatientProfile::query()
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->when($ignoreId !== null, fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->whereKeyNot($ignoreId))
            ->where(function (Builder $query) use ($byName, $name, $date, $phone): void {
                if ($byName) {
                    $query->where(function (Builder $same) use ($name, $date): void {
                        $same->whereRaw('lower(full_name) = ?', [$name])->where('birth_date', $date);
                    });
                }

                if ($phone !== '') {
                    $query->orWhere('phone', $phone);
                }
            })
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->limit(self::MAX_SIMILAR)
            ->get();
    }
}
```

```php
use App\Services\Audit\AuditLogger;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Menghubungkan profil walk-in (tanpa akun) ke akun pasien yang sudah ada (F7A-R12, 06 §16, 11 §6.8, BR-106..BR-109).
 * Tidak pernah ada pencocokan otomatis: petugas memilih akun dari email dan menegaskan verifikasi identitas di loket
 * (Form Request T7). Service tidak memeriksa izin Spatie (D-158). `problem()` dipakai panel UI tanpa kunci dan tanpa
 * tulis; `link()` mengulang pemeriksaan yang sama di bawah kunci karena instance pemanggil boleh basi.
 */
final class PatientAccountLinker
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    /** Akun pasien (bukan staf) dengan email itu; trim + huruf kecil. Akun nonaktif tetap ditemukan agar alasannya dapat dilaporkan. */
    public function findAccount(string $email): ?User
    {
        $email = mb_strtolower(trim($email));

        if ($email === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return User::query()->patients()->where('email', $email)->first();
    }

    /**
     * Alasan penghubungan ditolak (pesan Indonesia), atau null bila boleh. Tanpa kunci dan tanpa tulis.
     */
    public function problem(PatientProfile $walkIn, ?User $account): ?string
    {
        $accountProfile = $account === null
            ? null
            : PatientProfile::query()->where('user_id', $account->getKey())->first();

        return $this->evaluate($walkIn, $account, $accountProfile);
    }

    /**
     * @throws ValidationException kunci `account_email` bila syarat tidak terpenuhi (tidak ada yang ditulis)
     */
    public function link(PatientProfile $walkIn, User $account, Actor $actor): PatientProfile
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($walkIn, $account, $actor): PatientProfile {
            $accountProfileId = PatientProfile::query()->where('user_id', $account->getKey())->value('id');

            // Kunci kedua profil menurut id menaik (tidak ada deadlock dengan BookingService yang mengunci satu profil).
            $ids = array_values(array_filter([(int) $walkIn->getKey(), $accountProfileId === null ? null : (int) $accountProfileId]));
            sort($ids);

            $profiles = PatientProfile::query()->whereIn('id', $ids)->orderBy('id')->lockForUpdate()->get()->keyBy('id');
            $lockedWalkIn = $profiles->get((int) $walkIn->getKey());

            if ($lockedWalkIn === null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['account_email' => __('patients.link.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND')]);
            }

            $lockedAccountProfile = $accountProfileId === null ? null : $profiles->get((int) $accountProfileId);
            $lockedAccount = User::query()->whereKey($account->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->first();

            // Profil milik akun berubah sejak dibaca (mis. sudah ditautkan petugas lain): anggap akun sudah berprofil.
            $currentAccountProfileId = PatientProfile::query()->where('user_id', $account->getKey())->value('id');

            if (($currentAccountProfileId === null ? null : (int) $currentAccountProfileId) !== ($accountProfileId === null ? null : (int) $accountProfileId)) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['account_email' => __('patients.link.ACCOUNT_HAS_HISTORY')]);
            }

            $message = $this->evaluate($lockedWalkIn, $lockedAccount, $lockedAccountProfile);

            if ($message !== null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['account_email' => $message]);
            }

            $removed = $lockedAccountProfile === null ? null : [
                'id' => $lockedAccountProfile->getKey(),
                'patient_number' => $lockedAccountProfile->patient_number,
                'consent_at' => $lockedAccountProfile->consent_at->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
                'consent_version' => $lockedAccountProfile->consent_version,
            ];

            // Profil kosong dihapus lebih dulu: `patient_profiles.user_id` unik.
            $lockedAccountProfile?->delete();

            $lockedWalkIn->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $lockedAccount->getKey(),
                'email' => $lockedAccount->email,
                'is_active' => (bool) $lockedAccount->is_active,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->log(
                'patient.account_linked',
                $lockedWalkIn,
                ['removed_profile' => $removed],
                ['profile_id' => $lockedWalkIn->getKey(), 'user_id' => $lockedAccount->getKey()],
                'Profil pasien '.($lockedWalkIn->patient_number ?? '-').' dihubungkan ke akun pasien.',
                $actor,
            );

            $walkIn->setRawAttributes($lockedWalkIn->getRawOriginal(), true);
            $walkIn->unsetRelation('user');

            return $walkIn;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Urutan 06 §16: profil sudah terhubung, akun tidak ada atau bukan pasien, akun nonaktif, profil akun berriwayat.
     */
    private function evaluate(PatientProfile $walkIn, ?User $account, ?PatientProfile $accountProfile): ?string
    {
        if ($walkIn->user_id !== null) {
            return __('patients.link.PROFILE_ALREADY_LINKED');
        }

        if ($account === null || ! $account->isPatient()) {
            return __('patients.link.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND');
        }

        if (! $account->is_active) {
            return __('patients.link.ACCOUNT_INACTIVE');
        }

        if ($accountProfile !== null && Appointment::query()->where('patient_profile_id', $accountProfile->getKey())->exists()) {
            return __('patients.link.ACCOUNT_HAS_HISTORY');
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

### Task 4: Policy 7a, sanitasi log `QueryException`, dan retry `DoctorService`

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/Policies/PatientProfilePolicy.php` (ditulis ulang utuh)
- Modify: `app/Policies/AppointmentPolicy.php` (tiga method baru)
- Modify: `app/Policies/PracticeSessionPolicy.php` (satu method baru)
- Create: `app/Support/QueryLogSanitizer.php`
- Modify: `bootstrap/app.php` (impor + dua callback `report`)
- Modify: `app/Services/Doctors/DoctorService.php` (`archive()` dan `changeStatus()` dibungkus retry; satu method privat baru; konstruktor TIDAK berubah)
- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/Access/Phase7aPolicyTest.php`
- Test (baru): `tests/Unit/Support/QueryLogSanitizerTest.php`
- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/Errors/QueryExceptionReportTest.php`
- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/Concurrency/DoctorServiceRetryTest.php`
- Tidak diubah: migration, enum, izin (19), `DoctorController` (`ValidationException` kunci `status` sudah ditangani framework seperti penolakan arsip yang ada), `SanitizedBookingFault`, `AppointmentStatusService`/`BookingService` (T1/T2), `BookingParallelProcessesTest` (diperbarui T11; tetap hijau tanpa perubahan, lihat catatan 7).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (sudah ada):
  - `User::isStaff()`; izin `patients.view|manage`, `appointments.view|manage` (Petugas Pendaftaran memegang keempatnya; Admin Konten tidak satu pun; Super Admin lolos lewat `Gate::before`); `Illuminate\Contracts\Database\ConcurrencyErrorDetector` (pola `AppointmentStatusService`/`BookingService`); `Illuminate\Database\QueryException`, `Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException` (subkelas `PDOException`, dilempar `ManagesTransactions` saat galat konkurensi terjadi di transaksi bersarang, dengan `getPrevious()` = galat asli); `SensitiveInput`; `ConcurrencyTestCase::injectFault()`, `makeSession()`, `makeStaff()`, `rowsSince()`.
  - Teks pesan sibuk: `lang/id/booking.php` `errors.SYSTEM_BUSY` = `Sistem sedang sibuk, silakan coba lagi beberapa saat.`
- Produces (D kerangka):
  - `PatientProfilePolicy`: `viewAny(User): bool` (staf + `patients.view`), `create(User): bool` (staf + `patients.manage`), `changeStatus(User, PatientProfile): bool` (staf + `patients.manage`), `linkAccount(User, PatientProfile): bool` (staf + `patients.manage` DAN `$profile->user_id === null`). `view`/`update` tidak berubah.
  - `AppointmentPolicy`: `viewAny(User)` (staf + `appointments.view`), `createCounter(User)` dan `transition(User, Appointment)` (staf + `appointments.manage`). `view`/`cancel`/`createOnline` tidak berubah.
  - `PracticeSessionPolicy::markNoShow(User, PracticeSession): bool` (staf + `appointments.manage`).
  - `final class App\Support\QueryLogSanitizer` dengan `public static function message(QueryException|DeadlockException $e): string` → `Galat basis data: koneksi={nama} sqlstate={SQLSTATE} driver={kode} sql={SQL tanpa bindings, maks 1000 karakter}` (bagian yang tidak diketahui `-`).
  - `bootstrap/app.php`: callback `report` untuk `QueryException` dan `DeadlockException` yang menulis `Log::error(QueryLogSanitizer::message($e))` lalu mengembalikan `false` (pelaporan bawaan berhenti). Respons ke pengguna tidak berubah.
  - `DoctorService::archive()` dan `::changeStatus()`: `DB::transaction(…, 3)`; galat konkurensi yang lolos → `ValidationException::withMessages(['status' => __('booking.errors.SYSTEM_BUSY')])`; `lastReport` di-reset di awal tiap percobaan dan menjadi `null` bila gagal.

**Test IDs:** AKS-03..AKS-05 (sisi Policy), PAS-04 (Petugas), F7A-R13 (Policy), F7A-R25 (Review Focus E.4: log tanpa bindings, `KELUHAN-RAHASIA`/BPJS uji tidak ada di log), F7A-R26 (carry F3/F6: arsip dokter tidak lagi 500 saat deadlock), BR-72.

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Policy.** Semua method baru memeriksa `isStaff()` lebih dulu (pasien tidak pernah memegang izin Spatie, tetapi pemeriksaan eksplisit mencegah kebocoran bila peran/izin pasien suatu saat berubah). `Gate::before` meloloskan Super Admin SEBELUM Policy dijalankan, sehingga `linkAccount` untuk profil berakun tetap `true` bagi Super Admin; aturan "hanya profil tanpa akun" ditegakkan juga oleh view (T7: kartu hanya bila `$patient->user_id === null`) dan oleh `PatientAccountLinker` (`PROFILE_ALREADY_LINKED`). Tes mendokumentasikan perilaku itu secara eksplisit. `transition()` TIDAK memeriksa kepemilikan: pasien selalu `false` (pembatalan pasien tetap lewat `cancel`).
2. **`QueryLogSanitizer`.** Memakai `getSql()` (SQL dengan `?`), `getConnectionName()`, dan `errorInfo[0]`/`errorInfo[1]` (SQLSTATE dan kode driver) dari `QueryException` pertama pada rantai `getPrevious()`; TIDAK memakai `getRawSql()`, `getBindings()`, `getMessage()` (pesan Laravel menyisipkan bindings), atau `errorInfo[2]` (pesan driver, mis. `Duplicate entry '…'`). `DeadlockException` tidak membawa SQL sendiri; pesannya menyalin pesan galat asli (berisi bindings), sehingga rantai `getPrevious()` ditelusuri; tanpa `QueryException` pada rantai hasilnya `koneksi=- sqlstate=- driver=- sql=-`. SQL dipotong 1000 KARAKTER (`mb_substr`). Batasan yang diketahui: SQL yang sengaja menyisipkan nilai literal (mis. `whereRaw("x = 'abc'")`) tidak bisa disanitasi; aturan proyek tetap memakai bindings.
3. **Callback `report`.** `Handler::reportThrowable` menjalankan setiap callback yang `handles($e)` (berdasarkan petunjuk tipe parameter, termasuk subkelas seperti `UniqueConstraintViolationException`) dan berhenti bila callback mengembalikan `false`. Dua callback terpisah dipakai (bukan tipe gabungan) agar pencocokan tipe tidak bergantung pada refleksi tipe gabungan. `report($e)` yang dipanggil kode (mis. `catch (Throwable $e) { report($e); }` pada notifier) melewati callback yang sama. Pengecualian yang bukan galat basis data tetap dilaporkan bawaan (`message` = pesan asli dan `context['exception']`).
4. **Pembuktian dengan handler ASLI.** `Exceptions::fake()` mengganti handler sehingga callback `report` tidak berjalan; tes ini TIDAK memakainya. Log nyata diarahkan ke saluran `null` (`config(['logging.default' => 'null'])`, supaya RED tidak menulis `KELUHAN-RAHASIA` ke `storage/logs`) dan setiap tulisan log ditangkap lewat peristiwa `Illuminate\Log\Events\MessageLogged` (dikirim oleh semua `Logger`, baik jalur bawaan handler maupun `Log::error`). RED nyata: tanpa callback, pesan log berisi `values (KELUHAN-RAHASIA, 0001234567890)` dan `context['exception']` ada, sehingga asersi `assertSame` pesan persis dan `assertArrayNotHasKey('exception', …)` gagal.
5. **Retry dokter.** Perubahan memakai `DB::transaction($callback, 3)`: percobaan diulang hanya untuk galat konkurensi (`causedByConcurrencyError`). Di dalam transaksi bersarang (`ScheduleChangeService::applyDoctorInactive()` membuka transaksi di dalam transaksi `archive()`), galat konkurensi dilempar sebagai `DeadlockException` ke transaksi terluar yang kemudian mengulang; karena itu `catch` memuat `QueryException|DeadlockException`. Galat bukan-konkurensi (mis. kode 1406) dilempar ulang apa adanya (tes). Tiga titik gangguan diuji: `update \`doctors\`` (galat langsung di transaksi terluar), `update \`practice_sessions\`` (jalur transaksi bersarang → `DeadlockException`), dan `update \`doctor_schedules\`` (SESUDAH dokter dan sesi sudah ditulis: pembuktian rollback tanpa tulisan parsial).
6. **Instance `Doctor` pemanggil.** `lock()` membaca ulang dan mengganti atribut instance di setiap percobaan, sehingga percobaan ulang tidak membawa perubahan percobaan gagal. Sesudah kegagalan akhir instance dapat memegang atribut yang tidak tersimpan; pemanggil (controller) langsung mengalihkan dengan galat sehingga tidak dipakai lagi (tes memeriksa DB, bukan instance).
7. **Carry fase 6.** `BookingParallelProcessesTest::test_carry_f3_bookings_racing_a_doctor_archive_never_leave_an_archived_doctor_with_an_active_future_appointment` menangkap `QueryException|DeadlockException` sebagai hasil `'deadlock'`; sesudah tugas ini `archive()` melempar `ValidationException` (hasil `'rejected'`), sehingga tes lama TETAP hijau; T11 menghapus cabang `'deadlock'` (F7A-R26).
8. Jumlah tes baru 62 (matriks Policy 29, sanitizer dan laporan log 20, retry dokter 13; terukur di uji coba integrasi).

- [ ] **Step 2: Tulis tes (tool Write) `tests/Feature/Access/Phase7aPolicyTest.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Access;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Policies\AppointmentPolicy;
use App\Policies\PatientProfilePolicy;
use App\Policies\PracticeSessionPolicy;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R13 (04 §5, 11 §8): kemampuan baru Policy fase 7a per peran: `PatientProfilePolicy::viewAny|create|changeStatus|linkAccount`,
 * `AppointmentPolicy::viewAny|createCounter|transition`, `PracticeSessionPolicy::markNoShow`. Peran: Super Admin (Gate::before),
 * Admin Konten (tanpa izin pasien/pendaftaran), Petugas Pendaftaran, dan pasien. Service tidak memeriksa izin (D-158); Policy
 * dan middleware `permission:` yang menjaganya.
 */
class Phase7aPolicyTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->seedRoles();
    }

    private function userWithRole(string $role): User
    {
        return $role === 'patient' ? $this->createPatient() : $this->createStaff($role);
    }

    /** Staf Admin Konten yang diberi tepat satu izin tambahan (izin dimuat ulang lewat pengguna baru). */
    private function staffWithOnly(string $permission): User
    {
        $staff = $this->createStaff('content-admin');
        $staff->givePermissionTo($permission);

        return User::query()->findOrFail($staff->id);
    }

    private function allows(User $user, string $ability, mixed $subject): bool
    {
        return Gate::forUser($user)->allows($ability, $subject);
    }

    private function appointment(?PatientProfile $profile = null): Appointment
    {
        return $this->bookAppointment(
            $this->createSession(),
            AppointmentStatus::Pending,
            $profile === null ? [] : ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id],
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ PatientProfilePolicy

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string, bool, bool, bool, bool, bool}>
     */
    public static function patientProfileMatrix(): array
    {
        // [peran, viewAny, create, changeStatus (kedua profil), linkAccount profil walk-in, linkAccount profil berakun]
        return [
            'super admin (Gate::before, juga untuk profil berakun)' => ['super-admin', true, true, true, true, true],
            'admin konten' => ['content-admin', false, false, false, false, false],
            'petugas pendaftaran' => ['registration-officer', true, true, true, true, false],
            'pasien' => ['patient', false, false, false, false, false],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('patientProfileMatrix')]
    public function test_patient_profile_abilities_follow_the_role(string $role, bool $viewAny, bool $create, bool $changeStatus, bool $linkWalkIn, bool $linkLinked): void
    {
        $user = $this->userWithRole($role);
        $walkIn = PatientProfile::factory()->create();
        $linked = $this->createPatient()->patientProfile;

        $this->assertSame($viewAny, $this->allows($user, 'viewAny', PatientProfile::class), 'viewAny');
        $this->assertSame($create, $this->allows($user, 'create', PatientProfile::class), 'create');
        $this->assertSame($changeStatus, $this->allows($user, 'changeStatus', $walkIn), 'changeStatus walk-in');
        $this->assertSame($changeStatus, $this->allows($user, 'changeStatus', $linked), 'changeStatus berakun');
        $this->assertSame($linkWalkIn, $this->allows($user, 'linkAccount', $walkIn), 'linkAccount walk-in');
        $this->assertSame($linkLinked, $this->allows($user, 'linkAccount', $linked), 'linkAccount berakun');
    }

    public function test_link_account_is_denied_to_the_officer_for_a_profile_that_already_has_an_account(): void
    {
        $officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $linked = $this->createPatient()->patientProfile;

        $this->assertNotNull($linked->user_id);
        $this->assertFalse($this->allows($officer, 'linkAccount', $linked));
        $this->assertTrue($this->allows($officer, 'changeStatus', $linked), 'Status profil berakun boleh diubah petugas.');
    }

    public function test_the_super_admin_gate_bypass_is_why_the_service_and_view_enforce_unlinked_profiles_too(): void
    {
        $super = $this->createStaff('super-admin');
        $linked = $this->createPatient()->patientProfile;

        $this->assertTrue($this->allows($super, 'linkAccount', $linked), 'Gate::before melewati Policy; PatientAccountLinker menolak PROFILE_ALREADY_LINKED.');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string, bool, bool, bool, bool}>
     */
    public static function patientPermissionOnly(): array
    {
        // [izin tunggal, viewAny, create, changeStatus, linkAccount (walk-in)]
        return [
            'hanya patients.view' => ['patients.view', true, false, false, false],
            'hanya patients.manage' => ['patients.manage', false, true, true, true],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('patientPermissionOnly')]
    public function test_each_patient_ability_depends_on_its_own_permission(string $permission, bool $viewAny, bool $create, bool $changeStatus, bool $linkAccount): void
    {
        $staff = $this->staffWithOnly($permission);
        $walkIn = PatientProfile::factory()->create();

        $this->assertSame($viewAny, $this->allows($staff, 'viewAny', PatientProfile::class));
        $this->assertSame($create, $this->allows($staff, 'create', PatientProfile::class));
        $this->assertSame($changeStatus, $this->allows($staff, 'changeStatus', $walkIn));
        $this->assertSame($linkAccount, $this->allows($staff, 'linkAccount', $walkIn));
    }

    public function test_a_patient_cannot_use_the_staff_abilities_on_their_own_profile(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->createPatient();
        $profile = $owner->patientProfile;

        $this->assertTrue($this->allows($owner, 'view', $profile), 'Pemilik tetap boleh melihat profilnya.');
        $this->assertTrue($this->allows($owner, 'update', $profile), 'Pemilik tetap boleh memperbarui profilnya.');
        $this->assertFalse($this->allows($owner, 'viewAny', PatientProfile::class));
        $this->assertFalse($this->allows($owner, 'create', PatientProfile::class));
        $this->assertFalse($this->allows($owner, 'changeStatus', $profile));
        $this->assertFalse($this->allows($owner, 'linkAccount', $profile));
    }

    public function test_a_guest_has_no_patient_ability(): void
    {
        $walkIn = PatientProfile::factory()->create();

        $this->assertFalse(Gate::allows('viewAny', PatientProfile::class));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::allows('create', PatientProfile::class));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::allows('changeStatus', $walkIn));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::allows('linkAccount', $walkIn));
    }

        $this->assertSame($transition, $this->allows($user, 'transition', $appointment), 'transition');

    {
        $this->assertInstanceOf(PatientProfilePolicy::class, Gate::getPolicyFor(PatientProfile::class));

        foreach (['viewAny', 'create', 'changeStatus', 'linkAccount', 'view', 'update'] as $method) {
            $this->assertTrue(method_exists(PatientProfilePolicy::class, $method), "PatientProfilePolicy::{$method}");
        }

        foreach (['viewAny', 'createCounter', 'transition', 'view', 'cancel', 'createOnline'] as $method) {
            $this->assertTrue(method_exists(AppointmentPolicy::class, $method), "AppointmentPolicy::{$method}");
        }

        $this->assertTrue(method_exists(PracticeSessionPolicy::class, 'markNoShow'));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\User;

/**
 * F5-R14 / F7A-R13 / 11 §2.2: `view` dan `update` = pemilik profil atau staf berizin (fase 5). Kemampuan petugas fase 7a:
 * `viewAny` (daftar, `patients.view`), `create` (profil walk-in), `changeStatus`, dan `linkAccount` (semuanya `patients.manage`;
 * `linkAccount` juga mensyaratkan profil tanpa akun). Super Admin lolos lewat Gate::before sebelum sampai ke sini, sehingga
 * aturan "hanya profil tanpa akun" ditegakkan juga oleh view (T7) dan PatientAccountLinker. Pasien tidak memegang
 * peran/izin Spatie, jadi bagi pasien hanya kepemilikan yang menentukan `view`/`update`, dan kemampuan petugas selalu ditolak.
 */
final class PatientProfilePolicy
{
    /** Daftar pasien (#37). */
    public function viewAny(User $user): bool
    {
        return $user->isStaff() && $user->can('patients.view');
    }

    public function view(User $user, PatientProfile $profile): bool
    {
        return $user->can('patients.view') || $this->owns($user, $profile);
    }

    /** Membuat profil walk-in. */
    public function create(User $user): bool
    {
        return $user->isStaff() && $user->can('patients.manage');
    }

    public function update(User $user, PatientProfile $profile): bool
    {
        return $user->can('patients.manage') || $this->owns($user, $profile);
    }

    /** Aktifkan/nonaktifkan profil (aturan pendaftaran aktif ada di PatientRegistrationService::changeStatus). */
    public function changeStatus(User $user, PatientProfile $profile): bool
    {
        return $user->isStaff() && $user->can('patients.manage');
    }

    /** Hubungkan profil walk-in ke akun pasien: hanya profil yang belum punya akun. */
    public function linkAccount(User $user, PatientProfile $profile): bool
    {
        return $user->isStaff() && $user->can('patients.manage') && $profile->user_id === null;
    }

    /** Profil walk-in (`user_id` NULL) tidak dimiliki siapa pun. */
    private function owns(User $user, PatientProfile $profile): bool
    {
        return $profile->user_id !== null && (int) $profile->user_id === (int) $user->getKey();
    }
}
```
