#### Siklus B: sanitasi log `QueryException` (RED nyata, lalu GREEN)

- [ ] **Step 6: Tulis tes unit (tool Write) `tests/Unit/Support/QueryLogSanitizerTest.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit\Support;

use App\Support\QueryLogSanitizer;
use Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
use PDOException;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R25: isi pesan log galat basis data = koneksi, SQLSTATE, kode driver, dan SQL TANPA bindings (maks 1000 karakter).
 * Keluhan, alamat, dan nomor BPJS (bindings) serta pesan driver (`Duplicate entry '…'`) tidak pernah ikut.
 */
class QueryLogSanitizerTest extends TestCase
{
    private const SQL = 'insert into `appointments` (`complaint`, `payment_reference`) values (?, ?)';

    private const COMPLAINT = 'KELUHAN-RAHASIA';

    private const BPJS = '0001234567890';

    private function driverError(int $errno = 1062, string $state = '23000'): PDOException
    {
        $driverMessage = "Duplicate entry '".self::BPJS."' for key 'appointments_x'";
        $error = new PDOException("SQLSTATE[{$state}]: Integrity constraint violation: {$errno} {$driverMessage}");
        $error->errorInfo = [$state, $errno, $driverMessage];

        return $error;
    }

    private function query(string $sql = self::SQL, ?PDOException $driver = null): QueryException
    {
        return new QueryException('mariadb', $sql, [self::COMPLAINT, self::BPJS], $driver ?? $this->driverError());
    }

    private function sqlPart(string $message): string
    {
        return substr($message, (int) strpos($message, 'sql=') + 4);
    }

    public function test_the_message_has_connection_sqlstate_driver_code_and_the_sql_with_placeholders(): void
    {
        $message = QueryLogSanitizer::message($this->query());

        $this->assertSame('Galat basis data: koneksi=mariadb sqlstate=23000 driver=1062 sql='.self::SQL, $message);
    }

    public function test_bindings_and_the_driver_message_never_appear(): void
    {
        $exception = $this->query();

        // Prasyarat: pesan bawaan Laravel memang membocorkan bindings dan pesan driver.
        $this->assertStringContainsString(self::COMPLAINT, $exception->getMessage());
        $this->assertStringContainsString(self::BPJS, $exception->getMessage());

        $message = QueryLogSanitizer::message($exception);

        foreach ([self::COMPLAINT, self::BPJS, 'Duplicate entry', 'Integrity constraint violation', 'appointments_x'] as $secret) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($secret, $message, "Bocor ke log: {$secret}");
        }
    }

    public function test_the_raw_sql_with_embedded_bindings_is_not_used(): void
    {
        $message = QueryLogSanitizer::message($this->query());

        $this->assertStringContainsString('values (?, ?)', $message);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('values ('.self::COMPLAINT, $message);
    }

    public function test_unknown_parts_are_a_dash(): void
    {
        $message = QueryLogSanitizer::message(new QueryException('mariadb', 'select 1', [], new RuntimeException('galat')));

        $this->assertSame('Galat basis data: koneksi=mariadb sqlstate=- driver=- sql=select 1', $message);
    }

    public function test_a_unique_constraint_violation_is_a_query_exception_too(): void
    {
        $exception = new UniqueConstraintViolationException('mariadb', self::SQL, [self::COMPLAINT, self::BPJS], $this->driverError());

        $this->assertSame('Galat basis data: koneksi=mariadb sqlstate=23000 driver=1062 sql='.self::SQL, QueryLogSanitizer::message($exception));
    }

    public function test_the_sql_is_cut_at_one_thousand_characters(): void
    {
        $message = QueryLogSanitizer::message($this->query('select '.str_repeat('x', 1500)));

        $this->assertSame(1000, mb_strlen($this->sqlPart($message)));
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('select xxx', $this->sqlPart($message));
    }

    public function test_the_cut_counts_characters_not_bytes(): void
    {
        $message = QueryLogSanitizer::message($this->query(str_repeat("\u{00E9}", 1500)));

        $this->assertSame(1000, mb_strlen($this->sqlPart($message)));
        $this->assertTrue(mb_check_encoding($message, 'UTF-8'));
    }

    public function test_a_short_sql_is_kept_whole(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('select 1', $this->sqlPart(QueryLogSanitizer::message($this->query('select 1'))));
    }

    public function test_a_deadlock_exception_is_described_from_the_query_exception_in_its_chain(): void
    {
        $original = $this->query(self::SQL, $this->driverError(1213, '40001'));
        $deadlock = new DeadlockException($original->getMessage(), 0, $original);

        // Prasyarat: DeadlockException menyalin pesan galat asli yang berisi bindings.
        $this->assertStringContainsString(self::COMPLAINT, $deadlock->getMessage());

        $message = QueryLogSanitizer::message($deadlock);

        $this->assertSame('Galat basis data: koneksi=mariadb sqlstate=40001 driver=1213 sql='.self::SQL, $message);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(self::COMPLAINT, $message);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(self::BPJS, $message);
    }

    public function test_a_nested_deadlock_chain_is_followed_to_the_query_exception(): void
    {
        $original = $this->query(self::SQL, $this->driverError(1213, '40001'));
        $inner = new DeadlockException($original->getMessage(), 0, $original);
        $outer = new DeadlockException($inner->getMessage(), 0, $inner);

        $this->assertSame('Galat basis data: koneksi=mariadb sqlstate=40001 driver=1213 sql='.self::SQL, QueryLogSanitizer::message($outer));
    }

    public function test_a_deadlock_exception_without_a_query_exception_reveals_nothing(): void
    {
        $message = QueryLogSanitizer::message(new DeadlockException('SQLSTATE[40001]: ... 1213 Deadlock found ... (SQL: select '.self::COMPLAINT.')'));

        $this->assertSame('Galat basis data: koneksi=- sqlstate=- driver=- sql=-', $message);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Tulis tes `tests/Feature/Errors/QueryExceptionReportTest.php` (handler ASLI, log tertangkap, respons 500 generik)**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Errors;

use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
use Illuminate\Log\Events\MessageLogged;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PDOException;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\TestCase;
use Throwable;

/**
 * F7A-R25 / Review Focus E.4: callback `report` untuk `QueryException` dan `DeadlockException` di bootstrap/app.php, diuji dengan
 * handler ASLI (bukan Exceptions::fake(), yang melewati callback). Log nyata dialihkan ke saluran `null`; setiap tulisan log
 * ditangkap lewat MessageLogged. Bukti: bindings (keluhan, BPJS) TIDAK ada di log, SQL dengan `?` ADA, dan respons ke
 * pengguna tetap 500 generik.
 */
class QueryExceptionReportTest extends TestCase
{
    private const COMPLAINT = 'KELUHAN-RAHASIA';

    private const BPJS = '0001234567890';

    private const SQL = 'insert into `appointments` (`complaint`, `payment_reference`) values (?, ?)';

    private const EXPECTED = 'Galat basis data: koneksi=mariadb sqlstate=23000 driver=1062 sql='.self::SQL;

    /** @var list<MessageLogged> */
    private array $logged = [];

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        config(['app.debug' => false, 'logging.default' => 'null']);

        Event::listen(MessageLogged::class, function (MessageLogged $event): void {
            $this->logged[] = $event;
        });

        Route::middleware('web')->get('/_uji/query-gagal', fn () => throw $this->queryFault());
        Route::middleware('web')->post('/_uji/query-gagal-form', fn () => throw $this->queryFault());
        Route::middleware('web')->get('/_uji/unik-gagal', fn () => throw $this->uniqueFault());
        Route::middleware('web')->get('/_uji/deadlock-gagal', fn () => throw $this->deadlockFault());
        Route::middleware('web')->get('/_uji/galat-biasa', fn () => throw new RuntimeException('galat biasa'));
    }

    private function driverError(int $errno = 1062, string $state = '23000'): PDOException
    {
        $driverMessage = "Duplicate entry '".self::BPJS."' for key 'appointments_x'";
        $error = new PDOException("SQLSTATE[{$state}]: Integrity constraint violation: {$errno} {$driverMessage}");
        $error->errorInfo = [$state, $errno, $driverMessage];

        return $error;
    }

    private function queryFault(): QueryException
    {
        return new QueryException('mariadb', self::SQL, [self::COMPLAINT, self::BPJS], $this->driverError());
    }

    private function uniqueFault(): UniqueConstraintViolationException
    {
        return new UniqueConstraintViolationException('mariadb', self::SQL, [self::COMPLAINT, self::BPJS], $this->driverError());
    }

    private function deadlockFault(): DeadlockException
    {
        $original = new QueryException('mariadb', self::SQL, [self::COMPLAINT, self::BPJS], $this->driverError());

        return new DeadlockException($original->getMessage(), 0, $original);
    }

    /** @return list<MessageLogged> */
    private function errorRecords(): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter($this->logged, fn (MessageLogged $record): bool => $record->level === 'error'));
    }

    /** Seluruh isi semua catatan log (pesan + konteks, termasuk pesan pengecualian di konteks) untuk pencarian rahasia. */
    private function everythingLogged(): string
    {
        $blob = '';

        foreach ($this->logged as $record) {
            $blob .= $record->message."\n";

            foreach ($record->context as $value) {
                $blob .= ($value instanceof Throwable ? $value->getMessage() : json_encode($value))."\n";
            }
        }

        return $blob;
    }

    private function assertNoSecretInTheLog(): void
    {
        $blob = $this->everythingLogged();

        foreach ([self::COMPLAINT, self::BPJS, 'Duplicate entry', 'appointments_x'] as $secret) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($secret, $blob, "Bocor ke log: {$secret}");
        }
    }

    public function test_a_query_exception_is_logged_with_the_sql_placeholders_and_without_bindings(): void
    {
        $this->get('/_uji/query-gagal')->assertStatus(500);

        $errors = $this->errorRecords();
        $this->assertCount(1, $errors, 'Tepat satu catatan galat (pelaporan bawaan dihentikan).');
        $this->assertSame(self::EXPECTED, $errors[0]->message);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('values (?, ?)', $errors[0]->message);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('exception', $errors[0]->context, 'Pengecualian (yang pesannya memuat bindings) tidak ikut konteks.');
        $this->assertNoSecretInTheLog();
    }

    public function test_the_user_still_gets_the_generic_500_without_any_internal_detail(): void
    {
        $this->get('/_uji/query-gagal')
            ->assertStatus(500)
            ->assertSee('Terjadi kesalahan pada server')
            ->assertSee('Kami mencatat masalah ini.')
            ->assertDontSee(self::COMPLAINT)
            ->assertDontSee(self::BPJS)
            ->assertDontSee('insert into')
            ->assertDontSee('Duplicate entry')
            ->assertDontSee('QueryException')
            ->assertDontSee('Whoops');
    }

    public function test_a_json_client_also_gets_a_generic_500(): void
    {
        $response = $this->getJson('/_uji/query-gagal')->assertStatus(500);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(self::COMPLAINT, $response->getContent());
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('insert into', $response->getContent());
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->errorRecords());
    }

    public function test_a_failing_form_post_logs_no_submitted_value(): void
    {
        $this->post('/_uji/query-gagal-form', ['complaint' => self::COMPLAINT, 'bpjs_number' => self::BPJS])
            ->assertStatus(500)
            ->assertDontSee(self::COMPLAINT);

        $this->assertNoSecretInTheLog();
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->errorRecords());
    }

    public function test_a_unique_constraint_violation_is_sanitised_as_well(): void
    {
        $this->get('/_uji/unik-gagal')->assertStatus(500);

        $errors = $this->errorRecords();
        $this->assertCount(1, $errors);
        $this->assertSame(self::EXPECTED, $errors[0]->message);
        $this->assertNoSecretInTheLog();
    }

    public function test_a_deadlock_exception_is_logged_from_its_query_exception_without_bindings(): void
    {
        // Prasyarat: pesan DeadlockException menyalin pesan asli yang memuat bindings.
        $this->assertStringContainsString(self::COMPLAINT, $this->deadlockFault()->getMessage());

        $this->get('/_uji/deadlock-gagal')->assertStatus(500)->assertDontSee(self::COMPLAINT);

        $errors = $this->errorRecords();
        $this->assertCount(1, $errors);
        $this->assertSame(self::EXPECTED, $errors[0]->message);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('exception', $errors[0]->context);
        $this->assertNoSecretInTheLog();
    }

    public function test_the_report_helper_is_sanitised_too(): void
    {
        // Jalur non-HTTP (mis. `catch (Throwable $e) { report($e); }` pada notifier atau perintah konsol).
        report($this->queryFault());
        report($this->deadlockFault());

        $errors = $this->errorRecords();
        $this->assertCount(2, $errors);
        $this->assertSame(self::EXPECTED, $errors[0]->message);
        $this->assertSame(self::EXPECTED, $errors[1]->message);
        $this->assertNoSecretInTheLog();
    }

    public function test_other_exceptions_are_still_reported_by_default_with_their_own_message_and_context(): void
    {
        $this->get('/_uji/galat-biasa')->assertStatus(500);

        $errors = $this->errorRecords();
        $this->assertCount(1, $errors);
        $this->assertSame('galat biasa', $errors[0]->message);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(RuntimeException::class, $errors[0]->context['exception']);
    }

    public function test_booking_exceptions_remain_unreported(): void
    {
        report(BookingException::make(BookingException::QUOTA_FULL));

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorRecords());
    }
}

- [ ] **Step 9: Buat `app/Support/QueryLogSanitizer.php` (tool Write)**

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Support;

use Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Pesan log galat basis data tanpa data pasien (F7A-R25, 00 E.6): hanya nama koneksi, SQLSTATE, kode driver, dan SQL
 * dengan penanda `?` (maks 1000 karakter). Bindings (keluhan, alamat, nomor BPJS), `getRawSql()`, pesan Laravel (yang
 * menyisipkan bindings), dan pesan driver (`Duplicate entry '…'`) sengaja tidak dipakai. `DeadlockException` tidak membawa
 * SQL sendiri dan pesannya menyalin pesan galat asli, sehingga rantai `getPrevious()` ditelusuri sampai `QueryException`.
 * Batasan: SQL yang sengaja menyisipkan nilai literal tidak dapat disanitasi; kode proyek selalu memakai bindings.
 */
final class QueryLogSanitizer
{
    /** Panjang SQL maksimum (karakter). */
    public const MAX_SQL_LENGTH = 1000;

    public static function message(QueryException|DeadlockException $e): string
    {
        $query = self::queryException($e);
        $info = $query?->errorInfo ?? [];

        return sprintf(
            'Galat basis data: koneksi=%s sqlstate=%s driver=%s sql=%s',
            $query === null ? '-' : self::part($query->getConnectionName()),
            self::part($info[0] ?? null),
            self::part($info[1] ?? null),
            $query === null ? '-' : self::part(mb_substr((string) $query->getSql(), 0, self::MAX_SQL_LENGTH)),
        );
    }

    private static function queryException(Throwable $source): ?QueryException
    {
        $current = $source;

        while ($current !== null) {
            if ($current instanceof QueryException) {
                return $current;
            }

            $current = $current->getPrevious();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static function part(mixed $value): string
    {
        $text = is_scalar($value) ? (string) $value : '';

        return $text === '' ? '-' : $text;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Concurrency;

use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Doctors\DoctorService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use Tests\Support\Concurrency\ConcurrencyTestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R26 (carry F3/F6): `DoctorService::archive()` dan `changeStatus()` mengulang transaksi sampai tiga kali pada
 * deadlock dan, bila tetap gagal, menjawab `ValidationException` pesan sibuk pada kunci `status` (bukan 500) tanpa tulisan parsial.
 * Galat disuntikkan dengan injectFault (errno 1213); tidak ada proses anak. Titik gangguan: tulis dokter (galat langsung),
 * tulis sesi praktik (transaksi bersarang: DeadlockException), dan tulis templat jadwal (sesudah dokter dan sesi tertulis:
 * pembuktian rollback).
 */
#[Group('concurrency')]
class DoctorServiceRetryTest extends ConcurrencyTestCase
{
    private const DEADLOCK = 'SQLSTATE[40001]: Serialization failure: 1213 Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction';

    private const BUSY = 'Sistem sedang sibuk, silakan coba lagi beberapa saat.';

    /**
     * Dokter aktif dengan satu sesi mendatang tanpa pendaftaran (arsip/nonaktif membatalkannya).
     *
     * @return array{0: Doctor, 1: PracticeSession}
     */
    private function scenario(): array
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession();

        return [Doctor::query()->findOrFail($session->doctor_id), $session];
    }

    private function service(): DoctorService
    {
        return $this->app->make(DoctorService::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string}>
     */
    public static function archiveFaultPoints(): array
    {
        return [
            'tulis dokter (galat langsung)' => ['update `doctors`'],
            'tulis sesi praktik (transaksi bersarang)' => ['update `practice_sessions`'],
            'tulis templat jadwal (sesudah dokter dan sesi tertulis)' => ['update `doctor_schedules`'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string}>
     */
    public static function statusFaultPoints(): array
    {
        return [
            'tulis dokter (galat langsung)' => ['update `doctors`'],
            'tulis sesi praktik (transaksi bersarang)' => ['update `practice_sessions`'],
        ];
    }

    /** Tidak ada tulisan parsial: dokter aktif, sesi terbuka, dan jumlah audit sama dengan sebelum percobaan. */
    private function assertNothingWritten(Doctor $doctor, PracticeSession $session, int $auditsBefore): void
    {
        $fresh = Doctor::query()->findOrFail($doctor->id);
        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Active, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->archived_at);

        $freshSession = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $freshSession->status);
        $this->assertNull($freshSession->status_reason);

        $this->assertSame($auditsBefore, $this->rowsSince('audit_logs'), 'Tidak ada baris audit yang tertinggal.');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ archive()

    #[DataProvider('archiveFaultPoints')]
    public function test_archive_retries_a_transient_deadlock_and_succeeds_on_the_third_attempt(string $fragment): void
    {
        [$doctor, $session] = $this->scenario();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $service = $this->service();
        $fault = $this->injectFault($fragment, 1213, '40001', self::DEADLOCK, 2);

        $service->archive($doctor, 'Uji retry', Actor::staff($staff));

        $this->assertSame(3, $fault->hits, 'Dua kegagalan lalu sukses pada percobaan ketiga.');
        $this->assertSame(2, $fault->thrown);

        $fresh = Doctor::query()->findOrFail($doctor->id);
        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Archived, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertNotNull($fresh->archived_at);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->rowsSince('audit_logs', 'doctor.archived'), 'Satu audit walau diulang.');
        $this->assertSame(1, $service->lastReport()?->cancelled, 'Laporan dampak hanya dari percobaan yang berhasil.');
    }

    #[DataProvider('archiveFaultPoints')]
    public function test_archive_with_a_persistent_deadlock_becomes_the_busy_message_without_partial_writes(string $fragment): void
    {
        [$doctor, $session] = $this->scenario();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $service = $this->service();
        $auditsBefore = $this->rowsSince('audit_logs');
        $fault = $this->injectFault($fragment, 1213, '40001', self::DEADLOCK);

        try {
            $service->archive($doctor, 'Uji retry', Actor::staff($staff));
            $this->fail('ValidationException pesan sibuk tidak dilempar.');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(['status' => [self::BUSY]], $e->errors());
        }

        $this->assertSame(3, $fault->hits, 'Tiga percobaan sebelum menyerah.');
        $this->assertNull($service->lastReport());
        $this->assertNothingWritten($doctor, $session, $auditsBefore);
    }

    public function test_archive_does_not_translate_a_non_concurrency_database_error(): void
    {
        [$doctor, $session] = $this->scenario();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $service = $this->service();
        $auditsBefore = $this->rowsSince('audit_logs');
        $fault = $this->injectFault('update `doctors`', 1406, '22001', "SQLSTATE[22001]: String data, right truncated: 1406 Data too long for column 'status' at row 1");

        try {
            $service->archive($doctor, 'Uji retry', Actor::staff($staff));
            $this->fail('QueryException tidak dilempar.');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('22001', $e->errorInfo[0]);
        }

        $this->assertSame(1, $fault->hits, 'Galat bukan konkurensi tidak diulang.');
        $this->assertNull($service->lastReport());
        $this->assertNothingWritten($doctor, $session, $auditsBefore);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ changeStatus()

    #[DataProvider('statusFaultPoints')]
    public function test_deactivating_retries_a_transient_deadlock_and_succeeds_on_the_third_attempt(string $fragment): void
    {
        [$doctor, $session] = $this->scenario();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $service = $this->service();
        $fault = $this->injectFault($fragment, 1213, '40001', self::DEADLOCK, 2);

        $service->changeStatus($doctor, DoctorStatus::Inactive, 'Cuti panjang', Actor::staff($staff));

        $this->assertSame(3, $fault->hits);
        $this->assertSame(2, $fault->thrown);
        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Inactive, Doctor::query()->findOrFail($doctor->id)->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->rowsSince('audit_logs', 'doctor.status_changed'));
        $this->assertSame(1, $service->lastReport()?->cancelled);
    }

    #[DataProvider('statusFaultPoints')]
    public function test_deactivating_with_a_persistent_deadlock_becomes_the_busy_message_without_partial_writes(string $fragment): void
    {
        [$doctor, $session] = $this->scenario();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $service = $this->service();
        $auditsBefore = $this->rowsSince('audit_logs');
        $fault = $this->injectFault($fragment, 1213, '40001', self::DEADLOCK);

        try {
            $service->changeStatus($doctor, DoctorStatus::Inactive, 'Cuti panjang', Actor::staff($staff));
            $this->fail('ValidationException pesan sibuk tidak dilempar.');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(['status' => [self::BUSY]], $e->errors());
        }

        $this->assertSame(3, $fault->hits);
        $this->assertNull($service->lastReport());
        $this->assertNothingWritten($doctor, $session, $auditsBefore);
    }

    public function test_reactivating_retries_a_transient_deadlock_too(): void
    {
        [$doctor] = $this->scenario();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        Doctor::query()->whereKey($doctor->id)->update(['status' => DoctorStatus::Inactive->value]);
        $fault = $this->injectFault('update `doctors`', 1213, '40001', self::DEADLOCK, 2);

        $this->service()->changeStatus(Doctor::query()->findOrFail($doctor->id), DoctorStatus::Active, null, Actor::staff($staff));

        $this->assertSame(3, $fault->hits);
        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Active, Doctor::query()->findOrFail($doctor->id)->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->rowsSince('audit_logs', 'doctor.status_changed'));
    }

    public function test_the_validation_refusals_are_unchanged_by_the_retry_wrapper(): void
    {
        [$doctor] = $this->scenario();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $service = $this->service();
        $service->archive($doctor, 'Uji', Actor::staff($staff));

        try {
            $service->archive(Doctor::query()->findOrFail($doctor->id), 'Uji lagi', Actor::staff($staff));
            $this->fail('Arsip ganda harus ditolak.');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(['status' => ['Dokter sudah diarsipkan.']], $e->errors(), 'Penolakan validasi tidak diulang dan tidak menjadi pesan sibuk.');
        }

        $this->assertSame(1, $this->rowsSince('audit_logs', 'doctor.archived'));
    }
}

Bila slot `empty` diberikan, ia menggantikan seluruh pesan kosong bawaan (termasuk "Hapus filter"), sehingga slot `empty` di view ini memuat tombol "Hapus filter" sendiri (hanya saat ada query) dan tombol "Buat profil baru" (BP 05 #37: "Pencarian kosong → Pasien tidak ditemukan + tombol Buat profil baru").

- **Mode ketat Eloquent**: daftar memakai kolom model saja (`registration_channel`, `user_id`); riwayat di detail memuat `clinic`, `doctor`, `practiceSession` (wajib untuk `queue_label`, `display_name`, `time_range`); `user` dan `creator` dimuat sekali di detail. Tes daftar memakai 12 baris agar pelanggaran lazy loading tertangkap.

- **Riwayat pendaftaran**: paginator kedua memakai nama halaman `riwayat` (10 baris), jadi tidak bentrok dengan query `page`/`per_page` daftar. <?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

/**

 * EMP-03, dan SEK-15 (nama ber-HTML ter-escape).
 */
class AdminPatientsIndexTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    private function profile(array $attributes = []): PatientProfile
    {
        return PatientProfile::factory()->create($attributes);
    }

    /** Tiga profil walk-in bernomor tetap (nomor eksplisit agar tidak bentrok dengan nomor acak factory). */
    private function seedThree(): void
    {
        $this->profile(['full_name' => 'Siti Rahma', 'patient_number' => 'P000123', 'phone' => '081200000001', 'birth_date' => '1990-03-12']);
        $this->profile(['full_name' => 'Budi Santoso', 'patient_number' => 'P000124', 'phone' => '081200000002', 'birth_date' => '1985-07-03']);
        $this->profile(['full_name' => 'Dewi Lestari', 'patient_number' => 'P000125', 'phone' => '081300000003', 'birth_date' => '2001-01-20']);
    }

    // --- akses -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string}>
     */
    public static function viewers(): array
    {
        return [
            'super admin' => ['super-admin'],
            'petugas pendaftaran' => ['registration-officer'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('viewers')]
    public function test_staff_with_patients_view_can_open_the_list(string $role): void
    {
        $this->seedThree();

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))
            ->get(route('admin.patients.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Siti Rahma')
            ->assertSee('P000123');
    }

    public function test_admin_konten_gets_403_and_sees_no_patient_data_pas_07(): void
    {
        $this->seedThree();

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->get(route('admin.patients.index'))
            ->assertForbidden()
            ->assertDontSee('Siti Rahma')
            ->assertDontSee('P000123');
    }

    public function test_patient_gets_403_and_guest_is_redirected_to_admin_login(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createPatient())
            ->get(route('admin.patients.index'))
            ->assertForbidden();

        $this->app['auth']->forgetGuards();

        $this->get(route('admin.patients.index'))->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
    }

    public function test_urls_use_the_indonesian_segments_and_patients_have_no_destroy_route(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->profile();

        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/pasien'), route('admin.patients.index'));
        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/pasien/'.$profile->id), route('admin.patients.show', $profile));
        $this->assertFalse(Route::has('admin.patients.destroy'));
    }

    public function test_the_sidebar_shows_the_patient_menu_item_to_the_registration_officer(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('registration-officer'))
            ->get(route('admin.patients.index'))

    }

            'nama huruf besar' => ['SANTOSO', ['Budi Santoso'], ['Siti Rahma', 'Dewi Lestari']],

    /**

    #[DataProvider('searches')]

    {

    public function test_the_channel_and_status_filters_narrow_the_list(): void
    {

        $this->profile(['full_name' => 'Walk In Nonaktif', 'patient_number' => 'P000202', 'is_active' => false]);

    {

use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Detail pasien admin (#37): PAS-06 (BPJS tersamar, nomor lengkap tidak ada di HTML), akun terhubung atau "Tanpa akun",
 * riwayat pendaftaran terbaru dengan paginasi (halaman `riwayat`), 404 untuk id tak ada atau non-numerik, akses, SEK-15,
 * dan kontrak jangkar `<x-slot:actions>` (C.1c).
 */
class AdminPatientShowTest extends TestCase

    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    private int $sequence = 0;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poli Anak', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.A'], $this->clinic);

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** Kode booking valid (alfabet Crockford) dan berurutan: UPH-ABCD-0001, UPH-ABCD-0002, … */
    private function code(): string
    {
        return sprintf('UPH-ABCD-%04d', ++$this->sequence);
    }

    private function sessionOn(string $date): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,

     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function book(PatientProfile $profile, string $date, AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, array $overrides = []): Appointment
    {
        return $this->bookAppointment($this->sessionOn($date), $status, array_merge([
            'booking_code' => $this->code(),
            'patient_profile_id' => $profile->id,
        ], $overrides));

- [ ] **Step 7: Buat `app/Http/Requests/Admin/PatientIndexRequest.php` (tool Write)**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientSearch;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Filter daftar pasien admin (F7A-R15, 05 §408): `q` (satu kotak: nama, no. pasien, telepon, tanggal lahir dd/mm/yyyy;
 * diterjemahkan PatientSearch::apply, F7A-R16), `kanal` (`online`|`loket`), `status` (`aktif`|`nonaktif`). Urutan tetap
 * `full_name` naik lalu `id` (tanpa `urut`). Nilai tidak valid, termasuk larik, diabaikan oleh basis (12 V-45, 00 I.5).
 */
class PatientIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::rules(), [
            'kanal' => ['nullable', Rule::in(array_map(fn (BookingChannel $channel): string => $channel->value, BookingChannel::cases()))],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::messages(), [
            'kanal.in' => 'Kanal tidak valid.',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function statusValues(): array
    {
        return ['aktif', 'nonaktif'];
    }

    /** Kanal yang berlaku untuk tampilan filter: string kosong bila tidak ada atau tidak valid. */
    public function kanalFilter(): string
    {
        return $this->filters()['kanal'] ?? '';
    }

    /** Status yang berlaku untuk tampilan filter: string kosong bila tidak ada atau tidak valid. */
    public function statusFilter(): string
    {
        return $this->filters()['status'] ?? '';
    }

    /**
     * @param  Builder<PatientProfile>  $query
     * @return Builder<PatientProfile>
     */
    public function applyTo(Builder $query, PatientSearch $search): Builder
    {
        $filters = $this->filters();
        $model = $query->getModel();

        if (isset($filters['q'])) {
            $query = $search->apply($query, $filters['q']);
        }

        if (isset($filters['kanal'])) {
            $query->where($model->qualifyColumn('registration_channel'), $filters['kanal']);
        }

        if (isset($filters['status'])) {
            $query->where($model->qualifyColumn('is_active'), $filters['status'] === 'aktif');
        }

        return $query
            ->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('full_name'))
            ->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('id'));
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Buat `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/PatientController.php` (tool Write)**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\PatientIndexRequest;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientSearch;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class PatientController extends Controller
{
    public function index(PatientIndexRequest $request, PatientSearch $search): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', PatientProfile::class);

        $patients = $request
            ->applyTo(PatientProfile::query(), $search)
            ->paginate($request->perPage());

        return view('admin.patients.index', [
            'patients' => $patients,
            'kanalFilter' => $request->kanalFilter(),
            'statusFilter' => $request->statusFilter(),
        ]);
    }

    public function show(PatientProfile $patient): View
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $patient);

        $patient->loadMissing(['user', 'creator']);

        $appointments = Appointment::query()
            ->forPatient($patient)
            ->with(['clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession'])
            ->orderByDesc('session_date')
            ->orderByDesc('id')
            ->paginate(10, ['*'], 'riwayat');

        return view('admin.patients.show', [
            'patient' => $patient,
            'appointments' => $appointments,
        ]);
    }
}
```

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Pola grup route**: `Route::resource('pasien', …)->only([...])` dipanggil dua kali dengan `->names('patients')` yang sama (pola dokter, `routes/admin.php`); grup `patients.manage` didaftarkan SEBELUM grup `patients.view` supaya `/admin/pasien/buat` tidak tertangkap `{patient}` (selain itu `{patient}` numerik oleh grup admin, sehingga `buat` tidak pernah cocok).
- **`kembali` (F7A-R31)** TIDAK divalidasi sebagai aturan form: nilai larik atau liar pada POST cukup diabaikan (bukan galat validasi) lewat `walkInReturn()`, yang menerima nilai hanya bila `SafeRedirect::internalPath()` lolos DAN path-nya persis `/admin/pendaftaran/buat` (kuat dari awalan palsu seperti `/admin/pendaftaran/buatXYZ` atau `/admin/pendaftaran/buat/../x`). Hasilnya dibangun ulang dengan `http_build_query` (query `pasien` diganti atau ditambah; query lain dipertahankan). Field tersembunyi `kembali` di form hanya memakai nilai yang sudah dibersihkan controller, BUKAN `old('kembali')` (nilai larik pada `old()` memicu "Array to string conversion").
- **Profil mirip (BR-102, F7A-R11)**: galat `confirm_not_duplicate` dibuat di `StorePatientRequest::after()` hanya bila `full_name`, `birth_date`, dan `phone` sudah lolos dan kotak belum dicentang. Daftar profil mirip ditampilkan oleh `@create` (GET sesudah redirect) dari input lama (`$request->old()`), tanpa menyimpan apa pun di sesi; `old()` memuat nilai yang sudah dinormalkan karena `prepareForValidation()` memakai `merge()`.
- **Email profil berakun (F7A-R9)**: `UpdatePatientRequest` tidak memuat aturan `email` untuk profil berakun sehingga `validated()` tidak memuatnya dan `updateProfile()` tidak mengubahnya; field `email` di form diganti kotak teks hanya-baca TANPA atribut `name`. Nama dan telepon ikut disinkronkan ke `users` oleh `updateProfile()`.
- **Tanpa BPJS di form profil (F7A-R8)**: tidak ada field `bpjs_number`/`remove_bpjs`; nilai `bpjs_number` yang dikirim tidak ada di `rules()` sehingga tidak masuk `validated()`, tidak pernah disimpan, dan tidak masuk audit.
- **Modal status**: `x-confirm-modal` memberi `action` default lewat prop (`:action="route(...)"`) dan JS admin (`resources/js/admin.js`) hanya menimpa `action`/teks bila pemicu memakai `data-confirm-action`; di halaman detail tombol hanya memakai `data-bs-target`. Textarea alasan ditulis sendiri di slot (BUKAN prop `reasonRequired`) agar memuat `minlength="5" maxlength="255"` dan teks bantuan; JS mengosongkan `textarea[name="reason"]` saat modal ditutup. Galat validasi dan galat service dikirim ulang sebagai flash `error` karena modal sudah tertutup (pola `UpdateDoctorStatusRequest::failedValidation()` dan `PracticeSessionController::status()`).
- **Status sama** (aktifkan profil yang sudah aktif): service tidak menulis dan tidak mengaudit (F7A-R10); controller tetap menjawab dengan flash sukses karena keadaan akhir sudah sesuai.
- **Jumlah tes baru** 96 (`AdminPatientFormTest` 70 dengan provider, `AdminPatientStatusTest` 26; terukur di uji coba integrasi; satu tes lama di `AdminPatientsIndexTest` diganti dua tes).

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientNumberGenerator;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Tambah dan ubah profil pasien oleh petugas (#37, F7A-R8/R9/R11/R31): WLK-01 lewat HTTP (sukses, persetujuan lisan,
 * profil mirip, telepon, batas nama/alamat, BPJS tidak tersimpan), `kembali` ke form walk-in, ubah profil walk-in dan
 * profil berakun (email hanya-baca), akses (AKS-04, PAS-07), dan SEK-11 (BPJS tidak masuk audit).
 */
class AdminPatientFormTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const SIMILAR = 'Terdapat profil yang mirip. Pilih profil yang sudah ada atau centang konfirmasi untuk tetap membuat profil baru.';

    private const CONSENT = 'Persetujuan privasi lisan dari pasien wajib dicentang.';

    private const PHONE = 'Nomor telepon tidak valid. Gunakan nomor seluler Indonesia, mis. 081234567890.';

    private User $officer;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        $this->officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function payload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'full_name' => 'Siti Rahma',
            'birth_date' => '1990-03-12',
            'gender' => 'P',
            'phone' => '0812-3456-7890',
            'email' => '',
            'address' => 'Jl. Merpati No. 5, Pamulang',
            'verbal_consent' => '1',
        ], $overrides);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function store(array $overrides = [], ?User $user = null): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->officer)
            ->from(route('admin.patients.create'))
            ->post(route('admin.patients.store'), $this->payload($overrides));
    }

    private function created(string $name = 'Siti Rahma'): PatientProfile
    {
        return PatientProfile::query()->where('full_name', $name)->sole();
    }

    // --- WLK-01: sukses ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_a_walk_in_profile_is_created_with_the_verbal_consent_wlk_01(): void
    {
        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 08:00:00'));

        $response = $this->store();

        $profile = $this->created();

        $response->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.show', $profile))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Profil pasien '.$profile->patient_number.' berhasil dibuat.');

        $this->assertNull($profile->user_id);
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Loket, $profile->registration_channel);
        $this->assertSame($this->officer->id, (int) $profile->created_by_user_id);
        $this->assertSame(PatientNumberGenerator::format($profile->id), $profile->patient_number);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/^P\d{6}$/', $profile->patient_number);
        $this->assertSame('P', $profile->gender->value);
        $this->assertSame('1990-03-12', $profile->birth_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('081234567890', $profile->phone);
        $this->assertNull($profile->email);
        $this->assertSame('Jl. Merpati No. 5, Pamulang', $profile->address);
        $this->assertTrue($profile->is_active);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-05 08:00:00', $profile->consent_at->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
        $this->assertSame(app(SettingsService::class)->string('privacy.consent_version', '1.0'), $profile->consent_version);

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.created')->sole();

        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Staff, $log->actor_type);
        $this->assertSame($this->officer->id, (int) $log->user_id);
        $this->assertSame('Profil pasien '.$profile->patient_number.' dibuat oleh petugas (walk-in).', $log->description);
        $this->assertSame('loket', $log->new_values['registration_channel']);
        $this->assertSame($profile->patient_number, $log->new_values['patient_number']);
    }

    public function test_a_valid_email_is_stored_lowercase_and_the_profile_stays_without_an_account(): void
    {
        $this->store(['email' => ' Siti.Rahma@Contoh.Test ']);

        $profile = $this->created();

        $this->assertSame('siti.rahma@contoh.test', $profile->email);
        $this->assertNull($profile->user_id);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('users', 1);
    }

    public function test_the_bpjs_number_is_never_stored_even_when_it_is_posted(): void
    {
        $this->store(['bpjs_number' => '0009900000011', 'remove_bpjs' => '0']);

        $profile = $this->created();

        $this->assertNull($profile->bpjs_number);
        $this->assertNull($profile->bpjs_number_last4);
        $this->assertNull(\Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('patient_profiles')->where('id', $profile->id)->value('bpjs_number'));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('0009900000011', (string) json_encode(AuditLog::query()->get()->toArray()));
    }

    // --- WLK-01: persetujuan lisan -----------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string|null}>
     */
    public static function missingConsent(): array
    {
        return [
            'tanpa centang' => [null],
            'kosong' => [''],
            'nol' => ['0'],
            'false' => ['false'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('missingConsent')]
    public function test_without_the_verbal_consent_nothing_is_saved(?string $value): void
    {
        $this->store(['verbal_consent' => $value])
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.create'))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['verbal_consent' => self::CONSENT]);

        $this->assertDatabaseCount('patient_profiles', 0);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('audit_logs', ['action' => 'patient.created']);
    }

    // --- BR-102: profil mirip -----------------------------------------------------------------

    private function existingSiti(array $overrides = []): PatientProfile
    {
        return PatientProfile::factory()->create(array_merge([
            'full_name' => 'Siti Rahma',
            'birth_date' => '1990-03-12',
            'phone' => '081299990000',
            'patient_number' => 'P000500',
        ], $overrides));
    }

    public function test_a_profile_with_the_same_name_and_birth_date_must_be_confirmed(): void
    {
        $this->existingSiti();

        $this->store()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.create'))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['confirm_not_duplicate' => self::SIMILAR]);

        $this->assertDatabaseCount('patient_profiles', 1);
    }

    public function test_a_profile_with_the_same_phone_must_be_confirmed(): void
    {
        $this->existingSiti(['full_name' => 'Orang Lain', 'birth_date' => '1975-01-01', 'phone' => '081234567890']);

        $this->store()->assertSessionHasErrors(['confirm_not_duplicate' => self::SIMILAR]);

        $this->assertDatabaseCount('patient_profiles', 1);
    }

    public function test_the_second_submit_with_the_confirmation_creates_the_new_profile(): void
    {
        $existing = $this->existingSiti();

        $this->store()->assertSessionHasErrors('confirm_not_duplicate');

        $this->store(['confirm_not_duplicate' => '1'])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertDatabaseCount('patient_profiles', 2);
        $this->assertTrue(PatientProfile::query()->where('full_name', 'Siti Rahma')->where('id', '!=', $existing->id)->exists());
    }

    public function test_a_profile_that_is_not_similar_needs_no_confirmation(): void
    {
        $this->existingSiti(['birth_date' => '1991-03-12', 'phone' => '081299990000']);

        $this->store()->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertDatabaseCount('patient_profiles', 2);
    }

    public function test_an_inactive_profile_is_not_considered_similar(): void
    {
        $this->existingSiti(['is_active' => false]);

        $this->store()->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertDatabaseCount('patient_profiles', 2);
    }

    public function test_the_form_lists_the_similar_profiles_and_offers_the_confirmation_checkbox(): void
    {
        $existing = $this->existingSiti();

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->followingRedirects()
            ->from(route('admin.patients.create'))
            ->post(route('admin.patients.store'), $this->payload())
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Profil yang mirip ditemukan')
            ->assertSee('P000500')
            ->assertSee('081299990000')
            ->assertSee('12/03/1990')
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('admin.patients.show', $existing).'"', false)
            ->assertSee('name="confirm_not_duplicate"', false)
            ->assertSee('Tetap buat profil baru')
            ->assertSee(self::SIMILAR)
            ->assertSee('value="Siti Rahma"', false);
    }

    public function test_the_similar_list_offers_a_pick_link_back_to_the_walk_in_form(): void
    {
        $existing = $this->existingSiti();
        $kembali = '/admin/pendaftaran/buat?poli=x';

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->followingRedirects()
            ->from(route('admin.patients.create', ['kembali' => $kembali]))
            ->post(route('admin.patients.store'), $this->payload(['kembali' => $kembali]))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('poli=x&amp;pasien='.$existing->id, false);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $input
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidInputs')]
    public function test_invalid_input_is_rejected_with_an_indonesian_message(array $input, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $input = array_map(function (mixed $value): mixed {
            if (is_string($value) && str_starts_with($value, 'str:')) {
                [, $length, $char, $suffix] = array_pad(explode(':', $value, 4), 4, '');

                return str_repeat($char, (int) $length).$suffix;
            }

            return $value;
        }, $input);

        $this->store($input)
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.create'))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors([$field => $message]);

        $this->assertDatabaseCount('patient_profiles', 0);
    }

            'nama 100 karakter, alamat 500 karakter' => [['full_name' => str_repeat('a', 100), 'address' => str_repeat('x', 500)]],
            'telepon dengan +62' => [['phone' => '+62 812-3456-7890']],
            'email 255 karakter' => [['email' => str_repeat('a', 64).'@'.str_repeat('b', 62).'.'.str_repeat('c', 62).'.'.str_repeat('d', 59).'.test']],
        ];
    }

    public function test_the_create_page_carries_only_a_valid_return_path(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->officer);

        $this->get(route('admin.patients.create', ['kembali' => '/admin/pendaftaran/buat?poli=x']))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('name="kembali" value="/admin/pendaftaran/buat?poli=x"', false)
            ->assertSee('href="'.url('/admin/pendaftaran/buat?poli=x').'"', false);

        foreach (['https://situs-lain.test', '//situs-lain.test', '/pasien', '/admin/pendaftaran/buatXYZ'] as $path) {

            ->assertDontSee('name="password"', false)
            ->assertDontSee('name="nik"', false);
    }

    public function test_a_failed_submit_renders_the_errors_summary_and_keeps_the_input_without_bpjs(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->followingRedirects()
            ->from(route('admin.patients.create'))
            ->post(route('admin.patients.store'), $this->payload(['phone' => 'abc', 'bpjs_number' => '0009900000011']))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Periksa kembali isian Anda')
            ->assertSee(self::PHONE)
            ->assertSee('value="Siti Rahma"', false)
            ->assertDontSee('0009900000011');
    }

    // --- ubah profil ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function updatePayload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'full_name' => 'Siti Rahmawati',
            'birth_date' => '1990-03-13',
            'gender' => 'P',
            'phone' => '0813-1111-2222',
            'email' => 'Siti@Contoh.test',
            'address' => 'Jl. Baru No. 1, Pamulang',
        ], $overrides);
    }

    public function test_the_edit_page_for_a_walk_in_profile_has_an_editable_email_and_no_bpjs_field(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->withBpjs('0009900000011')->create(['full_name' => 'Siti Rahma', 'patient_number' => 'P000600', 'birth_date' => '1990-03-12', 'gender' => 'P']);

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->get(route('admin.patients.edit', $profile))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<h1 class="mb-1">Ubah Siti Rahma</h1>', false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">Ubah</li>', false)
            ->assertSee('value="Siti Rahma"', false)
            ->assertSee('value="1990-03-12"', false)
            ->assertSee('value="P" checked', false)
            ->assertSee('name="email"', false)
            ->assertSee('Simpan Perubahan')
            ->assertDontSee('name="verbal_consent"', false)
            ->assertDontSee('name="bpjs_number"', false)
            ->assertDontSee('0009900000011');
    }

    public function test_the_edit_page_for_a_linked_profile_shows_the_email_read_only(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'akun@contoh.test']);

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->get(route('admin.patients.edit', $user->patientProfile))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('akun@contoh.test')
            ->assertSee('Email akun tidak dapat diubah dari layar admin.')
            ->assertSee('readonly', false)
            ->assertDontSee('name="email"', false);
    }

    public function test_a_walk_in_profile_is_updated_and_system_fields_cannot_be_changed(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->withBpjs('0009900000011')->create([
            'full_name' => 'Siti Rahma',
            'patient_number' => 'P000600',
            'email' => 'lama@contoh.test',
        ]);
        $consentAt = $profile->consent_at->toDateTimeString();

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->from(route('admin.patients.edit', $profile))
            ->put(route('admin.patients.update', $profile), $this->updatePayload([
                'registration_channel' => 'online',
                'user_id' => 999,
                'patient_number' => 'P999999',
                'is_active' => '0',
                'bpjs_number' => '1111111111111',
                'remove_bpjs' => '1',
                'consent_at' => '2000-01-01 00:00:00',
                'created_by_user_id' => $this->officer->id,
            ]))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.show', $profile))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Profil pasien P000600 diperbarui.');

        $fresh = $profile->fresh();

        $this->assertSame('Siti Rahmawati', $fresh->full_name);
        $this->assertSame('1990-03-13', $fresh->birth_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('081311112222', $fresh->phone);
        $this->assertSame('siti@contoh.test', $fresh->email);
        $this->assertSame('Jl. Baru No. 1, Pamulang', $fresh->address);
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Loket, $fresh->registration_channel);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->user_id);
        $this->assertSame('P000600', $fresh->patient_number);
        $this->assertTrue($fresh->is_active);
        $this->assertSame($consentAt, $fresh->consent_at->toDateTimeString());
        $this->assertNull($fresh->created_by_user_id);
        $this->assertSame('0009900000011', $fresh->bpjs_number);
        $this->assertSame('0011', $fresh->bpjs_number_last4);

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.updated')->sole();
        $encoded = (string) json_encode($log->toArray());

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('0009900000011', $encoded);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('1111111111111', $encoded);
    }

    public function test_clearing_the_email_of_a_walk_in_profile_stores_null(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->create(['email' => 'lama@contoh.test']);

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->put(route('admin.patients.update', $profile), $this->updatePayload(['email' => '']))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertNull($profile->fresh()->email);
    }

    public function test_updating_a_linked_profile_keeps_the_email_and_syncs_name_and_phone_to_the_account(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient(
            ['email' => 'akun@contoh.test', 'name' => 'Nama Lama', 'phone' => '081200000010'],
            ['full_name' => 'Nama Lama', 'phone' => '081200000010', 'patient_number' => 'P000601'],
        );
        $profile = $user->patientProfile;

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->from(route('admin.patients.edit', $profile))
            ->put(route('admin.patients.update', $profile), $this->updatePayload([
                'full_name' => 'Nama Baru Pasien',
                'phone' => '0813 0000 0020',
                'email' => 'lain@contoh.test',
            ]))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.show', $profile))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Profil pasien P000601 diperbarui.');

        $profile->refresh();
        $user->refresh();

        $this->assertSame('Nama Baru Pasien', $profile->full_name);
        $this->assertSame('081300000020', $profile->phone);
        $this->assertSame('akun@contoh.test', $profile->email);
        $this->assertSame('Nama Baru Pasien', $user->name);
        $this->assertSame('081300000020', $user->phone);
        $this->assertSame('akun@contoh.test', $user->email);
    }

    public function test_an_invalid_email_is_ignored_for_a_linked_profile_but_rejected_for_a_walk_in(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'akun@contoh.test']);
        $walkIn = PatientProfile::factory()->create();

        $this->actingAs($this->officer);

        $this->put(route('admin.patients.update', $user->patientProfile), $this->updatePayload(['email' => 'bukan-email']))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->from(route('admin.patients.edit', $walkIn))
            ->put(route('admin.patients.update', $walkIn), $this->updatePayload(['email' => 'bukan-email']))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.edit', $walkIn))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['email' => 'Format email tidak valid.']);
    }

    public function test_an_invalid_update_changes_nothing(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->create(['full_name' => 'Siti Rahma', 'phone' => '081200000001']);

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->from(route('admin.patients.edit', $profile))
            ->put(route('admin.patients.update', $profile), $this->updatePayload(['phone' => 'abc']))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.edit', $profile))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['phone' => self::PHONE]);

        $this->assertSame('Siti Rahma', $profile->fresh()->full_name);
        $this->assertSame('081200000001', $profile->fresh()->phone);
    }

    public function test_update_and_edit_of_an_unknown_or_malformed_id_answer_404(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->officer);

        $this->get('/admin/pasien/999999/ubah')->assertNotFound();
        $this->get('/admin/pasien/abc/ubah')->assertNotFound();
        $this->put('/admin/pasien/999999', $this->updatePayload())->assertNotFound();
    }

    // --- akses -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_admin_konten_cannot_use_any_mutating_screen_aks_04_pas_07(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->create(['full_name' => 'Siti Rahma']);
        $contentAdmin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($contentAdmin);

        $this->get(route('admin.patients.create'))->assertForbidden();
        $this->post(route('admin.patients.store'), $this->payload(['full_name' => 'Pasien Baru']))->assertForbidden();
        $this->get(route('admin.patients.edit', $profile))->assertForbidden();
        $this->put(route('admin.patients.update', $profile), $this->updatePayload())->assertForbidden();
        $this->patch(route('admin.patients.status', $profile), ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'Uji penonaktifan'])->assertForbidden();

        $this->assertDatabaseCount('patient_profiles', 1);
        $this->assertSame('Siti Rahma', $profile->fresh()->full_name);
        $this->assertTrue($profile->fresh()->is_active);
    }

    public function test_patients_and_guests_cannot_use_the_mutating_screens(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->create();
        $requests = [
            ['get', route('admin.patients.create')],
            ['post', route('admin.patients.store')],
            ['get', route('admin.patients.edit', $profile)],
            ['put', route('admin.patients.update', $profile)],
            ['patch', route('admin.patients.status', $profile)],
        ];

        $this->actingAs($this->createPatient());

        foreach ($requests as [$method, $url]) {
            $this->{$method}($url)->assertForbidden();
        }

        $this->app['auth']->forgetGuards();

        foreach ($requests as [$method, $url]) {
            $this->{$method}($url)->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
        }
    }

    public function test_super_admin_can_create_a_profile(): void
    {
        $this->store(['full_name' => 'Dibuat Super Admin'], $this->createStaff('super-admin'))->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('patient_profiles', ['full_name' => 'Dibuat Super Admin', 'registration_channel' => 'loket']);
    }

    public function test_the_routes_use_the_indonesian_segments_and_create_is_registered_before_show(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->create();

        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/pasien/buat'), route('admin.patients.create'));
        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/pasien/'.$profile->id.'/ubah'), route('admin.patients.edit', $profile));
        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/pasien/'.$profile->id.'/status'), route('admin.patients.status', $profile));

        $names = collect(\Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route::getRoutes()->getRoutes())
            ->map(fn ($route) => (string) $route->getName())
            ->filter(fn (string $name): bool => str_starts_with($name, 'admin.patients.'))
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $this->assertLessThan(array_search('admin.patients.show', $names, true), array_search('admin.patients.create', $names, true));
    }
}

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Nonaktifkan dan aktifkan kembali pasien (#37, F7A-R10, V-18): WLK-07 lewat HTTP (alasan wajib 5-255, ditolak bila ada
 * pendaftaran aktif dengan pesan berjumlah, aktifkan kembali, profil berakun menyinkronkan `users.is_active` dan mengakhiri
 * sesi login), audit, akses, dan tampilan tombol serta modal di halaman detail.
 */
class AdminPatientStatusTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private User $officer;

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    private int $sequence = 0;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poli Anak', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani'], $this->clinic);
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private function sessionOn(string $date): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ]);
    }

    private function book(PatientProfile $profile, AppointmentStatus $status): void
    {
        $this->bookAppointment($this->sessionOn('2026-10-'.str_pad((string) (10 + ++$this->sequence), 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT)), $status, [
            'booking_code' => sprintf('UPH-ABCD-%04d', $this->sequence),
            'patient_profile_id' => $profile->id,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    private function patchStatus(PatientProfile $profile, array $data, ?User $user = null): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->officer)
            ->from(route('admin.patients.show', $profile))
            ->patch(route('admin.patients.status', $profile), $data);
    }

    private function walkIn(array $attributes = []): PatientProfile
    {
        return PatientProfile::factory()->create(array_merge(['patient_number' => 'P000700', 'full_name' => 'Siti Rahma'], $attributes));
    }

    // --- nonaktifkan -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_a_walk_in_profile_is_deactivated_with_a_reason_wlk_07(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();

        $this->patchStatus($profile, ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'Data ganda dengan profil lain'])
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.show', $profile))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Profil pasien P000700 dinonaktifkan.');

        $this->assertFalse($profile->fresh()->is_active);

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.status_changed')->sole();

        $this->assertTrue($log->old_values['is_active']);
        $this->assertFalse($log->new_values['is_active']);
        $this->assertSame('Data ganda dengan profil lain', $log->new_values['reason']);
        $this->assertSame('Profil pasien P000700 dinonaktifkan.', $log->description);
        $this->assertSame($this->officer->id, (int) $log->user_id);
    }

    public function test_the_history_is_kept_and_the_profile_can_be_activated_again(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::Completed);

        $this->patchStatus($profile, ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'Pasien pindah domisili'])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $this->assertFalse($profile->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(1, $profile->appointments()->count());

        $this->patchStatus($profile, ['is_active' => '1'])
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.show', $profile))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Profil pasien P000700 diaktifkan kembali.');

        $this->assertTrue($profile->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(1, $profile->appointments()->count());
        $this->assertSame(2, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.status_changed')->count());
    }

    public function test_activating_with_an_optional_reason_is_accepted(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn(['is_active' => false]);

        $this->patchStatus($profile, ['is_active' => '1', 'reason' => 'Data sudah diperbaiki'])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertTrue($profile->fresh()->is_active);
    }

    public function test_setting_the_same_status_writes_nothing_and_is_not_audited(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();

        $this->patchStatus($profile, ['is_active' => '1'])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertTrue($profile->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('audit_logs', ['action' => 'patient.status_changed']);
    }

    // --- V-18: alasan -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidInputs(): array
    {
        return [
            'tanpa alasan' => [['is_active' => '0'], 'reason', 'Alasan penonaktifan wajib diisi.'],
            'alasan kosong' => [['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => ''], 'reason', 'Alasan penonaktifan wajib diisi.'],
            'alasan spasi saja' => [['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => '      '], 'reason', 'Alasan penonaktifan wajib diisi.'],
            'alasan 4 karakter' => [['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'abcd'], 'reason', 'Alasan minimal 5 karakter.'],
            'alasan 256 karakter' => [['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'x256'], 'reason', 'Alasan maksimal 255 karakter.'],
            'alasan larik' => [['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => ['abcde']], 'reason', 'Alasan harus berupa teks.'],
            'status kosong' => [['reason' => 'Alasan yang cukup'], 'is_active', 'Status pasien wajib dipilih.'],
            'status asing' => [['is_active' => 'mungkin', 'reason' => 'Alasan yang cukup'], 'is_active', 'Status pasien tidak valid.'],
            'status larik' => [['is_active' => ['0'], 'reason' => 'Alasan yang cukup'], 'is_active', 'Status pasien tidak valid.'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $input
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidInputs')]
    public function test_invalid_status_input_is_rejected_and_shown_as_a_flash_error(array $input, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();
        $input = array_map(fn ($value) => $value === 'x256' ? str_repeat('x', 256) : $value, $input);

        $this->patchStatus($profile, $input)
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.show', $profile))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors([$field => $message])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', $message);

        $this->assertTrue($profile->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('audit_logs', ['action' => 'patient.status_changed']);
    }

    public function test_a_reason_of_exactly_five_and_255_characters_is_accepted(): void
    {
        $first = $this->walkIn(['patient_number' => 'P000701', 'full_name' => 'Pasien Satu']);
        $second = $this->walkIn(['patient_number' => 'P000702', 'full_name' => 'Pasien Dua']);

        $this->patchStatus($first, ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'abcde'])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $this->patchStatus($second, ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => str_repeat('x', 255)])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertFalse($first->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertFalse($second->fresh()->is_active);
    }

    // --- BR-105: pendaftaran aktif -------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_deactivation_is_refused_while_the_patient_has_active_appointments(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::Completed);

        $message = 'Pasien masih memiliki 2 pendaftaran aktif. Batalkan atau selesaikan terlebih dahulu.';

        $this->patchStatus($profile, ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'Uji penonaktifan'])
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.show', $profile))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['is_active' => $message])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', $message);

        $this->assertTrue($profile->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('audit_logs', ['action' => 'patient.status_changed']);
    }

    public function test_a_checked_in_appointment_also_blocks_the_deactivation(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);

        $this->patchStatus($profile, ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'Uji penonaktifan'])
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['is_active' => 'Pasien masih memiliki 1 pendaftaran aktif. Batalkan atau selesaikan terlebih dahulu.']);

        $this->assertTrue($profile->fresh()->is_active);
    }

    public function test_finished_cancelled_and_no_show_appointments_do_not_block_the_deactivation(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::Completed);
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $this->book($profile, AppointmentStatus::NoShow);

        $this->patchStatus($profile, ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'Uji penonaktifan'])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertFalse($profile->fresh()->is_active);
    }

    // --- profil berakun --------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_deactivating_a_linked_profile_deactivates_the_account_and_ends_its_login_sessions(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'akun@contoh.test'], ['patient_number' => 'P000710']);
        $profile = $user->patientProfile;

        DB::table('sessions')->insert([
            'id' => 'sesi-uji-pasien-0000000000000000000001',
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'ip_address' => '127.0.0.1',
            'user_agent' => 'PHPUnit',
            'payload' => 'x',
            'last_activity' => time(),
        ]);

        $this->patchStatus($profile, ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'Akun disalahgunakan'])
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Profil pasien P000710 dinonaktifkan.');

        $this->assertFalse($profile->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertFalse($user->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', $user->id)->count());

        $this->app['auth']->forgetGuards();

        $this->actingAs($user->fresh())
            ->get(route('patient.dashboard'))
            ->assertRedirect(route('login'));
    }

    public function test_activating_a_linked_profile_activates_the_account_again(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'akun@contoh.test', 'is_active' => false], ['patient_number' => 'P000711', 'is_active' => false]);

        $this->patchStatus($user->patientProfile, ['is_active' => '1'])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertTrue($user->patientProfile->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertTrue($user->fresh()->is_active);
    }

    public function test_deactivating_a_walk_in_profile_does_not_touch_other_accounts_or_sessions(): void
    {
        $other = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'lain@contoh.test']);
        $profile = $this->walkIn();

        DB::table('sessions')->insert([
            'id' => 'sesi-uji-pasien-0000000000000000000002',

        ]);

        $this->patchStatus($profile, ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'Uji penonaktifan'])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertTrue($other->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', $other->id)->count());
    }

    // --- akses -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_super_admin_can_change_the_status(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();

        $this->patchStatus($profile, ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'Uji oleh super admin'], $this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertFalse($profile->fresh()->is_active);
    }

    public function test_admin_konten_patients_and_guests_cannot_change_the_status(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->walkIn();
        $url = route('admin.patients.status', $profile);
