- [ ] **Step 7: Buat trait aturan identitas `app/Http/Requests/Admin/Concerns/HasPatientIdentityRules.php` (tool Write)**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin\Concerns;

use App\Enums\Gender;
use App\Rules\IndonesianPhone;
use App\Rules\PersonName;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Aturan identitas profil pasien yang dipakai bersama `StorePatientRequest` dan `UpdatePatientRequest` (12 V-13):
 * nama, tanggal lahir, jenis kelamin, telepon, alamat, dan email opsional (kontak; bukan email login). Tanpa NIK dan
 * tanpa nomor BPJS (F7A-R8): field di luar daftar ini tidak pernah masuk `validated()`.
 */
trait HasPatientIdentityRules
{
    /**
     * Normalisasi (12 §1 butir 4): trim teks, email huruf kecil (kosong menjadi null), telepon tanpa spasi, tanda
     * hubung, titik, dan kurung. Nilai bukan string dibiarkan agar aturan `string`/`required` yang menolaknya.
     */
    protected function normalizeIdentityInput(bool $withEmail): void
    {
        $normalized = [];

        foreach (['full_name', 'address'] as $field) {
            $value = $this->input($field);

            if (is_string($value)) {
                $normalized[$field] = trim($value);
            }
        }

        if ($withEmail) {
            $email = $this->input('email');

            if (is_string($email)) {
                $email = Str::lower(trim($email));
                $normalized['email'] = $email === '' ? null : $email;
            }
        }

        $phone = $this->input('phone');

        if (is_string($phone)) {
            $normalized['phone'] = IndonesianPhone::normalize(trim($phone));
        }

        $this->merge($normalized);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    protected function identityRules(bool $withEmail): array
    {
        $rules = [
            'full_name' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'min:3', 'max:100', new PersonName],
            'birth_date' => ['bail', 'required', 'date_format:Y-m-d', 'before:today', 'after_or_equal:-120 years'],
            'gender' => ['bail', 'required', Rule::enum(Gender::class)],
            'phone' => ['bail', 'required', new IndonesianPhone],
            'address' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'min:10', 'max:500'],
        ];

        if ($withEmail) {
            $rules['email'] = ['bail', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:255', 'email:rfc'];
        }

        return $rules;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function identityMessages(): array
    {
        return [
            'full_name.required' => 'Nama lengkap wajib diisi.',
            'full_name.string' => 'Nama lengkap harus berupa teks.',
            'full_name.min' => 'Nama lengkap minimal 3 karakter.',
            'full_name.max' => 'Nama lengkap maksimal 100 karakter.',
            'birth_date.required' => 'Tanggal lahir wajib diisi.',
            'birth_date.date_format' => 'Format tanggal lahir tidak valid.',
            'birth_date.before' => 'Tanggal lahir harus sebelum hari ini.',
            'birth_date.after_or_equal' => 'Tanggal lahir tidak boleh lebih dari 120 tahun yang lalu.',
            'gender.required' => 'Jenis kelamin wajib dipilih.',
            'gender.enum' => 'Jenis kelamin tidak valid.',
            'phone.required' => 'Nomor telepon wajib diisi.',
            'email.string' => 'Format email tidak valid.',
            'email.max' => 'Email maksimal 255 karakter.',
            'email.email' => 'Format email tidak valid.',
            'address.required' => 'Alamat wajib diisi.',
            'address.string' => 'Alamat harus berupa teks.',
            'address.min' => 'Alamat minimal 10 karakter.',
            'address.max' => 'Alamat maksimal 500 karakter.',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function identityAttributes(): array
    {
        return [
            'full_name' => 'Nama lengkap',
            'birth_date' => 'Tanggal lahir',
            'gender' => 'Jenis kelamin',
            'phone' => 'Nomor telepon',
            'email' => 'Email',
            'address' => 'Alamat',
            'verbal_consent' => 'Persetujuan privasi lisan',
            'confirm_not_duplicate' => 'Konfirmasi profil mirip',
            'is_active' => 'Status pasien',
            'reason' => 'Alasan',
        ];
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Requests/Admin/StorePatientRequest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Http\Requests\Admin\Concerns\HasPatientIdentityRules;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientSearch;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;

/**
 * V-13 (buat), F7A-R8/R11: profil walk-in dibuat petugas `patients.manage`. `verbal_consent` wajib dicentang
 * (BR-99); bila ada profil aktif yang mirip (nama + tanggal lahir sama, atau telepon sama; BR-102) petugas harus
 * mencentang `confirm_not_duplicate`. Tanpa NIK, tanpa nomor BPJS, tanpa akun login. `kembali` TIDAK divalidasi di sini:
 * controller hanya menerimanya bila sah (F7A-R31) dan mengabaikan nilai lain.
 */
class StorePatientRequest extends FormRequest
{
    use HasPatientIdentityRules;

    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return (bool) $this->user()?->can('create', PatientProfile::class);
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $this->normalizeIdentityInput(true);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return array_merge($this->identityRules(true), [
            'verbal_consent' => ['accepted'],
            'confirm_not_duplicate' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge($this->identityMessages(), [
            'verbal_consent.accepted' => __('patients.walk_in.consent_required'),
            'confirm_not_duplicate.boolean' => 'Konfirmasi profil mirip tidak valid.',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function attributes(): array
    {
        return $this->identityAttributes();
    }

    /**
     * Pemeriksaan profil mirip hanya berjalan bila nama, tanggal lahir, dan telepon sudah lolos dan petugas belum
     * mencentang konfirmasi. Daftar profil mirip ditampilkan ulang oleh PatientController::create.
     *
     * @return array<int, callable(Validator): void>
     */
    public function after(): array
    {
        return [
            function (Validator $validator): void {
                if ($validator->errors()->hasAny(['full_name', 'birth_date', 'phone', 'confirm_not_duplicate'])) {
                    return;
                }

                if ($this->boolean('confirm_not_duplicate')) {
                    return;
                }

                $similar = app(PatientSearch::class)->similarTo(
                    (string) $this->input('full_name'),
                    (string) $this->input('birth_date'),
                    (string) $this->input('phone'),
                );

                if ($similar->isNotEmpty()) {
                    $validator->errors()->add('confirm_not_duplicate', __('patients.walk_in.similar'));
                }
            },
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Data untuk PatientRegistrationService::createWalkIn(): enam kolom identitas; `email` null bila kosong.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function walkInData(): array
    {
        return array_merge(
            ['email' => null],
            Arr::only($this->validated(), ['full_name', 'birth_date', 'gender', 'phone', 'email', 'address']),
        );
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Requests/Admin/UpdatePatientRequest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Http\Requests\Admin\Concerns\HasPatientIdentityRules;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;

/**
 * V-13 (ubah), F7A-R9: enam kolom identitas profil. Field sistem (`user_id`, `patient_number`, `registration_channel`,
 * `consent_*`, `is_active`, `created_by_user_id`) dan nomor BPJS tidak ada di `rules()` sehingga tidak pernah masuk
 * `validated()`. Untuk profil berakun `email` TIDAK divalidasi dan tidak dipakai (email profil = email login, hanya-baca
 * di layar admin); nama dan telepon disinkronkan ke akun oleh PatientRegistrationService::updateProfile().
 */
class UpdatePatientRequest extends FormRequest
{
    use HasPatientIdentityRules;

    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $patient = $this->route('patient');

        return $patient instanceof PatientProfile && (bool) $this->user()?->can('update', $patient);
    }

    /** Profil yang diubah sudah terhubung ke akun login. */
    protected function hasAccount(): bool
    {
        $patient = $this->route('patient');

        return $patient instanceof PatientProfile && $patient->user_id !== null;
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $this->normalizeIdentityInput(! $this->hasAccount());
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return $this->identityRules(! $this->hasAccount());
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return $this->identityMessages();
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function attributes(): array
    {
        return $this->identityAttributes();
    }

    /**
     * Data untuk PatientRegistrationService::updateProfile(); `email` hanya ada untuk profil walk-in.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function profileData(): array
    {
        return Arr::only($this->validated(), ['full_name', 'birth_date', 'gender', 'phone', 'email', 'address']);
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Requests/Admin/UpdatePatientStatusRequest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator as ValidatorContract;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * V-18: `is_active` wajib boolean; `reason` wajib (5-255 karakter) saat menonaktifkan, opsional saat mengaktifkan.
 * Penolakan karena pendaftaran aktif (BR-105) datang dari PatientRegistrationService::changeStatus() sebagai
 * ValidationException kunci `is_active` dan ditangani controller.
 */
class UpdatePatientStatusRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $patient = $this->route('patient');

        return $patient instanceof PatientProfile && (bool) $this->user()?->can('changeStatus', $patient);
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $reason = $this->input('reason');

        if (is_string($reason)) {
            $this->merge(['reason' => trim($reason)]);
        }
    }

    /** Permintaan menonaktifkan: `is_active` bernilai salah yang dikenal (`0`, `false`). */
    private function deactivating(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this->input('is_active'), [0, '0', false, 'false'], true);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'is_active' => ['required', 'boolean'],
            'reason' => ['nullable', Rule::requiredIf(fn (): bool => $this->deactivating()), 'string', 'min:5', 'max:255'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'is_active.required' => 'Status pasien wajib dipilih.',
            'is_active.boolean' => 'Status pasien tidak valid.',
            'reason.required' => 'Alasan penonaktifan wajib diisi.',
            'reason.string' => 'Alasan harus berupa teks.',
            'reason.min' => 'Alasan minimal 5 karakter.',
            'reason.max' => 'Alasan maksimal 255 karakter.',
        ];
    }

    public function isActive(): bool
    {
        return $this->boolean('is_active');
    }

    public function reason(): ?string
    {
        $reason = $this->validated('reason');

        return is_string($reason) && trim($reason) !== '' ? trim($reason) : null;
    }

    /**
     * Modal ditutup setelah kirim, jadi galat juga dipasang sebagai flash `error` agar terlihat di halaman asal.
     */
    protected function failedValidation(ValidatorContract $validator): void
    {
        session()->flash('error', (string) $validator->errors()->first());

        parent::failedValidation($validator);
    }
}
```

```php
    public function create(Request $request, PatientSearch $search): View
    {
        $this->authorize('create', PatientProfile::class);

        $kembali = self::walkInReturn($request->query('kembali'));
        $similar = $this->similarProfiles($request, $search);

        return view('admin.patients.create', [
            'kembali' => $kembali,
            'similar' => $similar,
            'pickUrls' => $similar
                ->mapWithKeys(fn (PatientProfile $candidate): array => [
                    $candidate->id => $kembali === null ? null : url(self::walkInUrl($kembali, (int) $candidate->id)),
                ])
                ->all(),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(StorePatientRequest $request, PatientRegistrationService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', PatientProfile::class);

        $profile = $service->createWalkIn($request->walkInData(), $request->user());
        $message = __('patients.walk_in.created', ['number' => $profile->patient_number]);

        $kembali = self::walkInReturn($request->input('kembali'));

        if ($kembali !== null) {
            return redirect(self::walkInUrl($kembali, (int) $profile->getKey()))->with('success', $message);
        }

        return redirect()->route('admin.patients.show', $profile)->with('success', $message);
    }

    public function edit(PatientProfile $patient): View
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $patient);

        return view('admin.patients.edit', ['patient' => $patient]);
    }

    public function update(UpdatePatientRequest $request, PatientProfile $patient, PatientRegistrationService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $patient);

        $service->updateProfile($patient, $request->profileData(), Actor::staff($request->user()));

        return redirect()->route('admin.patients.show', $patient)
            ->with('success', __('patients.walk_in.updated', ['number' => $patient->patient_number]));
    }

    public function status(UpdatePatientStatusRequest $request, PatientProfile $patient, PatientRegistrationService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('changeStatus', $patient);

        $active = $request->isActive();

        try {
            $service->changeStatus($patient, $active, Actor::staff($request->user()), $request->reason());
        } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
            // Modal sudah tertutup: galat service (BR-105) juga dikirim sebagai flash `error`.
            session()->flash('error', (string) collect($exception->errors())->flatten()->first());

            throw $exception;
        }

        return redirect()->route('admin.patients.show', $patient)->with(
            'success',
            __($active ? 'patients.status.activated' : 'patients.status.deactivated', ['number' => $patient->patient_number]),
        );
    }

    /**
     * Profil aktif yang mirip dengan input lama bila submit terakhir ditolak karena `confirm_not_duplicate` (BR-102).
     * Tidak menyimpan apa pun di sesi: dihitung ulang dari old input (nilai sudah dinormalkan Form Request).
     *
     * @return Collection<int, PatientProfile>
     */
    private function similarProfiles(Request $request, PatientSearch $search): Collection
    {
        $errors = $request->session()->get('errors');

        if (! $errors instanceof ViewErrorBag || ! $errors->has('confirm_not_duplicate')) {
            return new Collection;
        }

        $name = $request->old('full_name');
        $birthDate = $request->old('birth_date');
        $phone = $request->old('phone');

        if (! is_string($name) || ! is_string($birthDate) || ! is_string($phone)) {
            return new Collection;
        }

        return $search->similarTo($name, $birthDate, $phone);
    }

    /**
     * Path walk-in yang sah dari `kembali` (F7A-R31): path internal (SafeRedirect) DAN persis `/admin/pendaftaran/buat`,
     * dengan atau tanpa query. Nilai lain (larik, URL eksternal, path lain, awalan palsu) menghasilkan null.
     */
    private static function walkInReturn(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        if (! is_string($value)) {
            return null;
        }

        $path = SafeRedirect::internalPath($value);

        if ($path === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $parts = parse_url($path);

        if (! is_array($parts) || ($parts['path'] ?? null) !== '/admin/pendaftaran/buat') {
            return null;
        }

        $query = $parts['query'] ?? '';

        return $query === '' ? $parts['path'] : $parts['path'].'?'.$query;
    }

    /**
     * Path walk-in dengan query `pasien` diganti atau ditambah id profil; query lain dipertahankan. Hanya dipanggil
     * dengan hasil walkInReturn().
     */
    private static function walkInUrl(string $path, int $patientId): string
    {
        $parts = parse_url($path);
        $query = [];

        parse_str(is_array($parts) ? ($parts['query'] ?? '') : '', $query);
        $query['pasien'] = (string) $patientId;

        return '/admin/pendaftaran/buat?'.http_build_query($query);
    }
}
```

Catatan: `walkInUrl()` ditutup dengan `return '/admin/pendaftaran/buat?'.http_build_query($query);`; T7 memakai baris itu sebagai jangkar.

### Task 7: Pasien #37 — hubungkan profil walk-in ke akun online (panel `?hubungkan=`, POST `link-account`)

**Files:**
- Modify: `routes/admin.php` (satu route: `admin.patients.link-account`, di grup `patients.manage` dari T6)
- Modify: `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/PatientController.php` (import; `show` menghitung panel; method baru `linkAccount` dan pembantu privat `linkPanel`)
- Create: `app/Http/Requests/Admin/LinkPatientAccountRequest.php`
- Create: `resources/views/admin/patients/_link-panel.blade.php`
- Modify: `resources/views/admin/patients/show.blade.php` (tombol "Hubungkan ke akun online" di slot `actions`; `@include` panel)
- Test: `tests/Feature/Admin/AdminPatientLinkAccountTest.php`
- Tidak diubah: `app/Services/Patients/PatientAccountLinker.php` (T3), `app/Policies/PatientProfilePolicy.php` (T4), `lang/id/patients.php` (T3), `bootstrap/app.php`, `resources/js/*`, `resources/scss/*`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T3: `PatientAccountLinker::findAccount(string $email): ?User` (trim + huruf kecil; hanya `account_type = patient`), `::problem(PatientProfile $walkIn, ?User $account): ?string` (tanpa kunci dan tanpa tulis; urutan: profil sudah terhubung, akun tidak ada/bukan pasien, akun nonaktif, profil akun beriwayat), `::link(PatientProfile, User, Actor): PatientProfile` (`ValidationException` kunci `account_email`; menyamakan `is_active` profil dengan akun; bila profil akun berubah di tengah jalan melapor `ACCOUNT_HAS_HISTORY`); kunci lang `patients.link.{PROFILE_ALREADY_LINKED,ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND,ACCOUNT_INACTIVE,ACCOUNT_HAS_HISTORY,identity_required,linked}`.
  - T4: `PatientProfilePolicy::linkAccount` (`patients.manage` dan `user_id === null`; Super Admin lolos lewat `Gate::before`).
  - T5/T6: `PatientController` (`show` T5; import dan method T6), `show.blade.php` (jangkar `    <x-slot:actions>` dan `    @include('admin.patients._status-modal')` + `</x-layouts.admin>`), grup route `patients.manage`.
- Produces:
  - Route `admin.patients.link-account` (POST `/admin/pasien/{patient}/hubungkan-akun`, `permission:patients.manage`). Total setelah T7: 158 route aplikasi, 114 di `/admin`.
  - `Admin\LinkPatientAccountRequest` (V-17; `accountEmail()`; menolak profil nonaktif), `PatientController@linkAccount`, view `admin.patients._link-panel`.
  - Perilaku UI (F7A-R12, keputusan koordinator): GET `admin.patients.show?hubungkan=<email>` menampilkan panel; panel perbandingan (nama, tanggal lahir, telepon kedua pihak) HANYA bila `problem()` null; selain itu hanya pesan penolakan tanpa data akun. Profil sudah terhubung: tanpa tombol dan tanpa panel. Profil NONAKTIF: tanpa tombol dan tanpa panel `#hubungkan-akun`; yang tampil hanya teks "Aktifkan profil terlebih dahulu untuk menghubungkannya ke akun online.", dan POST ditolak `LinkPatientAccountRequest` dengan galat `account_email` "Profil pasien tidak aktif. Aktifkan profil terlebih dahulu." tanpa memanggil linker.
  - Sukses: redirect `admin.patients.show` + flash `Profil pasien {nomor} berhasil dihubungkan ke akun {email}.`

**Test IDs:** WLK-05 (sukses: profil kosong akun dihapus, `user_id` terpasang, pasien login melihat riwayat walk-in di `patient.appointments.index`, audit tanpa PII), WLK-06 (akun beriwayat, profil sudah terhubung, akun nonaktif, email bukan pasien/tidak ada, tanpa centang, Admin Konten 403, tanpa pencocokan otomatis saat registrasi), V-17, E3 (parameter `hubungkan` larik/liar tanpa 500), SEK-11/SEK-15 (audit dan panel tanpa data akun yang tidak memenuhi syarat), panel GET tidak menulis apa pun.

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source dan T3):**
- **Dua langkah tanpa route GET baru** (DES §5.1): langkah 1 form GET ke halaman detail dengan field `hubungkan`; langkah 2 panel konfirmasi + form POST dengan `account_email` tersembunyi dan kotak `identity_verified`. `linkPanel()` murni baca: `findAccount` dan `problem` tidak menulis; parameter `hubungkan` berupa larik atau kosong diperlakukan sebagai belum mencari; nilai yang bukan email sah menampilkan "Format email tidak valid." (validasi `email:rfc|max:255` lewat `Validator::make`, tanpa redirect).
- **Penolakan tanpa membocorkan data akun**: pesan penolakan memakai kunci `patients.link.*` apa adanya; nama, telepon, dan tanggal lahir akun hanya dimuat (`loadMissing('patientProfile')`) bila `problem()` null. Email yang diketik petugas sendiri boleh ditampilkan kembali.
- **Otorisasi**: `LinkPatientAccountRequest::authorize()` memakai `PatientProfilePolicy::linkAccount`; Petugas pada profil yang sudah terhubung mendapat 403, Super Admin (lolos `Gate::before`) mencapai linker yang menjawab `PROFILE_ALREADY_LINKED` (F7A-R13). Dua petugas yang berlomba: yang kalah mendapat 403 (Petugas) atau pesan `PROFILE_ALREADY_LINKED` (Super Admin); pembuktian level service ada di T3/T11.
- **Profil nonaktif** (keputusan koordinator): linker menyamakan `is_active` profil dengan akun saat menghubungkan, sehingga menghubungkan profil nonaktif ke akun aktif diam-diam akan mengaktifkannya kembali; karena itu tombol, panel, dan POST ditutup untuk profil nonaktif. Pemeriksaan di `after()` berjalan walau validasi lain gagal.
- **Galat POST** (`ValidationException` dari request atau linker) mengalihkan ke halaman sebelumnya (detail dengan `?hubungkan=`), sehingga panel dihitung ulang dari query; galat `account_email` dirender sebagai alert di panel hanya bila panel sedang menampilkan perbandingan (bila ada pesan penolakan, pesan itu sudah menjelaskan).
- **Label centang** memakai teks 06 §16 "Saya telah memverifikasi identitas pasien di loket" (DES §5.1 menulis "Identitas sudah diverifikasi di loket"; 06 menang atas ringkasan DES); pesan galat verbatim 12 V-17.
- **Jumlah tes baru** 39 (`AdminPatientLinkAccountTest`, terukur di uji coba integrasi).

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Hubungkan profil walk-in ke akun online (#37, F7A-R12, V-17): WLK-05 (sukses lewat HTTP), WLK-06 (semua penolakan,
 * Admin Konten 403, tanpa pencocokan otomatis saat registrasi), panel GET murni baca, profil nonaktif ditutup,
 * parameter `hubungkan` liar tanpa 500.
 */
class AdminPatientLinkAccountTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const ALREADY_LINKED = 'Profil ini sudah terhubung ke sebuah akun.';

    private const NOT_FOUND = 'Akun pasien dengan email tersebut tidak ditemukan.';

    private const INACTIVE_ACCOUNT = 'Akun pasien tidak aktif.';

    private const HAS_HISTORY = 'Akun ini sudah memiliki riwayat pendaftaran. Penggabungan dua profil berriwayat belum didukung.';

    private const IDENTITY = 'Anda harus menegaskan bahwa identitas pasien telah diverifikasi di loket.';

    private const INACTIVE_PROFILE = 'Profil pasien tidak aktif. Aktifkan profil terlebih dahulu.';

    private User $officer;

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    private int $sequence = 0;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poli Anak', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani'], $this->clinic);
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    private function walkIn(array $attributes = []): PatientProfile
    {
        return PatientProfile::factory()->create(array_merge([
            'full_name' => 'Siti Rahma',
            'patient_number' => 'P000201',
            'birth_date' => '1990-03-12',
            'phone' => '081200000001',
        ], $attributes));
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    private function account(array $attributes = []): User
    {
        return User::factory()->patient()->create(array_merge([
            'email' => 'siti@contoh.test',
            'name' => 'Siti Akun',
            'phone' => '081200000009',
        ], $attributes));
    }

    private function book(PatientProfile $profile, AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed): Appointment
    {
        $session = $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-'.str_pad((string) (10 + ++$this->sequence), 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT),
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ]);

        return $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, [
            'booking_code' => sprintf('UPH-ABCD-%04d', $this->sequence),
            'patient_profile_id' => $profile->id,
            'channel' => BookingChannel::Loket,
        ]);
    }

    private function panelUrl(PatientProfile $profile, string $email): string
    {
        return route('admin.patients.show', ['patient' => $profile, 'hubungkan' => $email]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function link(PatientProfile $profile, array $overrides = [], ?User $user = null, string $email = 'siti@contoh.test'): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->officer)
            ->from($this->panelUrl($profile, $email))
            ->post(route('admin.patients.link-account', $profile), array_merge([
                'account_email' => $email,
                'identity_verified' => '1',
            ], $overrides));
    }

    private function assertNothingLinked(PatientProfile $profile): void
    {
        $this->assertNull($profile->fresh()->user_id);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('audit_logs', ['action' => 'patient.account_linked']);
    }

    // --- WLK-05: sukses ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_linking_succeeds_and_the_patient_sees_the_walk_in_history_wlk_05(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();
        $appointment = $this->book($walkIn);
        $account = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'siti@contoh.test', 'name' => 'Siti Akun'], ['patient_number' => 'P000300']);
        $emptyProfileId = $account->patientProfile->id;

        $this->link($walkIn)
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.patients.show', $walkIn))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Profil pasien P000201 berhasil dihubungkan ke akun siti@contoh.test.');

        $fresh = $walkIn->fresh();

        $this->assertSame($account->id, (int) $fresh->user_id);
        $this->assertSame('siti@contoh.test', $fresh->email);
        $this->assertSame('P000201', $fresh->patient_number);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('patient_profiles', ['id' => $emptyProfileId]);
        $this->assertSame($walkIn->id, $appointment->fresh()->patient_profile_id);

        $this->app['auth']->forgetGuards();

        $this->actingAs($account->fresh())
            ->get(route('patient.appointments.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee($appointment->booking_code);
    }

    public function test_the_audit_row_records_the_removed_profile_and_carries_no_personal_data(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();
        $account = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'siti@contoh.test', 'name' => 'Siti Akun'], ['patient_number' => 'P000300']);

        $this->link($walkIn)->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.account_linked')->sole();
        $encoded = (string) json_encode($log->toArray());

        $this->assertSame($this->officer->id, (int) $log->user_id);
        $this->assertSame('P000300', $log->old_values['removed_profile']['patient_number']);
        $this->assertSame($walkIn->id, $log->new_values['profile_id']);
        $this->assertSame($account->id, $log->new_values['user_id']);
        $this->assertSame('Profil pasien P000201 dihubungkan ke akun pasien.', $log->description);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('siti@contoh.test', $encoded);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Siti Akun', $encoded);
    }

    public function test_an_account_without_any_profile_can_be_linked(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();
        $account = $this->account();

        $this->link($walkIn)->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertSame($account->id, (int) $walkIn->fresh()->user_id);
        $this->assertNull(AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.account_linked')->sole()->old_values['removed_profile']);
    }

    public function test_the_email_is_normalised_before_the_lookup(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();
        $this->account();

        $this->link($walkIn, ['account_email' => '  SITI@Contoh.Test '])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertNotNull($walkIn->fresh()->user_id);
    }

    public function test_super_admin_can_link(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();
        $this->account();

        $this->link($walkIn, [], $this->createStaff('super-admin'))->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertNotNull($walkIn->fresh()->user_id);
    }

    // --- panel (GET) -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_detail_page_offers_the_lookup_form_and_the_action_button_for_an_unlinked_active_profile(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->get(route('admin.patients.show', $walkIn))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('href="#hubungkan-akun"', false)
            ->assertSee('id="hubungkan-akun"', false)
            ->assertSee('Hubungkan ke akun online')
            ->assertSee('name="hubungkan"', false)
            ->assertSee('Email akun pasien')
            ->assertDontSee('Periksa kecocokan identitas')
            ->assertDontSee('name="account_email"', false);
    }

    public function test_an_eligible_account_shows_the_comparison_and_the_confirmation_form(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();
        $this->createPatient(
            ['email' => 'siti@contoh.test', 'name' => 'Siti Akun', 'phone' => '081200000009'],
            ['patient_number' => 'P000300', 'birth_date' => '1991-04-15'],
        );

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->get($this->panelUrl($walkIn, 'siti@contoh.test'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Periksa kecocokan identitas')

            ->assertSee('<th scope="col">Akun online</th>', false)
            ->assertSee('Siti Rahma')
            ->assertSee('Siti Akun')
            ->assertSee('12/03/1990')
            ->assertSee('15/04/1991')
            ->assertSee('081200000001')
            ->assertSee('081200000009')
            ->assertSee('P000300')
            ->assertSee('action="'.route('admin.patients.link-account', $walkIn).'"', false)
            ->assertSee('name="account_email" value="siti@contoh.test"', false)
            ->assertSee('name="identity_verified"', false)
            ->assertSee('Saya telah memverifikasi identitas pasien di loket')
            ->assertSee('Hubungkan Akun');

    public function test_the_get_panel_writes_nothing(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();
        $this->createPatient(['email' => 'siti@contoh.test']);
        $snapshot = fn (): string => json_encode([
            DB::table('patient_profiles')->orderBy('id')->get(),
            DB::table('users')->orderBy('id')->get(),
            DB::table('audit_logs')->count(),
            DB::table('appointments')->count(),
        ]);
        $before = $snapshot();

        $this->actingAs($this->officer);
        $this->get($this->panelUrl($walkIn, 'siti@contoh.test'))->assertOk();
        $this->get($this->panelUrl($walkIn, 'tidak-ada@contoh.test'))->assertOk();
        $this->get($this->panelUrl($walkIn, 'bukan-email'))->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame($before, $snapshot());
    }

    public function test_an_unknown_email_shows_only_the_not_found_message(): void
    {

    public function test_an_invalid_email_format_is_reported_without_a_lookup(): void
    {

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string}>
     */
    public static function hostileLookups(): array
    {
        return [
            'larik' => ['hubungkan[]=x'],
            'hash larik' => ['hubungkan[a][b]=x'],
            'kosong' => ['hubungkan='],
            'spasi' => ['hubungkan=%20%20'],
            'null byte' => ['hubungkan=%00'],
            'sangat panjang' => ['hubungkan='.str_repeat('a', 400).'%40contoh.test'],
            'markup' => ['hubungkan=%3Cscript%3Ealert(1)%3C%2Fscript%3E'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('hostileLookups')]
    public function test_a_hostile_lookup_parameter_never_causes_a_500_or_leaks_markup(string $query): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->get('/admin/pasien/'.$walkIn->id.'?'.$query)
            ->assertOk();

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script>alert(1)</script>', $response->getContent());
    }

    public function test_the_lookup_term_is_echoed_escaped(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->get($this->panelUrl($walkIn, '"><script>alert(1)</script>'))
            ->assertOk();

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script>alert(1)</script>', $response->getContent());
    }

    public function test_posting_for_an_inactive_profile_is_refused_without_calling_the_linker(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn(['is_active' => false]);
        $this->account();

        $this->link($walkIn)
            ->assertRedirect($this->panelUrl($walkIn, 'siti@contoh.test'))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['account_email' => self::INACTIVE_PROFILE]);

        $this->assertNothingLinked($walkIn);
        $this->assertFalse($walkIn->fresh()->is_active);

        $this->link($walkIn, [], $this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['account_email' => self::INACTIVE_PROFILE]);

        $this->assertNothingLinked($walkIn);
    }

    public function test_posting_for_a_linked_profile_is_forbidden_for_the_officer_and_refused_for_super_admin(): void
    {
        $linked = PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create();
        $other = $this->account();

        $this->link($linked)->assertForbidden();

        $this->link($linked, [], $this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['account_email' => self::ALREADY_LINKED]);

        $this->assertNotSame($other->id, (int) $linked->fresh()->user_id);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('audit_logs', ['action' => 'patient.account_linked']);
    }

    public function test_an_account_with_history_is_refused(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->walkIn();

        $this->link($walkIn)

        $this->assertNothingLinked($walkIn);

    public function test_an_inactive_account_is_refused(): void
    {

    {

    public function test_the_identity_confirmation_is_required(): void
    {

        $this->account();

                ->assertSessionHasErrors(['identity_verified' => self::IDENTITY]);

        $this->assertNothingLinked($walkIn);
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;

/**
 * V-17 (F7A-R12): `account_email` (email akun pasien yang ditemukan lewat panel `?hubungkan=`) dan `identity_verified`
 * (petugas menegaskan identitas diverifikasi di loket, K-14). Otorisasi `PatientProfilePolicy::linkAccount`. Profil
 * nonaktif ditolak di sini (keputusan koordinator): linker menyamakan `is_active` profil dengan akun, sehingga tanpa
 * penolakan ini menghubungkan akan mengaktifkan kembali profil secara diam-diam. Aturan bisnis lain (sudah terhubung,
 * akun tidak ada/nonaktif/beriwayat) ada di PatientAccountLinker.
 */
class LinkPatientAccountRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $patient = $this->route('patient');

        return $patient instanceof PatientProfile && (bool) $this->user()?->can('linkAccount', $patient);
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $email = $this->input('account_email');

        if (is_string($email)) {
            $this->merge(['account_email' => Str::lower(trim($email))]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'account_email' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'email:rfc', 'max:255'],
            'identity_verified' => ['accepted'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'account_email.required' => 'Email akun wajib diisi.',
            'account_email.string' => 'Format email tidak valid.',
            'account_email.email' => 'Format email tidak valid.',
            'account_email.max' => 'Email maksimal 255 karakter.',
            'identity_verified.accepted' => __('patients.link.identity_required'),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function attributes(): array
    {
        return [
            'account_email' => 'Email akun',
            'identity_verified' => 'Verifikasi identitas',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, callable(Validator): void>
     */
    public function after(): array
    {
        return [
            function (Validator $validator): void {
                $patient = $this->route('patient');

                if ($patient instanceof PatientProfile && ! $patient->is_active) {
                    $validator->errors()->add('account_email', 'Profil pasien tidak aktif. Aktifkan profil terlebih dahulu.');
                }
            },
        ];
    }

    public function accountEmail(): string
    {
        return (string) $this->validated('account_email');
    }
}
```

```php
    public function linkAccount(LinkPatientAccountRequest $request, PatientProfile $patient, PatientAccountLinker $linker): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('linkAccount', $patient);

        $account = $linker->findAccount($request->accountEmail());

        if ($account === null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'account_email' => $linker->problem($patient, null) ?? __('patients.link.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND'),
            ]);
        }

        $profile = $linker->link($patient, $account, Actor::staff($request->user()));

        return redirect()->route('admin.patients.show', $patient)->with(
            'success',
            __('patients.link.linked', ['number' => $profile->patient_number, 'email' => $account->email]),
        );
    }

    /**
     * Panel "Hubungkan ke akun online" (F7A-R12). Null bila profil sudah terhubung atau pengguna tidak boleh
     * menghubungkan. Profil nonaktif hanya mendapat penanda `inactive` (tanpa pencarian dan tanpa data akun). Murni baca:
     * GET tidak menulis apa pun. Nilai `hubungkan` berupa larik atau kosong dianggap belum mencari.
     *
     * @return array{inactive: bool, email: string, searched: bool, invalid: ?string, problem: ?string, account: ?User}|null
     */
    private function linkPanel(Request $request, PatientProfile $patient, PatientAccountLinker $linker): ?array
    {
        if ($patient->user_id !== null || ! $request->user()->can('linkAccount', $patient)) {
            return null;
        }

        $panel = ['inactive' => ! $patient->is_active, 'email' => '', 'searched' => false, 'invalid' => null, 'problem' => null, 'account' => null];

        if ($panel['inactive']) {
            return $panel;
        }

        $raw = $request->query('hubungkan');

        if (! is_string($raw) || trim($raw) === '') {
            return $panel;
        }

        $email = Str::lower(trim(mb_substr($raw, 0, 300)));
        $panel['email'] = $email;
        $panel['searched'] = true;

        if (Validator::make(['email' => $email], ['email' => ['email:rfc', 'max:255']])->fails()) {
            $panel['invalid'] = 'Format email tidak valid.';

            return $panel;
        }

        $account = $linker->findAccount($email);
        $panel['problem'] = $linker->problem($patient, $account);

        if ($panel['problem'] === null && $account !== null) {
            $panel['account'] = $account->loadMissing('patientProfile');
        }

        return $panel;
    }
}
```

**Test IDs:** PAS-04 (sisi Petugas: bukti admin 200, Admin Konten 403), KON-05 (UI: `expected_status` basi), NTF-03 (via HTTP: walk-in tanpa notifikasi, pasien berakun menerima), BKG-14 (via HTTP: check-in tepat jendela dan satu menit sebelum), BKG-19 (koreksi via HTTP), SEK-12 (BPJS/polis tersamar di detail dan bukti), SEK-15 (nama dan keluhan ter-escape di daftar, detail, bukti), VAL-07 (query liar tidak 500), AKS (Admin Konten 403, pasien 403, tamu ke login), Review Focus E1 (tombol vs aturan server), E2 (klik ganda/halaman basi), E3 (field tersembunyi dan `kembali` dirusak), E4 (BPJS/polis tersamar).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari kode):**
- **Binding `{appointment:booking_code}`.** Grup admin di `bootstrap/app.php` memaksa `appointment` menjadi `[0-9]+`; kunci itu dihapus dari daftar (F7A-R3) dan tiap route memakai `->where('appointment', 'UPH-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}')` (pola yang sama dengan `routes/patient.php`). Kode berpola salah, huruf kecil, dan id numerik = 404 karena route tidak cocok; kode berpola sah yang tidak ada = 404 dari `ModelNotFoundException`. `{patient}` dan `{session}` tetap numerik. Model tidak memakai `getRouteKeyName()`; selalu kirim kode eksplisit: `route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $code])`.
- **Tombol = `transitionChecks()`.** Tombol dihitung evaluator yang SAMA dengan `transition()` (F7A-R5), jadi tombol yang tampil selalu diterima server (tes E1 membuktikan dua arah, termasuk `end` tepat dan `end + 1 menit`). Hanya `CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN` yang ditampilkan sebagai tombol `aria-disabled="true"` (tetap dalam urutan fokus, `aria-describedby` ke teks terlihat "Dibuka HH.MM"); penolakan lain tidak menampilkan tombol. `no_show` tidak pernah tombol per baris (hanya massal di antrean/T10).
- **Modal dan field tersembunyi.** `x-confirm-modal` hanya mengganti `action` dan teks lewat `data-confirm-*`; field tersembunyi di slot bersifat statis. Halaman detail memuat SATU appointment, jadi `to`, `expected_status`, dan `kembali` ditulis statis di slot dua modal (`modal-batal`, `modal-koreksi`). Alasan memakai `<textarea name="reason" minlength="5" maxlength="255" required>` di slot (bukan prop `reasonRequired`, yang tanpa `minlength`/`maxlength`). Batal/Koreksi memakai Bootstrap JS (seperti modal dokter dan sesi); tanpa JS tombolnya tidak membuka modal (keterbatasan yang sama dengan layar admin lain).
- **Galat transisi.** Dua jalur: (a) validasi Form Request (`to`, `reason`, `expected_status`) gagal → `failedValidation()` menjadikan galat pertama sebagai flash `error` (pola `UpdateDoctorStatusRequest`, karena modal sudah tertutup) lalu `ValidationException` dengan `getRedirectUrl()` = `AdminReturn::path(kembali, detail)`; (b) `InvalidTransitionException`/`BookingException` dari service → handler global → `BookingRedirect::after()` → cabang admin → `AdminReturn::path(kembali, detail)` + flash `error` dari `lang/id/booking.php`. Keduanya tidak pernah mengarah ke luar `/admin/pendaftaran` dan `/admin/antrean` (F7A-R19).
- **`expected_status`.** Wajib; nilai yang bukan status sah ditolak validasi dengan pesan `STALE_STATUS` (halaman basi atau diubah tangan). Status yang sah tetapi berbeda dengan status di bawah kunci ditolak service (`STALE_STATUS`) tanpa tulis apa pun (KON-05 UI).
- **Bukti admin.** `partials/appointment-proof.blade.php` memuat isi `<article class="proof-sheet">` apa adanya. Satu-satunya parameter baru ialah `$headingLevel` (bawaan 1, sehingga keluaran sisi pasien identik; sisi admin memakai 2 karena layout admin sudah merender `<h1>` judul halaman). <?php

```php
namespace Tests\Unit\Support;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Support\BookingRedirect;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Route as RoutingRoute;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R20: pemetaan `BookingException` pada route admin ke tujuan pengalihan (cabang transisi status; cabang walk-in
 * dan antrean ditambah T9 dan T10). Route admin lain tetap kembali ke halaman sebelumnya.
 */
class BookingRedirectAdminTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const CODE = 'UPH-ABCD-2345';

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $input
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $routeParameters
     */
    private function requestOn(string $routeName, array $input = [], array $routeParameters = []): Request
    {
        $uri = '/uji'.implode('', array_map(fn (string $name): string => '/{'.$name.'}', array_keys($routeParameters)));
        $path = '/uji'.str_repeat('/x', count($routeParameters));
        $route = (new RoutingRoute(['POST'], $uri, fn () => 'ok'))->name($routeName);
        $request = Request::create($path, 'POST', $input);
        $route->bind($request);

        foreach ($routeParameters as $name => $value) {
            $route->setParameter($name, $value);
        }

        $request->setRouteResolver(fn () => $route);
        $this->app->instance('request', $request);

        return $request;
    }

    private function stale(): InvalidTransitionException
    {
        return InvalidTransitionException::make('STALE_STATUS');
    }

    private function detailUrl(string $code = self::CODE): string
    {
        return route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $code]);
    }

    public function test_a_transition_failure_returns_to_the_detail_by_default(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn('admin.appointments.transition', [], ['appointment' => self::CODE]);

        $this->assertSame($this->detailUrl(), BookingRedirect::after($this->stale(), $request));
    }

    public function test_the_route_parameter_may_be_the_bound_model(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession();
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['booking_code' => self::CODE]);
        $request = $this->requestOn('admin.appointments.transition', [], ['appointment' => Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id)]);

        $this->assertSame($this->detailUrl(), BookingRedirect::after($this->stale(), $request));
    }

    public function test_a_valid_kembali_to_the_queue_or_the_list_wins(): void
    {
        foreach (['/admin/antrean?tanggal=2026-10-06&sesi=3', '/admin/pendaftaran?status=pending', '/admin/pendaftaran/UPH-WXYZ-6789'] as $back) {
            $request = $this->requestOn('admin.appointments.transition', ['kembali' => $back], ['appointment' => self::CODE]);

            $this->assertSame($back, BookingRedirect::after($this->stale(), $request), $back);
        }
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{mixed}> */
    public static function badKembali(): array
    {
        return [
            'domain lain' => ['https://evil.test/admin/antrean'],
            'protokol relatif' => ['//evil.test'],
            'portal pasien' => ['/pasien/pendaftaran'],
            'area admin lain' => ['/admin/pasien'],
            'segmen titik-titik' => ['/admin/antrean/../pasien'],
            'larik' => [['/admin/antrean']],
            'bilangan' => [123],
        ];
    }

    #[\PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider('badKembali')]
    public function test_an_unsafe_kembali_is_ignored(mixed $back): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn('admin.appointments.transition', ['kembali' => $back], ['appointment' => self::CODE]);

        $this->assertSame($this->detailUrl(), BookingRedirect::after($this->stale(), $request));
    }

    public function test_without_a_valid_booking_code_the_fallback_is_the_list(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn('admin.appointments.transition', [], ['appointment' => 'bukan-kode']);

        $this->assertSame(route('admin.appointments.index'), BookingRedirect::after($this->stale(), $request));
    }

    public function test_every_transition_error_code_goes_to_the_same_place(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn('admin.appointments.transition', [], ['appointment' => self::CODE]);

        foreach (InvalidTransitionException::CODES as $code) {
            $this->assertSame($this->detailUrl(), BookingRedirect::after(InvalidTransitionException::make($code), $request), $code);
        }

        $this->assertSame($this->detailUrl(), BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::make(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY), $request));
    }

    public function test_other_admin_routes_still_go_back_to_the_previous_page(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn('admin.doctors.status', [], ['doctor' => '3']);
        $request->headers->set('referer', 'http://localhost/admin/dokter/3');
        $this->app->instance('request', $request);

        $this->assertSame(
            'http://localhost/admin/dokter/3',
            BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::make(BookingException::QUOTA_FULL), $request),
        );
    }
}
```

Write `app/Support/AdminReturn.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Support;

/**
 * Tujuan `kembali` pada layar petugas (F7A-R19, 11 §1): path internal yang lolos `SafeRedirect::internalPath()` DAN
 * berada di `/admin/pendaftaran...` atau `/admin/antrean...`. Segmen `.`/`..` ditolak (termasuk yang diterjemahkan
 * `%2e`), supaya awalan yang diizinkan tidak dapat dipakai menyeberang ke area lain. Selain itu mengembalikan `$fallback`.
 */
final class AdminReturn
{
    /** @var list<string> */
    private const AREAS = ['/admin/pendaftaran', '/admin/antrean'];

    public static function path(?string $value, string $fallback): string
    {
        $path = SafeRedirect::internalPath($value);

        if ($path === null) {
            return $fallback;
        }

        $route = parse_url($path, PHP_URL_PATH);

        if (! is_string($route)) {
            return $fallback;
        }

        $decoded = rawurldecode($route);

        if (str_contains($decoded, '\\')) {
            return $fallback;
        }

        foreach (explode('/', $decoded) as $segment) {
            if ($segment === '.' || $segment === '..') {
                return $fallback;
            }
        }

        foreach (self::AREAS as $area) {
            if ($route === $area || str_starts_with($route, $area.'/')) {
                return $path;
            }
        }

        return $fallback;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\NavigationMenu;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Halaman #38, daftar pendaftaran (F7A-R17, 05 §409): bawaan hari ini, filter tanggal/poli/dokter/status/kanal/kata kunci,
 * rentang terbalik, query liar (VAL-07), escape nama pasien (SEK-15), akses per peran (AKS). Waktu dibekukan pada
 * Selasa 2026-10-06 07.00.
 */
class AdminAppointmentsIndexTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    private User $officer;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 07:00:00');
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poli Anak', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.A'], $this->clinic);
        $this->officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function sessionOn(string $date, array $overrides = [], ?Doctor $doctor = null): PracticeSession
    {
        $doctor ??= $this->doctor;

        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function appointmentOn(PracticeSession $session, string $name, AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, array $overrides = [], array $profile = []): Appointment
    {
        $owner = PatientProfile::factory()->create(['full_name' => $name] + $profile);

        return $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, array_merge(['patient_profile_id' => $owner->id], $overrides));
    }

    private function index(array $query = []): \Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($this->officer)->get(route('admin.appointments.index', $query));
    }

    // --- akses -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @return array<string, array{string, int}> */
    public static function roles(): array
    {
        return [
            'super admin' => ['super-admin', 200],
            'petugas pendaftaran' => ['registration-officer', 200],
            'admin konten' => ['content-admin', 403],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('roles')]
    public function test_access_per_staff_role(string $role, int $status): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))->get(route('admin.appointments.index'))->assertStatus($status);
    }

    public function test_a_patient_gets_403_and_a_guest_is_sent_to_the_admin_login(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->patient()->create())->get(route('admin.appointments.index'))->assertForbidden();

        auth()->logout();
        $this->get(route('admin.appointments.index'))->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
    }

    public function test_the_url_uses_the_indonesian_segment(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/pendaftaran'), route('admin.appointments.index'));

    // --- bawaan dan filter -------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_default_range_is_today_only(): void
    {
        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-05'), 'Pasien Kemarin');
        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-06'), 'Pasien Hari Ini');
        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-07'), 'Pasien Besok');

        $this->index()
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Pasien Hari Ini')
            ->assertDontSee('Pasien Kemarin')
            ->assertDontSee('Pasien Besok')
            ->assertSee('id="filter-dari"', false)
            ->assertSee('value="2026-10-06"', false);
    }

    public function test_dari_and_sampai_widen_the_range_inclusively(): void
    {
        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-05'), 'Pasien Lima');
        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-06'), 'Pasien Enam');
        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-07'), 'Pasien Tujuh');
        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-08'), 'Pasien Delapan');

        $this->index(['dari' => '2026-10-06', 'sampai' => '2026-10-07'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertDontSee('Pasien Lima')
            ->assertSee('Pasien Enam')
            ->assertSee('Pasien Tujuh')
            ->assertDontSee('Pasien Delapan');

        $this->index(['dari' => '2026-10-07'])
            ->assertSee('Pasien Tujuh')
            ->assertSee('Pasien Delapan')

        $this->index(['sampai' => '2026-10-05'])
            ->assertSee('Pasien Lima')
            ->assertDontSee('Pasien Enam');

    public function test_a_reversed_range_ignores_sampai_keeps_dari_and_says_so(): void
    {

        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-08'), 'Pasien Delapan');

        $this->index(['dari' => '2026-10-08', 'sampai' => '2026-10-06'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Tanggal sampai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal dari: batas sampai diabaikan, tanggal dari tetap berlaku.')
            ->assertSee('Pasien Delapan')
            ->assertDontSee('Pasien Enam');
    }

        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-06'), 'Pasien Anak Online');
        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-06', ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00']), 'Pasien Anak Loket', AppointmentStatus::Pending, ['channel' => BookingChannel::Loket]);
        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-06', [], $other), 'Pasien Bedah', AppointmentStatus::Completed);

        $this->index(['poli' => $this->clinic->slug])
            ->assertSee('Pasien Anak Online')->assertSee('Pasien Anak Loket')->assertDontSee('Pasien Bedah');
        $this->index(['dokter' => $other->slug])
            ->assertSee('Pasien Bedah')->assertDontSee('Pasien Anak Online');
        $this->index(['status' => 'pending'])
            ->assertSee('Pasien Anak Loket')->assertDontSee('Pasien Anak Online')->assertDontSee('Pasien Bedah');
        $this->index(['kanal' => 'loket'])
            ->assertSee('Pasien Anak Loket')->assertDontSee('Pasien Anak Online');
        $this->index(['kanal' => 'online', 'status' => 'completed'])
            ->assertSee('Pasien Bedah')->assertDontSee('Pasien Anak Loket');
    }

    public function test_the_keyword_matches_the_booking_code_the_patient_number_or_the_name(): void
    {
        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-06'), 'Siti Rahmawati', AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['booking_code' => 'UPH-ABCD-2345'], ['patient_number' => 'P000123']);
        $this->appointmentOn($this->sessionOn('2026-10-06'), 'Budi Santoso', AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['booking_code' => 'UPH-WXYZ-6789'], ['patient_number' => 'P000456']);
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\Clinic;

use App\Support\Actor;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Detail pendaftaran #38 (F7A-R18, E1): tombol per status dan waktu persis aturan server (check-in tepat jendela dibuka,
 * `aria-disabled` dengan teks "Dibuka HH.MM", `end` tepat dan `end + 1 menit`, koreksi hanya hari yang sama), BPJS dan
 * polis tersamar (SEK-12), escape (SEK-15), `kembali`, akses. Sesi uji: 09.00-12.00; check-in dibuka 08.00.
 */
class AdminAppointmentShowTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const BPJS = '0009900000011';

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    private User $officer;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 07:00:00');
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poli Anak', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.A'], $this->clinic);
        $this->officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $profile
     */
    private function appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus $status, string $date = '2026-10-06', array $overrides = [], array $profile = []): Appointment
    {
        $session = $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ]);

        $owner = PatientProfile::factory()->create($profile + ['full_name' => 'Siti Rahmawati']);

        return $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, array_merge(['patient_profile_id' => $owner->id], $overrides));
    }

    private function show(Appointment $appointment, array $query = [], ?User $user = null): \Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->officer)
            ->get(route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code] + $query));
    }

    /** @return list<string> nilai `to` dari semua field tersembunyi pada halaman, unik dan terurut */
    private function shownTargets(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/<input type="hidden" name="to" value="([a-z_]+)">/', $html, $matches);
        $targets = array_values(array_unique($matches[1]));
        sort($targets);

        return $targets;
    }

    // --- akses dan URL -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @return array<string, array{string, int}> */
    public static function roles(): array
    {
        return [
            'super admin' => ['super-admin', 200],
            'petugas pendaftaran' => ['registration-officer', 200],
            'admin konten' => ['content-admin', 403],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('roles')]
    public function test_access_per_staff_role(string $role, int $status): void
    {
        $this->show($this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed), [], $this->createStaff($role))->assertStatus($status);
    }

    public function test_a_patient_gets_403_and_a_guest_is_sent_to_the_admin_login(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->show($appointment, [], User::factory()->patient()->create())->assertForbidden();

        auth()->logout();
        $this->get(route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]))->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
    }

    public function test_the_url_uses_the_booking_code_and_other_shapes_are_404(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/pendaftaran/'.$appointment->booking_code), route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]));

        $this->actingAs($this->officer);
        $this->get('/admin/pendaftaran/'.$appointment->id)->assertNotFound();
        $this->get('/admin/pendaftaran/abc')->assertNotFound();
        $this->get('/admin/pendaftaran/'.strtolower($appointment->booking_code))->assertNotFound();
        $this->get('/admin/pendaftaran/UPH-ZZZZ-ZZZZ')->assertNotFound();
        $this->get('/admin/pendaftaran/UPH-ABCD-EFGH')->assertNotFound();
    }

    // --- E1: tombol vs aturan server ---------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{AppointmentStatus, string, string, list<string>, ?string}>
     *                                                                                      status, jam sekarang, tanggal sesi, tombol yang tampil (terurut), jam check-in dibuka bila tombol check-in nonaktif
     */
    public static function buttonMatrix(): array
    {
        $today = '2026-10-06';

        return [
            'pending, semenit sebelum jendela check-in' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending, $today.' 07:59:00', $today, ['cancelled', 'confirmed'], '08.00'],
            'pending, tepat jendela dibuka' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending, $today.' 08:00:00', $today, ['cancelled', 'checked_in', 'confirmed'], null],
            'pending, tepat akhir sesi' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending, $today.' 12:00:00', $today, ['cancelled', 'checked_in'], null],
            'pending, semenit setelah akhir sesi' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending, $today.' 12:01:00', $today, ['cancelled'], null],
            'confirmed, semenit sebelum jendela check-in' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $today.' 07:59:00', $today, ['cancelled'], '08.00'],
            'confirmed, tepat jendela dibuka' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $today.' 08:00:00', $today, ['cancelled', 'checked_in'], null],
            'confirmed, tepat akhir sesi' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $today.' 12:00:00', $today, ['cancelled', 'checked_in'], null],
            'confirmed, semenit setelah akhir sesi' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $today.' 12:01:00', $today, ['cancelled'], null],
            'confirmed, sesi besok' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $today.' 07:00:00', '2026-10-07', ['cancelled'], null],
            'checked_in, hari yang sama' => [AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $today.' 10:00:00', $today, ['completed', 'confirmed'], null],
            'checked_in, sesi kemarin (tanpa koreksi)' => [AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $today.' 10:00:00', '2026-10-05', ['completed'], null],
            'completed' => [AppointmentStatus::Completed, $today.' 10:00:00', $today, [], null],
            'cancelled' => [AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $today.' 10:00:00', $today, [], null],
            'no_show' => [AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $today.' 10:00:00', $today, [], null],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string>  $expected
     */
    #[DataProvider('buttonMatrix')]
    public function test_the_buttons_are_exactly_what_the_server_accepts(AppointmentStatus $status, string $now, string $sessionDate, array $expected, ?string $opensAt): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor($status, $sessionDate);
        $this->travelTo($now);
        Notification::fake();

        $html = $this->show($appointment)->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertSame($expected, $this->shownTargets($html), 'Tombol yang tampil.');

        if ($opensAt === null) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('aria-disabled="true"', $html);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Dibuka ', $html);
        } else {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('aria-disabled="true"', $html);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Dibuka '.$opensAt, $html);
        }

        // Arah sebaliknya: setiap tujuan dicoba ke server (dalam savepoint yang digulung balik).
        $accepted = [];

        foreach (['confirmed', 'checked_in', 'completed', 'cancelled'] as $to) {
            DB::beginTransaction();
            $this->flushSession();

            $this->actingAs($this->officer)->post(route('admin.appointments.transition', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]), [
                'to' => $to,
                'expected_status' => $status->value,
                'reason' => 'Alasan uji petugas',
            ]);

            if (DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $appointment->id)->value('status') !== $status->value) {
                $accepted[] = $to;
            }

            DB::rollBack();
        }

        sort($accepted);

        $this->assertSame($expected, $accepted, 'Tujuan yang diterima server.');
    }

    public function test_a_check_in_before_the_window_is_a_focusable_aria_disabled_button_with_visible_text(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 07:59:00');

        $html = $this->show($appointment)->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertSame(1, preg_match('/<button[^>]*aria-disabled="true"[^>]*>/', $html, $button));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('type="button"', $button[0]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('aria-describedby="checkin-open-'.$appointment->id.'"', $button[0]);
        $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('/<button[^>]*\sdisabled[\s>=]/', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('id="checkin-open-'.$appointment->id.'"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Dibuka 08.00', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<input type="hidden" name="to" value="checked_in">', $html);
    }

    public function test_the_modals_carry_the_static_fields_and_the_reason_limits(): void
    {
        $confirmed = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 08:30:00');

        $html = $this->show($confirmed)->assertOk()->getContent();
        $action = route('admin.appointments.transition', ['appointment' => $confirmed->booking_code]);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('id="modal-batal"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('action="'.$action.'"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<input type="hidden" name="to" value="cancelled">', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<input type="hidden" name="expected_status" value="confirmed">', $html);
        $this->assertSame(1, preg_match('/<textarea[^>]*name="reason"[^>]*>/', $html, $textarea));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('minlength="5"', $textarea[0]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('maxlength="255"', $textarea[0]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('required', $textarea[0]);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('id="modal-koreksi"', $html);

        $checked = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $html = $this->show($checked)->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('id="modal-koreksi"', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('id="modal-batal"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<input type="hidden" name="to" value="confirmed">', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<input type="hidden" name="expected_status" value="checked_in">', $html);
    }

            ->assertDontSee('<script>alert(1)</script>', false)
            ->assertDontSee('<script>alert(2)</script>', false)
            ->assertSee('&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;', false)
            ->assertSee('&lt;script&gt;alert(2)&lt;/script&gt;', false);
    }

    public function test_the_patient_card_links_to_the_patient_and_notes_a_missing_account(): void
    {
        $walkIn = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->show($walkIn)
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('admin.patients.show', $walkIn->patient_profile_id).'"', false)
            ->assertSee('Tanpa akun online');

        $account = PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create();
        $withAccount = $this->bookAppointment($this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id, 'session_date' => '2026-10-06', 'doctor_schedule_id' => null]), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['patient_profile_id' => $account->id]);

        $this->show($withAccount)->assertOk()->assertDontSee('Tanpa akun online');
    }

    public function test_a_valid_kembali_becomes_the_back_link_and_an_evil_one_is_ignored(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->show($appointment, ['kembali' => '/admin/antrean?tanggal=2026-10-06'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('href="/admin/antrean?tanggal=2026-10-06"', false);

        $this->show($appointment, ['kembali' => '//evil.test/x'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertDontSee('evil.test')
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('admin.appointments.index').'"', false);

        $this->show($appointment, ['kembali' => ['/admin/antrean']])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('admin.appointments.index').'"', false);
    }

    public function test_the_page_loads_in_strict_mode_with_a_long_history(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 08:30:00');
        $service = app(AppointmentStatusService::class);
        Notification::fake();
        $service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, Actor::staff($this->officer));
        $service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, Actor::staff($this->officer));
        $service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, Actor::staff($this->officer), 'Salah memilih pasien');

        $html = $this->show($appointment)->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertSame(3, substr_count($html, 'data-history-item'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Salah memilih pasien', $html);
    }
}
```
