Write `tests/Feature/Admin/AdminAppointmentTransitionTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentStatusChangedNotification;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * POST `admin.appointments.transition` (F7A-R18, V-15): setiap transisi dengan flash VERBATIM, BKG-14 dan BKG-19 via HTTP,
 * `to` yang dilarang, alasan 5 sampai 255 karakter, KON-05 UI (`expected_status` basi), NTF-03 via HTTP, `kembali`, akses.
 * Sesi uji: Selasa 2026-10-06 09.00-12.00; check-in dibuka 08.00.
 */
class AdminAppointmentTransitionTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const STALE = 'Status pendaftaran sudah berubah. Muat ulang halaman untuk melihat status terbaru.';

    private const REASON_REQUIRED = 'Alasan wajib diisi untuk pembatalan atau koreksi check-in.';

    private const BAD_TARGET = 'Status tujuan tidak diperbolehkan. Gunakan aksi Tandai tidak hadir pada antrean sesi.';

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    private User $officer;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 07:00:00');
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poli Anak', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani'], $this->clinic);
        $this->officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private function sessionOn(string $date): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ]);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus $status, string $date = '2026-10-06', ?PatientProfile $profile = null, array $overrides = []): Appointment
    {
        $profile ??= PatientProfile::factory()->create();

        return $this->bookAppointment($this->sessionOn($date), $status, array_merge(['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id], $overrides));
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $data */
    private function postTransition(Appointment $appointment, array $data, ?User $user = null): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->officer)
            ->post(route('admin.appointments.transition', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]), $data);
    }

    private function detailUrl(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        return route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]);
    }

    private function statusOf(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        return (string) DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $appointment->id)->value('status');
    }

    private function historyCount(Appointment $appointment): int
    {
        return AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->count();
    }

    // --- setiap transisi dengan flash VERBATIM -----------------------------------------------

    /** @return array<string, array{AppointmentStatus, string, ?string, string, string}> */
    public static function successCases(): array
    {
        return [
            'konfirmasi' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending, 'confirmed', null, '07:00:00', 'Pendaftaran {code} dikonfirmasi.'],
            'check-in dari confirmed' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, 'checked_in', null, '08:00:00', '{queue} check-in berhasil.'],
            'check-in langsung dari pending' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending, 'checked_in', null, '08:30:00', '{queue} check-in berhasil.'],
            'selesai' => [AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, 'completed', null, '10:00:00', 'Kunjungan {queue} selesai.'],
            'batal dari pending' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending, 'cancelled', 'Pasien menelepon membatalkan', '07:00:00', 'Pendaftaran {code} dibatalkan.'],
            'batal dari confirmed' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, 'cancelled', 'Dokter berhalangan hadir', '09:30:00', 'Pendaftaran {code} dibatalkan.'],
            'koreksi check-in' => [AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, 'confirmed', 'Salah memilih pasien', '10:00:00', 'Check-in {queue} dikoreksi menjadi Dikonfirmasi.'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('successCases')]
    public function test_every_transition_succeeds_with_the_verbatim_flash(AppointmentStatus $from, string $to, ?string $reason, string $time, string $flash): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor($from);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 '.$time);
        Notification::fake();

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => $to, 'expected_status' => $from->value, 'reason' => $reason])
            ->assertRedirect($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', strtr($flash, ['{code}' => $appointment->booking_code, '{queue}' => 'ANK-001']));

        $this->assertSame($to, $this->statusOf($appointment));

        $history = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->sole();
        $this->assertSame($from, $history->from_status);
        $this->assertSame($to, $history->to_status->value);
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Staff, $history->actor_type);
        $this->assertSame($this->officer->id, (int) $history->actor_user_id);
        $this->assertSame($reason, $history->reason);

        $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->sole();
        $this->assertSame($this->officer->id, (int) $audit->user_id);
        $this->assertSame($from->value, $audit->old_values['status']);
        $this->assertSame($to, $audit->new_values['status']);
    }

    public function test_cancelling_releases_the_quota_and_a_correction_clears_the_check_in_time(): void
    {
        $cancelled = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->postTransition($cancelled, ['to' => 'cancelled', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed', 'reason' => 'Pasien menelepon'])->assertSessionHas('success');

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($cancelled->practice_session_id)->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame('Pasien menelepon', Appointment::query()->findOrFail($cancelled->id)->cancel_reason);

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 10:00:00');
        $corrected = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $this->postTransition($corrected, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'checked_in', 'reason' => 'Salah memilih pasien'])->assertSessionHas('success');

        $this->assertNull(Appointment::query()->findOrFail($corrected->id)->checked_in_at);
    }

    // --- BKG-14 via HTTP ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_bkg_14_check_in_one_minute_before_the_window_is_rejected_and_exactly_at_the_opening_is_accepted(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 07:59:00');
        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed'])
            ->assertRedirect($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', 'Check-in belum dibuka. Check-in dibuka pukul 08.00.');
        $this->assertSame('confirmed', $this->statusOf($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($appointment));

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 08:00:00');
        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed'])
            ->assertRedirect($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'ANK-001 check-in berhasil.');
        $this->assertSame('checked_in', $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    public function test_bkg_14_check_in_exactly_at_the_end_is_accepted_and_one_minute_later_is_rejected(): void
    {
        $atEnd = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $late = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 12:00:00');
        $this->postTransition($atEnd, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed'])->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertSame('checked_in', $this->statusOf($atEnd));

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 12:01:00');
        $this->postTransition($late, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed'])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', 'Sesi sudah berakhir sehingga check-in tidak dapat dilakukan.');
        $this->assertSame('confirmed', $this->statusOf($late));
    }

    public function test_bkg_14_check_in_on_another_day_is_rejected_with_the_visit_date(): void
    {
        $tomorrow = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, '2026-10-07');
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 08:30:00');

        $this->postTransition($tomorrow, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed'])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', 'Check-in hanya dapat dilakukan pada tanggal kunjungan (Rabu, 7 Oktober 2026).');
        $this->assertSame('confirmed', $this->statusOf($tomorrow));
    }

    public function test_confirming_from_the_exact_end_of_the_session_is_rejected(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 12:00:00');

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'pending'])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', 'Sesi sudah berakhir sehingga pendaftaran tidak dapat dikonfirmasi.');
        $this->assertSame('pending', $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    // --- BKG-19 via HTTP ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_bkg_19_the_correction_works_on_the_visit_day_and_not_on_another_day(): void
    {
        $sameDay = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $yesterday = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, '2026-10-05');
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 10:00:00');

        $this->postTransition($sameDay, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'checked_in', 'reason' => 'Salah memilih pasien'])
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Check-in ANK-001 dikoreksi menjadi Dikonfirmasi.');
        $this->assertSame('confirmed', $this->statusOf($sameDay));

        $this->postTransition($yesterday, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'checked_in', 'reason' => 'Salah memilih pasien'])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', 'Koreksi check-in hanya dapat dilakukan pada hari yang sama.');
        $this->assertSame('checked_in', $this->statusOf($yesterday));
    }

    public function test_bkg_19_the_correction_requires_a_reason(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 10:00:00');

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'checked_in'])
            ->assertRedirect($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['reason' => self::REASON_REQUIRED])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', self::REASON_REQUIRED);
        $this->assertSame('checked_in', $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    public function test_a_cancelled_appointment_cannot_be_checked_in_nor_reopened(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Completed);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 10:00:00');

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'completed'])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', 'Pendaftaran ini sudah berstatus selesai dan tidak dapat diubah lagi.');
        $this->assertSame('completed', $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    // --- tujuan yang dilarang (E3) -----------------------------------------------------------

    /** @return array<string, array{mixed, string}> */
    public static function badTargets(): array
    {
        return [
            'no_show per individu' => ['no_show', self::BAD_TARGET],
            'pending' => ['pending', self::BAD_TARGET],
            'status tidak dikenal' => ['xyz', self::BAD_TARGET],
            'kosong' => ['', 'Status tujuan wajib dipilih.'],
            'larik' => [['cancelled'], 'Status tujuan tidak valid.'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('badTargets')]
    public function test_a_forbidden_target_is_rejected_with_the_verbatim_message(mixed $to, string $message): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 08:30:00');

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => $to, 'expected_status' => 'confirmed', 'reason' => 'Alasan uji petugas'])
            ->assertRedirect($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['to' => $message])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', $message);

        $this->assertSame('confirmed', $this->statusOf($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($appointment));
    }

    // --- alasan V-15 -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @return array<string, array{mixed, ?string}> */
    public static function reasons(): array
    {
        return [
            'tidak dikirim' => [null, self::REASON_REQUIRED],
            'hanya spasi' => ['      ', self::REASON_REQUIRED],
            'empat karakter' => ['abcd', 'Alasan minimal 5 karakter.'],
            'empat karakter berspasi' => ['  abcd  ', 'Alasan minimal 5 karakter.'],
            'lima karakter' => ['abcde', null],
            'dua ratus lima puluh lima karakter' => [str_repeat('a', 255), null],
            'dua ratus lima puluh enam karakter' => [str_repeat('a', 256), 'Alasan maksimal 255 karakter.'],
            'larik' => [['abcde'], 'Alasan harus berupa teks.'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('reasons')]
    public function test_the_cancellation_reason_follows_v15(mixed $reason, ?string $error): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $response = $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'cancelled', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed', 'reason' => $reason]);

        if ($error === null) {
            $response->assertSessionHas('success', 'Pendaftaran '.$appointment->booking_code.' dibatalkan.');
            $this->assertSame('cancelled', $this->statusOf($appointment));

            return;
        }

        $response->assertRedirect($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['reason' => $error])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', $error);
        $this->assertSame('confirmed', $this->statusOf($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($appointment));
    }

    public function test_a_reason_is_not_required_for_the_other_transitions(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'pending'])
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Pendaftaran '.$appointment->booking_code.' dikonfirmasi.');
    }

    // --- KON-05 UI: halaman basi dan klik ganda ----------------------------------------------

    public function test_kon_05_a_stale_expected_status_is_rejected_without_writing(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $other = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 08:30:00');

        // Petugas pertama memuat halaman (status confirmed); petugas lain lebih dulu melakukan check-in.
        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed'], $other)->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->historyCount($appointment));
        $booked = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($appointment->practice_session_id)->booked_count;

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'cancelled', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed', 'reason' => 'Pasien menelepon'])
            ->assertRedirect($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', self::STALE);

        $this->assertSame('checked_in', $this->statusOf($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->historyCount($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(1, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->count());
        $this->assertSame($booked, PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($appointment->practice_session_id)->booked_count);
    }

    public function test_a_double_submit_of_the_same_form_changes_the_status_only_once(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 08:30:00');
        $data = ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed'];

        $this->postTransition($appointment, $data)->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->flushSession();
        $this->postTransition($appointment, $data)->assertSessionHas('error', self::STALE);

        $this->assertSame(1, $this->historyCount($appointment));
    }

    public function test_expected_status_is_required_and_must_be_a_real_status(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 08:30:00');

        foreach ([null, '', 'xyz', ['confirmed']] as $value) {
            $this->flushSession();
            $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => $value])
                ->assertSessionHasErrors(['expected_status' => self::STALE])
                ->assertSessionHas('error', self::STALE);
        }

        $this->assertSame('confirmed', $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    // --- NTF-03 via HTTP ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_ntf_03_a_walk_in_patient_without_an_account_gets_no_notification_but_everything_is_written(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Pending, '2026-10-06', PatientProfile::factory()->create(['user_id' => null]));

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'pending'])->assertSessionHas('success');

        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('notifications')->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->historyCount($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(1, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->count());

        Notification::fake();
        $second = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Pending, '2026-10-06', PatientProfile::factory()->create(['user_id' => null]));
        $this->postTransition($second, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'pending'])->assertSessionHas('success');
        Notification::assertNothingSent();
    }

    public function test_ntf_03_a_patient_with_an_account_is_notified_of_a_staff_transition(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create();
        $recipient = User::query()->findOrFail($profile->user_id);
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Pending, '2026-10-06', $profile);
        Notification::fake();

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'pending'])->assertSessionHas('success');

        Notification::assertSentToTimes($recipient, AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class, 1);
        Notification::assertSentTo(
            $recipient,
            AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class,
            fn (AppointmentStatusChangedNotification $notification): bool => $notification->appointment->is($appointment)
                && $notification->to === AppointmentStatus::Confirmed,
        );
    }

    public function test_a_rejected_transition_sends_nothing_and_writes_nothing(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create();
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, '2026-10-06', $profile);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 07:00:00');
        Notification::fake();

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed'])->assertSessionHas('error');

        Notification::assertNothingSent();
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(0, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->count());
    }

    // --- kembali (F7A-R19) -------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_a_valid_kembali_is_used_on_success_and_on_error(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $queue = '/admin/antrean?tanggal=2026-10-06&sesi='.$appointment->practice_session_id;

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 08:30:00');
        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed', 'kembali' => $queue])
            ->assertRedirect($queue)
            ->assertSessionHas('success');

        $this->flushSession();
        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed', 'kembali' => $queue])
            ->assertRedirect($queue)
            ->assertSessionHas('error', self::STALE);

        $this->flushSession();
        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'no_show', 'expected_status' => 'checked_in', 'kembali' => $queue])
            ->assertRedirect($queue)
            ->assertSessionHasErrors('to');
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{mixed}> */
    public static function evilKembali(): array
    {
        return [
            'domain lain' => ['https://evil.test/admin/antrean'],
            'protokol relatif' => ['//evil.test'],
            'portal pasien' => ['/pasien'],
            'admin pasien' => ['/admin/pasien'],
            'segmen titik-titik' => ['/admin/antrean/../pasien'],
            'larik' => [['/admin/antrean']],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('evilKembali')]
    public function test_an_unsafe_kembali_never_leaves_the_allowed_area(mixed $kembali): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 08:30:00');

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed', 'kembali' => $kembali])
            ->assertRedirect($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHas('success');

        $this->flushSession();
        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'checked_in', 'expected_status' => 'confirmed', 'kembali' => $kembali])
            ->assertRedirect($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', self::STALE);
    }

    // --- akses dan URL -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @return array<string, array{string, int}> */
    public static function roles(): array
    {
        return [
            'super admin' => ['super-admin', 302],
            'petugas pendaftaran' => ['registration-officer', 302],
            'admin konten' => ['content-admin', 403],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('roles')]
    public function test_access_per_staff_role(string $role, int $status): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'pending'], $this->createStaff($role))->assertStatus($status);

        $this->assertSame($status === 302 ? 'confirmed' : 'pending', $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    public function test_a_staff_member_with_only_the_view_permission_gets_403(): void
    {
        $this->seedRoles();
        $viewer = User::factory()->staff()->create();
        $viewer->givePermissionTo('appointments.view');
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'pending'], $viewer)->assertForbidden();
        $this->assertSame('pending', $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    public function test_a_patient_gets_403_and_a_guest_is_sent_to_the_admin_login(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->postTransition($appointment, ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'pending'], User::factory()->patient()->create())->assertForbidden();

        auth()->logout();
        $this->post(route('admin.appointments.transition', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]), ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'pending'])
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
        $this->assertSame('pending', $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    public function test_malformed_unknown_and_numeric_codes_are_404(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->actingAs($this->officer);
        $data = ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'pending'];

        $this->post('/admin/pendaftaran/abc/status', $data)->assertNotFound();
        $this->post('/admin/pendaftaran/'.$appointment->id.'/status', $data)->assertNotFound();
        $this->post('/admin/pendaftaran/'.strtolower($appointment->booking_code).'/status', $data)->assertNotFound();
        $this->post('/admin/pendaftaran/UPH-ZZZZ-ZZZZ/status', $data)->assertNotFound();
        $this->assertSame('pending', $this->statusOf($appointment));
    }

    public function test_the_transition_is_post_only(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor(AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)
            ->get(route('admin.appointments.transition', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]))
            ->assertStatus(405);
    }
}
```

Write `app/Http/Requests/Admin/AppointmentIndexRequest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Booking\BookingCodeGenerator;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientSearch;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Filter daftar pendaftaran #38 (F7A-R17, 12 V-46): `dari`/`sampai` (tanggal kunjungan; bila keduanya kosong, hari ini
 * sampai hari ini), `poli` dan `dokter` (slug), `status` (AppointmentStatus), `kanal` (BookingChannel), `q` (kode booking,
 * nomor pasien, atau nama). Nilai tidak valid atau larik diabaikan (pola ListFilterRequest). Urutan tetap: tanggal kunjungan,
 * jam mulai sesi, sesi, nomor antrean.
 */
class AppointmentIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::rules(), [
            'dari' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d'],
            'sampai' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d', 'after_or_equal:dari'],
            'poli' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:150', Rule::exists('clinics', 'slug')],
            'dokter' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:150', Rule::exists('doctors', 'slug')],
            'kanal' => ['nullable', Rule::in(BookingChannel::values())],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::messages(), [
            'dari.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'sampai.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'sampai.after_or_equal' => 'Tanggal sampai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal dari.',
            'poli.string' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'poli.max' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'poli.exists' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'dokter.string' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'dokter.max' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'dokter.exists' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'kanal.in' => 'Kanal tidak valid.',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function statusValues(): array
    {
        return AppointmentStatus::values();
    }

    /**
     * Rentang terbalik: hanya `sampai` yang gagal dan diabaikan, `dari` tetap berlaku (pola ListFilterRequest, yang
     * tidak diubah). Pesan menyebut persis apa yang diabaikan; kegagalan lain memakai pesan umum.
     */
    protected function failedValidation(Validator $validator): void
    {
        $failed = $validator->failed();

        if (array_keys($failed) === ['sampai'] && array_keys($failed['sampai']) === ['AfterOrEqual']) {
            session()->now('warning', 'Tanggal sampai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal dari: batas sampai diabaikan, tanggal dari tetap berlaku.');

            return;
        }

        parent::failedValidation($validator);
    }

    /**
     * Rentang tanggal kunjungan yang berlaku. Tanpa `dari` dan `sampai`: hari ini sampai hari ini. Bila hanya satu yang
     * ada, sisi lainnya terbuka.
     *
     * @return array{0: ?CarbonImmutable, 1: ?CarbonImmutable}
     */
    public function range(): array
    {
        $filters = $this->filters();

        $from = isset($filters['dari']) ? CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $filters['dari']) : null;
        $to = isset($filters['sampai']) ? CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $filters['sampai']) : null;

        if ($from === null && $to === null) {
            $today = CarbonImmutable::today();

            return [$today, $today];
        }

        return [$from ?: null, $to ?: null];
    }

    /**
     * @param  Builder<Appointment>  $query
     * @return Builder<Appointment>
     */
    public function applyTo(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        $filters = $this->filters();
        [$from, $to] = $this->range();

        if ($from !== null) {
            $query->where('appointments.session_date', '>=', $from->toDateString());
        }

        if ($to !== null) {
            $query->where('appointments.session_date', '<=', $to->toDateString());
        }

        if (isset($filters['poli'])) {
            $query->whereIn('appointments.clinic_id', Clinic::query()->where('slug', $filters['poli'])->select('id'));
        }

        if (isset($filters['dokter'])) {
            $query->whereIn('appointments.doctor_id', Doctor::query()->where('slug', $filters['dokter'])->select('id'));
        }

        if (isset($filters['status'])) {
            $query->where('appointments.status', $filters['status']);
        }

        if (isset($filters['kanal'])) {
            $query->where('appointments.channel', $filters['kanal']);
        }

        $term = trim($filters['q'] ?? '');

        if ($term !== '') {
            $code = BookingCodeGenerator::normalize($term);

            $query->where(function (Builder $inner) use ($term, $code): void {
                if (BookingCodeGenerator::isValid($code)) {
                    $inner->orWhere('appointments.booking_code', $code);
                }

                $inner->orWhereHas('patientProfile', fn (Builder $profile): Builder => app(PatientSearch::class)->apply($profile, $term));
            });
        }

        return $query
            ->orderBy('appointments.session_date')
            ->orderBy(PracticeSession::query()->select('start_time')->whereColumn('practice_sessions.id', 'appointments.practice_session_id'))
            ->orderBy('appointments.practice_session_id')
            ->orderBy('appointments.queue_number')
            ->orderBy('appointments.id');
    }
}
```

Write `app/Http/Requests/Admin/TransitionAppointmentRequest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentStatusService;
use App\Support\AdminReturn;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * V-15 (F7A-R18): POST `admin.appointments.transition`. `to` hanya konfirmasi, check-in, selesai, atau batal (`no_show` dan
 * `pending` tidak pernah per individu); `reason` 5 sampai 255 karakter, wajib untuk pembatalan dan koreksi check-in;
 * `expected_status` = status yang dilihat petugas saat halaman dimuat (anti aksi ganda, KON-05). Aturan jendela waktu dan
 * status ada di AppointmentStatusService. Modal sudah tertutup setelah kirim, jadi galat pertama juga dijadikan flash `error`.
 */
class TransitionAppointmentRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $appointment = $this->route('appointment');

        return $appointment instanceof Appointment && (bool) $this->user()?->can('transition', $appointment);
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $reason = $this->input('reason');

        if (is_string($reason)) {
            $reason = trim($reason);

            $this->merge(['reason' => $reason === '' ? null : $reason]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $targets = array_map(
            fn (AppointmentStatus $status): string => $status->value,
            AppointmentStatusService::INDIVIDUAL_TARGETS,
        );

        return [
            'to' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', Rule::in($targets)],
            'expected_status' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', Rule::in(AppointmentStatus::values())],
            'reason' => ['bail', 'nullable', Rule::requiredIf(fn (): bool => $this->requiresReason()), 'string', 'min:5', 'max:255'],
            // `kembali` larik/liar diabaikan oleh AdminReturn (F7A-R19), bukan galat validasi.
            'kembali' => ['nullable'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'to.required' => 'Status tujuan wajib dipilih.',
            'to.string' => 'Status tujuan tidak valid.',
            'to.in' => __('booking.admin.invalid_target'),
            'expected_status.required' => __('booking.transitions.STALE_STATUS'),
            'expected_status.string' => __('booking.transitions.STALE_STATUS'),
            'expected_status.in' => __('booking.transitions.STALE_STATUS'),
            'reason.required' => __('booking.transitions.REASON_REQUIRED'),
            'reason.string' => 'Alasan harus berupa teks.',
            'reason.min' => 'Alasan minimal 5 karakter.',
            'reason.max' => 'Alasan maksimal 255 karakter.',
        ];
    }

    /** Pembatalan, atau konfirmasi pada pendaftaran yang sudah check-in (koreksi). */
    private function requiresReason(): bool
    {
        $to = $this->input('to');

        if ($to === AppointmentStatus::Cancelled->value) {
            return true;
        }

        if ($to !== AppointmentStatus::Confirmed->value) {
            return false;
        }

        $appointment = $this->route('appointment');
        $current = $appointment instanceof Appointment ? $appointment->status : null;

        return $current === AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn || $this->input('expected_status') === AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn->value;
    }

    protected function failedValidation(Validator $validator): void
    {
        session()->flash('error', (string) $validator->errors()->first());

        parent::failedValidation($validator);
    }

    /** Galat validasi kembali ke `kembali` yang sah (detail atau antrean), selain itu ke detail pendaftaran. */
    protected function getRedirectUrl(): string
    {
        $appointment = $this->route('appointment');
        $fallback = $appointment instanceof Appointment
            ? route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code])
            : route('admin.appointments.index');

        return AdminReturn::path($this->returnTo(), $fallback);
    }

    public function target(): AppointmentStatus
    {
        return AppointmentStatus::from((string) $this->validated('to'));
    }

    public function expectedStatus(): AppointmentStatus
    {
        return AppointmentStatus::from((string) $this->validated('expected_status'));
    }

    public function reason(): ?string
    {
        $reason = $this->validated('reason');

        return is_string($reason) && $reason !== '' ? $reason : null;
    }

    /** `kembali` mentah bila berupa teks (belum disaring AdminReturn). */
    public function returnTo(): ?string
    {
        $value = $this->input('kembali');

        return is_string($value) ? $value : null;
    }
}
```

Write `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/AppointmentController.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\AppointmentIndexRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\TransitionAppointmentRequest;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentProofService;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentStatusService;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use App\Support\AdminReturn;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Pendaftaran kunjungan #38 sisi petugas (F7A-R17, R18, R22): daftar, detail, transisi status per pendaftaran, dan bukti
 * cetak. Tulis status hanya lewat AppointmentStatusService (otorisasi izin di route dan Form Request; service tidak
 * memeriksa izin). T9 menambah form walk-in (`create`/`store`).
 */
class AppointmentController extends Controller
{
    public function index(AppointmentIndexRequest $request): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Appointment::class);

        $appointments = $request
            ->applyTo(Appointment::query()->with(['clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession', 'patientProfile']))
            ->paginate($request->perPage());

        return view('admin.appointments.index', [
            'appointments' => $appointments,
            'range' => $request->range(),
            'clinicOptions' => Clinic::query()->ordered()->pluck('name', 'slug')->all(),
            'doctorOptions' => Doctor::query()->ordered()->get()
                ->mapWithKeys(fn (Doctor $doctor): array => [$doctor->slug => $doctor->display_name])
                ->all(),
            'statusOptions' => AppointmentStatus::options(),
            'channelOptions' => BookingChannel::options(),
        ]);
    }

    public function show(Request $request, Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatusService $statuses): View
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $appointment);

        $appointment->load(['patientProfile', 'clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession', 'insurancePartner', 'creator', 'statusHistories.actor']);

        $user = $request->user();
        $checks = $user->can('transition', $appointment)
            ? $statuses->transitionChecks($appointment, Actor::staff($user))
            : [];
        $returnTo = $this->returnTo($request->query('kembali'));

        return view('admin.appointments.show', [
            'appointment' => $appointment,
            'checks' => $checks,
            'returnTo' => $returnTo,
            'backUrl' => $returnTo ?? route('admin.appointments.index'),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Satu transisi (V-15). Galat aturan (`InvalidTransitionException`) ditangani handler global dan
     * `BookingRedirect` (kembali ke `kembali` atau detail dengan flash `error`); tidak ada yang ditulis bila gagal.
     */
    public function transition(TransitionAppointmentRequest $request, Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatusService $statuses): RedirectResponse
    {
        $from = $appointment->status;
        $to = $request->target();

        $updated = $statuses->transition(
            $appointment,
            $to,
            Actor::staff($request->user()),
            $request->reason(),
            $request->expectedStatus(),
        );
        $updated->loadMissing('clinic');

        return redirect()
            ->to(AdminReturn::path($request->returnTo(), route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $updated->booking_code])))
            ->with('success', $this->successMessage($from, $to, $updated));
    }

    /** Bukti cetak (F7A-R22): isi bukti sama dengan sisi pasien, tanpa PDF. */
    public function proof(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentProofService $proof, SettingsService $settings): View
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $appointment);

        $appointment->loadMissing(['clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession', 'patientProfile', 'insurancePartner']);

        return view('admin.appointments.proof', [
            'appointment' => $appointment,
            'qrDataUri' => $proof->qrSvgDataUri($appointment),
            'siteName' => $settings->string('site.name', (string) config('app.name')),
            'logoUrl' => $settings->logoUrl(),
            'checkinMinutes' => $settings->bookingRules()->checkinOpenMinutes,
            'printedAt' => CarbonImmutable::now(),
        ]);
    }

    private function successMessage(AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        $replace = ['code' => $appointment->booking_code, 'queue' => $appointment->queue_label];

        return match (true) {
            $to === AppointmentStatus::Confirmed && $from === AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn => __('booking.admin.corrected', $replace),
            $to === AppointmentStatus::Confirmed => __('booking.admin.confirmed', $replace),
            $to === AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn => __('booking.admin.checked_in', $replace),
            $to === AppointmentStatus::Completed => __('booking.admin.completed', $replace),
            default => __('booking.admin.cancelled', $replace),
        };
    }

    /** `kembali` query yang sah (detail atau antrean), selain itu null. */
    private function returnTo(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        $path = AdminReturn::path(is_string($value) ? $value : null, '');

        return $path === '' ? null : $path;
    }
}
```

```blade
{{--
    Tombol aksi status satu pendaftaran (F7A-R18). Dipakai detail ($context = 'detail') dan antrean T10 ($context = 'queue').
    Variabel: $appointment (relasi patientProfile dan clinic termuat), $checks (list<TransitionCheck> dari
    AppointmentStatusService::transitionChecks), $context, $returnTo (path kembali yang sah atau null).
    Konfirmasi, check-in, dan selesai = form POST kecil. Batalkan dan Koreksi memerlukan alasan: pada detail membuka modal
    statis (modal-batal, modal-koreksi); pada antrean menjadi tautan ke detail. Check-in yang ditolak CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN =
    tombol aria-disabled (tetap dalam urutan fokus) dengan teks terlihat "Dibuka HH.MM"; penolakan lain tanpa tombol.
--}}
@php
    $context = ($context ?? 'detail') === 'queue' ? 'queue' : 'detail';
    $returnTo = isset($returnTo) && is_string($returnTo) && $returnTo !== '' ? $returnTo : null;
    $code = $appointment->booking_code;
    $isCorrection = $appointment->status === \App\Enums\AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn;
    $subject = $appointment->queue_label.' '.$appointment->patientProfile->full_name;
    $actionUrl = route('admin.appointments.transition', ['appointment' => $code]);
    $detailUrl = route('admin.appointments.show', array_filter(['appointment' => $code, 'kembali' => $returnTo]));
    $size = $context === 'queue' ? 'btn-sm' : '';
    $needsReason = fn (string $to): bool => $to === 'cancelled' || ($to === 'confirmed' && $isCorrection);
    $styles = [
        'confirmed' => $isCorrection
            ? ['Koreksi Check-in', 'bi-arrow-counterclockwise', 'outline-warning']
            : ['Konfirmasi', 'bi-check-circle', 'primary'],
        'checked_in' => ['Check-in', 'bi-person-check', 'success'],
        'completed' => ['Selesai', 'bi-check2-all', 'success'],
        'cancelled' => ['Batalkan', 'bi-x-circle', 'outline-danger'],
    ];
    $visible = collect($checks)->contains(
        fn ($check): bool => $check->allowed() || $check->errorCode === \App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException::CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN,
    );
@endphp
<div class="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2" data-appointment-actions>
    @foreach ($checks as $check)
        @php
            $to = $check->to->value;
            [$text, $icon, $variant] = $styles[$to];
        @endphp
        @if ($check->allowed())
            @if ($needsReason($to))
                @if ($context === 'detail')
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-{{ $variant }} {{ $size }}" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#{{ $to === 'cancelled' ? 'modal-batal' : 'modal-koreksi' }}"><i class="bi {{ $icon }}" aria-hidden="true"></i> {{ $text }}<span class="visually-hidden"> {{ $subject }}</span></button>
                @else
                    <a class="btn btn-{{ $variant }} {{ $size }}" href="{{ $detailUrl }}"><i class="bi {{ $icon }}" aria-hidden="true"></i> {{ $text }}<span class="visually-hidden"> {{ $subject }}, dilakukan di halaman detail</span></a>
                @endif
            @else
                <form method="POST" action="{{ $actionUrl }}" class="d-inline">
                    @csrf
                    <input type="hidden" name="to" value="{{ $to }}">
                    <input type="hidden" name="expected_status" value="{{ $appointment->status->value }}">
                    @if ($returnTo !== null)
                        <input type="hidden" name="kembali" value="{{ $returnTo }}">
                    @endif
                    <x-loading-button :variant="$variant" :icon="$icon" loading-text="Memproses…" class="{{ $size }}">{{ $text }}<span class="visually-hidden"> {{ $subject }}</span></x-loading-button>
                </form>
            @endif
        @elseif ($check->errorCode === \App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException::CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN)
            <span class="d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-2">
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary {{ $size }}" aria-disabled="true" aria-describedby="checkin-open-{{ $appointment->id }}"><i class="bi {{ $icon }}" aria-hidden="true"></i> {{ $text }}<span class="visually-hidden"> {{ $subject }}</span></button>
                <span class="small text-body-secondary" id="checkin-open-{{ $appointment->id }}">Dibuka {{ $check->opensAt() }}</span>
            </span>
        @endif
    @endforeach
    @unless ($visible)
        <span class="text-body-secondary">@if ($context === 'detail')Tidak ada aksi yang tersedia untuk status ini.@else-@endif</span>
    @endunless
</div>

@if ($context === 'detail')
    @foreach ($checks as $check)
        @if ($check->allowed() && $needsReason($check->to->value))
            @php
                $to = $check->to->value;
                $isCancel = $to === 'cancelled';
                $modalId = $isCancel ? 'modal-batal' : 'modal-koreksi';
            @endphp
            <x-confirm-modal
                :id="$modalId"
                :title="$isCancel ? 'Batalkan pendaftaran '.$code.'?' : 'Koreksi check-in '.$code.'?'"
                :message="$isCancel ? 'Kuota dilepas dan nomor antrean tidak dipakai ulang. Pasien berakun menerima pemberitahuan.' : 'Status kembali menjadi Dikonfirmasi. Koreksi hanya dapat dilakukan pada hari kunjungan.'"
                :confirm-label="$isCancel ? 'Ya, batalkan' : 'Ya, koreksi'"
                :variant="$isCancel ? 'danger' : 'primary'"
                :action="$actionUrl">
                <input type="hidden" name="to" value="{{ $to }}">
                <input type="hidden" name="expected_status" value="{{ $appointment->status->value }}">
                @if ($returnTo !== null)
                    <input type="hidden" name="kembali" value="{{ $returnTo }}">
                @endif
                <div class="mb-0">
                    <label for="{{ $modalId }}-alasan" class="form-label fw-semibold">Alasan <span class="required-mark" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
                    <textarea class="form-control" id="{{ $modalId }}-alasan" name="reason" rows="3" minlength="5" maxlength="255" required aria-required="true" aria-describedby="{{ $modalId }}-alasan-help"></textarea>
                    <div class="form-text" id="{{ $modalId }}-alasan-help">Wajib diisi, 5 sampai 255 karakter. Alasan tercatat pada riwayat status.</div>
                </div>
            </x-confirm-modal>
        @endif
    @endforeach
@endif
```

**Test IDs:** WLK-03 (status confirmed, kanal loket, riwayat staf, antrean berikutnya, sesi `booking_closed` online tetap bisa), WLK-04 (kuota bersama online-loket), BKG-07 sisi loket (`end - 1 menit` sukses, tepat `end` `CUTOFF_PASSED_COUNTER`), BKG-08 (loket tidak dibatasi batas aktif), SEK-11 (BPJS/polis tidak di-flash, tidak di audit), NTF-03 (pasien berakun walk-in diberi tahu, tanpa akun tidak), VAL-07 (query liar 200), AKS (Admin Konten dan pasien 403), Review Focus E2 (klik ganda), E3 (`practice_session_id`/`patient_profile_id` diubah tangan), E4 (BPJS tidak ke old input), E5 (`end` tepat ditolak, `end - 1 menit` diterima, profil nonaktif tidak dapat didaftarkan).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari kode):**
- **Dua lapis galat.** `StoreWalkInAppointmentRequest::withValidator()` menjalankan `BookingService::precheck()` (aturan F.5 tanpa kunci) SESUDAH semua field lolos, persis pola pasien. Hampir semua penolakan bisnis (kuota penuh, sesi tutup, `end` tepat, duplikat, benturan, profil nonaktif) karena itu muncul sebagai galat validasi pada `practice_session_id`/`patient_profile_id` dan dialihkan oleh `getRedirectUrl()`. Hanya penolakan yang terjadi di dalam `book()` (balapan) melewati handler `BookingException` global dan `BookingRedirect` (F7A-R20). Dua jalur ini memakai satu pembangun URL, `WalkInReturn::url()`, sehingga tujuan keduanya sama.
- **Tujuan pengalihan** (`WalkInReturn`): selalu `admin.appointments.create` dengan `pasien` (bila ada) dan, bila sesi ditemukan, `poli`, `dokter`, `tanggal` dari sesi itu (urutan kunci tetap: `pasien`, `poli`, `dokter`, `tanggal`, `sesi`); `sesi` hanya ditambahkan bila galatnya milik bagian 3 (pembayaran: `INVALID_PAYMENT`, `SYSTEM_BUSY`, galat field pembayaran, kirim ganda). Galat profil nonaktif: tanpa `pasien`.
- **Halaman bertahap.** `create` menurunkan poli, dokter, dan tanggal dari `sesi` bila `sesi` diberikan (menimpa query lain), sehingga URL pendek `?pasien=1&sesi=7` selalu konsisten. Bagian 2 aktif bila pasien terpilih dan aktif; bagian 3 hanya bila sesi terpilih `isBookableCounter` (sumber tunggal: `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::forSession($session, true)`). Sesi terpilih yang tidak dapat didaftarkan menghasilkan peringatan `Sesi yang dipilih tidak dapat didaftarkan: {label}.` tanpa bagian 3.
- **BPJS tersimpan.** Seperti sisi pasien: bila jenis BPJS dipilih dan nomor dikosongkan, server memakai nomor tersimpan profil pasien terpilih (`bookingProfile()`; `save_bpjs` dipaksa false). Nomor lengkap tidak pernah dirender; ringkasan pasien hanya menampilkan `masked_bpjs`.
- **Label "Online ditutup; loket masih bisa"** diturunkan dari `! isBookableOnline && isBookableCounter` (F7A-R21). Teks alasan sesi yang tidak dapat dipilih dibuat di view (`$reasonFor`), bukan di `Availability::label()` (label itu untuk situs publik).
- **Tanpa `x-wizard-steps`** (labelnya terpaku untuk wizard pasien): tiga kartu bernomor "1. Pasien", "2. Sesi", "3. Data Pembayaran". Bagian yang belum aktif memakai teks terlihat dengan `aria-disabled="true"`.
- **Tanpa throttle HTTP** pada `store` (tidak diminta F7A-R21); perlindungan kirim-ganda = `Cache::lock` per petugas (bukan lintas pengguna).
- **Peringatan lintas izin.** Pemegang `appointments.manage` tanpa `patients.view` tetap dapat membuka form dan mencari pasien (route hanya `appointments.manage`, F7A-R3); penyaringan lebih lanjut = keputusan peran kustom di luar 7a.

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit\Support;

use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Support\BookingRedirect;
use App\Support\WalkInReturn;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Route as RoutingRoute;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F7A-R20: tujuan pengalihan `BookingException` pada `admin.appointments.store` (form walk-in) dan pembangun URL
 * bersama `WalkInReturn`.
 */
class BookingRedirectWalkInTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 07:00:00');
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $input */
    private function storeRequest(array $input): Request
    {
        $route = (new RoutingRoute(['POST'], '/uji', fn () => 'ok'))->name('admin.appointments.store');
        $request = Request::create('/uji', 'POST', $input);
        $route->bind($request);
        $request->setRouteResolver(fn () => $route);
        $this->app->instance('request', $request);

        return $request;
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{string, bool}> kode, apakah `sesi` ikut */
    public static function codes(): array
    {
        return [
            'SESSION_UNAVAILABLE' => [BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE, false],
            'OUTSIDE_WINDOW' => [BookingException::OUTSIDE_WINDOW, false],
            'CUTOFF_PASSED' => [BookingException::CUTOFF_PASSED, false],
            'QUOTA_FULL' => [BookingException::QUOTA_FULL, false],
            'DUPLICATE_BOOKING' => [BookingException::DUPLICATE_BOOKING, false],
            'OVERLAPPING_BOOKING' => [BookingException::OVERLAPPING_BOOKING, false],
            'INVALID_PAYMENT' => [BookingException::INVALID_PAYMENT, true],
            'SYSTEM_BUSY' => [BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY, true],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('codes')]
    public function test_each_code_returns_to_the_right_step_of_the_walk_in_form(string $code, bool $withSession): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani']);
        $session = $this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'session_date' => '2026-10-06']);
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->create();
        $request = $this->storeRequest(['patient_profile_id' => (string) $profile->id, 'practice_session_id' => (string) $session->id]);

        $query = ['pasien' => $profile->id, 'poli' => $doctor->clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $doctor->slug, 'tanggal' => '2026-10-06'];

        if ($withSession) {
            $query['sesi'] = $session->id;
        }

        $this->assertSame(
            route('admin.appointments.create', $query),
            BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::make($code, [], ['practice_session_id' => $session->id]), $request),
        );
    }

    public function test_an_inactive_profile_returns_to_the_form_without_a_selected_patient(): void
    {
        $request = $this->storeRequest(['patient_profile_id' => '5', 'practice_session_id' => '9']);

        $this->assertSame(route('admin.appointments.create'), BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::profileInactive(), $request));
    }

    public function test_a_missing_or_hostile_input_never_breaks_the_url(): void
    {
        $request = $this->storeRequest(['patient_profile_id' => ['1'], 'practice_session_id' => 'abc']);

        $this->assertSame(
            route('admin.appointments.create'),
            BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::make(BookingException::QUOTA_FULL, [], ['practice_session_id' => 3]), $request),
        );
    }

    public function test_walk_in_return_ignores_unknown_sessions_and_non_positive_ids(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(route('admin.appointments.create'), WalkInReturn::url(null, null, true));
        $this->assertSame(route('admin.appointments.create', ['pasien' => 4]), WalkInReturn::url('4', '999999', true));
        $this->assertSame(route('admin.appointments.create'), WalkInReturn::url('0', '-3', true));
        $this->assertSame(route('admin.appointments.create'), WalkInReturn::url(['1'], 1.5, true));
    }
}
```

Write `tests/Feature/Admin/AdminWalkInTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\InsurancePartner;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentStatusChangedNotification;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Form walk-in W-20 (F7A-R21): pencarian pasien, pemilihan sesi loket, simpan lewat BookingService (kanal loket, status
 * `confirmed`). WLK-03/04, BKG-07/08 sisi loket, SEK-11, NTF-03, VAL-07, Review Focus E2/E3/E4/E5. Waktu dibekukan pada
 * Selasa 2026-10-06 07.00; sesi uji 09.00-12.00, kuota 20, check-in dibuka 08.00, batas online 60 menit.
 */
class AdminWalkInTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const BPJS = '0009900000011';

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    private User $officer;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 07:00:00');
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        Cache::put(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today()), true, CarbonImmutable::today()->endOfDay());

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poli Anak', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.A'], $this->clinic);
        $this->officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function sessionOn(string $date = '2026-10-06', array $overrides = [], ?Doctor $doctor = null): PracticeSession
    {
        $doctor ??= $this->doctor;

        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes */
    private function profile(array $attributes = []): PatientProfile
    {
        return PatientProfile::factory()->create($attributes + ['full_name' => 'Siti Rahmawati']);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function payload(PatientProfile $profile, PracticeSession $session, array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return $overrides + [
            'patient_profile_id' => (string) $profile->id,
            'practice_session_id' => (string) $session->id,
            'payment_type' => 'umum',
            'complaint' => 'Batuk berdahak sejak tiga hari.',
        ];
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $data */
    private function store(array $data, ?User $user = null): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->officer)
            ->from(route('admin.appointments.create'))
            ->post(route('admin.appointments.store'), $data);
    }

    private function create(array $query = [], ?User $user = null): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->officer)->get(route('admin.appointments.create', $query));
    }

    private function detailUrl(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        return route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]);
    }

    // --- akses -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @return array<string, array{string, int}> */
    public static function roles(): array
    {
        return [
            'super admin' => ['super-admin', 200],
            'petugas pendaftaran' => ['registration-officer', 200],
            'admin konten' => ['content-admin', 403],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('roles')]
    public function test_access_to_the_form_per_staff_role(string $role, int $status): void
    {
        $this->create([], $this->createStaff($role))->assertStatus($status);
    }

    public function test_content_admin_and_patient_cannot_store_and_a_guest_is_sent_to_the_login(): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionOn();
        $profile = $this->profile();
        $data = $this->payload($profile, $session);

        $this->store($data, $this->createStaff('content-admin'))->assertForbidden();
        $this->store($data, User::factory()->patient()->create())->assertForbidden();

        auth()->logout();
        $this->post(route('admin.appointments.store'), $data)->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_the_urls_use_the_indonesian_segments(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/pendaftaran/buat'), route('admin.appointments.create'));
        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/pendaftaran'), route('admin.appointments.store'));
    }

    // --- bagian 1: pasien --------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_initial_form_has_three_numbered_sections_and_two_inactive_ones(): void
    {
        $html = $this->create()
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('1. Pasien')
            ->assertSee('2. Sesi')
            ->assertSee('3. Data Pembayaran')
            ->assertSee('Pilih pasien terlebih dahulu.')
            ->assertSee('aria-disabled="true"', false)
            ->getContent();

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('name="payment_type"', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('name="poli"', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('x-wizard', $html);
    }

    public function test_the_patient_search_lists_matches_with_a_choose_link_and_marks_inactive_profiles(): void
    {
        $active = $this->profile(['full_name' => 'Siti Rahma', 'patient_number' => 'P000123']);
        $inactive = $this->profile(['full_name' => 'Siti Nonaktif', 'patient_number' => 'P000124', 'is_active' => false]);
        $this->profile(['full_name' => 'Budi Santoso', 'patient_number' => 'P000125']);

        $html = $this->create(['cari' => 'Siti'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Siti Rahma')
            ->assertSee('Siti Nonaktif')
            ->assertDontSee('Budi Santoso')
            ->assertSee('P000123')
            ->assertSee('Profil nonaktif')
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('admin.appointments.create', ['pasien' => $active->id]).'"', false)
            ->getContent();

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('pasien='.$inactive->id, $html);

        $this->create(['cari' => 'P000125'])->assertSee('Budi Santoso')->assertDontSee('Siti Rahma');
    }

    public function test_an_empty_search_shows_the_empty_text_and_the_new_profile_link(): void
    {
        $this->create(['cari' => 'Zzzzz'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Pasien tidak ditemukan.')
            ->assertSee('Buat profil baru')
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('admin.patients.create', ['kembali' => '/admin/pendaftaran/buat?cari=Zzzzz']).'"', false);
    }

    public function test_the_new_profile_link_is_hidden_without_the_patients_manage_permission(): void
    {
        $this->seedRoles();
        $limited = User::factory()->staff()->create();
        $limited->givePermissionTo('appointments.manage');

        $this->create(['cari' => 'Zzzzz'], $limited)->assertOk()->assertSee('Pasien tidak ditemukan.')->assertDontSee('Buat profil baru');
    }

    public function test_a_selected_patient_is_summarised_with_the_masked_bpjs_only(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->profile(['full_name' => 'Siti Rahma', 'patient_number' => 'P000123', 'birth_date' => '1990-03-12', 'bpjs_number' => '0009900000099']);

        $this->create(['pasien' => $profile->id])

    public function test_an_inactive_selected_profile_is_refused_with_a_warning(): void
    {
        $inactive = $this->profile(['is_active' => false]);

        $html = $this->create(['pasien' => $inactive->id])
            ->assertOk()

    public function test_patient_names_are_escaped_in_the_search_results_and_the_summary(): void
    {

        $this->create(['cari' => 'script'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertDontSee('<script>alert(1)</script>', false)
            ->assertSee('&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;', false);

        $this->create(['pasien' => $evil->id])
            ->assertDontSee('<script>alert(1)</script>', false)

    // --- bagian 2: sesi ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_sessions_are_listed_with_counter_labels_and_unavailable_ones_are_disabled(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->profile();
        $onlineClosed = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-06', ['start_time' => '07:30:00', 'end_time' => '11:30:00']);
        $open = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-06', ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00']);
        $full = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-06', ['start_time' => '16:00:00', 'end_time' => '18:00:00', 'quota' => 3, 'booked_count' => 3, 'last_queue_number' => 3]);
        $this->sessionOn('2026-10-05', ['start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '11:00:00']);

        $html = $this->create(['pasien' => $profile->id, 'poli' => $this->clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $this->doctor->slug, 'tanggal' => '2026-10-06'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('07.30–11.30')
            ->assertSee('Online ditutup; loket masih bisa')
            ->assertSee('13.00–15.00')
            ->assertSee('Sisa 20 dari 20')
            ->assertSee('16.00–18.00')
            ->assertSee('Penuh')
            ->assertSee('Kuota sesi sudah penuh.')
            ->getContent();

        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'Online ditutup; loket masih bisa'));
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/<input(?![^>]*disabled)[^>]*name="sesi"[^>]*value="'.$onlineClosed->id.'"[^>]*>/', $html);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/<input(?![^>]*disabled)[^>]*name="sesi"[^>]*value="'.$open->id.'"[^>]*>/', $html);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/<input(?=[^>]*disabled)[^>]*name="sesi"[^>]*value="'.$full->id.'"[^>]*>/', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('09.00–11.00', $html);
    }

    // --- bagian 3 dan simpan: WLK-03 ---------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_wlk_03_saving_creates_a_confirmed_counter_appointment_with_the_next_queue_number(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->profile();
        $session = $this->sessionOn();
        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $response = $this->store($this->payload($profile, $session));

        $appointment = Appointment::query()->where('patient_profile_id', $profile->id)->sole();

        $response->assertRedirect($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Pendaftaran walk-in berhasil. Kode booking '.$appointment->booking_code.', nomor antrean ANK-002.');

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $appointment->status);
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Loket, $appointment->channel);
        $this->assertSame($this->officer->id, (int) $appointment->created_by_user_id);
        $this->assertSame(2, $appointment->queue_number);
        $this->assertNotNull($appointment->confirmed_at);
        $this->assertSame(2, PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);

        $history = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->sole();
        $this->assertNull($history->from_status);
        $this->assertSame('confirmed', $history->to_status->value);
        $this->assertSame('staff', $history->actor_type->value);
        $this->assertSame($this->officer->id, (int) $history->actor_user_id);

        $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.created')->sole();
        $this->assertSame('loket', $audit->new_values['channel']);
    }

    public function test_after_saving_the_detail_page_offers_the_print_button(): void
    {

        $session = $this->sessionOn();

        $this->store($this->payload($profile, $session));
        $appointment = Appointment::query()->sole();

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)->get($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Cetak Bukti')
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('admin.appointments.proof', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]).'"', false);
    }

    public function test_wlk_03_a_session_closed_for_online_booking_can_still_be_registered_at_the_counter(): void
    {

        $session = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-06', ['start_time' => '07:30:00', 'end_time' => '11:30:00']);

    }

    public function test_the_save_works_for_a_walk_in_profile_and_an_account_profile_alike(): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionOn();
        $walkIn = $this->profile(['user_id' => null]);
        $withAccount = PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create();

        $this->store($this->payload($walkIn, $session))->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->store($this->payload($withAccount, $session))->assertSessionHas('success');

        $this->assertSame(2, Appointment::query()->where('channel', 'loket')->count());
    }

    // --- WLK-04: kuota bersama ---------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_wlk_04_the_counter_shares_the_quota_with_online_bookings(): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-06', ['quota' => 2]);
        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Pending, ['channel' => BookingChannel::Online]);
        $first = $this->profile(['full_name' => 'Pasien Loket Satu']);
        $second = $this->profile(['full_name' => 'Pasien Loket Dua']);

        $this->store($this->payload($first, $session))->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertSame(2, PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);

        $this->store($this->payload($second, $session))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['practice_session_id' => 'Kuota sesi ini sudah penuh. Silakan pilih tanggal atau sesi lain.']);

        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->where('patient_profile_id', $second->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame(2, PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);
    }

    public function test_payment_validation_errors_return_to_the_session_step_without_the_bpjs_number(): void

        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->count());

        $this->assertSame(PaymentType::Bpjs, $appointment->payment_type);
        $this->assertSame('0011', $appointment->payment_reference_last4);
        $this->assertNotSame(self::BPJS, DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $appointment->id)->value('payment_reference'));

        $this->actingAs($this->officer)->get($this->detailUrl($appointment))
            ->assertOk()->assertSee('•••••••••0011')->assertDontSee(self::BPJS);

        $logged = json_encode(AuditLog::query()->get()->map(fn (AuditLog $log): array => [$log->old_values, $log->new_values, $log->description])->all());
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(self::BPJS, (string) $logged);

    }

    public function test_a_double_submit_is_held_by_the_per_staff_lock(): void
    {

        $session = $this->sessionOn();
        $held = Cache::lock('walkin-submit:'.$this->officer->id, 10);

        $this->store($this->payload($profile, $session, ['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => self::BPJS]))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.appointments.create', ['pasien' => $profile->id, 'poli' => $this->clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $this->doctor->slug, 'tanggal' => '2026-10-06', 'sesi' => $session->id]))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', 'Permintaan Anda sedang diproses. Mohon tunggu sebentar dan jangan menekan tombol berulang kali.')
            ->assertSessionMissing('_old_input.bpjs_number');

        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->count());

        $held->release();
        $this->store($this->payload($profile, $session))->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertSame(1, Appointment::query()->count());
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implementasi `WalkInReturn`, cabang `BookingRedirect`, lang, dan route**

Write `app/Support/WalkInReturn.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Support;

use App\Models\PracticeSession;

/**
 * URL form walk-in `admin.appointments.create` untuk kembali ke langkah yang tepat (F7A-R20). Dipakai `BookingRedirect`
 * (galat dari `book()`) dan Form Request walk-in (galat validasi). Kunci query berurutan tetap: `pasien`, `poli`,
 * `dokter`, `tanggal`, `sesi`. `poli`/`dokter`/`tanggal` diturunkan dari sesi bila sesi ditemukan; `sesi` ikut hanya bila
 * `$keepSession` (galat bagian pembayaran). Id yang bukan bilangan bulat positif yang wajar diabaikan.
 */
final class WalkInReturn
{
    public static function url(mixed $profileId, mixed $sessionId, bool $keepSession): string
    {
        $profile = self::id($profileId);
        $sessionKey = self::id($sessionId);
        $session = $sessionKey === null ? null : PracticeSession::query()->with(['clinic', 'doctor'])->find($sessionKey);
        $query = [];

        if ($profile !== null) {
            $query['pasien'] = $profile;
        }

        if ($session !== null) {
            $query['poli'] = $session->clinic->slug;
            $query['dokter'] = $session->doctor->slug;
            $query['tanggal'] = $session->session_date->toDateString();

            if ($keepSession) {
                $query['sesi'] = $session->id;
            }
        }

        return route('admin.appointments.create', $query);
    }

    private static function id(mixed $value): ?int
    {
        if (is_int($value)) {
            $value = (string) $value;
        }

        if (! is_string($value) || preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$/', $value) !== 1) {
            return null;
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }
}
```

Lalu sisipkan method berikut TEPAT SEBELUM docblok `    /** \`practice_session_id\` hanya dipakai bila bilangan bulat positif yang wajar (nilai larik/teks diabaikan). */`:

```php
    /**
     * Form walk-in (F7A-R20): sesi-level kembali ke bagian 2 (`pasien`, `poli`, `dokter`, `tanggal`); pembayaran dan
     * sistem sibuk ke bagian 3 (ditambah `sesi`); profil nonaktif (kode SESSION_UNAVAILABLE tanpa `practice_session_id`
     * pada konteks) ke form tanpa pasien terpilih.
     */
    private static function adminWalkIn(BookingException $e, Request $request): string
    {
        if ($e->errorCode === BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE && ! isset($e->context['practice_session_id'])) {
            return route('admin.appointments.create');
        }

        $keepSession = in_array($e->errorCode, [BookingException::INVALID_PAYMENT, BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY], true);

        return WalkInReturn::url($request->input('patient_profile_id'), $request->input('practice_session_id'), $keepSession);
    }
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Query form walk-in (F7A-R21, 12 V-46): `pasien` (id profil), `cari` (pencarian pasien), `poli` dan `dokter` (slug),
 * `tanggal` (hari ini sampai hari ini + `booking.window_days`), `sesi` (id sesi), `kembali`. BUKAN pengalihan galat:
 * turunan ListFilterRequest, nilai tidak valid atau larik diabaikan dengan peringatan, tidak pernah 500. Keberadaan dan
 * keaktifan profil serta kelayakan sesi diperiksa controller (hasilnya peringatan, bukan galat validasi).
 */
class CreateWalkInAppointmentRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $last = $today->addDays(max(1, app(SettingsService::class)->bookingRules()->windowDays));

        return array_merge(parent::rules(), [
            'pasien' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1', Rule::exists('patient_profiles', 'id')],
            'cari' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'poli' => [
                'nullable', 'string', 'max:150',
                Rule::exists('clinics', 'slug')->where('is_active', true)->where('is_bookable', true),
            ],
            'dokter' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:150', Rule::exists('doctors', 'slug')->where('status', DoctorStatus::Active->value)],
            'tanggal' => [
                'nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d',
                'after_or_equal:'.$today->toDateString(),
                'before_or_equal:'.$last->toDateString(),
            ],
            'sesi' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1', Rule::exists('practice_sessions', 'id')],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::messages(), [
            'pasien.integer' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'pasien.min' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'pasien.exists' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'cari.string' => 'Kata kunci tidak valid.',
            'cari.max' => 'Kata kunci maksimal 100 karakter.',
            'poli.string' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
```
