Write `app/Http/Requests/Admin/StoreWalkInAppointmentRequest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Http\Requests\Patient\Concerns\HasBookingRules;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Actor;
use App\Support\WalkInReturn;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * V-14 (F7A-R21): POST `admin.appointments.store`. `patient_profile_id` (profil AKTIF) dan `practice_session_id`, lalu aturan
 * pembayaran yang sama dengan sisi pasien (trait HasBookingRules: `payment_type`, `bpjs_number`, `insurance_partner_id`,
 * `policy_number`, `complaint`, `save_bpjs`). Setelah semua field lolos, `BookingService::precheck()` dijalankan dengan
 * aktor petugas (kanal loket: `now < end`, batas aktif tidak berlaku, duplikat dan benturan tetap diperiksa). Kolom sistem
 * (`status`, `channel`, `queue_number`, `booking_code`) tidak pernah dibaca dari input.
 */
class StoreWalkInAppointmentRequest extends FormRequest
{
    use HasBookingRules;

    private ?PatientProfile $selectedProfile = null;

    private bool $profileResolved = false;

    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();

        return $user instanceof User && $user->can('createCounter', Appointment::class);
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $this->prepareBookingInput();
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return array_merge($this->bookingRules(), [
            'patient_profile_id' => [
                'bail', 'required', 'integer', 'min:1',
                Rule::exists('patient_profiles', 'id')->where('is_active', true),
            ],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge($this->bookingMessages(), [
            'patient_profile_id.required' => 'Pasien wajib dipilih.',
            'patient_profile_id.integer' => 'Profil pasien tidak aktif atau tidak ditemukan.',
            'patient_profile_id.min' => 'Profil pasien tidak aktif atau tidak ditemukan.',
            'patient_profile_id.exists' => 'Profil pasien tidak aktif atau tidak ditemukan.',
        ]);
    }

    /** Profil pilihan petugas (aktif); dipakai nomor BPJS tersimpan dan precheck. */
    protected function bookingProfile(): ?PatientProfile
    {
        if (! $this->profileResolved) {
            $this->profileResolved = true;
            $id = $this->input('patient_profile_id');

            if ((is_string($id) || is_int($id)) && preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$/', (string) $id) === 1) {
                $this->selectedProfile = PatientProfile::query()->whereKey((int) $id)->where('is_active', true)->first();
            }
        }

        return $this->selectedProfile;
    }

    protected function bookingActor(): ?Actor
    {
        $user = $this->user();

        return $user instanceof User ? Actor::staff($user) : null;
    }

    /**
     * Kegagalan validasi kembali ke form walk-in: galat bagian 1 (profil) tanpa `pasien`; galat sesi (termasuk hasil
     * `precheck`) ke bagian 2 tanpa `sesi`; galat pembayaran ke bagian 3 dengan `sesi`. Tidak pernah back().
     */
    protected function getRedirectUrl(): string
    {
        $errors = $this->validator?->errors();

        if ($errors !== null && $errors->has('patient_profile_id')) {
            return WalkInReturn::url(null, $this->input('practice_session_id'), false);
        }

        $sessionLevel = $errors !== null && $errors->has('practice_session_id');

        return WalkInReturn::url($this->input('patient_profile_id'), $this->input('practice_session_id'), ! $sessionLevel);
    }
}
```

Sisipkan dua method TEPAT SEBELUM docblok `    /**\n     * Satu transisi (V-15).` (cari baris `     * Satu transisi (V-15). Galat aturan`; sisipkan sebelum `    /**` pembukanya):

```php
    /**
     * Form walk-in bertahap (F7A-R21, W-20): pasien, lalu sesi (`DoctorAvailabilityQuery` mode loket), lalu pembayaran.
     * `sesi` yang valid menurunkan poli, dokter, dan tanggal (menimpa query lain). Bagian 3 hanya untuk sesi yang
     * `isBookableCounter`; aturan lengkap tetap di `precheck()`/`book()`.
     */
    public function create(
        CreateWalkInAppointmentRequest $request,
        PracticeSessionGenerator $generator,
        DoctorAvailabilityQuery $availability,
        SettingsService $settings,
        PatientSearch $search,
    ): View {
        $this->authorize('createCounter', Appointment::class);

        $generator->ensureDailyHorizon();

        $filters = $request->filters();
        $windowDays = max(1, $settings->bookingRules()->windowDays);
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();

        // Bagian 1: pasien. Profil nonaktif tampil di hasil pencarian tetapi tidak dapat dipilih.
        $profile = null;

        if (isset($filters['pasien'])) {
            $found = PatientProfile::query()->find((int) $filters['pasien']);

            if ($found !== null && $found->is_active) {
                $profile = $found;
            } else {
                session()->now('warning', __('booking.errors.PROFILE_INACTIVE'));
            }
        }

        $term = $filters['cari'] ?? null;
        $results = $term === null
            ? collect()
            : $search->apply(PatientProfile::query(), $term)->orderBy('full_name')->orderBy('id')->limit(10)->get();

        // Bagian 2: sesi. Sesi terpilih menurunkan poli, dokter, dan tanggal.
        $chosen = null;

        if ($profile !== null && isset($filters['sesi'])) {
            $chosen = PracticeSession::query()->with(['clinic', 'doctor', 'exception'])->find((int) $filters['sesi']);
        }

        $clinicSlug = $chosen !== null ? $chosen->clinic->slug : ($filters['poli'] ?? null);
        $doctorSlug = $chosen !== null ? $chosen->doctor->slug : ($filters['dokter'] ?? null);
        $date = $chosen !== null ? $chosen->session_date->toDateString() : ($filters['tanggal'] ?? $today->toDateString());

        $clinic = $clinicSlug === null ? null : Clinic::query()->bookable()->where('slug', $clinicSlug)->first();
        $doctor = $clinic !== null && $doctorSlug !== null
            ? Doctor::query()->active()->inClinic($clinic->id)->where('slug', $doctorSlug)->first()
            : null;

        $items = collect();

        if ($profile !== null && $clinic !== null && $doctor !== null) {
            $items = $availability->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter(
                clinicId: $clinic->id,
                doctorId: $doctor->id,
                date: CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $date) ?: $today,
                forLoket: true,
            ));
        }

        // Bagian 3: hanya untuk sesi yang dapat didaftarkan loket.
        $chosenItem = null;

        if ($chosen !== null) {
            $item = $availability->forSession($chosen, true);

            if ($item->isBookableCounter) {
                $chosenItem = $item;
            } else {
                session()->now('warning', 'Sesi yang dipilih tidak dapat didaftarkan: '.$item->availability->label().'.');
            }
        }

        return view('admin.appointments.create', [
            'profile' => $profile,
            'term' => $term,
            'results' => $results,
            'clinicOptions' => Clinic::query()->bookable()->ordered()->pluck('name', 'slug')->all(),
            'doctorOptions' => $clinic === null
                ? []
                : Doctor::query()->active()->inClinic($clinic->id)->ordered()->get()
                    ->mapWithKeys(fn (Doctor $item): array => [$item->slug => $item->display_name])
                    ->all(),
            'clinic' => $clinic,
            'doctor' => $doctor,
            'date' => $date,
            'minDate' => $today->toDateString(),
            'maxDate' => $today->addDays($windowDays)->toDateString(),
            'windowDays' => $windowDays,
            'items' => $items,
            'chosenItem' => $chosenItem,
            'partners' => InsurancePartner::query()->active()->ordered()->get(['id', 'name']),
            'storedBpjs' => $profile?->masked_bpjs,
            'kembali' => $filters['kembali'] ?? null,
            'backUrl' => AdminReturn::path($filters['kembali'] ?? null, route('admin.appointments.index')),
            'returnPath' => route('admin.appointments.create', $filters, false),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Simpan walk-in (V-14, F7A-R21): kunci kirim-ganda per petugas di controller (bukan service, supaya tes konkurensi
     * tetap menguji lapis DB), lalu `BookingService::book()` dengan aktor petugas (kanal loket, status `confirmed`).
     * Penolakan aturan dari `book()` ditangani handler `BookingException` global dan `BookingRedirect`.
     */
    public function store(StoreWalkInAppointmentRequest $request, BookingService $booking): RedirectResponse
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $profile = PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail((int) $request->validated('patient_profile_id'));
        $sessionId = (int) $request->validated('practice_session_id');

        $lock = Cache::lock('walkin-submit:'.$user->getKey(), 10);

        if (! $lock->get()) {
            return redirect()->to(WalkInReturn::url($profile->id, $sessionId, true))
                ->withInput($request->except(SensitiveInput::FIELDS))
                ->with('error', __('booking.submit_in_progress'));
        }

        try {
            $appointment = $booking->book($profile, $sessionId, $request->toBookingData(), Actor::staff($user));
        } finally {
            $lock->release();
        }

        return redirect()->route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code])
            ->with('success', __('booking.admin.walk_in_created', [
                'code' => $appointment->booking_code,
                'queue' => $appointment->queue_label,
            ]));
    }
```

```php
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private PracticeSession $session;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 07:00:00');

        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani']);
        $this->session = $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-05',
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $input
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $routeParameters
     */
    private function requestOn(array $input = [], array $routeParameters = []): Request
    {
        $uri = '/uji'.implode('', array_map(fn (string $name): string => '/{'.$name.'}', array_keys($routeParameters)));
        $path = '/uji'.str_repeat('/x', count($routeParameters));
        $route = (new RoutingRoute(['POST'], $uri, fn () => 'ok'))->name('admin.queue.mark-no-show');
        $request = Request::create($path, 'POST', $input);
        $route->bind($request);

        foreach ($routeParameters as $name => $value) {
            $route->setParameter($name, $value);
        }

        $request->setRouteResolver(fn () => $route);
        $this->app->instance('request', $request);

        return $request;
    }

    private function queueUrl(): string
    {
        return route('admin.queue.index', ['tanggal' => '2026-10-05', 'sesi' => $this->session->id]);
    }

    private function notEnded(): InvalidTransitionException
    {
        return InvalidTransitionException::make(InvalidTransitionException::SESSION_NOT_ENDED, ['time' => '12.00']);
    }

    public function test_a_bound_session_returns_to_its_own_queue(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn([], ['session' => $this->session]);

        $this->assertSame($this->queueUrl(), BookingRedirect::after($this->notEnded(), $request));
    }

    public function test_a_numeric_route_parameter_is_resolved_to_the_session(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn([], ['session' => (string) $this->session->id]);

        $this->assertSame($this->queueUrl(), BookingRedirect::after($this->notEnded(), $request));
    }

    public function test_the_error_context_is_the_fallback_when_the_route_has_no_session(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn();
        $exception = InvalidTransitionException::make(
            InvalidTransitionException::SESSION_NOT_ENDED,
            ['time' => '12.00'],
            ['practice_session_id' => $this->session->id],
        );

        $this->assertSame($this->queueUrl(), BookingRedirect::after($exception, $request));
    }

    public function test_the_under_review_variant_returns_to_the_same_queue(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn([], ['session' => $this->session]);
        $exception = InvalidTransitionException::makeVariant(
            InvalidTransitionException::INVALID_TRANSITION,
            'SESSION_UNDER_REVIEW',
            [],
            ['practice_session_id' => $this->session->id],
        );

        $this->assertSame($this->queueUrl(), BookingRedirect::after($exception, $request));
    }

    public function test_every_transition_error_code_and_a_busy_system_go_to_the_same_queue(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn([], ['session' => $this->session]);

        foreach (InvalidTransitionException::CODES as $code) {
            $this->assertSame($this->queueUrl(), BookingRedirect::after(InvalidTransitionException::make($code), $request), $code);
        }

        $this->assertSame($this->queueUrl(), BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::make(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY), $request));
    }

    public function test_the_date_comes_from_the_session_not_from_the_request(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn(['tanggal' => '2030-01-01', 'sesi' => '999', 'kembali' => '/admin/pendaftaran'], ['session' => $this->session]);

        $this->assertSame($this->queueUrl(), BookingRedirect::after($this->notEnded(), $request));
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{mixed}> */
    public static function unusableParameters(): array
    {
        return [
            'huruf' => ['abc'],
            'nol' => ['0'],
            'negatif' => ['-3'],
            'id tidak ada' => ['999999'],
            'larik' => [['1']],
            'desimal' => ['1.5'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('unusableParameters')]
    public function test_an_unusable_session_parameter_returns_to_the_plain_queue(mixed $parameter): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn([], ['session' => $parameter]);

        $this->assertSame(route('admin.queue.index'), BookingRedirect::after($this->notEnded(), $request));
    }

    public function test_a_hostile_context_never_breaks_the_url(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn();
        $exception = InvalidTransitionException::make(InvalidTransitionException::SESSION_NOT_ENDED, ['time' => '12.00'], ['practice_session_id' => ['1']]);

        $this->assertSame(route('admin.queue.index'), BookingRedirect::after($exception, $request));
    }
}
```

```php
     */
    private function appointmentOn(PracticeSession $session, string $name, AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, array $overrides = [], array $profile = []): Appointment
    {
        $owner = PatientProfile::factory()->create(['full_name' => $name] + $profile);

        return $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, array_merge(['patient_profile_id' => $owner->id], $overrides));

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $query */
    private function queue(array $query = [], ?User $user = null): TestResponse

    /** @return list<string> nilai `to` dari semua field tersembunyi pada halaman, unik dan terurut */
    private function formTargets(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/<input type="hidden" name="to" value="([a-z_]+)">/', $html, $matches);
        $targets = array_values(array_unique($matches[1]));
        sort($targets);

        return $targets;
    }

    /** @return list<array{int, bool}> id sesi pada pemilih sesi, berurutan, dan apakah terpilih */
    private function sessionOptions(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/<option value="(\d+)"\s*(selected)?\s*>/', $html, $matches, PREG_SET_ORDER);

        return array_map(fn (array $match): array => [(int) $match[1], ($match[2] ?? '') === 'selected'], $matches);
    }

    private function selectedSessionId(string $html): ?int
    {
        foreach ($this->sessionOptions($html) as [$id, $selected]) {
            if ($selected) {
                return $id;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    public static function actionMatrix(): array

            'confirmed, sesi besok' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $today.' 07:00:00', '2026-10-07', [], ['Batalkan'], null],
            'checked_in, hari yang sama' => [AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $today.' 10:00:00', $today, ['completed'], ['Koreksi Check-in'], null],
            'checked_in, sesi kemarin (tanpa koreksi)' => [AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $today.' 10:00:00', '2026-10-05', ['completed'], [], null],
            'completed' => [AppointmentStatus::Completed, $today.' 10:00:00', $today, [], [], null],
            'cancelled' => [AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $today.' 10:00:00', $today, [], [], null],
            'no_show' => [AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $today.' 10:00:00', $today, [], [], null],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string>  $forms
     * @param  list<string>  $links
     */
    #[DataProvider('actionMatrix')]
    public function test_the_row_actions_are_exactly_what_the_server_accepts(AppointmentStatus $status, string $now, string $sessionDate, array $forms, array $links, ?string $opensAt): void
    {
        $session = $this->sessionOn($sessionDate);
        $appointment = $this->appointmentOn($session, 'Pasien Uji', $status);
        $this->travelTo($now);
        Notification::fake();

        $html = $this->queue(['tanggal' => $sessionDate, 'sesi' => $session->id])->assertOk()->getContent();

        // Tombol form (konfirmasi, check-in, selesai) dan tautan ke detail (batal, koreksi).
        $this->assertSame($forms, $this->formTargets($html), 'Tombol form.');
        $this->assertSame(count($forms), substr_count($html, 'name="to"'), 'Tidak ada field `to` lain.');
        $this->assertSame(count($links), substr_count($html, 'dilakukan di halaman detail'), 'Tautan ke detail.');

        foreach (['Batalkan', 'Koreksi Check-in'] as $label) {
            if (in_array($label, $links, true)) {
                $this->assertStringContainsString($label, $html);
            } else {
                $this->assertStringNotContainsString($label, $html);
            }
        }

        // Tidak pernah tombol no_show (atau pending) per baris: hanya field `to` yang dibatasi (`expected_status` boleh `pending`).
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('name="to" value="no_show"', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('name="to" value="pending"', $html);

        if ($opensAt === null) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('aria-disabled="true"', $html);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Dibuka ', $html);
        } else {
            $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'aria-disabled="true"'));
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Dibuka '.$opensAt, $html);
        }

        // Arah sebaliknya: setiap tujuan dicoba ke server (dalam savepoint yang digulung balik).
        $accepted = [];

        foreach (['confirmed', 'checked_in', 'completed', 'cancelled'] as $to) {
            DB::beginTransaction();
            $this->flushSession();

            $this->actingAs($this->officer)->post(route('admin.appointments.transition', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]), [
                'to' => $to,
                'expected_status' => $status->value,
                'reason' => 'Alasan uji petugas',
            ]);

            if (DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $appointment->id)->value('status') !== $status->value) {
                $accepted[] = $to;
            }

            DB::rollBack();
        }

        $shown = $forms;

        foreach ($links as $label) {
            $shown[] = $label === 'Batalkan' ? 'cancelled' : 'confirmed';
        }

        sort($shown);
        sort($accepted);

        $this->assertSame($shown, $accepted, 'Tujuan yang diterima server.');
    }
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * POST `admin.queue.mark-no-show` (F7A-R23, V-16) dan banner/modal pada antrean: BKG-16 via HTTP (riwayat dan audit
 * per appointment, aktor petugas), E5 (batas `end_time` strik, sesi `needs_review`, tanpa konfirmasi), E2 (tekan dua
 * kali), NTF-03, E4 (escape di modal), akses. Waktu dibekukan pada Selasa 2026-10-06 07.00; sesi uji 09.00-12.00.
 */
class AdminQueueMarkNoShowTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const NOT_ENDED = 'Tandai tidak hadir hanya dapat dilakukan setelah sesi berakhir (pukul 12.00).';

    private const UNDER_REVIEW = 'Sesi ini sedang menunggu penyelesaian di layar Sesi terdampak.';

    private const NOTHING = 'Tidak ada pendaftaran yang perlu ditandai tidak hadir pada sesi ini.';

    private const CONFIRM_REQUIRED = 'Centang konfirmasi untuk menandai seluruh pendaftaran yang belum hadir sebagai tidak hadir.';

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    private User $officer;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 07:00:00');
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poli Anak', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.A'], $this->clinic);
        $this->officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function sessionOn(string $date, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /** Sesi kemarin 09.00-12.00 (sudah berakhir pada 07.00 hari ini). */
    private function endedSession(array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->sessionOn('2026-10-05', $overrides);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $profile
     */
    private function appointmentOn(PracticeSession $session, string $name, AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, array $overrides = [], array $profile = []): Appointment
    {
        $owner = PatientProfile::factory()->create(['full_name' => $name] + $profile);

        return $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, array_merge(['patient_profile_id' => $owner->id], $overrides));
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $data */
    private function markNoShow(PracticeSession $session, array $data = ['confirm' => '1'], ?User $user = null): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->officer)
            ->post(route('admin.queue.mark-no-show', ['session' => $session->id]), $data);
    }

    private function queueUrl(PracticeSession $session): string
    {
        return route('admin.queue.index', ['tanggal' => $session->session_date->toDateString(), 'sesi' => $session->id]);
    }

    private function statusOf(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        return (string) DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $appointment->id)->value('status');
    }

    private function historyCount(Appointment $appointment): int
    {
        return AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->count();
    }

    private function queue(PracticeSession $session, ?User $user = null): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->officer)->get($this->queueUrl($session));
    }

    // --- BKG-16 via HTTP ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_bkg_16_marks_only_pending_and_confirmed_with_staff_history_and_audit(): void
    {
        $session = $this->endedSession();
        $pending = $this->appointmentOn($session, 'Pasien Menunggu', AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $confirmed = $this->appointmentOn($session, 'Pasien Terkonfirmasi', AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $checkedIn = $this->appointmentOn($session, 'Pasien Hadir', AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $completed = $this->appointmentOn($session, 'Pasien Selesai', AppointmentStatus::Completed);
        $cancelled = $this->appointmentOn($session, 'Pasien Batal', AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $booked = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count;
        Notification::fake();

        $this->markNoShow($session, ['confirm' => '1', 'reason' => '  Pasien tidak datang  '])
            ->assertRedirect($this->queueUrl($session))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', '2 pendaftaran ditandai tidak hadir.');

        foreach ([$pending, $confirmed] as $appointment) {
            $this->assertSame('no_show', $this->statusOf($appointment));
            $this->assertNotNull(Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id)->no_show_at);

            $history = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->sole();
            $this->assertSame($appointment->status, $history->from_status);
            $this->assertSame('no_show', $history->to_status->value);
            $this->assertSame(ActorType::Staff, $history->actor_type);
            $this->assertSame($this->officer->id, (int) $history->actor_user_id);
            $this->assertSame('Pasien tidak datang', $history->reason);

            $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->where('auditable_id', $appointment->id)->sole();
            $this->assertSame($this->officer->id, (int) $audit->user_id);
            $this->assertSame($appointment->status->value, $audit->old_values['status']);
            $this->assertSame('no_show', $audit->new_values['status']);
        }

        foreach ([['checked_in', $checkedIn], ['completed', $completed], ['cancelled', $cancelled]] as [$status, $appointment]) {
            $this->assertSame($status, $this->statusOf($appointment));
            $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($appointment));
        }

        $this->assertSame(2, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->count());
        // `no_show` tetap memakai kuota.
        $this->assertSame($booked, PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);
    }

        $this->assertStringContainsString('required', $checkbox[0]);
        $this->assertSame(1, preg_match('/<textarea[^>]*name="reason"[^>]*>/', $html, $textarea));

        $this->assertStringContainsString('ANK-002 Pasien Terkonfirmasi', $list[1]);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Pasien Sudah Hadir', $list[1]);
```

```php
    /**
     * Tandai tidak hadir dari antrean (F7A-R20): kembali ke antrean sesi itu dengan `tanggal` (= `session_date`) dan
     * `sesi`. Sesi diambil dari parameter route `{session}` (model terikat atau id), lalu dari konteks galat; tanpa sesi
     * yang ditemukan, antrean polos. `kembali` tidak dipakai: aksi massal selalu kembali ke antrean sesi yang sama.
     */
    private static function adminQueue(BookingException $e, Request $request): string
    {
        $parameter = $request->route('session');
        $session = $parameter instanceof PracticeSession ? $parameter : null;

        if ($session === null) {
            $id = self::queueSessionId($parameter) ?? self::queueSessionId($e->context['practice_session_id'] ?? null);
            $session = $id === null ? null : PracticeSession::query()->find($id);
        }

        if ($session === null) {
            return route('admin.queue.index');
        }

        return route('admin.queue.index', ['tanggal' => $session->session_date->toDateString(), 'sesi' => $session->id]);
    }

    /** Id sesi hanya bila bilangan bulat positif yang wajar (larik, desimal, dan teks lain diabaikan). */
    private static function queueSessionId(mixed $value): ?int
    {
        if (is_int($value)) {
            $value = (string) $value;
        }

        if (! is_string($value) || preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$/', $value) !== 1) {
            return null;
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Filter Antrean Hari Ini (F7A-R23, W-19, 12 V-46): `tanggal` (bawaan hari ini; boleh lampau sampai hari ini +
 * `booking.window_days`), `poli` dan `dokter` (slug), `sesi` (id sesi; hanya dipakai bila sesi itu ada pada tanggal
 * yang ditampilkan), `kode` (kode booking apa adanya; dinormalkan dan dicari controller). Nilai tidak valid atau larik
 * diabaikan dengan flash "Filter tidak valid dan diabaikan." (pola ListFilterRequest); tidak pernah 500.
 */
class QueueIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $last = CarbonImmutable::today()
            ->addDays(max(1, app(SettingsService::class)->bookingRules()->windowDays))
            ->toDateString();

        return array_merge(parent::rules(), [
            'tanggal' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d', 'before_or_equal:'.$last],
            'poli' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:150', Rule::exists('clinics', 'slug')],
            'dokter' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:150', Rule::exists('doctors', 'slug')],
            'sesi' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
            'kode' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::messages(), [
            'tanggal.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'tanggal.before_or_equal' => 'Tanggal antrean melebihi batas pendaftaran.',
            'poli.string' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'poli.max' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'poli.exists' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'dokter.string' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'dokter.max' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'dokter.exists' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'sesi.integer' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'sesi.min' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'kode.string' => 'Kode booking tidak valid.',
            'kode.max' => 'Kode booking tidak valid.',
        ]);
    }

    /** Tanggal antrean yang ditampilkan; hari ini bila `tanggal` kosong atau tidak valid. */
    public function queueDate(): CarbonImmutable
    {
        $value = $this->filters()['tanggal'] ?? null;
        $date = $value === null ? null : CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $value);

        return $date instanceof CarbonImmutable ? $date : CarbonImmutable::today();
    }

    public function clinicSlug(): ?string
    {
        return $this->filters()['poli'] ?? null;
    }

    public function doctorSlug(): ?string
    {
        return $this->filters()['dokter'] ?? null;
    }

    /** Id sesi yang diminta (belum tentu ada pada tanggal itu). */
    public function sessionId(): ?int
    {
        $value = $this->filters()['sesi'] ?? null;

        return $value === null ? null : (int) $value;
    }

    /** Kode yang diketik atau dipindai (dipangkas), atau null bila kosong. Belum dinormalkan. */
    public function bookingCode(): ?string
    {
        $value = trim($this->filters()['kode'] ?? '');

        return $value === '' ? null : $value;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

/**
 * V-16 (F7A-R23): POST `admin.queue.mark-no-show`. `confirm` wajib dicentang (pesan `booking.no_show.confirm_required`);
 * `reason` opsional, maksimal 255 karakter. Aturan sesi (`SESSION_NOT_ENDED`, `needs_review`) ada di
 * AppointmentStatusService dan ditangani handler global + BookingRedirect. Modal sudah tertutup setelah kirim, jadi
 * galat pertama juga dijadikan flash `error`; galat validasi kembali ke antrean sesi itu (`tanggal`, `sesi`).
 */
class MarkNoShowRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $session = $this->route('session');

        return $session instanceof PracticeSession && (bool) $this->user()?->can('markNoShow', $session);
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $reason = $this->input('reason');

        if (is_string($reason)) {
            $reason = trim($reason);

            $this->merge(['reason' => $reason === '' ? null : $reason]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'confirm' => ['bail', 'accepted'],
            'reason' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'confirm.accepted' => __('booking.no_show.confirm_required'),
            'reason.string' => 'Alasan harus berupa teks.',
            'reason.max' => 'Alasan maksimal 255 karakter.',
        ];
    }

    protected function failedValidation(Validator $validator): void
    {
        session()->flash('error', (string) $validator->errors()->first());

        parent::failedValidation($validator);
    }

    /** Galat validasi kembali ke antrean sesi yang sama, bukan ke halaman sebelumnya. */
    protected function getRedirectUrl(): string
    {
        $session = $this->route('session');

        return $session instanceof PracticeSession
            ? route('admin.queue.index', ['tanggal' => $session->session_date->toDateString(), 'sesi' => $session->id])
            : route('admin.queue.index');
    }

    public function reason(): ?string
    {
        $reason = $this->validated('reason');

        return is_string($reason) && $reason !== '' ? $reason : null;
    }
}
```

Write `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/QueueController.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\MarkNoShowRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\QueueIndexRequest;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentStatusService;
use App\Services\Booking\BookingCodeGenerator;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Antrean Hari Ini (W-19, F7A-R23) dan aksi massal Tandai tidak hadir. Daftar membaca per sesi dalam satu kueri
 * (urut nomor antrean, eager-load penuh); tombol per baris dihitung `AppointmentStatusService::transitionChecks()`
 * (evaluator yang sama dengan `transition()`), dengan satu `$now` per muat halaman. Tulis status hanya lewat
 * AppointmentStatusService (`markNoShowForSession` untuk aksi massal; aksi per baris memakai route
 * `admin.appointments.transition` milik AppointmentController). Pemindaian kode hanya mencari dan menyorot (BR-69).
 */
class QueueController extends Controller
{
    /** Urutan ringkasan per status (BP 06 alur 7). */
    private const STATUS_ORDER = [
        AppointmentStatus::Pending,
        AppointmentStatus::Confirmed,
        AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn,
        AppointmentStatus::Completed,
        AppointmentStatus::NoShow,
        AppointmentStatus::Cancelled,
    ];

    public function index(QueueIndexRequest $request, AppointmentStatusService $statuses): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Appointment::class);

        $user = $request->user();
        $loadedAt = CarbonImmutable::now();
        $date = $request->queueDate();
        $clinicSlug = $request->clinicSlug();
        $doctorSlug = $request->doctorSlug();

        [$scan, $found] = $this->scan($request->bookingCode(), $date);

        $sessions = $this->sessionsOn($date, $clinicSlug, $doctorSlug);

        // Kode yang ditemukan pada tanggal ini selalu ditampilkan, juga bila filter poli/dokter menyembunyikan sesinya.
        if ($found !== null && ! $sessions->contains('id', (int) $found->practice_session_id)) {
            $clinicSlug = null;
            $doctorSlug = null;
            $sessions = $this->sessionsOn($date, null, null);
        }

        $wanted = $found !== null ? (int) $found->practice_session_id : $request->sessionId();
        $session = $wanted === null
            ? null
            : $sessions->first(fn (PracticeSession $candidate): bool => (int) $candidate->id === $wanted);
        $session ??= $sessions->first();

        $returnUrl = route('admin.queue.index', array_filter([
            'tanggal' => $date->toDateString(),
            'sesi' => $session?->id,
            'poli' => $clinicSlug,
            'dokter' => $doctorSlug,
        ], fn (mixed $value): bool => $value !== null), false);

        /** @var Collection<int, Appointment> $appointments */
        $appointments = new Collection;
        $checks = [];
        $pendingCount = 0;
        $ended = false;
        $underReview = false;
        $canManage = false;
        $canMarkNoShow = false;

        if ($session !== null) {
            $appointments = Appointment::query()
                ->with(['patientProfile', 'clinic', 'practiceSession'])
                ->where('appointments.practice_session_id', $session->id)
                ->orderBy('appointments.queue_number')
                ->orderBy('appointments.id')
                ->get();

            $canManage = $appointments->isNotEmpty() && $user->can('transition', $appointments->first());

            if ($canManage) {
                $actor = Actor::staff($user);

                foreach ($appointments as $appointment) {
                    $checks[$appointment->id] = $statuses->transitionChecks($appointment, $actor, $loadedAt);
                }
            }

            // Batas strik, sama dengan markNoShowForSession(): tepat pada end_time sesi BELUM berakhir.
            $ended = $loadedAt->greaterThan($session->ends_at);
            $underReview = $session->status === SessionStatus::NeedsReview;
            $pendingCount = $statuses->pendingNoShowCount($session);
            $canMarkNoShow = $user->can('markNoShow', $session);
        }

        return view('admin.queue.index', [
            'date' => $date,
            'loadedAt' => $loadedAt,
            'clinicOptions' => Clinic::query()->ordered()->pluck('name', 'slug')->all(),
            'doctorOptions' => Doctor::query()->ordered()->get()
                ->mapWithKeys(fn (Doctor $doctor): array => [$doctor->slug => $doctor->display_name])
                ->all(),
            'clinicSlug' => $clinicSlug,
            'doctorSlug' => $doctorSlug,
            'sessions' => $sessions,
            'session' => $session,
            'appointments' => $appointments,
            'checks' => $checks,
            'statusOrder' => self::STATUS_ORDER,
            'statusCounts' => $appointments->countBy(fn (Appointment $appointment): string => $appointment->status->value)->all(),
            'scan' => $scan,
            'codeInput' => (string) ($request->bookingCode() ?? ''),
            'highlightId' => $found !== null ? (int) $found->id : null,
            'returnUrl' => $returnUrl,
            'ended' => $ended,
            'underReview' => $underReview,
            'pendingCount' => $pendingCount,
            'showBanner' => $ended && ! $underReview && $pendingCount > 0,
            'awaiting' => $appointments
                ->filter(fn (Appointment $appointment): bool => in_array($appointment->status, [AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], true))
                ->values(),
            'canManage' => $canManage,
            'canMarkNoShow' => $canMarkNoShow,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Tandai tidak hadir semua `pending`/`confirmed` sesi (V-16). Galat aturan (`SESSION_NOT_ENDED`,
     * `SESSION_UNDER_REVIEW`, `SYSTEM_BUSY`) dilempar service dan ditangani handler global + `BookingRedirect`
     * (antrean sesi yang sama dengan flash `error`); tidak ada yang ditulis bila gagal sebelum loop.
     */
    public function markNoShow(MarkNoShowRequest $request, PracticeSession $session, AppointmentStatusService $statuses): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('markNoShow', $session);

        $count = $statuses->markNoShowForSession($session, Actor::staff($request->user()), $request->reason());

        $target = redirect()->to(route('admin.queue.index', ['tanggal' => $session->session_date->toDateString(), 'sesi' => $session->id]));

        if ($count === 0) {
            return $target->with('warning', __('booking.no_show.nothing'));
        }

        return $target->with('success', __('booking.no_show.done', ['count' => $count]));
    }

    /**
     * Pemindaian kode (F7A-R23, BR-69): hanya menemukan, tidak menulis. Mengembalikan pesan untuk ditampilkan dan, bila
     * kode milik tanggal yang sedang ditampilkan, pendaftarannya (untuk berpindah sesi dan menyorot baris).
     *
     * @return array{0: ?array{type: string, message: string, url: ?string}, 1: ?Appointment}
     */
    private function scan(?string $raw, CarbonImmutable $date): array
    {
        if ($raw === null) {
            return [null, null];
        }

        $code = BookingCodeGenerator::normalize($raw);
        $appointment = BookingCodeGenerator::isValid($code)
            ? Appointment::query()->with('clinic')->where('appointments.booking_code', $code)->first()
            : null;

        if ($appointment === null) {
            return [['type' => 'missing', 'message' => 'Kode booking tidak ditemukan.', 'url' => null], null];
        }

        if ($appointment->session_date->toDateString() !== $date->toDateString()) {
            return [[
                'type' => 'other-date',
                'message' => 'Pendaftaran ini untuk tanggal '.$appointment->session_date->format('d/m/Y').', bukan tanggal yang sedang ditampilkan.',
                'url' => route('admin.queue.index', [
                    'tanggal' => $appointment->session_date->toDateString(),
                    'sesi' => $appointment->practice_session_id,
                    'kode' => $appointment->booking_code,
                ]),
            ], null];
        }

        return [[
            'type' => 'found',
            'message' => 'Kode booking '.$appointment->booking_code.' ditemukan pada antrean '.$appointment->queue_label.'.',
            'url' => null,
        ], $appointment];
    }

    /**
     * Sesi pada satu tanggal (semua status), urut jam mulai, nama poliklinik, lalu id.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, PracticeSession>
     */
    private function sessionsOn(CarbonImmutable $date, ?string $clinicSlug, ?string $doctorSlug): Collection
    {
        return PracticeSession::query()
            ->with(['clinic', 'doctor'])
            ->onDate($date)
            ->when($clinicSlug !== null, fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->whereIn(
                'practice_sessions.clinic_id',
                Clinic::query()->where('slug', $clinicSlug)->select('id'),
            ))
            ->when($doctorSlug !== null, fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->whereIn(
                'practice_sessions.doctor_id',
                Doctor::query()->where('slug', $doctorSlug)->select('id'),
            ))
            ->orderBy('practice_sessions.start_time')
            ->orderBy(Clinic::query()->select('clinics.name')->whereColumn('clinics.id', 'practice_sessions.clinic_id'))
            ->orderBy('practice_sessions.id')
            ->get();
    }
}
```

#### Catatan penulis (konteks untuk implementer dan reviewer)

- **Teks statis view antrean.** Teks statis di `admin/queue/index.blade.php` tidak boleh memuat `Batalkan`, `Koreksi Check-in`, atau `dilakukan di halaman detail`, karena teks itu dipakai asersi tes aksi baris (pemeriksaan statis C10-1).

- **Bentuk `BookingRedirect` yang diasumsikan (T8 + T9).** `forAdmin()` adalah `match ($routeName)` privat dengan cabang `admin.appointments.transition` (T8) dan `admin.appointments.store` (T9, memanggil `adminWalkIn()`), `default => null`. Dua jangkar `Edit` T10 bergantung pada baris persis `'admin.appointments.store' => self::adminWalkIn($e, $request),` dan akhir `adminWalkIn()` (`return WalkInReturn::url(... $keepSession);` + `}`) dari T9. Bila implementer T9 menyimpang (nama method/formatting), sesuaikan jangkar, bukan perilakunya. `PracticeSession` sudah diimpor di `BookingRedirect` (kode lama); tidak ada impor baru.
- **Partial `_actions` dipakai ulang tanpa perubahan.** Kontrak T8 (`$context = 'queue'`) sudah mencakup form POST, tautan Batal/Koreksi ke detail dengan `?kembali=`, tombol `aria-disabled`, dan `-` bila tidak ada aksi. T10 hanya memanggilnya; tes T10 mengunci markup yang dihasilkannya lewat teks "dilakukan di halaman detail", `Batalkan`, `Koreksi Check-in`, `aria-disabled="true"`, dan `<input type="hidden" name="to" value="…">`.
- **Tidak ada kunci lang baru** (kerangka C.1b dipenuhi; `BookingExceptionTest` tidak berubah). Teks yang tidak ada di lang ditulis langsung di view/controller dalam bahasa Indonesia: pesan `kode` (`Kode booking tidak ditemukan.`, `Pendaftaran ini untuk tanggal {d/m/Y}, bukan tanggal yang sedang ditampilkan.`, `Kode booking {kode} ditemukan pada antrean {antrean}.`), banner, dan teks modal. Teks sesi `needs_review` memakai `booking.transitions.SESSION_UNDER_REVIEW` (milik T2).
- **Keputusan kecil T10 (tidak memengaruhi tugas lain).** (1) Antrean tidak dipaginasi (dibatasi kuota satu sesi; W-19 tanpa pagination); BP/DES §10 menyebut daftar pendaftaran (#38 index, T8) yang dipaginasi. (2) `kode` yang ditemukan pada tanggal tampilan melepas filter `poli`/`dokter` bila filter itu menyembunyikan sesinya. (3) `kembali` baris antrean tidak memuat `kode` (sorotan hanya sekali). (4) `kode` memakai `max:100` (bukan `max:20` BP 12 V-45) agar teks acak pendek menghasilkan "Kode booking tidak ditemukan." alih-alih flash filter umum; nilai > 100 atau larik tetap diabaikan dengan flash umum. (5) Kolom "Kanal" dari BP 06 tidak ditampilkan (wireframe W-19 tidak memuatnya); kanal terlihat di detail dan daftar pendaftaran.
- **Item sidebar "Antrean Hari Ini" sudah ada di `config/navigation.php`** (baris `admin.queue.index` dengan `Route::has` menyembunyikannya sampai route ada); begitu T10 menambah route, item itu muncul untuk Petugas Pendaftaran dan Super Admin. Tes lama yang mengasersi isi sidebar persis (bila ada) mungkin perlu diperbarui; di repo saat ini tidak ada tes yang menyebut "Antrean Hari Ini".
- **Temuan untuk penulis/implementer T8 (bukan perubahan T10).** `tests/Feature/Admin/AdminAppointmentTransitionTest.php` di T8 mendefinisikan `private function post(Appointment $appointment, array $data, ?User $user = null)`. Itu menimpa `Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\Concerns\MakesHttpRequests::post(string $uri, array $data = [], array $headers = [])` dengan visibilitas dan tanda tangan yang tidak kompatibel (fatal error saat kelas dimuat), dan sebagian tesnya memanggil `$this->post('/admin/pendaftaran/abc/status', $data)` dengan URI string. Ganti nama pembantu itu (mis. `transitionPost()`) dan pakai `$this->actingAs($this->officer)->post(...)` untuk panggilan URI string. Tes T10 sengaja memakai nama `markNoShow()`, `queue()`, `queueUrl()` agar tidak berbenturan dengan method `TestCase`.

### Task 11: Tes konkurensi 7a (tandai tidak hadir, walk-in vs online, hubungkan akun) dan pembaruan tes carry arsip dokter

**Files:**
- Modify: `tests/Support/Concurrency/book-session.php` (ditulis ulang utuh: operasi baru `mark-no-show` dan `link`; `ValidationException` dicatat sebagai `code` = `VALIDATION`)
- Create: `tests/Feature/Concurrency/Phase7aConcurrencyTest.php` (skenario (a) sampai (d) F7A-R27)
- Modify: `tests/Feature/Concurrency/BookingParallelProcessesTest.php` (tes carry arsip dokter vs booking: hasil sah `archived` atau `rejected`, cabang `deadlock` dihapus; F7A-R26)
- Tidak diubah: `tests/Support/Concurrency/ConcurrencyTestCase.php` (lihat Catatan teknis no. 6), `TransitionConcurrencyTest.php`, `BookingConcurrencyTest.php`, `DoctorServiceRetryTest.php` (milik T4), seluruh kode aplikasi.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T2: `AppointmentStatusService::markNoShowForSession(PracticeSession $session, Actor $actor, ?string $reason = null): int` (tanpa transaksi luar, `InvalidTransitionException` per appointment dilewati, `SYSTEM_BUSY` diteruskan).
  - T3: `PatientAccountLinker::link(PatientProfile $walkIn, User $account, Actor $actor): PatientProfile` (`ValidationException` kunci `account_email`; pesan `PROFILE_ALREADY_LINKED` = "Profil ini sudah terhubung ke sebuah akun.").
  - T4: `DoctorService::archive()` dengan `DB::transaction(…, 3)`; galat konkurensi sisa menjadi `ValidationException` kunci `status` berpesan "Sistem sedang sibuk, silakan coba lagi beberapa saat.".
  - Fase 6: `BookingService::book()`, `AppointmentStatusService::transition()`, `Tests\Support\Concurrency\ConcurrencyTestCase` (`makeSession()`, `makePatient()`, `makeStaff()`, `spawn()`, `gather()`, `barrier()`, `rowsSince()`, `notificationsSince()`, `assertSessionIsConsistent()`, `assertNoInfrastructureErrors()`, `successes()`, `failureCodes()`), `InteractsWithSchedules::bookAppointment()`.
- Produces:
  - Operasi skrip anak `--op=mark-no-show` (`--session`, `--as=staff|system`, `--actor-user`, `--reason?`) dengan keluaran `{"ok":true,"marked":N,...}`, dan `--op=link` (`--profile`, `--account`, `--actor-user`) dengan keluaran `{"ok":true,"profile":ID,"user":ID,...}`. `ValidationException` pada operasi apa pun menghasilkan `{"ok":false,"code":"VALIDATION","message":"<pesan pertama>"}`.
  - `Phase7aConcurrencyTest` (grup `concurrency`): empat tes.
  - Tes carry arsip dokter yang tidak lagi menerima `QueryException`/`DeadlockException` mentah.

**Test IDs:** F7A-R27 (a) sampai (d), F7A-R26 (e), KON-05 (antarmuka staf: sisi layanan), WLK-04 (kuota bersama online dan loket, varian proses nyata), WLK-06 (hubungkan akun dua petugas), BKG-16 (tanpa transaksi luar: tidak ada `SYSTEM_BUSY` pada jalur normal), NTF-03 (walk-in tanpa akun tidak menerima notifikasi), Review Focus E.2 (dua petugas/aksi ganda).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Jam asli proses anak.** `ConcurrencyTestCase` melarang `travelTo()`: proses anak memakai jam dinding. "Sesi sudah berakhir" untuk tandai tidak hadir (`now > ends_at`) dibuat dengan `session_date` = kemarin (08.00 sampai 12.00); ini tidak peka terhadap pergantian tengah malam (kemarin tetap sudah berakhir). Sesi untuk booking (skenario (c)) memakai `makeSession()` bawaan (besok 08.00 sampai 12.00): booking online sah sampai 07.00 besok dan booking loket sampai 12.00 besok, jadi tes aman kapan pun dijalankan. Tidak ada tes "tandai tidak hadir massal vs check-in" (mustahil: check-in hanya sampai `end`, tidak hadir hanya sesudah `end`; F7A-R27). Pengganti yang benar-benar dapat terjadi adalah tandai tidak hadir massal vs pembatalan petugas (skenario (b)).
2. **Hasil sah per skenario.**
   - (a) dua petugas pada satu sesi berakhir berisi N appointment `pending`/`confirmed`: kedua proses `ok`, jumlah `marked` keduanya = tepat N (yang sudah diubah proses lain `ALREADY_FINAL` dan dilewati, tidak dihitung), tiap appointment tepat satu riwayat dan satu audit `appointment.status_changed`, `booked_count` tetap N (`no_show` memakai kuota), tidak ada `SYSTEM_BUSY`.
   - (b) proses 1 = tandai tidak hadir massal, proses 2 = pembatalan petugas pada appointment yang sama: tepat satu status akhir. Bila pembatalan menang: massal `marked = 1` (appointment lain), `booked_count` turun satu; bila massal menang: pembatalan `ALREADY_FINAL`, `marked = 2`, `booked_count` tetap. Riwayat dan audit tepat satu per appointment.
   - (c) kursi terakhir: satu proses `ok`, satu `QUOTA_FULL`; walk-in tanpa akun menang = kanal `loket` status `confirmed` tanpa notifikasi; online menang = kanal `online` status `pending` dan satu notifikasi.
   - (d) walk-in yang sama ke dua akun berbeda: tepat satu `ok`; yang kalah `code = VALIDATION` dengan pesan "Profil ini sudah terhubung ke sebuah akun."; tepat satu audit `patient.account_linked`; profil kosong akun pemenang terhapus, profil kosong akun yang kalah tetap ada.
3. **Urutan kunci (d).** Linker mengunci profil menurut `id` menaik. Profil walk-in dibuat TERAKHIR (id terbesar): kedua petugas mengunci profil kosong masing-masing lebih dulu, lalu berebut baris walk-in. Itu menyerialisasi tanpa deadlock; pemenang meng-commit, pecundang membaca ulang baris walk-in di bawah kunci dan melihat `user_id` terisi.
4. **Notifikasi.** `AppointmentNotifier` memakai `DB::afterCommit`; di proses anak (tanpa transaksi pembungkus) notifikasi `database` langsung ditulis. `notificationsSince()` menghitung baris untuk akun yang dibuat tes ini. Surat `array` (dibuang).
5. **Arsip dokter (e).** Sesudah T4 `DoctorService::archive()` mengulang deadlock 3 kali dan, bila masih gagal, melempar `ValidationException` (`status` = pesan sibuk). Karena itu satu-satunya hasil di luar `archived` adalah `ValidationException` (penolakan bisnis "masih ada pendaftaran aktif" atau pesan sibuk). Tes ini karakterisasi: ia lulus sebelum dan sesudah perubahan blok, sehingga RED nyata tidak ada untuk (e); bukti nyata (retry dan pesan sibuk) milik `DoctorServiceRetryTest` (T4).
6. **`ConcurrencyTestCase` tidak diubah.** Tabel yang disentuh skenario ini sudah ada di `CLEANUP_TABLES`: `appointments`, `appointment_status_histories`, `practice_sessions`, `patient_profiles` (profil walk-in dan profil kosong yang tersisa), `audit_logs`, `doctors`, `clinics`, `users`; `notifications` dibersihkan lewat `notifiable_id` di atas baseline `users`. Profil kosong yang dihapus linker tidak menimbulkan sisa. Bila `tearDown` melaporkan "Data tes konkurensi tertinggal di database uji: <tabel>", tambahkan tabel itu ke `CLEANUP_TABLES` HANYA dengan aturan: anak sebelum induk (FK), `audit_logs` dan `users` tetap di akhir; jangan menghapus baris di luar `id > baseline`.
7. **Waktu dan keandalan.** Tiap tes ±6 sampai 8 detik (dua proses PHP, penghalang 2,5 + 0,35 × 2 detik). Tes konkurensi bersifat probabilistik: satu kegagalan sudah berarti cacat (Step 8 mengulang tiga kali).
8. Jumlah tes baru: 4 (`Phase7aConcurrencyTest`); tes lama yang diubah: 1.

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Concurrency;

use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;

/**
 * Konkurensi fase 7a (F7A-R27): dua petugas menandai tidak hadir sesi yang sama; tandai tidak hadir massal melawan
 * pembatalan petugas; walk-in loket melawan booking online berebut kursi terakhir; dua petugas menghubungkan
 * profil walk-in yang sama ke dua akun berbeda. Proses anak (tests/Support/Concurrency/book-session.php) memakai jam
 * dinding asli: sesi "sudah berakhir" = kemarin, sesi untuk booking = besok.
 */
#[Group('concurrency')]
class Phase7aConcurrencyTest extends ConcurrencyTestCase
{
    private const LINKED_MESSAGE = 'Profil ini sudah terhubung ke sebuah akun.';

    /** Sesi kemarin 08.00 sampai 12.00: sudah berakhir pada jam asli kapan pun tes berjalan. */
    private function endedSession(int $quota = 6): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->makeSession($quota, ['session_date' => today()->subDay()->toDateString()]);
    }

    /**
     * Appointment pada sesi, masing-masing milik pasien berakun baru (notifikasi `database` nyata).
     *
     * @param  list<AppointmentStatus>  $statuses
     * @return list<Appointment>
     */
    private function appointmentsOn(PracticeSession $session, array $statuses): array
    {
        $appointments = [];

        foreach ($statuses as $status) {
            $appointments[] = $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, ['patient_profile_id' => $this->makePatient()->id]);
        }

        return $appointments;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ (a) dua petugas, satu sesi

    public function test_a_two_staff_marking_the_same_ended_session_mark_every_appointment_exactly_once(): void
    {
        $session = $this->endedSession();
        $appointments = $this->appointmentsOn($session, [
            AppointmentStatus::Pending,
            AppointmentStatus::Confirmed,
            AppointmentStatus::Pending,
            AppointmentStatus::Confirmed,
        ]);
        $first = $this->makeStaff();
        $second = $this->makeStaff();
        $startAt = $this->barrier(2);

        $one = $this->spawn('mark-no-show', ['session' => $session->id, 'as' => 'staff', 'actor-user' => $first->id], $startAt);
        $two = $this->spawn('mark-no-show', ['session' => $session->id, 'as' => 'staff', 'actor-user' => $second->id], $startAt);

        $results = $this->gather([$one, $two]);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors($results);
        $this->assertCount(2, $this->successes($results), 'Kedua petugas berhasil (yang sudah diubah dilewati): '.json_encode($results));
        $this->assertSame(
            4,
            array_sum(array_map(fn (array $result): int => (int) $result['marked'], $results)),
            'Jumlah yang ditandai kedua petugas harus tepat 4: '.json_encode($results),
        );

        foreach ($appointments as $appointment) {
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $appointment->fresh()->status);
            $this->assertSame(1, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->count(), 'Riwayat tidak boleh ganda.');
        }

        $this->assertSame(4, $this->rowsSince('appointment_status_histories'));
        $this->assertSame(4, $this->rowsSince('audit_logs', 'appointment.status_changed'));
        $this->assertSame(4, $this->notificationsSince());
        $this->assertSame(4, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count, 'no_show tetap memakai kuota.');
        $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($session);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ (b) tandai tidak hadir massal vs pembatalan

    public function test_b_mass_no_show_racing_a_staff_cancellation_leaves_exactly_one_final_status(): void
    {
        $session = $this->endedSession();
        [$contested, $other] = $this->appointmentsOn($session, [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::Pending]);
        $marker = $this->makeStaff();
        $canceller = $this->makeStaff();
        $startAt = $this->barrier(2);

        $mass = $this->spawn('mark-no-show', ['session' => $session->id, 'as' => 'staff', 'actor-user' => $marker->id], $startAt);
        $cancel = $this->spawn('transition', [
            'appointment' => $contested->id,
            'to' => 'cancelled',
            'as' => 'staff',
            'actor-user' => $canceller->id,
            'reason' => 'Dibatalkan petugas uji',
        ], $startAt);

        [$massResult, $cancelResult] = $this->gather([$mass, $cancel]);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors([$massResult, $cancelResult]);
        $this->assertTrue($massResult['ok'], 'Aksi massal tidak boleh gagal karena satu appointment berubah: '.json_encode($massResult));

        $cancelWon = $cancelResult['ok'] === true;
        $fresh = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id);

        if ($cancelWon) {
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $contested->fresh()->status);
            $this->assertSame(1, (int) $massResult['marked'], 'Massal hanya menandai appointment lain: '.json_encode($massResult));
            $this->assertSame(1, (int) $fresh->booked_count, 'Pembatalan melepas satu kursi.');
        } else {
            $this->assertSame('ALREADY_FINAL', $cancelResult['code'], json_encode($cancelResult));
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $contested->fresh()->status);
            $this->assertSame(2, (int) $massResult['marked'], json_encode($massResult));
            $this->assertSame(2, (int) $fresh->booked_count, 'no_show tetap memakai kuota.');
        }

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, $other->fresh()->status);

        foreach ([$contested, $other] as $appointment) {
            $this->assertSame(1, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->count(), 'Satu riwayat per appointment.');
        }

        $this->assertSame(2, $this->rowsSince('audit_logs', 'appointment.status_changed'), 'Satu audit per appointment.');
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->notificationsSince());
        $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($session);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ (c) walk-in vs online, kursi terakhir

    public function test_c_a_counter_booking_and_an_online_booking_share_the_last_seat(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(1);
        $walkIn = PatientProfile::factory()->create();
        $online = $this->makePatient();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $startAt = $this->barrier(2);

        $counter = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $walkIn->id, 'session' => $session->id, 'as' => 'staff', 'actor-user' => $staff->id], $startAt);
        $web = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $online->id, 'session' => $session->id], $startAt);

        $results = $this->gather([$counter, $web]);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors($results);
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->successes($results), 'Tepat satu pemenang: '.json_encode($results));
        $this->assertSame(['QUOTA_FULL'], $this->failureCodes($results));

        $counterWon = $results[0]['ok'] === true;
        $appointment = Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->sole();

        $this->assertSame($counterWon ? $walkIn->id : $online->id, (int) $appointment->patient_profile_id);
        $this->assertSame($counterWon ? BookingChannel::Loket : BookingChannel::Online, $appointment->channel);
        $this->assertSame($counterWon ? AppointmentStatus::Confirmed : AppointmentStatus::Pending, $appointment->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->rowsSince('appointment_status_histories'));
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->rowsSince('audit_logs', 'appointment.created'));
        $this->assertSame($counterWon ? 0 : 1, $this->notificationsSince(), 'Walk-in tanpa akun tidak menerima notifikasi (NTF-03); pasien online menerima satu.');
        $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($session);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ (d) dua petugas menghubungkan profil walk-in yang sama

    public function test_d_two_staff_linking_the_same_walk_in_to_different_accounts_one_wins_and_one_is_refused(): void
    {
        // Profil kosong akun dibuat lebih dulu (id kecil); walk-in dibuat terakhir (id terbesar): urutan kunci menaik.
        $accountOne = $this->makePatient();
        $accountTwo = $this->makePatient();
        $walkIn = PatientProfile::factory()->create();
        $first = $this->makeStaff();
        $second = $this->makeStaff();
        $startAt = $this->barrier(2);

        $one = $this->spawn('link', ['profile' => $walkIn->id, 'account' => $accountOne->user_id, 'actor-user' => $first->id], $startAt);
        $two = $this->spawn('link', ['profile' => $walkIn->id, 'account' => $accountTwo->user_id, 'actor-user' => $second->id], $startAt);

        $results = $this->gather([$one, $two]);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors($results);
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->successes($results), 'Tepat satu petugas berhasil: '.json_encode($results));

        $failure = array_values(array_filter($results, fn (array $result): bool => ($result['ok'] ?? false) !== true))[0];
        $this->assertSame('VALIDATION', $failure['code'], json_encode($failure));
        $this->assertSame(self::LINKED_MESSAGE, $failure['message']);

        [$winner, $loser] = $results[0]['ok'] === true ? [$accountOne, $accountTwo] : [$accountTwo, $accountOne];

        $this->assertSame((int) $winner->user_id, (int) $walkIn->fresh()->user_id, 'Walk-in terhubung ke akun pemenang.');
        $this->assertFalse(PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($winner->id)->exists(), 'Profil kosong akun pemenang dihapus.');
        $this->assertTrue(PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($loser->id)->exists(), 'Profil kosong akun yang kalah tetap ada.');
        $this->assertSame((int) $loser->user_id, (int) $loser->fresh()->user_id);
        $this->assertSame(1, PatientProfile::query()->where('user_id', $winner->user_id)->count(), 'Satu profil per akun (UNIQUE user_id).');
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->rowsSince('audit_logs', 'patient.account_linked'), 'Tepat satu audit hubungkan akun.');
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Tulis ulang `tests/Support/Concurrency/book-session.php` (tool Write)**

```php
<?php

/**
 * Pembantu tes konkurensi fase 6 dan 7a (F6-R34, F7A-R27). Dijalankan SEBAGAI PROSES PHP TERPISAH oleh
 * tests/Support/Concurrency/ConcurrencyTestCase::spawn(); bukan kelas tes dan tidak dimuat aplikasi.
 *
 *   php book-session.php --op=book --patient=ID --session=ID [--as=patient|staff] [--actor-user=USER_ID]
 *   php book-session.php --op=transition --appointment=ID --to=STATUS --as=patient|staff|system
 *                        [--actor-user=USER_ID] [--reason=TEKS] [--expected=STATUS]
 *   php book-session.php --op=mark-no-show --session=ID [--as=staff|system] [--actor-user=USER_ID] [--reason=TEKS]
 *   php book-session.php --op=link --profile=ID --account=USER_ID --actor-user=USER_ID
 *   opsi bersama: [--start-at=EPOCH.FRAK] [--lock-timeout=DETIK]
 *
 * Keluaran: SATU baris JSON pada baris terakhir stdout, mis.
 *   {"ok":true,"queue":2,"booking_code":"UPH-...","status":"pending","begin":1.7e9,"end":1.7e9}
 *   {"ok":true,"marked":3,"begin":...,"end":...}                      (mark-no-show)
 *   {"ok":true,"profile":12,"user":7,"begin":...,"end":...}           (link)
 *   {"ok":false,"code":"QUOTA_FULL","message":"...","begin":...,"end":...}
 * `code` = kode BookingException/InvalidTransitionException; `VALIDATION` untuk ValidationException (message =
 * pesan pertama); `DB_<errno>` untuk QueryException tak terduga; `EXC_<kelas>` untuk pengecualian lain. Kode keluar 0
 * untuk semua hasil domain; 3 bila lingkungan bukan database uji (pagar keamanan: tidak pernah menulis ke database
 * selain `*_test`).
 */

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentStatusService;
use App\Services\Booking\BookingData;
use App\Services\Booking\BookingService;
use App\Services\Patients\PatientAccountLinker;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Tests\Support\DatabaseGuard;

require __DIR__.'/../../../vendor/autoload.php';

$app = require __DIR__.'/../../../bootstrap/app.php';
$app->make(Kernel::class)->bootstrap();

try {
    if (! $app->environment('testing')) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Skrip ini hanya boleh berjalan dengan APP_ENV=testing.');
    }

    DatabaseGuard::assertIsTestDatabase((string) DB::connection()->getDatabaseName());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    fwrite(STDERR, $e->getMessage().PHP_EOL);

    exit(3);
}

$options = getopt('', [
    'op:',
    'patient:',
    'session:',
    'appointment:',
    'profile:',
    'account:',
    'to:',
    'as::',
    'actor-user::',
    'reason::',
    'expected::',
    'start-at::',
    'lock-timeout::',
]);

$emit = static function (array $payload): void {
    echo json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES).PHP_EOL;
};

$begin = null;

try {
    if (isset($options['lock-timeout'])) {
        DB::statement('SET SESSION innodb_lock_wait_timeout = '.max(1, (int) $options['lock-timeout']));
    }

    // Koneksi dibuka dan service dimuat SEBELUM penghalang agar waktu setelahnya hanya milik operasi.
    DB::connection()->getPdo();

    $operation = (string) ($options['op'] ?? 'book');
    $as = (string) ($options['as'] ?? 'patient');

    if ($operation === 'book') {
        $service = $app->make(BookingService::class);
        $profile = PatientProfile::query()->with('user')->findOrFail((int) $options['patient']);
        $sessionId = (int) $options['session'];
        $actor = $as === 'staff'
            ? Actor::staff(User::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['actor-user']))
            : Actor::patient($profile->user);

        $action = static function () use ($service, $profile, $sessionId, $actor): array {
            $appointment = $service->book($profile, $sessionId, new BookingData(PaymentType::Umum), $actor);

            return [
                'queue' => $appointment->queue_number,
                'booking_code' => $appointment->booking_code,
                'status' => $appointment->status->value,
            ];
        };
    } elseif ($operation === 'transition') {
        $service = $app->make(AppointmentStatusService::class);
        $appointment = Appointment::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['appointment']);
        $to = AppointmentStatus::from((string) $options['to']);
        $expected = isset($options['expected']) ? AppointmentStatus::from((string) $options['expected']) : null;
        $reason = isset($options['reason']) ? (string) $options['reason'] : null;
        $actor = match ($as) {
            'staff' => Actor::staff(User::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['actor-user'])),
            'system' => Actor::system(),
            default => Actor::patient(User::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['actor-user'])),
        };

        $action = static function () use ($service, $appointment, $to, $actor, $reason, $expected): array {
            $updated = $service->transition($appointment, $to, $actor, $reason, $expected);

            return ['status' => $updated->status->value];
        };
    } elseif ($operation === 'mark-no-show') {
        // Aksi massal "Tandai tidak hadir" satu sesi (T2): petugas (`--as=staff`) atau sistem (`--as=system`).
        $service = $app->make(AppointmentStatusService::class);
        $session = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['session']);
        $reason = isset($options['reason']) ? (string) $options['reason'] : null;
        $actor = $as === 'system'
            ? Actor::system()
            : Actor::staff(User::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['actor-user']));

        $action = static function () use ($service, $session, $actor, $reason): array {
            return ['marked' => $service->markNoShowForSession($session, $actor, $reason)];
        };
    } elseif ($operation === 'link') {
        // Hubungkan profil walk-in ke akun pasien (T3); selalu oleh petugas.
        $linker = $app->make(PatientAccountLinker::class);
        $walkIn = PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['profile']);
        $account = User::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['account']);
        $actor = Actor::staff(User::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['actor-user']));

        $action = static function () use ($linker, $walkIn, $account, $actor): array {
            $linked = $linker->link($walkIn, $account, $actor);

            return ['profile' => (int) $linked->getKey(), 'user' => (int) $account->getKey()];
        };
    } else {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException("Operasi tidak dikenal: {$operation}.");
    }

    $startAt = (float) ($options['start-at'] ?? 0);

    while (microtime(true) < $startAt) {
        usleep(500);
    }

    $begin = microtime(true);
    $payload = $action();

    $emit(['ok' => true] + $payload + ['begin' => $begin, 'end' => microtime(true)]);
} catch (BookingException $e) {
    $emit(['ok' => false, 'code' => $e->errorCode, 'message' => $e->getMessage(), 'begin' => $begin, 'end' => microtime(true)]);
} catch (ValidationException $e) {
    $emit(['ok' => false, 'code' => 'VALIDATION', 'message' => (string) collect($e->errors())->flatten()->first(), 'begin' => $begin, 'end' => microtime(true)]);
} catch (QueryException $e) {
    $emit(['ok' => false, 'code' => 'DB_'.($e->errorInfo[1] ?? 'ERR'), 'message' => $e->getMessage(), 'begin' => $begin, 'end' => microtime(true)]);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    $emit(['ok' => false, 'code' => 'EXC_'.(new ReflectionClass($e))->getShortName(), 'message' => $e->getMessage(), 'begin' => $begin, 'end' => microtime(true)]);
}
```

### Task 12: `AppointmentSeeder`, enam profil walk-in demo, `seed-invariants.sql`, dan pembaruan tes seeder

**Files:**
