- Create: `scripts/sql/seed-invariants.sql` (kueri 13 §11.1, 17 baris, ASCII murni)
- Modify: `database/seeders/DemoSeeder.php` (memanggil `AppointmentSeeder` antara `PatientSeeder` dan `ContactMessageSeeder`)
- Create (tes): `tests/Feature/Seeding/AppointmentSeederTest.php`
- Modify (tes): `tests/Feature/Seeding/DemoSeederInvariantsTest.php` (angka 7 menjadi 13, loket 0 menjadi 6, BPJS 3 menjadi 5, `[10, 7]` menjadi `[10, 13]`; dua tes baru: berkas SQL dan angka acuan 13 §10.3), `tests/Feature/Seeding/DemoSeederWiringTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Seeding/SeederProductionGuardTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Seeding/ScheduleSeederTest.php` (3 pengecualian dan 333 sesi), `tests/Feature/Seeding/PatientSeederTest.php` (hanya satu asersi pada tes `DemoSeeder` dan dua teks komentar)
- Tidak diubah: `PatientSeeder.php` (tetap 7 akun berakun), `DatabaseSeeder.php`, `ScheduleExceptionSeeder.php`, semua kode layanan (T1 sampai T10), migration, enum, izin.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T2: `AppointmentStatusService::markNoShowForSession(PracticeSession, Actor, ?string): int` dan `markNoShowForDate(?CarbonInterface, Actor): int`.
  - T3: `PatientRegistrationService::createWalkIn(array $validated, User $staff): PatientProfile` (kunci `full_name`, `birth_date` `Y-m-d`, `gender`, `phone`, `email?`, `address`).
  - Fase 6: `BookingService::book(PatientProfile $profile, int $practiceSessionId, BookingData $data, Actor $actor): Appointment` (BUKAN `PracticeSession`; kerangka 13 §10.2 usang), `BookingData(paymentType:, paymentReference:, insurancePartnerId:, complaint:, saveBpjs:)` (argumen BERNAMA; urutan konstruktor berbeda dari contoh 13), `AppointmentStatusService::transition(Appointment, AppointmentStatus, Actor, ?string $reason = null, ?AppointmentStatus $expected = null)`.
  - Fase 3: `PracticeSessionGenerator::ensureRange(CarbonInterface $from, CarbonInterface $to): int` (mengklem rentang ke "hari ini" menurut `CarbonImmutable::today()`), `ScheduleChangeService::applyException(ScheduleException, ?array, Actor)`, `ScheduleExceptionSeeder::EXTRA_REASON`, `DoctorScheduleSeeder::CREATOR_EMAIL`.
  - `DemoUserSeeder` (akun `pendaftaran@unpamhospital.test`), `PatientSeeder::ACCOUNTS`, `ContentSeeder` (mitra `asuransi-contoh-sehat` dan `asuransi-contoh-sentosa`, kolom `slug`).
- Produces:
  - `AppointmentSeeder`: 6 profil walk-in (P000008 sampai P000013 pada DB baru), sesi lampau 14 hari, 29 pendaftaran A01 sampai A29 persis 13 §10.3, pengecualian ketiga "Cuti mendadak (contoh)" (sesi `needs_review`), notifikasi pendaftaran lampau ditandai dibaca.
  - `scripts/sql/seed-invariants.sql` yang dijalankan tes (17 invarian = 0) dan koordinator di gerbang (T13).
  - Angka acuan yang dikunci tes pada `travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00')` (Senin): status 6/9/1/8/2/3, riwayat 64, `SUM(booked_count)` 26, loket 9, online 20, `needs_review` 1, `closed` 1, profil 13 (loket 6), pengecualian 3, sesi 333 (231 + 102).

**Test IDs:** SEED-01 (17 invarian + angka acuan 13 §11.2 untuk hari Senin), SEED-02 (penjaga produksi `AppointmentSeeder`), SEED-03 (idempoten lewat penjaga), WLK-01 (walk-in demo lewat `createWalkIn`), BKG-12 (transisi demo hanya lewat service), BKG-13 (kuota), BKG-16 (A09 sistem, A10 petugas), NTF-03 (walk-in tanpa notifikasi), F7A-R28, D-150, D-64 (angka sesi diverifikasi).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Penempatan.** Enam walk-in dibuat di AWAL `AppointmentSeeder` (bukan `PatientSeeder`), sehingga `PatientSeederTest` (hanya `PatientSeeder`, tanpa `DemoUserSeeder`) tidak pecah selain satu asersi pada tes yang menjalankan `DemoSeeder`. `createWalkIn()` memakai `now()` nyata untuk `consent_at` (dibuat sebelum jam semu pertama). Penjaga: bila `Appointment::query()->exists()` seeder berhenti dengan `warn` SEBELUM membuat walk-in (idempoten; `DemoSeeder` sendiri sudah berhenti bila akun Super Admin ada).
2. **Tanpa nomor pasien literal.** AUTO_INCREMENT InnoDB tidak di-reset oleh rollback `RefreshDatabase`, jadi `P000008` hanya berlaku pada `migrate:fresh`. Seeder dan tes mengenali profil lewat nama dan kanal (`WALK_INS`), bukan nomor. Telepon walk-in ke-n (n = 8 sampai 13) = `'0812000000'.str_pad((string) n, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT)` (12 digit; `PatientSeeder` memakai `'08120000000'.n` yang hanya benar untuk n kurang dari 10), alamat `Jl. Contoh No. {n}, Pamulang, Tangerang Selatan`.
3. **Jam semu (13 §10.2).** `$previous = Carbon::getTestNow()` disimpan, tiap langkah memanggil `Carbon::setTestNow(...)` (`Illuminate\Support\Carbon::setTestNow` mengatur `Carbon` DAN `CarbonImmutable`, yang dipakai `BookingService`, `BookingRules`, dan `AppointmentStatusService`), dan `finally { Carbon::setTestNow($previous); }` memulihkan jam, sehingga tes yang membekukan waktu dengan `travelTo()` (`ScheduleSeederTest`, tes invarian) tidak kehilangan jam bekunya. Tabel jam semu: booking online sesi lampau/hari ini = hari sebelum sesi 10.00; konfirmasi petugas online = hari sebelum sesi 14.00; booking loket = `start - 30` menit; check-in = `start - 20`; selesai = `start + 40`; pembatalan pasien (A11) = hari sebelum sesi 16.00 (sebelum `start - 120`); pembatalan petugas (A12) = hari sebelum sesi 15.00; tidak hadir A10 = `end + 15`, A09 = `end + 10`; sesi mendatang = waktu nyata (`$previous`).
4. **Sesi lampau.** `ensureRange` mengklem `$from` ke `CarbonImmutable::today()`; karena `today()` mengikuti `setTestNow`, seeder memanggil `setTestNow(<hari lampau> 00:00)` lalu `ensureRange(hari itu, kemarin)` untuk setiap hari dari 14 hari lalu sampai kemarin (generator yang sama, tanpa insert manual; panggilan pertama sudah membuat semuanya, 13 panggilan berikutnya no-op berkat `insertOrIgnore`). Templat berlaku sejak `today - 45` (`DoctorScheduleSeeder`), jadi 14 hari ke belakang selalu tercakup.
5. **Perhitungan angka sesi baru (`ScheduleSeederTest`, `travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00')`, Senin).** Sebelum 7a: 231 sesi = 230 dari templat (hari ini 5 Okt sampai +30 hari = 4 minggu penuh x 51 templat aktif + Sen/Sel/Rab 26 sesi = 204 + 26) + 1 sesi tambahan manual Teguh; tidak ada sesi cadangan hari ini karena Senin 07.00 sudah punya 3 atau lebih sesi `open` yang belum berakhir. Sesi lampau: 14 hari terakhir = 21 Sep sampai 4 Okt 2026 = TEPAT dua minggu, jadi 2 x 51 templat aktif = **102** sesi (Minggu tidak punya templat; dokter dan poliklinik semuanya aktif; tidak ada pengecualian di masa lampau). Total = 231 + 102 = **333**. Pengecualian: 2 + 1 ("Cuti mendadak (contoh)") = **3**. Angka 102 tidak bergantung pada hari beku selama 14 hari ke belakang tercakup templat (selalu dua minggu penuh). IMPLEMENTER WAJIB memastikan angka nyata (Step 8): jalankan sekali, catat, kunci di tes; bila berbeda dari 333, hitung selisihnya (`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_sessions WHERE session_date < '2026-10-05'` harus 102) dan laporkan penyebabnya sebelum mengubah angka.
6. **Pemilihan sesi (tanpa kelas `SessionPicker`).** Metode privat `pastSessions()` (sesi `open` dokter sebelum hari ini, terbaru dulu; `lampau-N` = irisan mulai indeks N-1), `todaySessions()` (sesi `open` hari ini urut `start_time` lalu `id`, satu per poliklinik; `hari ini-N`), `futureSessions()` (`open`, `session_date >= today + k`, urut naik; `depan-N`), dan sesi manual (`status_reason` = `ScheduleExceptionSeeder::EXTRA_REASON`). `bookFirst()` mencoba kandidat berikutnya bila `BookingService` menolak dengan `OVERLAPPING_BOOKING`, `DUPLICATE_BOOKING`, `QUOTA_FULL`, atau `SESSION_UNAVAILABLE`; galat lain dilempar. Bila hari seeding sama sekali tidak punya sesi hari ini (mis. Minggu malam, sesudah sesi cadangan `ScheduleExceptionSeeder::TODAY_BACKUP` tidak dapat dibuat), A13 sampai A16 dilewati dengan `warn`; bila sesi hari ini kurang dari tiga, kandidat diputar (`todayCandidates`). Tes skenario membekukan Senin 07.00 sehingga deterministik; tes `seedingMoments` membuktikan seeder selesai pada tujuh hari pukul 07.00 dan dua malam; tes lain memakai waktu nyata dan hanya mensyaratkan 25 sampai 29 pendaftaran.
7. **Urutan (F7A-R28).** Walk-in, profil, sesi lampau, lampau (A01 sampai A12 dibuat dan difinalkan), A10 ditandai petugas (`markNoShowForSession`) SEBELUM A09 ditandai sistem (`markNoShowForDate`) agar A10 tidak jatuh ke aktor sistem, hari ini (A13 sampai A16), mendatang (A17 sampai A27; A22 batal sebelum A23), sesi manual (A28, A29), pengecualian ketiga pada tanggal sesi A26/A27 (waktu nyata), terakhir notifikasi pendaftaran lampau (`session_date` sebelum hari ini) yang belum dibaca ditandai dibaca. A15 dan A16 loket hari ini langsung `confirmed` (booking loket); "konfirmasi `start - 45`" di tabel 13 hanya berlaku bila pendaftaran loket dikonfirmasi terpisah, yang tidak terjadi di data demo.
8. **Pembayaran dan keluhan.** BPJS memakai nomor fiktif 13 digit per pasien (Anisa `…011`, Budi `…022`, Fitri `…033`, Mulyani walk-in `…044`, Nayla `…055`); `saveBpjs: true` pada A05 (Nayla) dan A25 (Mulyani walk-in) menyimpan nomor ke profil (hook `saving` mengisi `bpjs_number_last4`; audit `patient.updated` menyamarkan nomor), sehingga profil ber-BPJS = 5. Asuransi: A07 mitra "Asuransi Contoh Sehat" dengan polis `POL-CONTOH-001` (bukan deret 13 digit; invarian I14 aman), A19 "Asuransi Contoh Sentosa" tanpa polis. Keluhan `null` kecuali A02 `Kontrol rutin`.
9. **Notifikasi.** Hanya pasien berakun menerima notifikasi `database` (surat `array`). `DatabaseNotification` yang `data.appointment_id`-nya milik pendaftaran lampau ditandai dibaca lewat `markAsRead()`; yang hari ini dan mendatang tetap belum dibaca.
10. **Mode ketat Eloquent.** Seeder memuat profil dengan `with('user')`, memakai `forceFill` hanya pada `ScheduleException::created_by`, dan tidak mengakses relasi yang belum dimuat (`book()` mengembalikan appointment dengan `clinic`, `doctor`, `practiceSession` termuat; `transition()` menyalin relasi terkunci ke instance pemanggil).
11. **Tes seeder yang pecah (digest-data §9):** `DemoSeederInvariantsTest` (profil 7 menjadi 13, loket 0 menjadi 6, BPJS 3 menjadi 5, `[10, 7]` menjadi `[10, 13]`), `SeederProductionGuardTest` (dua kali 7 menjadi 13), `ScheduleSeederTest` (2 menjadi 3 pengecualian; 231 menjadi 333 sesi), `PatientSeederTest` (satu asersi pada tes `DemoSeeder`; selebihnya tetap karena `PatientSeeder` tetap 7). `DemoSeederWiringTest` diperluas agar urutan `AppointmentSeeder` terkunci. Tes yang memanggil `DatabaseSeeder` pada waktu nyata (`FacilitySeedersTest`, `RolePermissionSeederTest`, `PatientSeederTest`) hanya bergantung pada hitungan pengguna, media, peran, dan izin sehingga tidak pecah.
12. **Jangan menyeed DB pengembangan.** `migrate:fresh --seed` pada `unpam_hospital` adalah langkah MANUAL koordinator di T13 (izin pemilik). Implementer hanya memakai `unpam_hospital_test` lewat tes.

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Seeding;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use App\Models\User;
use Database\Seeders\AppointmentSeeder;
use Database\Seeders\DatabaseSeeder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Notifications\DatabaseNotification;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * AppointmentSeeder (13 §10, F7A-R28): 6 profil walk-in, sesi lampau lewat generator di bawah jam semu, 29 pendaftaran
 * A01 sampai A29 lewat BookingService dan AppointmentStatusService, pengecualian ketiga (`needs_review`), dan notifikasi
 * lampau dibaca. Tes skenario membekukan Senin 5 Oktober 2026 07.00 agar sesi hari ini tersedia (A13 sampai A16).
 */
class AppointmentSeederTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public'); // DatabaseSeeder membuat 83 gambar contoh.
    }

    /** Satu pendaftaran menurut nama pasien, slug dokter, dan status akhir (A-kode 13 §10.3 tidak disimpan). */
    private function appointmentOf(string $patientName, string $doctorSlug, string $status): Appointment
    {
        return Appointment::query()
            ->with(['patientProfile', 'doctor', 'practiceSession', 'statusHistories', 'insurancePartner'])
            ->where('status', $status)
            ->whereHas('patientProfile', fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->where('full_name', $patientName))
            ->whereHas('doctor', fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->where('slug', $doctorSlug))
            ->sole();
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string>  $statuses
     * @param  list<string>  $actors
     */
    private function assertHistory(Appointment $appointment, array $statuses, array $actors, string $label): void
    {
        $this->assertSame($statuses, $appointment->statusHistories->map(fn ($history): string => $history->to_status->value)->all(), "{$label}: status riwayat");
        $this->assertSame($actors, $appointment->statusHistories->map(fn ($history): string => $history->actor_type->value)->all(), "{$label}: pelaku riwayat");
    }

    public function test_the_seeder_builds_the_29_scenarios_of_13_section_10_3_through_the_services(): void
    {
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00'); // Senin
        $this->seed(DatabaseSeeder::class);

        $officer = User::query()->where('email', 'pendaftaran@unpamhospital.test')->firstOrFail();

        $this->assertSame('2026-10-05 07:00:00', now()->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'), 'Jam beku tes harus dipulihkan seeder.');
        $this->assertSame(29, Appointment::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(102, PracticeSession::query()->where('session_date', '<', '2026-10-05')->count(), '14 hari lampau = 2 minggu x 51 templat aktif.');

        // Enam walk-in lewat createWalkIn (13 §10.1).
        $walkIns = PatientProfile::query()->where('registration_channel', BookingChannel::Loket->value)->orderBy('id')->get();
        $this->assertCount(6, $walkIns);

        foreach (AppointmentSeeder::WALK_INS as $index => $row) {
            $number = $index + 8;
            $profile = $walkIns->firstWhere('full_name', $row['name']);

            $this->assertNotNull($profile, $row['name']);
            $this->assertNull($profile->user_id, $row['name']);
            $this->assertSame((int) $officer->id, (int) $profile->created_by_user_id, $row['name']);
            $this->assertSame('0812000000'.str_pad((string) $number, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT), $profile->phone, $row['name']);
            $this->assertSame("Jl. Contoh No. {$number}, Pamulang, Tangerang Selatan", $profile->address, $row['name']);
            $this->assertTrue($profile->is_active, $row['name']);
            $this->assertNotNull($profile->consent_at, $row['name']);
            $this->assertNotNull($profile->patient_number, $row['name']);
        }

        $this->assertSame('0044', $walkIns->firstWhere('full_name', 'Mulyani Astuti')->bpjs_number_last4);
        $this->assertSame('0055', $walkIns->firstWhere('full_name', 'Nayla Putri Prakoso')->bpjs_number_last4);
        $this->assertSame(2, $walkIns->whereNotNull('bpjs_number_last4')->count(), 'Hanya P000012 dan P000013 yang menyimpan BPJS.');

        // Lampau: selesai, dengan jam semu (A01) dan pelaku riwayat.
        $a01 = $this->appointmentOf('Anisa Rahmawati', 'rani-oktaviani', 'completed');
        $this->assertHistory($a01, ['pending', 'confirmed', 'checked_in', 'completed'], ['patient', 'staff', 'staff', 'staff'], 'A01');
        $session = $a01->practiceSession;
        $day = $session->starts_at->startOfDay();
        $this->assertSame([
            $day->subDay()->setTime(10, 0)->format('Y-m-d H:i'),
            $day->subDay()->setTime(14, 0)->format('Y-m-d H:i'),
            $session->starts_at->subMinutes(20)->format('Y-m-d H:i'),
            $session->starts_at->addMinutes(40)->format('Y-m-d H:i'),
        ], $a01->statusHistories->map(fn ($history): string => $history->created_at->format('Y-m-d H:i'))->all(), 'A01: jam semu');
        $this->assertTrue($session->session_date->lt(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05')), 'A01 pada sesi lampau.');

        $a02 = $this->appointmentOf('Budi Hartanto', 'sekar-ayuningtyas', 'completed');
        $this->assertSame(PaymentType::Bpjs, $a02->payment_type);
        $this->assertSame('0022', $a02->payment_reference_last4);
        $this->assertSame('Kontrol rutin', $a02->complaint);
        $this->assertSame(1, Appointment::query()->whereNotNull('complaint')->count(), 'Keluhan hanya pada A02.');

        $a04 = $this->appointmentOf('Eko Prasetyo', 'teguh-wicaksono', 'completed');
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Loket, $a04->channel);
        $this->assertHistory($a04, ['confirmed', 'checked_in', 'completed'], ['staff', 'staff', 'staff'], 'A04');

        $this->assertSame('Asuransi Contoh Sehat', $a07->insurancePartner->name);
        $this->assertSame('POL-CONTOH-001', $a07->payment_reference);

        $this->assertSame(8, Appointment::query()->where('status', 'completed')->count());

        // Tidak hadir: A09 oleh sistem (markNoShowForDate), A10 oleh petugas (markNoShowForSession).
        $a09 = $this->appointmentOf('Gilang Saputra', 'arif-budiman-santoso', 'no_show');
        $this->assertHistory($a09, ['pending', 'confirmed', 'no_show'], ['patient', 'staff', 'system'], 'A09');
        $this->assertNotNull($a09->no_show_at);

        $a10 = $this->appointmentOf('Imam Santosa', 'hendra-mahardika', 'no_show');
        $this->assertHistory($a10, ['confirmed', 'no_show'], ['staff', 'staff'], 'A10');
        $this->assertSame((int) $officer->id, (int) $a10->statusHistories->last()->actor_user_id);

        // Batal: A11 pasien, A12 petugas, A22 pasien.
        $a11 = $this->appointmentOf('Kartika Dewi Anggraini', 'maya-kartika-sari', 'cancelled');
        $this->assertHistory($a11, ['pending', 'cancelled'], ['patient', 'patient'], 'A11');
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Patient, $a11->cancelled_by_type);
        $this->assertSame('Berhalangan hadir', $a11->cancel_reason);

        $a12 = $this->appointmentOf('Budi Hartanto', 'yoga-prasetya', 'cancelled');
        $this->assertHistory($a12, ['pending', 'confirmed', 'cancelled'], ['patient', 'staff', 'staff'], 'A12');
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Staff, $a12->cancelled_by_type);
        $this->assertSame('Pasien meminta pembatalan melalui telepon', $a12->cancel_reason);

        // A22 dibatalkan lalu A23 memesan sesi yang sama: antrean 1 tidak dipakai ulang.
        $a22 = $this->appointmentOf('Kartika Dewi Anggraini', 'intan-permatasari', 'cancelled');
        $a23 = $this->appointmentOf('Fitri Handayani', 'intan-permatasari', 'confirmed');
        $this->assertHistory($a22, ['pending', 'confirmed', 'cancelled'], ['patient', 'staff', 'patient'], 'A22');
        $this->assertSame('Jadwal bentrok dengan pekerjaan', $a22->cancel_reason);
        $this->assertHistory($a23, ['pending', 'confirmed'], ['patient', 'staff'], 'A23');
        $this->assertSame($a22->practice_session_id, $a23->practice_session_id);
        $this->assertSame([1, 2], [(int) $a22->queue_number, (int) $a23->queue_number]);
        $shared = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($a22->practice_session_id);
        $this->assertSame([1, 2], [(int) $shared->booked_count, (int) $shared->last_queue_number]);

        // Hari ini (Senin): A13 pending, A14 confirmed (bpjs), A15 checked_in, A16 confirmed; semuanya pada sesi hari ini.
        $today = Appointment::query()->where('session_date', '2026-10-05')->get();
        $this->assertCount(4, $today);
        $this->assertSame(['checked_in' => 1, 'confirmed' => 2, 'pending' => 1], $today->countBy(fn (Appointment $appointment): string => $appointment->status->value)->sortKeys()->all());
        $a15 = Appointment::query()->with('statusHistories')->where('status', 'checked_in')->sole();
        $this->assertHistory($a15, ['confirmed', 'checked_in'], ['staff', 'staff'], 'A15');

        // Mendatang: A25 walk-in BPJS, A28 dan A29 mengisi sesi manual hingga penuh.
        $a25 = $this->appointmentOf('Mulyani Astuti', 'bagas-setiawan-nugroho', 'confirmed');
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Loket, $a25->channel);
        $this->assertNull($a25->patientProfile->user_id);
        $this->assertSame('0044', $a25->payment_reference_last4);

        $a19 = $this->appointmentOf('Dewi Susilowati', 'maya-kartika-sari', 'pending');
        $this->assertSame('Asuransi Contoh Sentosa', $a19->insurancePartner->name);

        $a28 = $this->appointmentOf('Dewi Susilowati', 'teguh-wicaksono', 'pending');
        $a29 = $this->appointmentOf('Kartika Dewi Anggraini', 'teguh-wicaksono', 'pending');
        $manual = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($a28->practice_session_id);
        $this->assertSame($a28->practice_session_id, $a29->practice_session_id);
        $this->assertNull($manual->doctor_schedule_id, 'A28 dan A29 memesan sesi tambahan manual.');
        $this->assertSame([2, 2, SessionStatus::Open], [(int) $manual->quota, (int) $manual->booked_count, $manual->status], 'Sesi manual menjadi penuh.');

        // Jumlah per jenis pembayaran: umum 20, BPJS 7, asuransi 2.
        $this->assertSame(
            ['asuransi' => 2, 'bpjs' => 7, 'umum' => 20],
            Appointment::query()->get()->countBy(fn (Appointment $appointment): string => $appointment->payment_type->value)->sortKeys()->all(),
        );

        // Pengecualian ketiga: sesi A26/A27 menjadi needs_review, appointment tetap aktif.
        $a26 = $this->appointmentOf('Budi Hartanto', 'hendra-mahardika', 'pending');
        $a27 = $this->appointmentOf('Lukman Fauzi', 'hendra-mahardika', 'confirmed');
        $this->assertSame($a26->practice_session_id, $a27->practice_session_id);

        $review = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($a26->practice_session_id);
        $exception = ScheduleException::query()->where('reason', AppointmentSeeder::SUDDEN_LEAVE_REASON)->sole();

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $review->status);
        $this->assertSame(2, (int) $review->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame('exception', $review->pending_change['source']);
        $this->assertSame((int) $exception->id, (int) $review->pending_change['exception_id']);
        $this->assertSame((int) $exception->id, (int) $review->schedule_exception_id);
        $this->assertSame($review->session_date->toDateString(), $exception->start_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame($review->session_date->toDateString(), $exception->end_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame(1, PracticeSession::query()->where('status', SessionStatus::NeedsReview->value)->count());

        // Notifikasi: pendaftaran lampau dibaca, yang mendatang masih belum dibaca; walk-in tidak punya notifikasi sama sekali.
        $past = Appointment::query()->where('session_date', '<', '2026-10-05')->pluck('id')->map(fn ($id): int => (int) $id)->all();
        $this->assertCount(12, $past);
        $notifications = DatabaseNotification::query()->get();
        $ofPast = $notifications->filter(fn (DatabaseNotification $notification): bool => in_array((int) ($notification->data['appointment_id'] ?? 0), $past, true));

        $this->assertNotEmpty($ofPast, 'Pendaftaran lampau punya notifikasi.');
        $this->assertTrue($ofPast->every(fn (DatabaseNotification $notification): bool => $notification->read_at !== null), 'Notifikasi pendaftaran lampau ditandai dibaca.');
        $this->assertTrue($notifications->diff($ofPast)->contains(fn (DatabaseNotification $notification): bool => $notification->read_at === null), 'Notifikasi hari ini dan mendatang tetap belum dibaca.');
        $this->assertSame(0, $notifications->where('notifiable_type', (new PatientProfile)->getMorphClass())->count());
    }

    public function test_the_seeder_works_on_the_real_clock_and_leaves_no_frozen_time_behind(): void
    {
        Carbon::setTestNow(null);

        $this->seed(DatabaseSeeder::class);

        $this->assertFalse(Carbon::hasTestNow(), 'Seeder harus memulihkan keadaan tanpa jam beku.');
        $this->assertSame(6, PatientProfile::query()->where('registration_channel', BookingChannel::Loket->value)->count());
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(25, Appointment::query()->count(), 'Paling banyak A13 sampai A16 dilewati (hari seeding tanpa sesi).');
        $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(29, Appointment::query()->count());
    }

    /**
     * Banyak tes lama menjalankan DatabaseSeeder pada jam nyata, jadi seeder tidak boleh gagal pada hari atau jam
     * mana pun. Minggu 4 sampai Sabtu 10 Oktober 2026 pukul 07.00, ditambah dua malam (Minggu malam tanpa sesi hari
     * ini; Rabu malam dengan semua sesi hari ini sudah berakhir).
     *
     * @return array<string, array{string}>
     */
    public static function seedingMoments(): array
    {
        return [
            'minggu pagi' => ['2026-10-04 07:00:00'],
            'senin pagi' => ['2026-10-05 07:00:00'],
            'selasa pagi' => ['2026-10-06 07:00:00'],
            'rabu pagi' => ['2026-10-07 07:00:00'],
            'kamis pagi' => ['2026-10-08 07:00:00'],
            'jumat pagi' => ['2026-10-09 07:00:00'],
            'sabtu pagi' => ['2026-10-10 07:00:00'],
            'minggu malam' => ['2026-10-04 23:30:00'],
            'rabu malam' => ['2026-10-07 23:30:00'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('seedingMoments')]
    public function test_the_seeder_completes_at_any_seeding_moment_with_the_core_invariants(string $moment): void
    {
        $this->travelTo($moment);

        $this->seed(DatabaseSeeder::class);

        $count = Appointment::query()->count();
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(25, $count, $moment);
        $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(29, $count, $moment);
        $this->assertSame(6, PatientProfile::query()->where('registration_channel', BookingChannel::Loket->value)->count(), $moment);
        $this->assertSame(1, PracticeSession::query()->where('status', SessionStatus::NeedsReview->value)->count(), $moment);
        $this->assertSame(2, Appointment::query()->where('status', AppointmentStatus::NoShow->value)->count(), $moment);
        $this->assertSame($moment, now()->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'), 'Jam beku tes dipulihkan seeder.');
    }

    public function test_the_seeder_skips_when_appointments_already_exist(): void
    {
        Appointment::factory()->create();
        $profiles = PatientProfile::query()->count();

        $this->seed(AppointmentSeeder::class);

        $this->assertSame($profiles, PatientProfile::query()->count(), 'Penjaga berhenti sebelum membuat walk-in.');
        $this->assertSame(1, Appointment::query()->count());
    }
}

    public function test_every_doctor_has_exactly_one_primary_specialty_and_archive_state_is_consistent(): void
```

Dengan:

```text
    /** SEED-01 fase 7a: 17 invarian 13 §11.1 dari `scripts/sql/seed-invariants.sql`, semuanya `pelanggaran = 0`. */
    public function test_the_seed_invariants_sql_file_reports_zero_violations_after_seeding(): void
    {
        $path = base_path('scripts/sql/seed-invariants.sql');
        $this->assertFileExists($path);
        $contents = (string) file_get_contents($path);

        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/[^\x00-\x7F]/', $contents), 'Berkas SQL harus ASCII murni (13 §11.1).');
        $this->assertSame(17, preg_match_all("/SELECT 'I\\d+ /", $contents), 'Tujuh belas invarian I1 sampai I17.');

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00'); // Senin: A13 sampai A16 mendapat sesi hari ini
        $this->seedDemo();

        $rows = DB::select($this->invariantQuery($contents));

        $this->assertCount(17, $rows);

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $this->assertSame(0, (int) $row->pelanggaran, "Invarian dilanggar: {$row->invarian}");
        }

        // Bukti tes tidak kosong: merusak satu pencacah harus tertangkap I1 dan hanya I1.
        $sessionId = (int) DB::table('appointments')->where('status', 'completed')->orderBy('id')->value('practice_session_id');
        DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('id', $sessionId)->update(['booked_count' => 0]);

        $violations = collect(DB::select($this->invariantQuery($contents)))->filter(fn (object $row): bool => (int) $row->pelanggaran > 0);

        $this->assertSame(1, $violations->count());
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('I1 ', $violations->first()->invarian);
    }

    /** Isi berkas tanpa baris komentar dan titik koma penutup, siap dikirim sebagai satu kueri. */
    private function invariantQuery(string $contents): string
    {
        $lines = array_filter(
            preg_split('/\R/', $contents) ?: [],
            fn (string $line): bool => ! str_starts_with(ltrim($line), '--'),
        );

        return rtrim(trim(implode("\n", $lines)), ';');
    }

use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Data demo pendaftaran (13 §10, F7A-R28): enam profil walk-in (P000008 sampai P000013 pada DB baru), sesi lampau 14 hari,
 * 29 pendaftaran A01 sampai A29, dan pengecualian ketiga yang membuat satu sesi `needs_review`.
 *
 * Semua pendaftaran dan perubahan status lewat service (`BookingService::book()`, `AppointmentStatusService`) di bawah jam
 * semu (`Carbon::setTestNow`, dipulihkan di `finally`), sehingga pencacah sesi, riwayat status, audit, dan notifikasi
 * konsisten (13 §1 butir 3). Sesi lampau dibuat `PracticeSessionGenerator::ensureRange` di bawah jam semu tiap hari lampau,
 * karena generator mengklem rentang ke "hari ini". Hanya `local`/`testing`; berhenti bila sudah ada pendaftaran.
 */
class AppointmentSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public const SUDDEN_LEAVE_REASON = 'Cuti mendadak (contoh)';

    /** Hari lampau yang dibangkitkan sesinya: tepat dua minggu. */
    public const PAST_DAYS = 14;

    /**
     * Profil walk-in menurut urutan nomor pasien 8 sampai 13 (13 §10.1). `key` dipakai internal seeder.
     *
     * @var list<array{key: string, name: string, gender: string, birth_date: string}>
     */
    public const WALK_INS = [
        ['key' => 'eko', 'name' => 'Eko Prasetyo', 'gender' => 'L', 'birth_date' => '1975-03-04'],
        ['key' => 'hesti', 'name' => 'Hesti Purwanti', 'gender' => 'P', 'birth_date' => '1988-08-18'],
        ['key' => 'imam', 'name' => 'Imam Santosa', 'gender' => 'L', 'birth_date' => '1969-06-27'],
        ['key' => 'lukman', 'name' => 'Lukman Fauzi', 'gender' => 'L', 'birth_date' => '1992-10-10'],
        ['key' => 'mulyani', 'name' => 'Mulyani Astuti', 'gender' => 'P', 'birth_date' => '1958-02-20'],
        ['key' => 'nayla', 'name' => 'Nayla Putri Prakoso', 'gender' => 'P', 'birth_date' => '2020-03-18'],
    ];

    /** Kunci internal untuk `PatientSeeder::ACCOUNTS` (urutan sama). */
    private const ONLINE_KEYS = ['anisa', 'budi', 'dewi', 'fitri', 'gilang', 'kartika', 'mulyani_online'];

    private BookingService $booking;

    private AppointmentStatusService $statuses;

    private Actor $officer;

    private Actor $system;

    private CarbonImmutable $today;

    private Closure|CarbonInterface|null $previous = null;

    /** @var Collection<string, Doctor> */
    private Collection $doctors;

    /** @var array<string, PatientProfile> */
    private array $profiles = [];

    private ?int $creatorId = null;

    private ?int $leaveSessionId = null;

    public function run(): void
    {
        if (! app()->environment(['local', 'testing'])) {
            throw new RuntimeException('AppointmentSeeder DILARANG di APP_ENV='.app()->environment().'. Data pendaftaran contoh memakai pasien fiktif dan jam semu.');
        }

        if (Appointment::query()->exists()) {
            $this->command?->warn('Data pendaftaran demo sudah ada, dilewati.');

            return;
        }

        $officer = User::query()->where('email', 'pendaftaran@unpamhospital.test')->first()
            ?? throw new RuntimeException('Akun Petugas Pendaftaran Demo belum ada. Jalankan DemoUserSeeder lebih dulu.');

        $this->booking = app(BookingService::class);
        $this->statuses = app(AppointmentStatusService::class);
        $this->officer = Actor::staff($officer);
        $this->system = Actor::system();
        $this->today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $this->previous = Carbon::getTestNow();
        $this->doctors = Doctor::query()->get()->keyBy('slug');
        $this->creatorId = User::query()->where('email', DoctorScheduleSeeder::CREATOR_EMAIL)->value('id');

        try {
            $this->seedWalkInProfiles($officer);
            $this->loadProfiles();
            $this->ensurePastSessions();
            $this->seedPast();
            $this->seedToday();
            $this->seedUpcoming();
            $this->seedSuddenLeave();
            $this->at(null);
            $this->markPastNotificationsAsRead();
        } finally {
            Carbon::setTestNow($this->previous);
        }

        $this->command?->line('AppointmentSeeder: '.Appointment::query()->count().' pendaftaran contoh dan '.count(self::WALK_INS).' profil walk-in dibuat.');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ profil dan sesi lampau

    /** Enam walk-in lewat createWalkIn (waktu nyata, sebelum jam semu pertama). */
    private function seedWalkInProfiles(User $officer): void
    {
        $service = app(PatientRegistrationService::class);

        foreach (self::WALK_INS as $index => $walkIn) {
            $number = $index + 8;

            $service->createWalkIn([
                'full_name' => $walkIn['name'],
                'birth_date' => $walkIn['birth_date'],
                'gender' => $walkIn['gender'],
                'phone' => '0812000000'.str_pad((string) $number, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT),
                'email' => null,
                'address' => "Jl. Contoh No. {$number}, Pamulang, Tangerang Selatan",
            ], $officer);
        }
    }

    /** Memuat ulang semua profil dengan relasi `user` (mode ketat tidak mengizinkan lazy loading). */
    private function loadProfiles(): void
    {
        foreach (PatientSeeder::ACCOUNTS as $index => $account) {
            $this->profiles[self::ONLINE_KEYS[$index]] = PatientProfile::query()->with('user')->where('email', $account['email'])->first()
                ?? throw new RuntimeException("Profil pasien {$account['email']} belum ada. Jalankan PatientSeeder lebih dulu.");
        }

        foreach (self::WALK_INS as $walkIn) {
            $this->profiles[$walkIn['key']] = PatientProfile::query()->with('user')
                ->where('registration_channel', 'loket')
                ->where('full_name', $walkIn['name'])
                ->firstOrFail();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sesi 14 hari terakhir lewat generator yang sama: `ensureRange` mengklem rentang ke "hari ini" (BR-22), jadi jam
     * semu diatur ke awal tiap hari lampau. Panggilan pertama sudah membuat semuanya; sisanya no-op (`insertOrIgnore`).
     */
    private function ensurePastSessions(): void
    {
        $generator = app(PracticeSessionGenerator::class);
        $yesterday = $this->today->subDay();

        for ($offset = self::PAST_DAYS; $offset >= 1; $offset--) {
            $day = $this->today->subDays($offset);

            $this->at($day->startOfDay());
            $generator->ensureRange($day, $yesterday);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ skenario

    /** A01 sampai A12 dan penandaan tidak hadir A10 lalu A09. */
    private function seedPast(): void
    {
        $umum = $this->umum();

        // A01 sampai A03 dan A07, A08: pasien online, konfirmasi petugas, check-in, selesai.
        $this->visitOnline('anisa', 'rani-oktaviani', 1, $umum);
        $this->visitOnline('budi', 'sekar-ayuningtyas', 2, $this->bpjs('0009900000022', complaint: 'Kontrol rutin'));
        $this->visitOnline('dewi', 'nadira-kusumawardani', 1, $umum);

        // A04 sampai A06: walk-in loket (langsung confirmed), check-in, selesai.
        $this->visitCounter('eko', 'teguh-wicaksono', 1, $umum);
        $this->visitCounter('nayla', 'laras-wulandari', 1, $this->bpjs('0009900000055', save: true));
        $this->visitCounter('hesti', 'citra-anindya-putri', 1, $umum);

        $this->visitOnline('fitri', 'intan-permatasari', 1, $this->asuransi('asuransi-contoh-sehat', 'POL-CONTOH-001'));
        $this->visitOnline('anisa', 'ayu-larasati-hakim', 2, $umum);

        // A09 (online, menunggu penandaan sistem) dan A10 (loket, menunggu penandaan petugas).
        $a09 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['gilang'], $this->pastSessions('arif-budiman-santoso'), fn (PracticeSession $s): CarbonImmutable => $this->dayBefore($s, 10), $umum, false);
        $this->move($a09, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->officer, $this->dayBefore($a09->practiceSession, 14));
        $a10 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['imam'], $this->pastSessions('hendra-mahardika'), fn (PracticeSession $s): CarbonImmutable => $s->starts_at->subMinutes(30), $umum, true);

        // A11: dibatalkan pasien; A12: dibatalkan petugas.
        $a11 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['kartika'], $this->pastSessions('maya-kartika-sari'), fn (PracticeSession $s): CarbonImmutable => $this->dayBefore($s, 10), $umum, false);
        $this->move($a11, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, Actor::patient($this->profiles['kartika']->user), $this->dayBefore($a11->practiceSession, 16), 'Berhalangan hadir');

        $a12 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['budi'], $this->pastSessions('yoga-prasetya'), fn (PracticeSession $s): CarbonImmutable => $this->dayBefore($s, 10), $umum, false);
        $this->move($a12, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->officer, $this->dayBefore($a12->practiceSession, 14));
        $this->move($a12, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->officer, $this->dayBefore($a12->practiceSession, 15), 'Pasien meminta pembatalan melalui telepon');

        // Tidak hadir: petugas (aksi massal sesi A10) LEBIH DULU, baru sistem (perintah per tanggal A09); kalau terbalik,
        // A10 yang masih confirmed ikut ditandai aktor sistem bila kedua sesi jatuh pada tanggal yang sama.
        $session10 = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($a10->practice_session_id);
        $this->at($session10->ends_at->addMinutes(15));
        $this->statuses->markNoShowForSession($session10, $this->officer);

        $session09 = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($a09->practice_session_id);
        $this->at($session09->ends_at->addMinutes(10));
        $this->statuses->markNoShowForDate($session09->session_date, $this->system);
    }

    /** A13 sampai A16 pada sesi hari ini (dilewati dengan peringatan bila hari seeding tidak punya sesi). */
    private function seedToday(): void
    {
        $sessions = $this->todaySessions();

        if ($sessions->isEmpty()) {
            $this->command?->warn('Tidak ada sesi hari ini; pendaftaran contoh A13 sampai A16 dilewati.');

            return;
        }

        $umum = $this->umum();
        $online = fn (PracticeSession $s): CarbonImmutable => $this->dayBefore($s, 10);
        $counter = fn (PracticeSession $s): CarbonImmutable => $s->starts_at->subMinutes(30);

        // A13: pending. A14: dikonfirmasi petugas. A15: loket, sudah check-in. A16: loket, confirmed.
        $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['anisa'], $this->todayCandidates($sessions, 1), $online, $umum, false);

        $a14 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['budi'], $this->todayCandidates($sessions, 2), $online, $this->bpjs('0009900000022'), false);
        $this->move($a14, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->officer, $this->dayBefore($a14->practiceSession, 14));

        $a15 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['hesti'], $this->todayCandidates($sessions, 3), $counter, $umum, true);
        $this->move($a15, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->officer, $a15->practiceSession->starts_at->subMinutes(20));

        $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['lukman'], $this->todayCandidates($sessions, 1), $counter, $umum, true);
    }

    /** A17 sampai A29 pada sesi mendatang dan sesi manual, semuanya pada waktu nyata. */
    private function seedUpcoming(): void
    {
        $umum = $this->umum();
        $real = fn (PracticeSession $s): ?CarbonImmutable => null;

        $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['anisa'], $this->futureSessions('raka-pradipta-wibowo'), $real, $this->bpjs('0009900000011'), false);

        $a18 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['budi'], $this->futureSessions('sekar-ayuningtyas'), $real, $umum, false);
        $this->move($a18, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->officer, null);

        $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['dewi'], $this->futureSessions('maya-kartika-sari'), $real, $this->asuransi('asuransi-contoh-sentosa'), false);

        $a20 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['fitri'], $this->futureSessions('nadira-kusumawardani'), $real, $this->bpjs('0009900000033'), false);
        $this->move($a20, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->officer, null);

        $a21 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['gilang'], $this->futureSessions('fajar-ramadhan-lubis'), $real, $umum, false);
        $this->move($a21, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->officer, null);

        // A22 dibatalkan pasien sebelum A23 memesan sesi yang sama (antrean 1 tidak dipakai ulang; A23 mendapat antrean 2).
        $a22 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['kartika'], $this->futureSessions('intan-permatasari'), $real, $umum, false);
        $this->move($a22, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->officer, null);
        $this->move($a22, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, Actor::patient($this->profiles['kartika']->user), null, 'Jadwal bentrok dengan pekerjaan');

        $a23 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['fitri'], PracticeSession::query()->whereKey($a22->practice_session_id)->get(), $real, $umum, false);
        $this->move($a23, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->officer, null);

        // A24 dan A25: walk-in loket BPJS; A25 menyimpan nomor BPJS ke profil.
        $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['nayla'], $this->futureSessions('laras-wulandari')->slice(1)->values(), $real, $this->bpjs('0009900000055'), true);
        $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['mulyani'], $this->futureSessions('bagas-setiawan-nugroho'), $real, $this->bpjs('0009900000044', save: true), true);

        // A26 dan A27: sesi pertama Hendra pada atau setelah hari ini + 5 (tanggal pengecualian ketiga).
        $a26 = $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['budi'], $this->futureSessions('hendra-mahardika', 5), $real, $umum, false);
        $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['lukman'], PracticeSession::query()->whereKey($a26->practice_session_id)->get(), $real, $umum, true);
        $this->leaveSessionId = (int) $a26->practice_session_id;

        // A28 dan A29: sesi tambahan manual kuota 2 (menjadi penuh).
        $manual = $this->manualSessions();

        if ($manual->isEmpty()) {
            $this->command?->warn('Sesi tambahan manual dr. Teguh tidak ada; A28 dan A29 dilewati.');

            return;
        }

        $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['dewi'], $manual, $real, $umum, false);
        $this->bookFirst($this->profiles['kartika'], $manual, $real, $umum, false);
    }

    /** Pengecualian ketiga pada tanggal sesi A26/A27: sesi menjadi `needs_review` (menunggu layar 7b). */
    private function seedSuddenLeave(): void
    {
        if ($this->leaveSessionId === null) {
            return;
        }

        $session = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($this->leaveSessionId);
        $this->at(null);

        $exception = new ScheduleException([
            'doctor_id' => $session->doctor_id,
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'start_date' => $session->session_date->toDateString(),
            'end_date' => $session->session_date->toDateString(),
            'reason' => self::SUDDEN_LEAVE_REASON,
        ]);
        $exception->forceFill(['created_by' => $this->creatorId]);
        $exception->save();

        app(ScheduleChangeService::class)->applyException($exception, null, $this->system);
    }

    /** Notifikasi pendaftaran lampau ditandai dibaca; yang hari ini dan mendatang tetap belum dibaca. */
    private function markPastNotificationsAsRead(): void
    {
        $past = Appointment::query()
            ->where('session_date', '<', $this->today->toDateString())
            ->pluck('id')
            ->map(fn ($id): int => (int) $id)
            ->all();

        if ($past === []) {
            return;
        }

        DatabaseNotification::query()->whereNull('read_at')->get()
            ->filter(fn (DatabaseNotification $notification): bool => in_array((int) ($notification->data['appointment_id'] ?? 0), $past, true))
            ->each(fn (DatabaseNotification $notification) => $notification->markAsRead());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ alur kunjungan

    /** Online: pending (hari sebelum 10.00), confirmed (hari sebelum 14.00), check-in (start - 20), selesai (start + 40). */
    private function visitOnline(string $profile, string $doctor, int $nth, BookingData $data): Appointment
    {
        $appointment = $this->bookFirst(
            $this->profiles[$profile],
            $this->pastSessions($doctor)->slice($nth - 1)->values(),
            fn (PracticeSession $s): CarbonImmutable => $this->dayBefore($s, 10),
            $data,
            false,
        );
        $session = $appointment->practiceSession;

        $this->move($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->officer, $this->dayBefore($session, 14));
        $this->move($appointment, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->officer, $session->starts_at->subMinutes(20));
        $this->move($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Completed, $this->officer, $session->starts_at->addMinutes(40));

        return $appointment;
    }

    /** Loket: confirmed saat dibuat (start - 30), check-in (start - 20), selesai (start + 40). */
    private function visitCounter(string $profile, string $doctor, int $nth, BookingData $data): Appointment
    {
        $appointment = $this->bookFirst(
            $this->profiles[$profile],
            $this->pastSessions($doctor)->slice($nth - 1)->values(),
            fn (PracticeSession $s): CarbonImmutable => $s->starts_at->subMinutes(30),
            $data,
            true,
        );
        $session = $appointment->practiceSession;

        $this->move($appointment, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->officer, $session->starts_at->subMinutes(20));
        $this->move($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Completed, $this->officer, $session->starts_at->addMinutes(40));

        return $appointment;
    }

    /**
     * Mendaftar pada kandidat pertama yang diterima. Jam semu diatur per kandidat (null = waktu nyata). Kandidat yang
     * ditolak karena bentrok, duplikat, kuota penuh, atau tidak tersedia dilewati; galat lain dilempar.
     *
     * @param  iterable<PracticeSession>  $candidates
     * @param  Closure(PracticeSession): ?CarbonInterface  $moment
     */
    private function bookFirst(PatientProfile $profile, iterable $candidates, Closure $moment, BookingData $data, bool $counter): Appointment
    {
        $actor = $counter ? $this->officer : Actor::patient($profile->user ?? throw new RuntimeException('Pasien online tanpa akun.'));
        $last = null;

        foreach ($candidates as $session) {
            $this->at($moment($session));

            try {
                return $this->booking->book($profile, (int) $session->getKey(), $data, $actor);
            } catch (BookingException $e) {
                if (! in_array($e->errorCode, [
                    BookingException::OVERLAPPING_BOOKING,
                    BookingException::DUPLICATE_BOOKING,
                    BookingException::QUOTA_FULL,
                    BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE,
                ], true)) {
                    throw $e;
                }

                $last = $e;
            }
        }

        throw new RuntimeException('Tidak ada sesi yang dapat dipakai untuk skenario pendaftaran contoh.', 0, $last);
    }

    /** Satu transisi lewat service pada jam semu `$moment` (null = waktu nyata). */
    private function move(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, ?CarbonInterface $moment, ?string $reason = null): void
    {
        $this->at($moment);
        $this->statuses->transition($appointment, $to, $actor, $reason);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pemilih sesi

    /** Sesi `open` dokter sebelum hari ini, terbaru dulu: `lampau-N` = irisan mulai indeks N-1. */
    private function pastSessions(string $slug): Collection
    {
        return PracticeSession::query()
            ->where('doctor_id', $this->doctor($slug)->id)
            ->where('status', SessionStatus::Open->value)
            ->where('session_date', '<', $this->today->toDateString())
            ->orderByDesc('session_date')
            ->orderByDesc('start_time')
            ->orderByDesc('id')
            ->get();
    }

    /** Sesi `open` dokter dengan `session_date >= today + $minDays`, terdekat dulu (`depan-N`). */
    private function futureSessions(string $slug, int $minDays = 1): Collection
    {
        return PracticeSession::query()
            ->where('doctor_id', $this->doctor($slug)->id)
            ->where('status', SessionStatus::Open->value)
            ->where('session_date', '>=', $this->today->addDays($minDays)->toDateString())
            ->orderBy('session_date')
            ->orderBy('start_time')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get();
    }

    /** Sesi `open` hari ini urut jam mulai, satu per poliklinik (`hari ini-N`). */
    private function todaySessions(): Collection
    {
        return PracticeSession::query()
            ->where('session_date', $this->today->toDateString())
            ->where('status', SessionStatus::Open->value)
            ->orderBy('start_time')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get()
            ->unique('clinic_id')
            ->values();
    }

    /** Kandidat `hari ini-N`: mulai dari sesi ke-N lalu sisanya (berputar bila sesi kurang dari tiga). */
    private function todayCandidates(Collection $sessions, int $nth): Collection
    {
        return $sessions->slice($nth - 1)->concat($sessions->slice(0, $nth - 1))->values();
    }

    /** Sesi tambahan manual kuota 2 dr. Teguh (ScheduleExceptionSeeder). */
    private function manualSessions(): Collection
    {
        return PracticeSession::query()
            ->where('doctor_id', $this->doctor('teguh-wicaksono')->id)
            ->where('status_reason', ScheduleExceptionSeeder::EXTRA_REASON)
            ->where('status', SessionStatus::Open->value)
            ->orderBy('session_date')
            ->get();
    }

    private function doctor(string $slug): Doctor
    {
        return $this->doctors->get($slug) ?? throw new RuntimeException("Dokter {$slug} belum ada. Jalankan DoctorSeeder lebih dulu.");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ waktu dan data pembayaran

    /** Jam semu: hari sebelum sesi pada `$hour:$minute`. */
    private function dayBefore(PracticeSession $session, int $hour, int $minute = 0): CarbonImmutable
    {
        return $session->starts_at->startOfDay()->subDay()->setTime($hour, $minute);
    }

    /** Mengatur jam semu; null memulihkan jam sebelum seeder (nyata atau beku oleh tes). */
    private function at(?CarbonInterface $moment): void
    {
        Carbon::setTestNow($moment ?? $this->previous);
    }

    private function umum(): BookingData
    {
        return new BookingData(paymentType: PaymentType::Umum);
    }

    private function bpjs(string $number, bool $save = false, ?string $complaint = null): BookingData
    {
        return new BookingData(paymentType: PaymentType::Bpjs, paymentReference: $number, complaint: $complaint, saveBpjs: $save);
    }

    private function asuransi(string $slug, ?string $policy = null): BookingData
    {
        $partnerId = InsurancePartner::query()->where('slug', $slug)->value('id')
            ?? throw new RuntimeException("Mitra asuransi {$slug} belum ada. Jalankan ContentSeeder lebih dulu.");

        return new BookingData(paymentType: PaymentType::Asuransi, paymentReference: $policy, insurancePartnerId: (int) $partnerId);
    }
}
```

```sql
-- UNPAM HOSPITAL: invarian setelah seeding (13 section 11.1; 15 SEED-01).
-- ASCII murni, kompatibel MariaDB 10.4. Hasil lulus: 17 baris dengan pelanggaran = 0.
-- Jalankan (PowerShell; password dari .env DB_PASSWORD, jangan diketik di riwayat perintah):
--   $env:MYSQL_PWD = "<DB_PASSWORD>"
--   Get-Content -Raw "D:\Project Web RS\scripts\sql\seed-invariants.sql" | & "C:\xampp3\mysql\bin\mysql.exe" -u unpam_app --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --table unpam_hospital
--   Remove-Item Env:\MYSQL_PWD
SELECT 'I1 booked_count = appointment non-batal' AS invarian, COUNT(*) AS pelanggaran FROM (
  SELECT ps.id FROM practice_sessions ps
  LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.practice_session_id = ps.id AND a.status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY ps.id, ps.booked_count HAVING ps.booked_count <> COUNT(a.id)) x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I2 last_queue_number >= MAX(queue_number)', COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT ps.id FROM practice_sessions ps JOIN appointments a ON a.practice_session_id = ps.id
  GROUP BY ps.id, ps.last_queue_number HAVING ps.last_queue_number < MAX(a.queue_number)) x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I3 last_queue_number = jumlah seluruh appointment', COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT ps.id FROM practice_sessions ps LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.practice_session_id = ps.id
  GROUP BY ps.id, ps.last_queue_number HAVING ps.last_queue_number <> COUNT(a.id)) x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I4 tidak ada duplikat aktif pasien+sesi', COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT patient_profile_id, practice_session_id FROM appointments
  WHERE status IN ('pending','confirmed','checked_in')
  GROUP BY patient_profile_id, practice_session_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I5 tidak ada benturan jam aktif', COUNT(*) FROM appointments a1
  JOIN appointments a2 ON a2.patient_profile_id = a1.patient_profile_id
   AND a2.session_date = a1.session_date AND a2.id > a1.id
  JOIN practice_sessions s1 ON s1.id = a1.practice_session_id
  JOIN practice_sessions s2 ON s2.id = a2.practice_session_id
  WHERE a1.status IN ('pending','confirmed','checked_in')
    AND a2.status IN ('pending','confirmed','checked_in')
    AND s1.start_time < s2.end_time AND s2.start_time < s1.end_time
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I6 denormalisasi appointment = sesi', COUNT(*) FROM appointments a
  JOIN practice_sessions ps ON ps.id = a.practice_session_id
  WHERE a.doctor_id <> ps.doctor_id OR a.clinic_id <> ps.clinic_id OR a.session_date <> ps.session_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I7 beds_available dalam 0..bed_capacity', COUNT(*) FROM room_categories
  WHERE beds_available < 0 OR beds_available > bed_capacity
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I8 booked_count dalam 0..quota', COUNT(*) FROM practice_sessions
  WHERE booked_count < 0 OR booked_count > quota
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I9 status = riwayat terakhir', COUNT(*) FROM appointments a
  WHERE a.status <> COALESCE((SELECT h.to_status FROM appointment_status_histories h
                              WHERE h.appointment_id = a.id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1), '')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I10 cap waktu status terisi', COUNT(*) FROM appointments
  WHERE (status = 'checked_in' AND checked_in_at IS NULL)
     OR (status = 'completed' AND completed_at IS NULL)
     OR (status = 'no_show' AND no_show_at IS NULL)
     OR (status = 'cancelled' AND (cancelled_at IS NULL OR cancelled_by_type IS NULL))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I11 konsistensi pembayaran', COUNT(*) FROM appointments
  WHERE (payment_type = 'bpjs' AND (payment_reference IS NULL OR payment_reference_last4 IS NULL))
     OR (payment_type = 'asuransi' AND insurance_partner_id IS NULL)
     OR (payment_type = 'umum' AND (payment_reference IS NOT NULL OR insurance_partner_id IS NOT NULL))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I12 format booking_code', COUNT(*) FROM appointments
  WHERE booking_code NOT REGEXP '^UPH-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}$'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I13 needs_review punya pending_change', COUNT(*) FROM practice_sessions
  WHERE status = 'needs_review' AND pending_change IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I14 audit_logs tanpa deret 13 digit', COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs
  WHERE CONCAT_WS(' ', description, old_values, new_values) REGEXP '[0-9]{13}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I15 format patient_number', COUNT(*) FROM patient_profiles
  WHERE patient_number IS NULL OR patient_number <> CONCAT('P', LPAD(id, 6, '0'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I16 email profil = email akun', COUNT(*) FROM patient_profiles p
  JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
  WHERE p.email IS NULL OR p.email <> u.email
UNION ALL
SELECT 'I17 is_active profil = is_active akun', COUNT(*) FROM patient_profiles p
  JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
  WHERE p.is_active <> u.is_active;
```

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari kode):**
1. **Middleware persis.** `route:list --json` pada `master` memberi untuk route admin `["web","auth","account:staff","active","password.changed","permission:…"]` (contoh `admin.doctors.index`, `admin.messages.status`). `gatherMiddleware()` memberi urutan yang sama; tes memfilter hanya string (`array_filter(…, 'is_string')`) seperti fase 5 dan 6. Route resource di dalam grup `Route::middleware('permission:…')` tidak menambah middleware sendiri.
2. **`wheres` admin berisi SELURUH daftar grup.** `bootstrap/app.php` memasang `->where(array_fill_keys([...], '[0-9]+'))` untuk semua route admin, sehingga `$route->wheres` memuat puluhan kunci (bukan hanya parameter route itu). Karena itu tes fase 7a TIDAK membandingkan `wheres` utuh seperti `Phase6RoutePermissionTest`: ia memeriksa `wheres['appointment']` = pola kode booking pada tiga route berkode, kunci `appointment` TIDAK ada pada route admin lain (bukti T8 menghapusnya dari daftar numerik, F7A-R3), serta `wheres['patient']` dan `wheres['session']` = `[0-9]+`. `Route::bindingFields()` = `['appointment' => 'booking_code']` hanya pada `show`, `transition`, `proof`. `$route->uri()` membuang `:booking_code` sehingga URI = `admin/pendaftaran/{appointment}` (pola yang sama dengan `Phase6RoutePermissionTest`).
3. **Hitungan route.** `master` 150 (106 admin, 13 `/pasien`) + 16 = **166** (122 admin). Tes menghitung aksi berawalan `App\` seperti fase 6 (tiga route vendor berupa Closure tidak dihitung). Hitungan antara T5 sampai T10 (152/108, 157/113, 158/114, 162/118, 164/120, 166/122) dikunci tugas masing-masing lewat `route:list`, bukan tes.
4. **Peta tes yang sudah ada (agar T13 tidak menduplikasi).** T5: `AdminPatientsIndexTest`/`AdminPatientShowTest` (akses per peran, Admin Konten 403 dan tanpa data pasien, pasien 403, tamu ke login, nama ter-escape, BPJS tersamar), `PatientPageMatrixTest` AKS-06 (`/admin/pasien` dan detail 403; `/admin/pengaturan` 404). T6/T7: akses mutasi Admin Konten/pasien/tamu per layar. T8: akses per peran, izin lihat saja, PAS-04, SEK-15 per layar. T9: akses form, Admin Konten/pasien 403 pada `store`. T10: akses antrean dan `mark-no-show`, izin lihat saja, nama ter-escape. T13 menambah TIGA hal yang tidak ada di sana: (a) satu matriks seragam 16 route × 5 aktor × GET/mutasi di `AdminPageMatrixTest` dan pembagian izin per route (satu izin tepat, tiga izin lain ditolak), (b) kunci akhir `Phase7aRoutePermissionTest`, (c) sapuan lintas layar (satu fixture, 22 halaman, audit/flash/notifikasi) serta pemindaian view. Tes per layar TIDAK diubah.
5. **Kode booking nyata untuk semua aktor.** Pola fase 6 (catatan teknis 2): urutan `SubstituteBindings` terhadap `account:staff` dan `permission:*` tidak dikunci kerangka, jadi matriks selalu memberi route berkode sebuah kode booking NYATA (kode, id profil, dan id sesi nyata). Kode tak ada atau salah format = 404 diuji di `Phase7aRoutePermissionTest` lewat pencocokan route, bukan lewat respons per aktor. Untuk alasan yang sama, pemeriksaan "tanpa kueri data pasien" pada PAS-07 hanya untuk route tanpa parameter (index, create, store): pada route berparameter, binding model dapat mengueri `patient_profiles` sebelum middleware izin menolak (CELAH C-14 digest) dan itu bukan kebocoran ke pengguna.
6. **Hasil sel matriks.** `L` = redirect `admin.login`; `403`; `200`; `OK` = lolos otorisasi (200/201/204/302/422, bukan 403 dan bukan login) karena badan kosong membuat Form Request menolak validasi dengan 302; `G` = tamu (302 login atau 401). Layar #37/#38 = `['L','403','403','200','200']` (Tamu, Pasien, Admin Konten, Petugas, Super Admin), mutasi = `['G','403','403','OK','OK']`, sama dengan kotak pesan kontak (15 §3.3 baris 39b). Baris 38b (ekspor CSV) dan 35c (Sesi Terdampak) TIDAK ditambah (fase 8 dan 7b).
7. **Izin kustom.** Pola T8 (`seedRoles()`; `User::factory()->staff()->create()`; `givePermissionTo()`) dipakai tes pembagian izin: untuk tiap route, pengguna yang HANYA memegang izin route itu lolos otorisasi, sedangkan pengguna yang memegang ketiga izin lain dari empat izin (`patients.view`, `patients.manage`, `appointments.view`, `appointments.manage`) mendapat 403.
