- [ ] **Step 2: Tulis `tests/Feature/Access/Phase7aRoutePermissionTest.php` (tool Write)**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Access;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Booking\BookingCodeGenerator;
use App\Support\NavigationMenu;
use Database\Seeders\RolePermissionSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\MethodNotAllowedHttpException;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\NotFoundHttpException;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * KNS-01 (bagian fase 7a), KNS-02 (route `admin.*` berpagar), dan KNS-03 (izin tetap 19): 16 route baru persis kerangka C.1
 * (nama, URI, method, middleware berurutan, action), pola kode booking dan binding `booking_code` pada tiga route
 * `{appointment}`, serta angka AKHIR fase 7a: 166 route aplikasi (150 + 16), 122 di `/admin` (106 + 16), dan 13 di `/pasien`.
 * Angka global tidak lagi dikunci di `Phase4b`/`Phase5`/`Phase6RoutePermissionTest` sejak T5 (F7A-R4). Fase 7b dan 8 memperbarui
 * daftar "route yang belum ada" di bawah.
 */
class Phase7aRoutePermissionTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const ADMIN_NAMESPACE = 'App\\Http\\Controllers\\Admin\\';

    private const CODE_PATTERN = 'UPH-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}';

    private const SAMPLE_CODE = 'UPH-ABCD-EFGH';

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string, list<string>, list<string>, string}> */
    public static function routes(): array
    {
        $guard = ['web', 'auth', 'account:staff', 'active', 'password.changed'];
        $get = ['GET', 'HEAD'];
        $patients = self::ADMIN_NAMESPACE.'PatientController@';
        $appointments = self::ADMIN_NAMESPACE.'AppointmentController@';
        $queue = self::ADMIN_NAMESPACE.'QueueController@';

        $rows = [
            'admin.patients.index' => ['admin/pasien', $get, 'patients.view', $patients.'index'],
            'admin.patients.create' => ['admin/pasien/buat', $get, 'patients.manage', $patients.'create'],
            'admin.patients.store' => ['admin/pasien', ['POST'], 'patients.manage', $patients.'store'],
            'admin.patients.show' => ['admin/pasien/{patient}', $get, 'patients.view', $patients.'show'],
            'admin.patients.edit' => ['admin/pasien/{patient}/ubah', $get, 'patients.manage', $patients.'edit'],
            'admin.patients.update' => ['admin/pasien/{patient}', ['PUT', 'PATCH'], 'patients.manage', $patients.'update'],
            'admin.patients.status' => ['admin/pasien/{patient}/status', ['PATCH'], 'patients.manage', $patients.'status'],
            'admin.patients.link-account' => ['admin/pasien/{patient}/hubungkan-akun', ['POST'], 'patients.manage', $patients.'linkAccount'],
            'admin.appointments.index' => ['admin/pendaftaran', $get, 'appointments.view', $appointments.'index'],
            'admin.appointments.create' => ['admin/pendaftaran/buat', $get, 'appointments.manage', $appointments.'create'],
            'admin.appointments.store' => ['admin/pendaftaran', ['POST'], 'appointments.manage', $appointments.'store'],
            'admin.appointments.show' => ['admin/pendaftaran/{appointment}', $get, 'appointments.view', $appointments.'show'],
            'admin.appointments.transition' => ['admin/pendaftaran/{appointment}/status', ['POST'], 'appointments.manage', $appointments.'transition'],
            'admin.appointments.proof' => ['admin/pendaftaran/{appointment}/bukti', $get, 'appointments.view', $appointments.'proof'],
            'admin.queue.index' => ['admin/antrean', $get, 'appointments.view', $queue.'index'],
            'admin.queue.mark-no-show' => ['admin/antrean/{session}/tidak-hadir', ['POST'], 'appointments.manage', $queue.'markNoShow'],
        ];

        $cases = [];

        foreach ($rows as $name => [$uri, $methods, $permission, $action]) {
            $cases[$name] = [$name, $uri, $methods, [...$guard, 'permission:'.$permission], $action];
        }

        return $cases;
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string>  $methods
     * @param  list<string>  $middleware
     */
    #[DataProvider('routes')]
    public function test_route_exists_with_the_documented_uri_methods_middleware_and_action(string $name, string $uri, array $methods, array $middleware, string $action): void
    {
        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name);

        $this->assertNotNull($route, "Route {$name} belum terdaftar.");
        $this->assertSame($uri, $route->uri(), $name);
        $this->assertSame($methods, $route->methods(), $name);
        $this->assertSame($middleware, array_values(array_filter($route->gatherMiddleware(), 'is_string')), "Middleware {$name} harus persis dan berurutan.");
        $this->assertSame($action, $route->getActionName(), $name);
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string>  $methods
     * @param  list<string>  $middleware
     */
    #[DataProvider('routes')]
    public function test_the_action_points_to_an_existing_controller_method(string $name, string $uri, array $methods, array $middleware, string $action): void
    {
        [$class, $method] = explode('@', $action);

        $this->assertTrue(class_exists($class), "{$class} belum ada.");
        $this->assertTrue(method_exists($class, $method), "{$class}::{$method} belum ada.");
    }

    public function test_the_phase_7a_route_names_are_the_sixteen_documented_ones_and_nothing_else_under_the_three_prefixes(): void
    {
        $expected = array_keys(self::routes());

        $this->assertCount(16, $expected);

        $found = [];

        foreach (Route::getRoutes()->getRoutes() as $route) {
            $name = (string) $route->getName();

            if (preg_match('/^admin\.(patients|appointments|queue)\./', $name) === 1) {
                $found[] = $name;
            }
        }

        sort($expected);
        sort($found);

        $this->assertSame($expected, $found, 'Nama route 7a harus tepat 16 dan tidak ganda.');
    }

    public function test_the_admin_area_has_one_hundred_and_twenty_two_routes_after_phase_7a(): void
    {
        $count = 0;

        foreach (Route::getRoutes()->getRoutes() as $route) {
            if ($route->uri() === 'admin' || str_starts_with($route->uri(), 'admin/')) {
                $count++;
            }
        }

        // 31 fase 1-2 + 19 fase 3 + 40 fase 4a + 16 fase 4b + 16 fase 7a = 122 (106 + 16). Fase 7b dan 8 memperbarui angka ini.
        $this->assertSame(122, $count);
    }

    /**
     * Setara `route:list --except-vendor`: route milik aplikasi (aksi `App\…`). Tiga route vendor (`storage.local`,
     * `storage.local.upload`, `up`) berupa Closure dan tidak dihitung. 150 sebelum fase 7a + 16 = 166.
     */
    public function test_the_application_has_one_hundred_and_sixty_six_routes_after_phase_7a(): void
    {
        $count = 0;

        foreach (Route::getRoutes()->getRoutes() as $route) {
            if (str_starts_with($route->getActionName(), 'App\\')) {
                $count++;
            }
        }

        $this->assertSame(166, $count);
    }

    public function test_there_are_still_exactly_thirteen_routes_under_pasien(): void
    {
        $found = [];

        foreach (Route::getRoutes()->getRoutes() as $route) {
            if ($route->uri() === 'pasien' || str_starts_with($route->uri(), 'pasien/')) {
                $found[] = (string) $route->getName();
            }
        }

        $expected = [
            'patient.dashboard', 'patient.profile.edit', 'patient.profile.update', 'patient.password.update',
            'patient.appointments.create', 'patient.appointments.review', 'patient.appointments.store', 'patient.appointments.show',
            'patient.appointments.index', 'patient.appointments.cancel', 'patient.appointments.proof', 'patient.appointments.proof-pdf',
            'patient.notifications.read',
        ];

        sort($found);
        sort($expected);

        $this->assertCount(13, $found);
        $this->assertSame($expected, $found);
    }

    /** KNS-02: tiap route 7a memuat tepat satu `permission:*` dan tidak memakai `role:`, `role_or_permission:`, atau `can:`. */
    public function test_every_phase_7a_route_has_exactly_one_permission_and_no_role_or_gate_middleware(): void
    {
        foreach (array_keys(self::routes()) as $name) {
            $middleware = array_values(array_filter(Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name)->gatherMiddleware(), 'is_string'));

            $this->assertCount(1, array_filter($middleware, fn (string $item): bool => str_starts_with($item, 'permission:')), "{$name}: harus tepat satu permission:*.");

            foreach ($middleware as $item) {
                $this->assertFalse(
                    str_starts_with($item, 'role:') || str_starts_with($item, 'role_or_permission:') || str_starts_with($item, 'can:'),
                    "{$name}: otorisasi lewat izin Spatie dan Policy, bukan {$item}.",
                );
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_the_appointment_routes_use_the_booking_code_pattern_and_bind_by_booking_code(): void
    {
        foreach (['show', 'transition', 'proof'] as $suffix) {
            $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName('admin.appointments.'.$suffix);

            $this->assertSame(self::CODE_PATTERN, $route->wheres['appointment'] ?? null, $suffix);
            $this->assertSame(['appointment' => 'booking_code'], $route->bindingFields(), $suffix);
        }

        foreach (['index', 'create', 'store'] as $suffix) {
            $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName('admin.appointments.'.$suffix);

            $this->assertSame([], $route->bindingFields(), $suffix);
            $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('appointment', $route->wheres, $suffix);
        }

        // `appointment` tidak lagi dipaksa numerik oleh grup admin (F7A-R3); `patient` dan `session` tetap numerik.
        foreach (['admin.patients.show', 'admin.patients.update', 'admin.queue.mark-no-show', 'admin.doctors.show'] as $name) {
            $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('appointment', Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name)->wheres, $name);
        }

        foreach (['admin.patients.show', 'admin.patients.edit', 'admin.patients.update', 'admin.patients.status', 'admin.patients.link-account'] as $name) {
            $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name);

            $this->assertSame('[0-9]+', $route->wheres['patient'] ?? null, $name);
            $this->assertSame([], $route->bindingFields(), $name);
        }

        $mark = Route::getRoutes()->getByName('admin.queue.mark-no-show');

        $this->assertSame('[0-9]+', $mark->wheres['session'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame([], $mark->bindingFields());

        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/^'.self::CODE_PATTERN.'$/', BookingCodeGenerator::generate());
    }

    /** `buat` didaftarkan sebelum parameter: `/admin/pasien/buat` dan `/admin/pendaftaran/buat` tidak tertangkap `{patient}`/`{appointment}`. */
    public function test_static_routes_are_registered_before_the_wildcard_routes(): void
    {
        $order = [];

        foreach (Route::getRoutes()->getRoutes() as $index => $route) {
            $order[(string) $route->getName()] = $index;
        }

        $this->assertLessThan($order['admin.patients.show'], $order['admin.patients.create']);
        $this->assertLessThan($order['admin.appointments.show'], $order['admin.appointments.create']);
    }

    public function test_urls_resolve_to_the_documented_routes_and_wrong_formats_do_not_match(): void
    {
        $code = self::SAMPLE_CODE;

        $matches = [
            ['/admin/pasien', 'GET', 'admin.patients.index'],
            ['/admin/pasien/buat', 'GET', 'admin.patients.create'],
            ['/admin/pasien', 'POST', 'admin.patients.store'],
            ['/admin/pasien/12', 'GET', 'admin.patients.show'],
            ['/admin/pasien/12/ubah', 'GET', 'admin.patients.edit'],
            ['/admin/pasien/12', 'PUT', 'admin.patients.update'],
            ['/admin/pasien/12', 'PATCH', 'admin.patients.update'],
            ['/admin/pasien/12/status', 'PATCH', 'admin.patients.status'],
            ['/admin/pasien/12/hubungkan-akun', 'POST', 'admin.patients.link-account'],
            ['/admin/pendaftaran', 'GET', 'admin.appointments.index'],
            ['/admin/pendaftaran/buat', 'GET', 'admin.appointments.create'],
            ['/admin/pendaftaran', 'POST', 'admin.appointments.store'],
            ["/admin/pendaftaran/{$code}", 'GET', 'admin.appointments.show'],
            ["/admin/pendaftaran/{$code}/status", 'POST', 'admin.appointments.transition'],
            ["/admin/pendaftaran/{$code}/bukti", 'GET', 'admin.appointments.proof'],
            ['/admin/antrean', 'GET', 'admin.queue.index'],
            ['/admin/antrean/7/tidak-hadir', 'POST', 'admin.queue.mark-no-show'],
        ];

        foreach ($matches as [$uri, $method, $name]) {
            $this->assertSame($name, Route::getRoutes()->match(Request::create($uri, $method))->getName(), "{$method} {$uri}");
        }

        $misses = [
            ['/admin/pasien/abc', 'GET'],
            ['/admin/pasien/abc/ubah', 'GET'],
            ['/admin/pasien/12/hapus', 'POST'],
            ['/admin/pendaftaran/UPH-ABCD-EFGI', 'GET'],
            ['/admin/pendaftaran/uph-abcd-efgh', 'GET'],
            ['/admin/pendaftaran/12', 'GET'],
            ["/admin/pendaftaran/{$code}/hapus", 'POST'],
            ["/admin/pendaftaran/{$code}/bukti.pdf", 'GET'],
            ['/admin/antrean/abc/tidak-hadir', 'POST'],
        ];

        foreach ($misses as [$uri, $method]) {
            try {
                Route::getRoutes()->match(Request::create($uri, $method));

                $this->fail("{$method} {$uri} tidak boleh cocok dengan route mana pun.");
            } catch (NotFoundHttpException) {
                $this->addToAssertionCount(1);
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_wrong_methods_answer_405_and_there_is_no_destroy(): void
    {
        $code = self::SAMPLE_CODE;

        $wrongMethod = [
            ['/admin/pasien/12', 'POST'],
            ['/admin/pasien/12', 'DELETE'],
            ['/admin/pasien/buat', 'PUT'],
            ['/admin/pasien/12/status', 'POST'],
            ['/admin/pasien/12/hubungkan-akun', 'GET'],
            ['/admin/pendaftaran/buat', 'POST'],
            ["/admin/pendaftaran/{$code}", 'POST'],
            ["/admin/pendaftaran/{$code}/status", 'GET'],
            ["/admin/pendaftaran/{$code}/bukti", 'POST'],
            ['/admin/antrean', 'POST'],
            ['/admin/antrean/7/tidak-hadir', 'GET'],
        ];

        foreach ($wrongMethod as [$uri, $method]) {
            try {
                Route::getRoutes()->match(Request::create($uri, $method));

                $this->fail("{$method} {$uri} tidak boleh cocok dengan route mana pun.");
            } catch (MethodNotAllowedHttpException) {
                $this->addToAssertionCount(1);
            }
        }

        $this->get('/admin/antrean/7/tidak-hadir')->assertStatus(405);
    }

    public function test_uris_use_indonesian_segments(): void
    {
        $code = self::SAMPLE_CODE;

        $this->assertSame('/admin/pasien', route('admin.patients.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/pasien/buat', route('admin.patients.create', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/pasien', route('admin.patients.store', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/pasien/12', route('admin.patients.show', ['patient' => 12], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/pasien/12/ubah', route('admin.patients.edit', ['patient' => 12], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/pasien/12', route('admin.patients.update', ['patient' => 12], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/pasien/12/status', route('admin.patients.status', ['patient' => 12], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/pasien/12/hubungkan-akun', route('admin.patients.link-account', ['patient' => 12], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/pendaftaran', route('admin.appointments.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/pendaftaran/buat', route('admin.appointments.create', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/pendaftaran', route('admin.appointments.store', [], false));
        $this->assertSame("/admin/pendaftaran/{$code}", route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $code], false));
        $this->assertSame("/admin/pendaftaran/{$code}/status", route('admin.appointments.transition', ['appointment' => $code], false));
        $this->assertSame("/admin/pendaftaran/{$code}/bukti", route('admin.appointments.proof', ['appointment' => $code], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/antrean', route('admin.queue.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/antrean/7/tidak-hadir', route('admin.queue.mark-no-show', ['session' => 7], false));
    }

    /**
     * Tidak ada route di luar cakupan 7a: tanpa `destroy` pasien/pendaftaran (BP 15 KNS-01), tanpa `edit`/`update`
     * pendaftaran (status hanya lewat `transition`), tanpa PDF admin, tanpa ekspor CSV (fase 8), dan tanpa layar
     * Sesi Terdampak (7b). 7b dan fase 8 memperbarui daftar ini.
     */
    public function test_no_route_of_phase_7b_or_8_or_a_destructive_route_exists_yet(): void
    {
        $absent = [
            'admin.patients.destroy', 'admin.appointments.destroy', 'admin.appointments.edit', 'admin.appointments.update',
            'admin.appointments.proof-pdf', 'admin.queue.show', 'admin.queue.store',
            'admin.appointments.export', 'admin.sessions.review', 'admin.sessions.resolve',
        ];

        foreach ($absent as $name) {
            $this->assertFalse(Route::has($name), "{$name} belum boleh ada di fase 7a.");
        }
    }

    /** KNS-03: fase 7a tidak menambah izin. */
    public function test_phase_7a_adds_no_permission_to_the_catalogue(): void
    {
        $this->assertCount(19, RolePermissionSeeder::PERMISSIONS);
    }

    /** Menu "Pelayanan Pasien" (05 §3.5): Petugas dan Super Admin melihat tiga item 7a (dan Pesan Kontak); Admin Konten dan tamu tidak. */
    public function test_the_patient_care_sidebar_group_follows_the_permissions(): void
    {
        $full = ['Pendaftaran', 'Antrean Hari Ini', 'Pasien', 'Pesan Kontak'];

        $this->assertSame($full, $this->careLabels($this->createStaff('registration-officer')));
        $this->assertSame($full, $this->careLabels($this->createStaff('super-admin')));
        $this->assertNull($this->careLabels($this->createStaff('content-admin')));
        $this->assertNull($this->careLabels(null));
    }

    /** @return list<string>|null */
    private function careLabels(?User $user): ?array
    {
        $group = collect(NavigationMenu::items('admin', $user))->firstWhere('group', 'Pelayanan Pasien');

        return $group === null ? null : array_column($group['items'], 'label');
    }
}
```

```php
    /**
     * AKS-01 sampai AKS-05 dengan peran kustom: pengguna yang HANYA memegang izin route itu lolos otorisasi, sedangkan pengguna
     * yang memegang ketiga izin lain (dari `patients.view|manage`, `appointments.view|manage`) mendapat 403. `view` tidak
     * mencakup `manage` dan sebaliknya.
     */
    #[DataProvider('phase7aPermissionSplit')]
    public function test_each_phase_7a_route_follows_only_its_own_permission(string $method, string $routeName, ?string $kind, string $permission): void
    {
        $this->seedRoles();

        $holder = User::factory()->staff()->create();
        $holder->givePermissionTo($permission);

        $others = User::factory()->staff()->create();
        $others->givePermissionTo(array_values(array_diff(['patients.view', 'patients.manage', 'appointments.view', 'appointments.manage'], [$permission])));

        $url = route($routeName, $this->parameters($kind));

        $this->actingAs($others)->{$method}($url)->assertForbidden();

        $allowed = $this->actingAs($holder)->{$method}($url);

        $this->assertAuthorized($allowed->getStatusCode(), (string) $allowed->headers->get('Location'));
    }

    /**
     * PAS-07 dan AKS-04: Admin Konten mendapat 403 di 16 route #37/#38 tanpa data pasien pada respons (route tanpa parameter
     * juga tidak mengueri tabel pasien), dan dashboard hanya menyapa tanpa nama, telepon, atau keluhan pasien.
     */
    public function test_pas_07_content_admin_gets_403_on_every_phase_7a_route_and_sees_no_patient_data(): void
    {
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00');

        $contentAdmin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->create(['full_name' => 'Nama Rahasia Pasien Uji', 'phone' => '081299990000']);
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($this->createSession(), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id, 'complaint' => 'Keluhan rahasia uji']);
        $secrets = ['Nama Rahasia Pasien Uji', '081299990000', 'Keluhan rahasia uji'];

        $this->actingAs($contentAdmin);

        foreach (self::phase7aPermissionSplit() as $label => [$method, $routeName, $kind]) {
            $parameters = match ($kind) {
                'patient' => ['patient' => $profile->id],
                'appointment' => ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code],
                'session' => ['session' => $appointment->practice_session_id],
                default => [],
            };

            DB::flushQueryLog();
            DB::enableQueryLog();

            $response = $this->{$method}(route($routeName, $parameters))->assertForbidden();

            foreach ($secrets as $secret) {
                $this->assertStringNotContainsString($secret, (string) $response->getContent(), "{$label}: {$secret}");
            }

            if ($kind === null) {
                foreach (DB::getQueryLog() as $entry) {
                    $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression(
                        '/\b(patient_profiles|appointments|appointment_status_histories)\b/',
                        $entry['query'],
                        "{$label} mengueri data pasien: {$entry['query']}",
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        DB::disableQueryLog();

        $dashboard = $this->get(route('admin.dashboard'))->assertOk();

        foreach ($secrets as $secret) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($secret, (string) $dashboard->getContent(), "dashboard: {$secret}");
        }
    }

    /** @return array<string, string> */
    private function publicRoomParameters(string $slug, string $name): array
```

```php
 * (a) tidak memuat payload mentah, (b) meng-escape nama bila ditampilkan, (c) tidak memuat nomor BPJS/polis lengkap,
 * (d) berstatus `no-store`, dan (e) tanpa atribut event inline. Lalu alur tulis lewat layar (profil, pendaftaran walk-in,
 * konfirmasi, hubungkan akun, status, tandai tidak hadir) tidak boleh meninggalkan nomor lengkap, keluhan, nama, atau telepon
 * di `audit_logs`, flash/sesi, atau `notifications`. Tes per layar (T5 sampai T10) tidak diulang; ini sapuan lintas layar.
 */
class Phase7aOutputSweepTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const HOSTILE = '<script>alert(1)</script>';

    private const ESCAPED = '&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;';

    private const BPJS = '0009900000044';

    private const BPJS_TYPED = '0009900000088';

    private const BPJS_ACCOUNT = '0009900000099';

    private const POLICY = 'POLIS-RAHASIA-98765432';

    private const COMPLAINT_MARK = 'KELUHAN-RAHASIA-SAPUAN';

    private const MORNING = '2026-10-05 07:00:00';

    private const AFTERNOON = '2026-10-05 13:00:00';

    private User $officer;

    private User $account;

    private PatientProfile $walkIn;

    private PracticeSession $session;

    private Appointment $bpjsAppointment;

    private Appointment $insuranceAppointment;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo(self::MORNING);

        $this->officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $this->session = $this->createSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);

        // Data lama dengan nama berbahaya (PersonName menolaknya di layar, jadi ditanam lewat factory).
        $this->walkIn = PatientProfile::factory()->withBpjs(self::BPJS)->create([
            'full_name' => self::HOSTILE,
            'address' => 'Jl. '.self::HOSTILE.' No. 9, Pamulang',
            'phone' => '081200000099',
            'email' => null,
        ]);

        $this->bpjsAppointment = $this->bookAppointment($this->session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, [
            'patient_profile_id' => $this->walkIn->id,
            'channel' => BookingChannel::Loket,
            'payment_type' => PaymentType::Bpjs,
            'payment_reference' => self::BPJS,
            'payment_reference_last4' => '0044',
            'complaint' => self::COMPLAINT_MARK.' '.self::HOSTILE,
        ]);

        $this->insuranceAppointment = $this->bookAppointment($this->session, AppointmentStatus::Pending, [
            'patient_profile_id' => PatientProfile::factory()->create(['full_name' => 'Asuransi '.self::HOSTILE])->id,
            'payment_type' => PaymentType::Asuransi,
            'insurance_partner_id' => $this->createInsurancePartner()->id,
            'payment_reference' => self::POLICY,
            'payment_reference_last4' => '5432',
        ]);

        // Akun online tanpa riwayat (kandidat hubungkan akun) dengan nama berbahaya.
        $this->account = $this->createPatient(['name' => 'Akun '.self::HOSTILE, 'email' => 'akun.sapuan@contoh.test']);

    /** @return array<string, array{string}> */
    public static function pages(): array
    {
        $keys = [
            'pasien: daftar', 'pasien: pencarian nama', 'pasien: pencarian berbahaya', 'pasien: detail',
            'pasien: panel hubungkan akun', 'pasien: panel dengan email berbahaya', 'pasien: ubah', 'pasien: tambah dengan kembali berbahaya',
            'pendaftaran: daftar', 'pendaftaran: pencarian nama', 'pendaftaran: pencarian berbahaya', 'pendaftaran: detail',
            'pendaftaran: detail dengan kembali berbahaya', 'pendaftaran: bukti',
            'walk-in: pasien terpilih', 'walk-in: pasien dan sesi terpilih', 'walk-in: pencarian nama', 'walk-in: pencarian berbahaya',
            'antrean: sesi', 'antrean: kode', 'antrean: kode berbahaya', 'antrean: sesudah sesi berakhir',
        ];

        return array_combine($keys, array_map(fn (string $key): array => [$key], $keys));
    }

    /**
     * URL, apakah nama berbahaya HARUS tampil ter-escape, dan waktu bekunya.
     *
     * @return array{string, bool, string}
     */
    private function target(string $key): array
    {
        $code = $this->bpjsAppointment->booking_code;
        $day = ['tanggal' => '2026-10-05'];
        $range = ['dari' => '2026-10-05', 'sampai' => '2026-10-05'];

        return match ($key) {
            'pasien: daftar' => [route('admin.patients.index'), true, self::MORNING],
            'pasien: pencarian nama' => [route('admin.patients.index', ['q' => 'script']), true, self::MORNING],
            'pasien: pencarian berbahaya' => [route('admin.patients.index', ['q' => self::HOSTILE]), false, self::MORNING],
            'pasien: detail' => [route('admin.patients.show', $this->walkIn), true, self::MORNING],
            'pasien: panel hubungkan akun' => [route('admin.patients.show', ['patient' => $this->walkIn, 'hubungkan' => $this->account->email]), true, self::MORNING],
            'pasien: panel dengan email berbahaya' => [route('admin.patients.show', ['patient' => $this->walkIn, 'hubungkan' => self::HOSTILE]), true, self::MORNING],
            'pasien: ubah' => [route('admin.patients.edit', $this->walkIn), true, self::MORNING],
            'pasien: tambah dengan kembali berbahaya' => [route('admin.patients.create', ['kembali' => '"><script>alert(1)</script>']), false, self::MORNING],
            'pendaftaran: daftar' => [route('admin.appointments.index', $range), true, self::MORNING],
            'pendaftaran: pencarian nama' => [route('admin.appointments.index', $range + ['q' => 'script']), true, self::MORNING],
            'pendaftaran: pencarian berbahaya' => [route('admin.appointments.index', $range + ['q' => self::HOSTILE]), false, self::MORNING],
            'pendaftaran: detail' => [route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $code]), true, self::MORNING],
            'pendaftaran: detail dengan kembali berbahaya' => [route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $code, 'kembali' => '//evil.test"><script>alert(1)</script>']), true, self::MORNING],
            'pendaftaran: bukti' => [route('admin.appointments.proof', ['appointment' => $code]), true, self::MORNING],
            'walk-in: pasien terpilih' => [route('admin.appointments.create', ['pasien' => $this->walkIn->id]), true, self::MORNING],
            'walk-in: pasien dan sesi terpilih' => [route('admin.appointments.create', ['pasien' => $this->walkIn->id, 'sesi' => $this->session->id]), true, self::MORNING],
            'walk-in: pencarian nama' => [route('admin.appointments.create', ['cari' => 'script']), true, self::MORNING],
            'walk-in: pencarian berbahaya' => [route('admin.appointments.create', ['cari' => self::HOSTILE]), false, self::MORNING],
            'antrean: sesi' => [route('admin.queue.index', $day + ['sesi' => $this->session->id]), true, self::MORNING],
            'antrean: kode' => [route('admin.queue.index', $day + ['kode' => $code]), true, self::MORNING],
            'antrean: kode berbahaya' => [route('admin.queue.index', $day + ['kode' => self::HOSTILE]), false, self::MORNING],
            'antrean: sesudah sesi berakhir' => [route('admin.queue.index', $day + ['sesi' => $this->session->id]), true, self::AFTERNOON],
        };
    }

    #[DataProvider('pages')]
    public function test_every_phase_7a_page_escapes_hostile_values_and_never_shows_full_numbers(string $key): void
    {
        [$url, $expectsName, $time] = $this->target($key);

        $this->travelTo($time);

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->officer)->get($url)->assertOk();
        $html = (string) $response->getContent();

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script>alert(1)', $html, "{$key}: payload mentah di HTML.");

        if ($expectsName) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString(self::ESCAPED, $html, "{$key}: nama berbahaya harus tampil ter-escape.");
        }

        foreach ([self::BPJS, '000990000', self::POLICY, 'POLIS-RAHASIA'] as $secret) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($secret, $html, "{$key}: nomor lengkap {$secret} tampil.");
        }

        $this->assertStringContainsString('no-store', (string) $response->headers->get('Cache-Control'), "{$key}: halaman data pribadi harus no-store.");
        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/\son[a-z]{3,}\s*=\s*["\']/i', $html), "{$key}: atribut event inline.");
    }

    /** SEK-12: nomor tampil hanya sebagai `•••••••••` + 4 digit terakhir di detail pasien, detail pendaftaran, dan bukti admin. */
    public function test_numbers_are_masked_to_the_last_four_digits_on_the_detail_pages(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->officer);

        $this->get(route('admin.patients.show', $this->walkIn))->assertOk()->assertSee('•••••••••0044', false);
        $this->get(route('admin.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $this->bpjsAppointment->booking_code]))->assertOk()->assertSee('•••••••••0044', false);

        foreach (['admin.appointments.show', 'admin.appointments.proof'] as $name) {
            $this->get(route($name, ['appointment' => $this->insuranceAppointment->booking_code]))->assertOk()->assertSee('•••••••••5432', false);
        }
    }

    /**
     * SEK-11 dan Review Focus E.4: alur tulis lewat layar (profil baru, pendaftaran BPJS walk-in dengan keluhan dan simpan nomor,
     * konfirmasi, hubungkan akun, nonaktifkan, tandai tidak hadir) tidak meninggalkan nomor lengkap, keluhan, nama, telepon, atau
     * email akun di audit, flash/sesi, atau notifikasi.
     */
    public function test_audit_rows_flash_data_and_notifications_written_by_the_screens_hold_no_sensitive_values(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->officer);

        // 1. Profil walk-in baru (patient.created); alamat memuat payload.
        $this->post(route('admin.patients.store'), [
            'full_name' => 'Sapuan Uji',
            'birth_date' => '1990-03-12',
            'gender' => 'P',
            'phone' => '0812-0000-0077',
            'email' => '',
            'address' => 'Jl. '.self::HOSTILE.' No. 7, Pamulang',
            'verbal_consent' => '1',
        ])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $created = PatientProfile::query()->where('full_name', 'Sapuan Uji')->sole();

        // 2. Pendaftaran walk-in BPJS dengan keluhan; nomor disimpan ke profil (appointment.created dan patient.updated).
        $this->post(route('admin.appointments.store'), [
            'patient_profile_id' => (string) $created->id,
            'practice_session_id' => (string) $this->session->id,
            'payment_type' => 'bpjs',
            'bpjs_number' => self::BPJS_TYPED,
            'save_bpjs' => '1',
            'complaint' => self::COMPLAINT_MARK.' '.self::HOSTILE,
        ])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(self::BPJS_TYPED, json_encode(session()->all(), JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), 'Nomor BPJS tersimpan di flash/sesi.');

        // 3. Konfirmasi pendaftaran pasien berakun (appointment.status_changed dan notifikasi database).
        $owner = $this->createPatient();
        $pending = $this->bookAppointment($this->session, AppointmentStatus::Pending, [
            'patient_profile_id' => $owner->patientProfile->id,
            'payment_type' => PaymentType::Bpjs,
            'payment_reference' => self::BPJS_ACCOUNT,
            'payment_reference_last4' => '0099',
            'complaint' => self::COMPLAINT_MARK.' '.self::HOSTILE,
        ]);

        $this->post(route('admin.appointments.transition', ['appointment' => $pending->booking_code]), ['to' => 'confirmed', 'expected_status' => 'pending'])
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertSame(1, $owner->notifications()->count(), 'Pasien berakun harus menerima satu notifikasi.');

        // 4. Hubungkan profil walk-in ke akun online tanpa riwayat (patient.account_linked).
        $this->post(route('admin.patients.link-account', $created), ['account_email' => $this->account->email, 'identity_verified' => '1'])
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertSame($this->account->id, $created->fresh()->user_id);

        // 5. Nonaktifkan profil tanpa pendaftaran aktif (patient.status_changed).
        $spare = PatientProfile::factory()->create();

        $this->patch(route('admin.patients.status', $spare), ['is_active' => '0', 'reason' => 'Data ganda terdeteksi saat verifikasi'])
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        // 6. Tandai tidak hadir sesudah sesi berakhir.
        $this->travelTo(self::AFTERNOON);

        $this->post(route('admin.queue.mark-no-show', ['session' => $this->session->id]), ['confirm' => '1'])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertSame(4, Appointment::query()->where('status', AppointmentStatus::NoShow)->count());

        $actions = AuditLog::query()->pluck('action')->all();

        foreach (['patient.created', 'appointment.created', 'patient.updated', 'appointment.status_changed', 'patient.account_linked', 'patient.status_changed'] as $action) {
            $this->assertContains($action, $actions, "Audit {$action} tidak tercatat (tes ini tidak boleh kosong).");
        }

        $forbidden = [
            'alert(1)', self::COMPLAINT_MARK, self::BPJS, self::BPJS_TYPED, self::BPJS_ACCOUNT,
            '0812-0000-0077', '081200000077', 'Sapuan Uji', $this->account->email,
        ];

        $audit = json_encode(DB::table('audit_logs')->get()->all(), JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        $notifications = json_encode(DB::table('notifications')->pluck('data')->all(), JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        $this->assertNotSame('[]', $notifications);

        foreach ($forbidden as $fragment) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($fragment, $audit, "audit_logs memuat {$fragment}.");
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($fragment, $notifications, "notifications memuat {$fragment}.");
        }
    }
}
```

```php
    private function phase7aViews(): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter($this->viewFiles(), fn (string $file): bool => str_contains($this->relative($file), 'admin/patients/')
            || str_contains($this->relative($file), 'admin/appointments/')
            || str_contains($this->relative($file), 'admin/queue/')
            || str_contains($this->relative($file), 'partials/appointment-proof')));
    }

    /** SEK-15 (statis): view admin 7a tanpa `<script`, `javascript:`, atribut event inline, atau `{!!`; QR bukti hanya sebagai `<img>`. */
    public function test_phase_7a_views_have_no_inline_script_event_handler_javascript_url_or_raw_output(): void
    {
        $files = $this->phase7aViews();

        // patients 7 + appointments 8 + queue 1 + partial bukti 1 (kerangka D).
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(17, count($files));

        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $source = (string) file_get_contents($file);
            $name = $this->relative($file);

            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script', $source, $name);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('javascript:', $source, $name);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('{!!', $source, $name);
            $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/\son[a-z]{3,}\s*=\s*["\']/i', $source), $name);

            if (preg_match('/qr/i', $source) === 1) {
                $this->assertStringContainsString('<img', $source, $name);
                $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<svg', $source, $name);
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_gallery_carousel_instance_is_created_eagerly_with_keyboard_support(): void
```

Ini menutup carry D-165 untuk arsip dokter vs booking; carry `ScheduleChangeService::applyException` vs booking tidak dicakup 7a (invarian data tetap benar). | 11 §6.17, D-165 (F7A-R25, R26) |

Tes (grup `concurrency`, pola D-165): dua petugas menekan Tandai tidak hadir pada sesi yang sama (total tepat N, satu riwayat dan satu audit per appointment); Tandai tidak hadir melawan pembatalan petugas pada appointment yang sama (tepat satu final, pencacah konsisten); walk-in petugas melawan booking online berebut kursi terakhir (satu sukses, satu `QUOTA_FULL`); dua petugas menghubungkan profil walk-in yang sama ke dua akun (satu sukses, satu `PROFILE_ALREADY_LINKED`); tes carry arsip dokter vs booking diperbarui (hasil sah `archived` atau `rejected`). "Tandai tidak hadir massal vs check-in" TIDAK diuji karena jendela keduanya tidak beririsan (check-in ditutup pada `end_time`, tidak hadir hanya sesudahnya). | 15 §6, 14 Fase 7a (F7A-R27) |

```markdown
#### Fase 7b — Sesi Terdampak dan Pemberitahuan Lintas Peran

**Tujuan.** Petugas dan Admin Konten dapat menyelesaikan sesi yang terdampak perubahan jadwal dan melihat pemberitahuannya.

**Keluaran.**
- Halaman: layar **tinjau sesi terdampak** (`admin.sessions.review` + `resolve`, bagian dari #35).
- Fitur: F-ADM-08, F-SYS-06 (resolusi), F-SYS-19 (notifikasi perubahan jadwal).
- Kelas: resolusi sesi pada `ScheduleChangeService` (`keep`, `apply`, `cancel`), `AppointmentStatusService::cancelAllForSession()`, `PracticeSessionPolicy::review()` dan `resolve()`.

**Dependensi.** Fase 7a.

**Tugas utama (berurutan).**
1. Layar sesi terdampak: tampilkan keenam sumber (`exception`, `template_time`, `template_removed`, `manual_time`, `manual_cancel`, `doctor_inactive`) dan pilihan sah per sumber (`allowedResolutions()`; `keep` untuk `doctor_inactive` hanya bila dokter aktif kembali); `apply` memberi `schedule_changed_at` dan notifikasi; `cancel` membatalkan appointment aktif dengan alasan wajib; peringatan benturan jam pasien.
2. Pemberitahuan lintas peran: Admin Konten melihat "N sesi perlu ditindaklanjuti"; petugas melihat daftar.
3. Bawaan fase 3 untuk layar sesi terdampak (carry fase 3).

**Keputusan terkait (17).** K-15 (pelacakan "sudah dihubungi" pasien walk-in: default (a), tidak ada), K-13 (notifikasi perubahan jadwal).

**Kriteria keluar.**
- `JDW-11` (resolusi `keep`/`apply`/`cancel` per sumber), `NTF-06`, `NTF-07` (sisi resolusi `apply`), dan `AKS-03`–`AKS-05` untuk layar sesi terdampak.
- Setelah resolusi `cancel`, `booked_count` sesi = jumlah appointment non-batal (invarian I1 di [13 §11](13-data-contoh.md#11-invarian-setelah-seeding-dan-cara-memeriksanya)).

**Risiko dan mitigasi.**

| Risiko | Mitigasi |
|---|---|
| Resolusi sesi massal melanggar urutan kunci → deadlock | Gunakan satu jalur kode `AppointmentStatusService` dengan urutan kunci baku; tes konkurensi tambahan |
```

````markdown
## Fase 7a — Pasien, walk-in, pendaftaran, dan antrean (layar petugas)

Yang tersedia (Super Admin dan Petugas Pendaftaran; Admin Konten tidak punya akses):
- **Pasien (#37)** di <http://unpam-hospital.test/admin/pasien>: daftar dengan satu kotak pencarian (nama, nomor pasien `P000012`, telepon, atau tanggal lahir `dd/mm/yyyy`) dan filter kanal serta status; detail dengan nomor BPJS tersamar dan riwayat pendaftaran; **tambah profil walk-in** (persetujuan privasi lisan wajib dicentang; tanpa NIK dan tanpa nomor BPJS di form; profil yang mirip ditampilkan dulu); **ubah**; **nonaktifkan atau aktifkan** (ditolak bila pasien masih punya pendaftaran aktif; profil berakun ikut menonaktifkan akunnya); dan **hubungkan profil walk-in ke akun online** dalam dua langkah: masukkan email akun di panel `?hubungkan=`, periksa perbandingan nama, tanggal lahir, dan telepon, centang verifikasi identitas di loket, lalu hubungkan (hanya bila akun belum punya riwayat pendaftaran).
- **Pendaftaran (#38)** di `/admin/pendaftaran`: daftar dengan filter tanggal kunjungan (bawaan hari ini), poliklinik, dokter, status, kanal, dan pencarian kode booking, nomor pasien, atau nama; detail dengan tombol status yang selalu sama dengan aturan server (konfirmasi, check-in, selesai, batal dengan alasan, koreksi check-in; check-in yang belum dibuka tampil nonaktif dengan jam bukanya); **bukti pendaftaran** versi cetak untuk petugas (tanpa PDF); dan **walk-in** di `/admin/pendaftaran/buat` dalam tiga bagian (pasien, sesi, data pembayaran). Sesi yang pendaftaran online-nya sudah ditutup tetap dapat dipilih petugas sampai jam selesai sesi.
- **Antrean Hari Ini** di `/admin/antrean`: pilih tanggal, poliklinik, dokter, dan sesi; cari atau pindai kode booking (baris disorot, tidak mengubah status); aksi per baris; ringkasan terisi dan jumlah per status; dan **Tandai tidak hadir** untuk seluruh pendaftaran Menunggu atau Dikonfirmasi setelah sesi berakhir (dengan daftar dan konfirmasi). Halaman tidak diperbarui otomatis: gunakan "Muat ulang".
- **Tidak hadir otomatis**: `appointments:mark-no-show` (opsi `--date=YYYY-MM-DD`) berjalan harian pukul 23.30 lewat scheduler dan menandai pendaftaran Menunggu atau Dikonfirmasi pada sesi yang sudah berakhir.
- Menu **Pelayanan Pasien** memuat Pendaftaran, Antrean Hari Ini, dan Pasien; halaman pendaftaran dan antrean memakai tab modul yang sama.

### Hak akses

| Peran | Lihat pasien dan pendaftaran (`patients.view`, `appointments.view`) | Kelola: walk-in, ubah, status, hubungkan akun, transisi, tidak hadir (`patients.manage`, `appointments.manage`) |
|---|:-:|:-:|
| Super Admin | ya | ya |
| Admin Konten | tidak (403) | tidak (403) |
| Petugas Pendaftaran | ya | ya |

Peran kustom dapat diberi izin lihat saja: tombol dan form kelola tidak tampil dan permintaan tulis ditolak 403. Ekspor CSV pendaftaran menyusul di fase 8; layar Sesi Terdampak dan notifikasi jadwal berubah di fase 7b.

### Mencoba di lokal

Data demo fase 7a memerlukan DB baru (`& $PHP artisan migrate:fresh --seed`, lokal saja; menghapus semua tabel `unpam_hospital`). Seeder menambah enam profil walk-in (P000008–P000013), 29 pendaftaran contoh dengan semua status (dibuat lewat service dengan jam semu, termasuk riwayat dan notifikasi), sesi 14 hari ke belakang, dan satu pengecualian "Cuti mendadak (contoh)". Masuk sebagai `pendaftaran@unpamhospital.test` (password `Demo12345`) di <http://unpam-hospital.test/admin/login>. Pasangan uji hubungkan akun: profil walk-in "Mulyani Astuti" (P000012, sudah punya pendaftaran) dengan akun `mulyani.astuti@contoh.test` (profil kosong P000007): buka detail P000012, tekan "Hubungkan ke akun online", dan masukkan email itu. Untuk melihat tombol Tandai tidak hadir, buka antrean sesi hari ini yang waktunya sudah lewat, atau jalankan perintah berikut untuk kemarin:

```powershell
& $PHP artisan appointments:mark-no-show --date=2026-10-08   # ganti dengan tanggal kemarin; keluaran per sesi dan ringkasan
```

Pemeriksaan data demo (17 invarian, kolom `pelanggaran` harus 0 semua; pengguna `unpam_app`; password diminta dan diambil dari `DB_PASSWORD` di `.env`):

```powershell
& "$XAMPP\mysql\bin\mysql.exe" -h 127.0.0.1 -u unpam_app -p unpam_hospital -e "source scripts/sql/seed-invariants.sql"
```

### Keterbatasan fase 7a

- Layar Sesi Terdampak, resolusi `keep`/`apply`/`cancel`, dan notifikasi "jadwal berubah" menyusul di fase 7b. Sesi yang menunggu penyelesaian ditolak untuk aksi petugas dengan pesan "Sesi ini sedang menunggu penyelesaian di layar Sesi terdampak." dan tidak diproses perintah tidak hadir.
- Notifikasi tetap dikirim sinkron sesudah transaksi (tanpa antrean Laravel), sama dengan fase 6.
- Seeding saat tidak ada sesi hari ini sama sekali (misalnya Minggu malam) melewatkan pendaftaran contoh A13–A16 dengan peringatan, sehingga jumlah pendaftaran contoh menjadi 25, bukan 29; angka acuan 13 §10.3 persis dijamin hanya bila di-seed pada hari Senin pagi (dikunci tes); pada hari lain periksa 17 invarian dan bahwa jumlah per status sama dengan jumlah pendaftaran.
- Form profil admin tidak memuat nomor BPJS: nomor tersimpan lewat pendaftaran walk-in ("Simpan nomor BPJS ke profil pasien") atau diisi pasien sendiri. Email profil yang sudah berakun ditampilkan hanya-baca.
- Penggabungan dua profil yang sama-sama punya riwayat dan pelepasan tautan akun belum didukung; hubungkan akun hanya untuk akun tanpa riwayat pendaftaran dan profil walk-in yang aktif.
- Tandai tidak hadir bukan satu transaksi: setiap pendaftaran diproses sendiri. Bila sistem sibuk, proses berhenti dan pesan meminta mengulang; mengulang aman karena yang sudah ditandai tidak diproses lagi.
- Antrean tidak diperbarui otomatis, dan pindai kode booking hanya menemukan dan menyorot baris.
- Kunci kirim ganda walk-in memakai `Cache::lock`; dengan `CACHE_STORE=array` hanya berlaku dalam satu proses, sedangkan kunci database tetap melindungi dari pendaftaran ganda.

### Aturan keamanan yang berlaku

Semua layar #37 dan #38 menjawab 403 bagi pasien dan Admin Konten dan mengalihkan tamu ke `/admin/login`; Admin Konten tidak pernah menerima data pasien. Nomor BPJS dan polis hanya tampil sebagai `•••••••••` dan empat digit terakhir (tanpa aksi "tampilkan lengkap") dan tidak masuk flash, data formulir yang dipulihkan, audit, notifikasi, atau log; keluhan tidak masuk audit atau notifikasi. Nama pasien, alamat, dan keluhan selalu di-escape. Tombol status mengikuti aturan server dan halaman yang basi ditolak tanpa menulis apa pun. Parameter `kembali` hanya dapat menunjuk ke `/admin/pendaftaran` atau `/admin/antrean` (dan form walk-in), tidak pernah ke situs lain. Pendaftaran di URL admin memakai kode booking (`UPH-XXXX-XXXX`), bukan id. Log galat basis data ditulis tanpa nilai parameter.

```powershell
````
```powershell
$XAMPP = "C:\xampp3"; $PHP = "$XAMPP\php\php.exe"; $COMPOSER = "C:\composer\composer.phar"; $APP = "D:\Project Web RS"; $env:Path = "$XAMPP\php;$env:Path"; Set-Location $APP
```

```powershell
& $PHP artisan migrate:status | Select-String -Pattern 'Pending'

& "$XAMPP\mysql\bin\mysql.exe" -h 127.0.0.1 -P 3306 -u unpam_app "--password=$pw" unpam_hospital --batch -e "SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS jumlah FROM appointments GROUP BY status ORDER BY status; SELECT COUNT(*) AS profil, SUM(registration_channel = 'loket') AS loket FROM patient_profiles; SELECT COUNT(*) AS riwayat FROM appointment_status_histories; SELECT SUM(booked_count) AS terisi FROM practice_sessions; SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS jumlah FROM practice_sessions WHERE status IN ('needs_review','closed') GROUP BY status;"
$kemarin = (Get-Date).AddDays(-1).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
& $PHP artisan appointments:mark-no-show --date=$kemarin
"kode keluar: $LASTEXITCODE"
& $PHP artisan appointments:mark-no-show --date=2099-01-01
"kode keluar: $LASTEXITCODE"
& $PHP artisan appointments:mark-no-show --date=besok
"kode keluar: $LASTEXITCODE"
& $PHP artisan schedule:list
& $PHP artisan media:prune --dry-run
```
